tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 1 'dzam gling gna' rabs lo rgyus kyi gtam rgyud/

tei:div.tei:p: byaḥ/bka'agu/ //spya chi/hā sdu 77/mesbya 'jiciXng060jib jing 505533 7 bci kho zhugaX 50 yokhog
'bring rimaslobama'i klogadebanorabu'ibang mdzod/
'bringarimaslobara'iXsadebarorabu'ibangamajong

dkar chagasger dbang lam lugs ni thog ma nas yod pa zhig ma yin/wa wazhor du ya thog spyi tshogs la ngos 'dzin byed tshul brjod pa/ (1)gna' bo'i e jib kyi nyi rtsis dang spyi lo byung tshul/ (12)gtor gzugs mchod rten dang spur skam/ (21)i khe nā thon gyi bcos bsgyur dang pham kha/ (32)gna' mi'i dpe cha ste/ so phag dang shog rtsukhug lpags dang smyug leb/ (42)gna' bo'i sba sbe lon gyi ka zlum khrims yig/ (54)'dzam gling gi lo rgyus snyan rtsom snga shos ste 〈〈rjel sga sme sa〉〉/ (65)rigs rgyud lam lugs dang bram ze'i chos lugs/ (75)zas gtsang rgyal sras sangs rgyas tshul/ (85)tsa rlabs che ba'i sil tshong rgyag mkhan h+phe ne khe a'i mi/ (93)gna' bo'i rje'u yi mi'i mngon shes pa'i las 'gul ’ (103)rgyal po rdi re si zhes pa si khi the'i yul du rgyang skyod byas pa/ (115)e rjen rgya mtsho'i shes rig rnyed tshul/ (125)drag rtsal la spro ba'i rgyal khams si phar tha/ (135)gna' rabs ghi ri si'i bcos bsgyur mkhan dam pa so lon/ (146)mi ser dkyus ma'i gtso 'dzin phe si thi ra tho si/ (157)rang dbang dang rang btsan srung ba'i ma ra sung dmag 'khrug (170)dpa' ngar ldan zhing yid skyo brjid nyams che pa'i chu tshan 'gag gi 1

dmag 'khrug (179)phe ri khi le si dang a then gyi dmangs gtso/ (189)gna' rabs kyi o lim phig lus rtsal 'gran tshogs/ (198)gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i lha sgrung gnyis/ (207)lo rgyus rig pa'i srol gtod mkhan he ro rdo thu si/ (217)chang lha'i dus chen skabs/wa waghi ri si'i zlos gar gyi 'byung khungs/ (226)a then gyi mkhar rdzong la lta skor byed pa/ (234)phe la tho dang khong gi〈phugs re'i rgyal khab〉 (242)kun shes mkhas pa chen po a ri si tho the le si (253)sme se rdon gyi rgyal po e legs gzan rdar/ (264)ar khi smi sde si yi gtam rgyud/ (276)bar snang gi skyed mos tshal dang nyi lha'i sku 'dra/ sgron stegs/ (286)rom gyi 'byung khungs/ (298)ngang bas rom bskyabs pa/ (308)khe gyong go ldog pa'i phe ro si'i rgyal kha/ (315)han ne+e sbal gyis rom zil gyis mnan pa/wa wapho ni'i dmag 'khrug gnyis pa/ (324)khi ra khu phu nu gnyis kyi bsgyur bcos/ (335)'dzing res pa si phar tha khu si/ (347)gong ma chen po se gzir bkrongs pa/ (359)o tha we'u si yis rgyal po'i lam lugs btsugs pa/ (369)ne+e ro yi srid dbang gdug rtsub can/ (379)snga /bas kyi ye shu'i chos lugs/ (388)

sger dbangalam lugs ni thog mgasald pa ga ma'an/wa wazhor du ya thog spyi tshogs la ngos 'dzin byed tshul brjod pa/son hran/khyod kyis mi'i rigs lo rgyus kyi dus yun ji 'dra ring ba shes sam/ lo bcu phrag du ma'i ring gi gna' rdzas brtag dpyad las byung ba'i rgyu cha dang /lhag par 'gyur rdo mi'i rigs rig pas mkho sprod byas pa'i yig cha ltar na/mi'i lo rgyus la phal cher lo ngo sa ya gsum yas mas zhig yod ces brjod chogayin na yang mi'i rigs spyi tshogs su sger dbang lam lugs dang gral rim 'brel ba byung nas ches mang ba'i dbang du btang na'ang lo ngo stong lnga nas stong drug las 'gor med la/ ha lam mi'i rigs kyis brgyud zin pa'i lo rgyus dus yun yongs kyi lnga brgya cha'i gcig gam drug brgya cha'i gcig tsam las zin med/gal te 'das zin pa'i mi'i rigs lo rgyus kyi spyi'i ring tshad lo gcig yin pa'i dbang du btang na/ mi'i rigs spyi tshogs sger dbang lam lugs dang gral rim spyi tshogs la zhugs pa'i lo rgyuso dus yun ni nyin gcig tsam las med/yin yang / mi'i rigs kyis rang nyid tsho'i byis dus te ya thog spyi tshogs la rgyusacan byas pa nyung zhing / de'i rkyen gtso bo zhig ni ya thog gi mi la yi ge med gshes/ kho tshos phyi rabs pa ltar rang nyid kyi lo rgyus thad gar yig thog tu 'god thabs bral/ deng sang yi ge'i lam nas bris pa'am spel ba'i ya thog gi mi'i gnas tshul sna tshogs ni mi gzhan pas kha snon legs sgrig byas te shu/sa

nas nga tshor bstan pa ma yin pa ni gcig kyang med ces bshad choga'o na mi rnams la ya thog spyi tshogs skor gyi shes bya gang nas thob 'ongs pa yin zhe na/ gtso bo ni gna' rdzas brtag dpyad rig pa dang mi'i rigs rig pa/ mi rigs rig pa sogs ched las rig gzhung tshan khag rab dang rim par brten nas byung ba red/ ches dka' tshegs che ba ni gna' rdzas brtag dpyad rig pa tsho las ma 'das te/ kho tshos sa stong lung stong du sa rko rdo slog gis gna' rdzas sngog 'don byas pa las/ ya thog gi mi'i thon skyed dang 'tsho ba rol ba'i skor gyi dngos rdzas dang rjes shul sna tshogs yang bskyar nga tsho'i mthong lam du bstar ba red/ 'on kyang gna' rdzas brtag dpyad kyi bya ba la stes dbang rang bzhin gyi tshad bkag thebs kyi yod de/ gna' rdzas brtag dpyad rig pa ba tshor rin thang ldan pa'i('dir gna' rdzas brtag dpyad rig pa'i thad kyi rin thang las dngos rdzas de'i rin gong bstan pa min)sa thon dngosaljas thob min ni tshad nges can zhig gi steng nas rlung rta rgyug min la rag las/ las btsog pa'i gna' rdzas brtag dpyad ru khag gis bya ba lo mang bsgrubs kyang grub 'bras ci yang mi thob pa'ang yod/ gna' rdzas brtag dpyad rig pa ba'i lag la rin thang ldan pa'i sa thon dngos rdzas shig rnyed tshe kho tsho'i dga' spro ni brjod thabs bral ba zhig yin/ gna' rdzas brtag dpyad kyi shul rdzas dag ni srog med dngos po yin pa smos med yin khar/ la la 'gyur rdor gyur tshar ba'i gnas tshul byung tsa na/ shes ldan pa rnams kyis ched las sna tshogs kyi shes bya bed spyad nas gsal 'byed byed dgos shing / yang dag pa'i gsal 'byed kho nas gnad don gsal bshad byed thub/ 'on kyang de ni las sla bo zhig ga la yin te/ mi'i rigs kyi 'gyur rdo gcig la dpe bzhag na de ga sa gshes lo tshod gang du gnas pa tsam la mtshon na'ang / lan reswā dus khyad gong( 'og gnyis kyi bar la lo khri phrag gam 'bum phrag gi bar

khyad 'byung srid/ gna' rdzas brtag dpyad rig pa ba tshos gna' rdzas(rdzas dngos ma)dang gna' shul(shul bzhag rjes)sna tshogs la 'grel bshad rgyag pa'i thad du/ mi sum cur bsam pa sum cu dang mdzo sum cur rwa kha drug cu'i tshul du song nas rang 'dod mkhregs 'dzin gyi shas che/ de yang gna' rdzas brtag dpyad rig pa'i sngar yod skyon cha 'di rigs la kha gsab byed thabs e yod ce na/ yod de/ de ni mi rigs rig pa(mi rgyud rig pa zhes kyang zer)red/ nga tshos shes gsal ltar na/ mi'i rigs spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas ni do mnyam pa zhig min te/ sa khams dang lo rgyus bye brag pa sogs phyogs gang ci'i cha rkyen mi 'dra ba'i rkyen gyis/ 'dzam gling steng gi mi rigs so so'i 'phel rgyas la dal mgyogs rang shugs kyis byung yod pa red/ la la zhig lo stong phrag du ma'i sngon nas gral rim spyi tshogs su bar brgal byas pa ma zad rgyal khab dang srid dbang btsugs yod/ la la zhig dus rabs bco brgyad pa dang bcu dgu bar/ sa cha la lar tha na da lta'i bar/ gzhan yang mi rigs rjes lus nyung shas shig da dung sngar bzhin ya thog sbyi tshogs su gnas yod/6 spyi tshogs kyi 'gyur rdo ru 'bod pa 'di rigs kyis nga tshor bskal ba ya thog spyi tshogs kyi bsdus ris gson po zhig mkho sprod byed thub/ a me ri ku'i mi rigs rig pa ba le'u si hon ri mor rgan(60 1350077 5༷ rtsa ba1818—1881 skyalo stos/sgo77)zhes pa des en rdi an gzhis sdod yul mi'i spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i goms srol la rgyus lon bya ched sa de'i yul mi tsho dang 'tsho ba mnyam rol byas pa ma zad/ tsho ba zhig gi bu dod kyang byas/ khos lo bcu phrag 'ga'i brtag dpyad zhib 'jug dang dpyad gzhi yig cha gzhan pa phyogs bsdu byas nas〈〈gna' rabs spyi tshogs〉〉(1877lor)zhes pa'i brtsams chos grags can de bcoms nas/ ya thog spyi tshogs lo rgyus kyi zhib 'jug de rim pa gsar ba zhig tu brtags/ mar khe si dang en ke si gnyis kyis por /na

gyi grub 'bras la gdeng 'jog mthon po mdzad yod la/ en ke si'i〈〈khyim tshang / sger dbang lam lugs dang rgyal khab kyi byung ba〉〉(1884lor)zhes pa ni grub 'bras 'di'i rmang gzhi'i steng nas bris pa zhig yin/ rig gzhung las rigs kyis gna' rdzas brtag dpyad rig pa dang mi rigs rig pa'i dpyad gzhi zung 'brel byas pa'i stong du/ ram 'desas byed nus can gyi rig gzhung tshan khag gzhan pa bsnan na da gzod ya thog spyi tshogs la rgyus lon legs po zhig byed thub pa'i bzhed pa 'dzin/ya thog spyi tshogs ni mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs dpal 'byor gyi rnam pa dang po yin zhing / de la rjes su byung ba'i bran g.yog lam lugs dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs/ ma rtsa ring lugs sogs dang mi 'dra ba'i spyi tshogs dpal 'byor rnam pa'i khyad chos yod/ des na ya thog spyi tshogs kyi khyad chos gtso bo gang yin zhe na/ de ni sger dbang lam lugs zhes pa ci yin pa rbad de mi shes pa de yin la/ tag tag khyad chos 'dis ya thog spyi tshogs su mis mir bshu gzhog byed pa'i gral rim 'brel ba med pa thag gcod byas/skabs der rgyal po med la blon po'ang med/ zhing bdag med la ma rtsa can yang med par/ mi rnams 'dra mnyam sgos rus rgyud dang tsho ba'i nang du 'tsho ba rol/ ya thog gi gung khran ring lugs 'di rigs ni gral rim spyi tshogs chags nas dus yun ring bo 'gor rjes da dung mi rnams kyi dran pa'i ngos su rab rib tu lus yod/ 'dzam gling steng gi mi rigs mang po zhig la kho tsho rang nyid kyi ya thog dus skabs kyi ngag rgyun sna tshogs rgyun 'byams su song yod pa dang la las rtsom rig brtsams chos su'ang bris yod de/ dper na/ si phen(3bgrab po skya)gyi rtsom pa po ser wan the sis(516501 60 0075 ba 03byal slong (77)mdzad pa'i brtsams chos grags can〈rtsartsam 〉〈〈snang ci khe thu'u〉〉yi le'u bcu gcig par/ thang ci khe thu'u yis phyugs rdzi la

ya thog spyi tshogs skor gyi gtam gleng mtshar po mang po byas yod/ kho na re/skabs de ni ca rdzogs ldan gyi dus skabs shig ste/ dngos po tshang ma spyi la dbang zhing / 6 khyod kyi dang 6 nga yi 7dbye ba med/ tha na tshig 'di dag gi bstan don ci yin yang mi shes/ ltogs dus shing sdong las zhim mngar shing 'bras mang po btogs nas kha la za zhing / skom tshe dwangs shing gtsang ba'i 'dzad med chu mig 'thung / zol med gzhung drang gi brtse dung ni pho mo'i bar gyi sbrel thag tu gyur la/ mi tshos 6 tshangs ma zhes pa ci zhig yin pa ha mi gode dus khrims gcod pa'i zhal lce ba med de rgyu mtshan ni gyod don rtsa ba nas med la/ nyes chad gcod dgos sa'i mi yang med/ mi rnams zhi bde mdza' gcugs kyis 'tsho bar rol ba la sogs pa bkod yod/ ser wan the sis ya thogathi tshogs de dngos gnas phugs bsam rang bzhin can tu bris yod cing /khos de ltar 'bri don ni gna' bo'i dus rabs bar ma'i spyi tshogs 'dra mnyam min par 'khang ra dang / mi'i rigs slar yang 6 rdzogs ldan dus skabs ’ su phyir ldog pa'i stong bsam 'chang ba las ma 'das/ de ni 'grub thub pa zhig ga la yin/ ya thog spyi tshogs ni sger dbang lam lugs dang gral rim bshu gzhog med pa'i spyi tshogs shig yin kyang / nga tshos de ga ches yid 'ong zhig tu sgrub pa'i gnas lugs kyang med do//ya thog spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed nus shugs ha cang zhan la/ mi tshos gtso bo rdo chas yo byad bkol spyod byed/ rdo rgyu cha byas nas yo byad cig brdar bar byed pa ste/ dper na gcod gcog yo byad dang bzhar gzhig yo byad/ snyung 'bugasayo byad/ mi tshos bkol ba'i ma dbyibs yo byad kyang sngar bzhin rdo yin pa lta bu'o// gcog bzo byas pa'i yo byad ha cang rtsing po 'di dag la gna' rdzas brtag dpyad rig pas rdo chas rnying ma zer/ gal te ched las mkhas pas gsal 'byed byas pa min tshe/ nga tsho'i rang byung gi rdo zhig /da

snyam srid/ skabs der mi tshos srog chags sna tshosas rngon pa dang shing tog dang skye dngos kyi rtsad pa btus nas 'tsho thabs byed/ lo ngo sa ya du ma 'das song /mi rabs nas mi rabs bar 'bad brtson byas pas mi'i rigs la yar thon mngonagasal byung / kho tshos rdo chas brdar shes par gyur la yo byad kyi rnam grangs kyang je mang du song ba ma zad/ bzo dbyibs rim gyis zhib cing phra bar gyur/ gri dang / sta re/ 'bigs sogs yod la/ drag chas la mdung dang mda' gzhu sogs yod/ la lar u khung thag nas shing gi yu ba bzos pas bkol spyod stabs bde bzos/ yo byad 'di dag la gna' rdzas brtag dpyad rig pas rdo chas gsar ma zer/ rdo chas gsar ma'i dus rabs nas deng gi bar lo khri gcig yas mas las med/ rdochas las gzhan mi tshos rus chas kyang rgya khyab tu bkol spyod byed de/ chu bo'i rgyud dang mtshe'u'i 'gram du/ya thog mis gcan gzan gyi rus pas nya kyu dang nya mdung bzos nas nya rigs 'dzin/ mi'i rigs thon skyed kyi khyab khongs rim bzhin rgya bskyed byung / rdo chas rnying ma'am rdo chas gsar ma'i rjes shul mang po zhig 'dzam gling gi sa gnas so sor(krung go'ang 'du)gsar rnyed byung / rdo chas gsar ma'i dus skabs kyi mi'i rigs kyi gsar btod gal chen 'grub pa ni zhing las yin/zhing las ni skye dngos 'tshol sdud dang 'debs 'dzugs las 'phel rgyas byung ba yin/ dus mtshungs su sa khul la lar phyugs las byung / phyugs las ni ri dwags rngon pa dang srog chags 'dul gso las 'phel rgyas byung ba yin/ zhing las dang phyugs las byung ba ni mi'i rigs kyi thon skyed lo rgyus steng gi gsar brje gting zab pa zhig yin/ sngon chad mi rnams kyi ngal rtsol ni rang byung khams kyi lhun grub za ma bed spyod rgyu de las ma 'das shing / da ni de 'dra gtan nas ma yin te/ kho tshos 'bru rigs 'debs pa dang sgo phyugs skyong rgyu sheX pa ma zad/ rang nyid kyi lag par brten nas za ma'i thon skyed ldab

'gyur gyis 'phar bar byas pa 'dis mi'i rigs kyi rang byung khams 'dul ba'i khrod gom pa gal chen zhig spos pa mtshon/ rdo chas gsar ma'i dus rabs kyi mi'i rigs kyis rdza bzo lag rtsal yang gsar gtod byas shing / sa brdzis nas bsregs te yo byad sna tshogs bzo ba dang de'i thog tshon byugs pa dang ri mo sna tshogs bris/ rdza chas byung bas ni mi rnams kyi 'tsho ba sngar bas stabs bde bar gyur/ skabs 'dir/ mi'i rigs rang nyid la khang ba bzo bar goms la/ 'tsho gzhes la 'tsham pa'i sa cha mang por gtan sdod du gyur/ sde ba gcig rjes gnyis mthud du byung /rdo chas rnying ma nas rdo chas gsar ma'i dus skabs kyis ya thog spyi tshogs 0997 yan gyi dus tshod zin yod/ skabs de'i spyi tshogs sgrig gzhi de 'dra'i rtog dra min la/ dang thog mi rnams kyis ya thog tshogs spo'i 'tsho ba rol ba ste/spyir btang mi bcu re tshogs pa gcig re(ha lam o si khru li ya gzhis sdod yul mi tsho dang 'dra)yin la/ gzhi khyon 'di ni phyi rol khor yug gis bkag rgya thebs pa ste/ mi nyung drags na thun mong gi thon skyed dang rang srung la mi dge zhing / gal te mang drags na sa gnas gcig tu 'tsho ba'i rgyu cha de 'dra rnyed thabs bral/ rjes su ha lam lo ngo bzhi khri'am lnga'i yar sngon du/ mi'i rigs rigs rgyud spyi tshogs la bar brgal byed 'go brtsams/ rigs rgyud ni tshogs pa'i nang khul du phan tshun bar gnyen sgrig byed mi chog pa'i(rigs rgyud mi gcig pa'i bar gnyen bsgrigs pa)sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin pa'i 'og gnas pa red/ des ni mi'i rigs rang nyid 'phel rgyas khrod kyi yar thon chen po zhig mtshon/ rigs rgyud ni ches thog mar ma'i gdung rgyud(ma rgyud)ltar brtsi ba dang / rjes su pha'i gdung rgyud(pha rgyud)ltar brtsi bar gyur/ brgyud rim 'di la snga gzhug yod na'ang 'dzam gling steng gi mi rigs tshang mas thun mong du brgyud myong ba zhig yin/ sa cha la lar gdung rgyud nye ba'i rigs rgyud kha ltos

'dus nas rigs rgyud chen por (spun rgyud)chags pa'am/ yang na mnyam 'brel bgyis nas tsho bar grub/ 'on kyang rigs rgyud rtsa 'dzugs ni nam zhar yang ya thog spyi tshogs kyi rtsa ba'i phra phung yin no//rigs rgyud spyi tshogs su ma rgyud dam pha rgyud gang yin rung dpal 'byor thog ya thog gi spyi dbang lam lugs lag bstar byed/ yin na'ang pha rgyud spyi tshogs su/ skyes pho'i spyi tshogs go gnas dang dpal 'byor go gnas ches cher mtho ru song la rigs rgyud skyong ba'i lte bar gyur/ yen rdi an gyi i ro khe(1 la50177〉〉ba'i khrod du/ de'i ma rgyud rigs rgyud kung hre'i gzhi khyon ha cang che la/ skabs 'gar sde ba gcig gam 'ga' dbang du bzung yod cing / de'i mnga' 'og tu da rung ma rgyud khyim chen du ma bgos yod/ kho tshos khod yangs pa'i spyil khang chen po bzos yod la/ spyil khang la lar khyim rgyud 'ga' 'am bcu phrag 'ga' shong thub/ i ro khe ba'i rigs rgyud tsho dpon dang tsho ba'i dmag don 'go ba tshang ma 'dem bsko byas pa yin phyir/ de'i go sa rgyud 'dzin byed mi chog la go sa mi zin pa dus ltar brje spor byas chog bud med tshor skyes pho tsho dpon brje spor byed skabs dbang cha chen po yod/ yus la'o khe bas gtso bo zhing las gnyer te/ ma rmos lo tog sun rigs/ nan bka' sogs 'debs la/ dus mtshungs su ri dwags brngon zhing nya yang 'dzin/ dus rabs bco lnga ba'i dus mjug tu bslebs dus kho tshor sgo phyugs lug rnga mong(stsalha'i)gcig pu las med/ kho tsho'i zhing tshang ma rigs rgyud spyi la dbang zhing / mi grangs ltar khyim tshang so sor bgos nas rmo 'debs byed/mi rnams kyis thun mong du ngal rtsol byed la thon rdzas cha snyoms bgo bsha' rgyaga'adi ru sa zhing gi nyo tshongamed la mis mi la bshu gzhog byed pa'i gral rim gyi 'brel ba'ang med/ pha rgyud rigs rgyud kung hre skor gyi dpe mtshon ni/ gna' bordi ghi ri si ba (6744yolkotshom)dngarom gyi mi(2076ba3294)/

'jar man pa(4 go sa cho r+sā chol(bras shā))sogs kyi khrod mtshon pa ha cang mngon gsal yin/ snga ma gnyis ku'i skor sngon chad mi tshos bgro gling nyung ba zhig byas yod/ 'di ru spyi lo dus rabs dang po'i 'jar man pa'i gnas tshul rags tsam gleng bar bya/ gna' bo'i ro mā'i lo rgyus rig pa smra mkhan thā si thu si(2061110300la 11031gyi 53 po7)yis bris pa ltar na/skabs de'i 'jar man pa la ro mā'i (76)bran g.yog lam lugs kyi shugs rkyen thebs yod na'ang / gzhi rtsa'i steng ya thog gi spyi dbang lam lugs kyi dus rim las ma 'das/ kho tshos rigs rgyud tsho ba'i 'tsho ba rol bzhin yod la/ tsho ba'i dmag don dpon po(rje bo)dang kho'i lag rogs tshang ma 'dem bsko byed pa yin phyir/ de'i dbang cha la mi dmangs('thab mo ba)gros tshogs kyis tshod 'dzin byed pa ste/ kho tshor 'thab mo ba tsho'i rgyab skyor thob pa ni bka' la brten pa min par/ g.yul 'gyed skabs kyi snying stobs dang gdong mchong la brten nas thob pa yin/ mi dmangs gros tshogs kyis gnad don gal chen thag gcod byed skabs rgyun srol ltar thog mar bsam 'char la nyan dgos/ gal te gtam bshad mkhan de mi tsho'i blor ma babs na mi 'thad pa'i brda la mgo g.yug g.yug dang dngan pa 'then la/ blor babs tshe 'thad pa'i brda la lag nang gi mdung ring g.yug g.yug byed/ 'di ni rtag par mi tshos 6 dmag don dmangs gtso lam lugs zhes 'bod pa de yin/ 'jar man pa'i (ma shāshā)sa zhing ni thun mong gi yin/ 'on kyang kung hres dus bcad nas mi grangs ltar khyim rgyud so sor bgos nas bed spyod du 'jugabago bsha' ni cha snyoms min par/ byas rjes yod pa'i mir sa zhing cung mang po thob nges/ rgyu 'byor bas phyug min gyi tshad thig ni kho tshos sgo phyugs kyi grangs ku'i mang nyung la blta ba yin/ ro lnga'i sa mtshams dang thag cung ring ba'i 'jar man par skabs der dngul lor 'khor rgyug dar med chos/

dngos po de dngos por brje ba'i srol rnying 'dzin/ ro mā btsan rgyal la thag nye ba'i 'jar man par de tsho la gser dngul yod na'ang /dngos po 'di la mthong chen gtan mi byed/ kho tshos tha na dngul bum zhig rdza chas las rtsa che bar 'dod kyang mi srid/ 'jar man pas dngul sgor bun la 'jog pa dang skyed che'i bu lon gtong ba'i bshu gzhog gi skor ci yang mi shes/ thā si thu si'i dus rabs kyi 'jar man pas pha dbang lam lugs kyis ma dbang lam lugs lha tshab byas te go med tshor med dpal yon(gral rim spyi tshogs)gyi sgo them la ma pa zlok+ta k+tar nga tsho 'jar man pa sogs kyi zhabs rjes ded de ya thog spyi tshogs kyi pha mtha' la son/ ya thog spyi tshogs kyi rtsa thor ni thon skyed nus shugs 'phel rgyas kyi 'bras bu ldog tu med pa zhig yin/ rdo chas gsar ma'i dus rabs kyi rjes nas mi'i rigs ni lcags rigs yo byad(li'i yo byad dang lcags kyi yo byad)kyi dus rabs la bslebs pa yin/ lcags rigs bzhu ba'i lag rtsal gsar btod byas pas spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed nus shugs tshad mthon po zhig la btegs pa ste/ mi'i rigs la thon skyed thon rdzas lhag ma thengs dang por 'thob thub par gyur la/ 'dis ni sger dbang lam lugs dang mis mi la bshu gzhog byed pa la dngos po'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen bskrun pa red/6 thonaskyed nus shugs 'phel rgyas kyi tshad 'di la thon nas/ mi'i ngal rtsol nus shugs kyis ngal rtsol nus shugs thebs chag kho na la mkho ba'i dngos po las lhag tu mang pa zhig thon skyed byed thub pa byung / de nas ngal rtsol nus shugs la rin thang yod par gyur/’ (yen ke si'i gsung) 'di ltar pha rgyud rigs rgyud spyi tshogs kyi dus mjug la thon tshe/ rigs rgyud tsho khag bar dbul phyug rigs gnyis kyi dbye ba byung / sger dbang lam lugs dang gral ra/ /shu gzhog kyang rim bzhin byung ngo // mjug mthar/ dbang sgyur gral

rim(thog mar bran bdag gral rim)gyi khe phan mtshon pa'i rgyal khab srid dbang yang btsugs byung / sa'i go la'i steng du 'pho 'gyur gyi rgyud rim 'di ches thog mar dar sa ni/ a h+phe ri ka byang shar gyi ne le chu bo'i (77snyo1)'bab rgyud kyi e jib pa(2279 1803224)dang / e sha ya nub ma'i (po༅)gtsang bo gnyis kyi 'bab rgyud kyi su'u mere an pa'i(35400 la zozomedo)khrod du 'go brtsams pa yin/

gna'atho'i' zhib kyi rtsisadang spyil byungatshul/lo rtsis zhes pa ni go bde bor brjod na/ lo dang zla ba/ nyi ma brtsi ba'i lugs dang thabs shes yin/ lo rgyus stong du/ rgyal khab dang mi rigs mang po zhig la rang nyid kyi srol rgyun gyi lo rtsis yod myong mod/ 'on te deng sang 'dzam gling spyi mthun du spyod pa'i lo rtsis ni gcig las med/ mi rnams kyis de la ming 'tsham po zhig btags yod pa ni 6 spyi lo zer ba de'o// yang mi re 'gasayin 'dra ma yin pa'i ming smyo nub lo zhes kyang btags nas/ de ni nub phyogs kyi thon dngos sheg yin 'drar bshad mod/ nga tshos bshad tshul 'di ni phyogs re ba'i gtam zhig yin zhes brjod chog don dngos su spyi lo thog mar nub phyogs nas byung ba min par/ de ni shar phyogs kyi dpal yon ldan pa'i gna' bo'i i jib(2279 ṣ+ṭha1)nas byung ba yin/gna' bo'i e jib ni phal cher deng sang gi e jib sa khams chags tshul dang phal cher 'dra la/ 'bab rgyun ring ba'i ne le(sa116777)gtsang bo lho nas byang du 'phred kyis bcad de/ 'gram gnyis kyi sa zhing gshin po brlan par byas nas gnas 'di'i gzhis sdod pa gso skyong gnang / dus yun ring ba'i gna' bo'i dus te/ ha lam lo khri gcig yar sngon gyi rdo chas gsar ma'i dus rabs nas bzung / e jib pa rnams kyis gzhis sdod sgos so nam pa'i 'tsho ba rol bzhin yod/ e jib kyi gnam zlar tsha gdug che zhing char chu nyung bas/ zhing las thon skyed de tshad nges can zhig gi steng nas ne le gtsang bo'i dudi )cad mched rgyas la brten dgos/ e jib kyi mnga' khongs su/ ne le

gtsang bo zla drug pa nas rgyas 'go brtsams te zla bdun pa nas bcu bar mched 'byams su 'gro la/ shwa 'od kyis skye dngos rul ba grangs med khur yong nas sa zhing skam po brlan par byed/ de nas sha 'od rim gyis 'jags rjes zhing sa ru bye 'dam gshin po rim pa zhig lus yod/ zla bcu gcig par son 'debasakhyed la/ myu gu skye dus da rung las tshegs che ba'i mi'i thabs kyi chu 'dren dgos pa smos ci dgos/ de ltar na phyi lo'i zla ba gsum pa'am bzhi bar lo legs yong bar re ba yod/ spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs lnga bar/ snyi re si'i(6nga44lkotsho)lo rgyus rig pa smra mkhan he ro rdo thu si(501060 5377zas)sku dngos kyis e jib la rtog zhib byas shing / khong gis sa gzhi 'di ni 66na le gtsang bo'i legs skyes ’ su 'dod par gnas lugs med ces sus kyang smra bar ga la spobs/e jib mi dmangs kyis zhing las thon skyed dar rgyas gtong ched/ zhing las dus tshod dam 'dzin yong dgos par brten/ snga mo'i dus nas ne+e le gtsang bo rgyas pa'i chos nyid ngos 'dzin dang dus tshod cung yang dag cig brtsi dgos par lo rtsis shig mkho ba'i ngos zin thob/ kho tshos yun ring bo'i lag len khrod nyams myong mang po zhig bsags pa ste/ dper na lo re'i ne+e le gtsang bo rgyas dus kyi dus tshod sdong rkang steng la bskos/ rtags mang po zhig brkos nas phan tshun bsdur bar/ brtson 'grus can gyis gtsang bo thengs gnyis rgyas pa'i bar thag nyi ma sum brgya dang drug cu re lnga re yin pa shes rtogs byung / e jib pas mu mthud du nam mkha'i gnas tshul la lta zhib(tshad nges can zhig gi steng nas de ni rmongs dad kyi dmigs yul ched yin)bgyis mthar/ kho tshos rab gsal brtan skar(mkha' dbyings kyi ches che ba'i brtan skar yin la/ de'i tshangs thig nyi ma'i ldab gnyis yin)dang nyi ma gnyis lhan cig shar phyogs kyi gnam mtha' nas shar yong dus/ 'khor yun re re/ /sa

tshod kyi yun yang de dang 'dra mtshungs yin pa de gzhir bzung nas/ gna' bo'i e jib pas lo gcig nyi ma 365yin pa gtan la phab/ go thos su spyi lo sngon gyi 4241lo'i(da rung 4236lo yin pa sogs bshad srol yod)zla drug pa'i nyin ga ge mo'i zhogs par/ ne+e le gtsang bo rgyas pa'i rba rlabs them h+phe si(507961 3deng sang gi khe ro'i nye 'gram)thon dus/ brtan skar dang nyi ma gnyis lhan cig sa ngos nas shar 'ongs par/ de nas bzung nyi ma 'di lo gcig gi 'go rtsom sar gtan 'khel byas/ e jib pas lo gcig zla ba bcu gnyis dang / zla ba gcig nyi ma sum cu/ lo mjug la nyi ma lnga bsnan nas lo mjug gi dus chen gyi nyin mor thag bcad pa 'di e jib pa'i nyi ma'i lo rtsis yin/ drang mor bshad na/ gna' bo'i e jib par grub 'bras 'di thob pa ni kho tsho'i gnam rig shes bya phran tshegs de kho nar brten pa ma yin par/ de ni de le gtsang bo dus bcad ltar rgyas pa de la rag las/e jib pas gsar btod byas pa'i mi'i rigs lo rgyus steng gi nyi ma'i lo rtsis dang po de/ nam rgyun bshad bzhin pa'i sa'i go las nyi ma la bskor ba gcig brgyab pa'i dus tshodawa wanyi ma 365dang dus tshod 5skar ma 48skar cha 46dang bsdur na/ bar khyad nyi ma 174las med gshes/ skabs der mtshon na ches sngon thon yin/ 'on te lo gcig la nyi ma 174yi bar khyad yod par ci mi snyam na'ang / lo bzhi 'gor na nyi ma gcig gi bar khyad yod la/ lo 120'gor tshe zla gcig gi bar khyad yod/ lo730song na/ lo rtsis steng gi dus tshod dngos las lo phyed kyis mgyogs nas/ dbyar dgun dro grang tag tag go mjug go ldog yod pa red/ 'di ltar/ yang bskyar lo ngo130'gor tshe da gzod sngar gyi 'go 'dzugs sa de la slebs nas bskor ba gzhan zhig cig gi 'go rtsom thub pa red/ lag len ni bden don zhib bsher byed pa'i tshad gagi byin/ e jib pas nyi ma'i lo rtsis bed spyod byed pa'i brgyud rim khrod lo

rtsis 'di'i nor 'dzol zhan cha tshor la/ des zhing las thon skyed dang rgyun ldan 'tsho bar stabs mi bde ba mang po bzos/ 'on te yo bsrang bya thabs bral bas don 'dir do dam byed pa'i btsun pa yis gnas skabs dag ther dang kha gsab re byed pa las ma 'das/e jib pa'i nyi ma'i lo rtsis ni nga tshos da lta bkol spyod byed bzhin pa'i spyi lo min pa smos ci dgos/ yin yang / nga tshos bkol spyod byed bzhin pa'i spyi lo dang gna' bo'i e jib pa'i nyi ma'i lo rtsis bar la lo rgyus kyi las skal zhig yod myong ste/ yo rob gling du/ gna' bo'i snyi ri si ba (lkotshol)dngaro man(201—376〉〉pas sngar nas rang gi lo rtsis gtan la phab yod mod/e jib pa'i lo rtsis dang bsdur na nor chad ha cang che/ ngag rgyun ltar na spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs brgyad pa'i gna' bo'i ro man(2018)gyi no mā (r+sā7)rgyal pos srid 'dzin dus su/ ghi ri si (lko )bas bkol ba'i lugs rnying lo rtsis(〈༅7)gzhir byas nas ro ma'i lo rtsis gtan la phab cing / lo gcig la zla ba bcu gnyis/ de'i nang nas zla ba dang po/ gsum pa/ lnga ba/ brgyad pa la nyi ma so gcig dang / zla gnyis pa/ bzhi ba/ drug pa/ bdun pa/dgu ba/ bcu pa/ bcu gcig bcas zla bdun la zla rer nyi ma nyer dgu zla bcu gnyis par nyi ma nyer brgyad/ lo hril por bsdoms na nyi ma 355yin par thag bcad pa der/ lo 'khor mo gcig la nyi ma 10174yis nyung / nor chad che drags pas dngos su bed spyod dus 'gal ba ha cang mang /sbyi lo sngon gyi 432lor/ ghi re si'i gnam dpyad rig pa ba sme thon(skostob)gyis lugs rnying lo rtsis kyi lo'i bar khyad che ba legs sgrig byed ched/ sba sbi lon(26710ba18 377)gyi gnam dpyad rig pa'i shes bya'i rmang gzhi'i steng / lo ngo 19yi nang zla lhag bdun 'jog pa'i thabs bton pa ni/ lo ngo 19yi nang lo ngogal zla ba 13re yod pa ste/ 6 lo ngo 1milas7lhag rtsis /sna pa

yin/ yin na'ang / sme thon khyi don snying che ba'i gsar gtod 'di khyab spel dang byed spyod byed ma thub/spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs gcig pa'i dus dkyil du/ ro ma'i chab srid pa se gzir(645335553khulnga'i ngadzir+sā)yis kho'i dgra bo pham phe si(670053204chu 535༷ ba53 lko)pham par brgyab nas/ srid dbang sger gcod kyi dbang chen thob par/ bcos bsgyur byed thabs rab dang rim pa spel/ de'i nang du lo rtsis kyi bcos bsgyur kyang 'du/ skabs der ro ma ni sa dbus rgya mtsho'i rgyud du rgyal khab btsan shos yin la/ bran g.yog lam lugs kyi dpal 'byor sngar mus su yar 'phel 'byung bzhin yod/ thon skyed nus shugs 'phel rgyas la sngar bas yang dag pa'i lo rtsis shig mkho phyir/ spyi lo sngon gyi 46lor/ se gzir kyis a le khe gzan sdir grong khyer gyi(de ni sa dbus rgya mtsho'i shar phyogs kyi rig gnas lte ba yin)gnam dpyad rig pa ba so se sgu ne+e (r+sāsgro 2)gdan drangs nas/ e jib pa'i nyi ma'i lo rtsis ma dpe byas nas ro man la lo rtsis gsar bsgrigs gnang du bcug de nas/ e jib rme dmangs kyi rin thang bral ba'i rig gnas shul rdzas 'di dngos su yo rob gling du khyab pa red/se gzir (ṣ+ṭha )gyi dus skabs su bzo bcos gtan 'khel bgyis pa'i lo sa nang du/ e jib kyi nyi ma'i lo rtsis kyi lo re'i bzhi cha'i gcig gi bar khyad de la dag ther thog ma byas pa'i thabs shes gsham gsal ltar/ zla lhag med pa'i lor nyi ma 365dang / zla lhag yod pa'i lor nyi ma 366lo bzhi re'i nang zla lhag yod pa'i lo gcig yod/ zla dang po dang / gsum pa/ lnga ba/bdun pa/ dgu pa/ bcu gcig pa bcas pa la zla rer nyi ma sum cu so gcig dang / zla bzhi pa/ drug pa/ brgyad pa/ bcu pa/ bcu gnyis pa bcas la zla sdo/ nyi ma sum cu tham pa/ zla gnyis pa la zla lhag med pa'i lor nyi ma nyi shu

rtsa dgu dang / zla lhag yod pa'i lor nyi ma sum cu tham pa bcas so 'di ltar na/ lo yi 'khor mo gcig dang thag nye bar gyur/ se gzir gyi rus ming hru le'u si yin pas/ lo tho 'di la 6 hru le'u si'i lo rtsis mi (::sgoji15)zhes pa'i ming thob/ 6 se gzir lo rtsis mi (shā577)zhes bos kyang chog de ni spyi lo sngon gyi 45lo nas bzung lag bstar byed 'go bcoms/ gzhan yang se gzir zla bdun par 'khrungs pa'i zla bdun pa la 6 sgru le'u si'i zla ba ’ ( 5)yang zer/ se gzir gyi rgyud 'dzin pa u sgu si thu si(sa565ca bcu lhalozlo'i)kyis dbang sgyur skabs/ khong zla brgyad par 'khrungs phyir zla ba gnyis pa'i nang nas nyi ma gcig zla ba brgyad par bsnan nas/ zla ba brgyad pa yang zla che bar bsgyur te/ khong gi go 'phang de se gzir las mi dman pa gsal mngon byas/ de nas bzung zla brgyad par 6 u sgu si thu si'i zla ba ( lhalozlos7)zhes btags/ dus mtshungs su zla ba dgu pa dang bcu gcig pa gnyis zla ba chung bar bsgyur ba dang / zla ba bcu pa dang bcu gnyis pa zla che bar gtan 'khel byas/ bsgyur bcos 'di brgyud pa nas bzung deng sang nga tshos spyod bzhin pa'i spyi lo dang phal cher 'dra bar gyur ba ste/ zla ba dang po dang gsum pa/ lnga ba/ bdun pa/ brgyad pa/ bcu pa/ bcu gnyis pa bcas la zla rer nyi ma sum cu so gcig dang / zla ba bzhi pa/ drug pa/ dgu pa/ bcu gcig pa bcas la zla rer nyi ma sum cu tham pa dang / zla ba gnyis pa zla lhag med pa'i lor nyi ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / zla lhag yod pa'i lor nyi ma nyi shu rtsa dgu'o// de las mthong thub pa ni/ zla ba re re'i nyin grangs mi gcig par ni gnamadapyad rig pa'i thad kyi gzhi 'dzin sa ci yang med par/ dbang sgyur gral rim gyi 'dod mos ltar bzos pa zhig red/spyi lo 325lor/ ro ma'i rgyal po khon si than then si sku rabs dang pos(6003 chib 1043)a she ya chung ba'i ne+e se ya(khupo4)nas ye shu'i chos sdugs

kyi lo rgyus steng gi chos dpon gros tshogs thengs dang po bsdus shing / tshogs thog tu sgru le'u si'i lo rtsis ye shu'i chos lugs kyi lo thor gtan la phab na'ang /lo gang nas 'go rtsom rgyu yin pa thag ma bcad/ spyi lo 525lor bslebs dus/ro ma'i btsun pa the o ne+e se si chung ba (7)ri'i thaṣ+ṭha)yis ngag rgyun khrod kyi ye shu'i ma shu ga'i 'khrungs lo de btsan gyis spyi lo'i lo 'go rtsom sar bzhag don ngo mar skabs der smyo ye shu'i 'khrungs skar 7'das nas dus rabs lnga lhag 'gor yod/ 6 spyi lo 7zhes pa lā then yi ge'i nang don ltar na che dkon mchog gi 'khrungs lo 7(la teng yi ge bganyis kyis mtshon)zhes so// des ni spyi lo'i lo rtsis kyi 'go rtsom sa mtshon no/ de'i yar sngon la 6 spyi lo sngon (goms srol ltar na la teng yi ge 2dang (yis mtshon)ste 6 ye shu ma shu ku'i yar sngon 7zhes pa'o/dus rabs bcu drug pa'i yo rab gling du ma rtsa ring lugs dar ba dang bstun nas/ dngos rdzas thon skyed dang bsam pa'i rig gnas la 'phel rgyas mgyogs po byung ste/ lo rtsis sngar bas 'thus tshang du gtong dgos pa'i re 'dodayang bskyar gros mol 'char gzhir bkod/ sgru le'u si'i lo rtsis de e jib kyi nyi ma'i lo rtsis las khyad du 'phags na'ang / lo 'khor mo gcig la skar ma bcu gcig dang skar cha bcu bzhi'i nor 'dzol yod pa dang / lo ngo 128la gsog na nyin gcig gi bar khyad yong ba red/ sgru le'i si'i lo rtsis de yo rob gling du lo ngo 1600lhag la dar khyab byung nas/ dus rabs bcu drug pa'i dus mjug la bslebs tshe lo rtsis steng gi tshes grangs lo 'khor mo gcig las nyin bcu lhag yod pa red/ dper na/ spyir btang dpyid mnyam zla gsum pa'i tshes nyer gcig yin na'ang / lo rtsis steng du zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu gcig yin/ de ltar chos tshogs la'ang rnyog dra mang po bzos pa ste/chodi rdogs kyi gtan khel ltar na ye shu yi 66'das log dus chen ’ ni lo re'i

dpyid mnyam zla ba nya gang rjes kyi gza' nyi ma dang po de yin pa la/ dpyid mnyam la nyin bcu'i bar khyad thon pas/ ye shu nyin gang la 6 'das log ’ bgyis pa yin pa'ang gnad don zhig tu gyur/ 'di ni chos tshogs kyis hur thag gis lo rtsis la bzo bcos 'dod blo 'dzin don yang yin/ de dus chos tshogs la dbang cha ha cang che stabs/ ha lam chos tshogs kho na la lo rtsis bcos pa'i bya ba spel ba'i stobs nus ldan pa red/ro ma'i chos rgyal sge re sgo re'u si ( tsho lko1)sku rabs bcu gsum pas(676600 53)1582lor gnam dpyad rig pa ba khag cig rtsa 'dzugs byas nas/ kho pher ne khu si(9097105 ma 2)yi 66nyi ma lte bar smra ba ltar brtsis yong ba'i gnam dpyad gzhi grangs ji bzhin/ sgru le'u si'i lo rtsis la tshad yod cing gal che ba'i bzo bcos byas shing / de la phyogs gnyis kyi nang don 'du ste/ (gcig) lo rtsis steng gi 1582lo'i zla 10ba'i tshes 5nas tshes 14bar gyi nyin bcu med par bzos pa khyab bsgrags byas/ zla ba 10pa'i tshes 4rjes ni zla ba 10pa'i tshes 15yin/ de ltar na 1583lo'i dpyid mnyam slar yang zla ba 3pa'i tshes 21nyin yin/ (gnyis) sngon chad lo bzhi rer zla lhag yod pa'i lo gcig ltar na lo ngo 40)la zla lhag yod pa'i lo 100yod pa de/da lta lo ngo 40)la zla lhag yod pa'i lo 97du bsgyur bas/ phal cher skar ma 11dang skar cha 14yi bar khyad kha gsab byas/ zla lhag yod pa'i lo 'jog pa'i thabs ni/ bzhis bgos tshar ba'i lo de ni zla lhag yod pa'i lo yin la/ brgya lo lon pa'i lo der 400yis bgos tshar ba ni zla lhag yod pa'i lo yinazhing bgos mi tshar pa ni min/ dper na 160)lo ni zla lhag yod pa'i lo yin la/170)lo dang 180)lo/ 190)lo tshang ma min par/ 200)lo yang zla lhag yod pa'i lo yin/ 'di la 6 sge re sgo re'u si'i lo rtsis 7zer zhing / deng sang 'dzam gling du spyi mthun du spyod pa'i lo rtsis kyang yin/ bsdus ming di / sge

re'i lo rtsis ’ sam 6 spyi lo )zer/rang rgyal du lcags phag lo'i gsar brje yis ching rgyal rabs(7)mgo mjug bslogs rjes kyi 1912lo nas spyi lo spyod 'go brtsams/ krung hwa mi dmangasasbyi mthun rgyal khyab dbu brnyes rjes srid gzhung gis/ krung gos sge re'i lo rtsis rgyal khab kyi gtan khel lo rtsis byed rgyu dang spyi lo'i lo rtsis bed spyod byed rgyu dang / srol rgyun gyi 6 lugs rnying lo rtsis rtsa med du mi gtong rgyu gsal bsgrags byas/sge re'i lo rtsis kyang skyon phran cam yang med pa zhig ga la yin te/ zla ba re re'i nyin grangs la sgrig lam gyi shas mi che/ goms lob tu song yod na'ang bed spyod dus stabs mi bde ba'ang yod/ lhag par du lo ngo sum stong dang brgya phrag kha shas brgyud na/ der kyang nyin gcig gi nor 'dzol yod nges/de'i rkyen gyis lo rtsis la bzo bcos byed dgos pa'i 'dod blo can yang mang po yod/ spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas dang gnam dpyad shes bya'i zhib dpyad mu mthud je rgyas su phyin na/ deng skabs kyi lo rtsis steng gi skyon cha legs bcos sgos bkol spyod stabs bde ba/ phyi rol 'jig rten gyi chos nyid dang yang je bstun pa smos med red/ 20

gtor gathugs mchod rten dang rtsaralim/krang tshe| sdog/gna' bo'i e jib ni 'dzam gling steng gi ches snga ba'i bran g.yog lam lugs rgyal khab kyi gras yin/ rgyal rabs gsum pa (ha lam spyi lo sngon tā/ 2686wa spyi lo sngon gyi 2613lo)nas bzung / e jib gna' bo'i rgyal po'i rgyal khab kyi dus rabs la bslebs(ha lam spyi lo sngon gyi 2686wa spyi lo sngon gyi 2181lo)shing / dus skabs 'dir/ h+pha rog (2681 05 76)①gis dkyil snying dbang cha gcig sdud kyi dbang bsgyur shugs je drag tu phyin/gtor gzugs mchod rten gyi bzo skrun las h+pha rog la dbang cha che ba dang dbang bsgyur gral rim la rgyas spros che ba/ mi dmangs la gdug rtsub spyod che ba sogs kyi bsdus gzugs shig mthong thub pa red/ de'i phyir/ gna' bo'i rgyal bo'i rgyal khab dus skabs la 6 gtor gzugs mchod rten gyi dus skabs kyang zer/gtor gzugs mchod rten ni gna' bo'i e jib kyi h+pha rog gis rang nyid la bskrun pa'i bang so yin/ bang so 'di dag 'og nas steng du rim pa gcig las gcig chung ba mchod rten zhig dang gnyis su med/ de'i phyi dbyibs rang re'i chos pa'i gtor ma dang 'dra bas/ nga tshos de la 6 gtor mi 'bodzi pazlo spyi ṭā sdishā zloshā snanā ཿlja/ spya shā ཿdū sdo spro/ sdir+sha skyut+na shāna' rabs jib pas thad kur rgyal // ming

gzugs mchod rten zhes 'bod chog/don dngos su/ e jib(2279 )kyi ches snga ba'i bang so'i rnam pa ha cang stabs bde zhig yin te/ bye thang du sa dong zhig brkos nas bem ro nang du sbas nas bye phung zhig srungs la mtha' skor du rdo brtsigs nas bye ma rlung gis 'khur ba sngon 'gog byed/ rjes sor/ dbul po 'das rjes sngar mus bzhin sa 'og gi dur khung thabs chag tu sbed mod/ 'on te dpon ngan sku drag gi dur khung ni je che je rgyas su song nas/ sa 'og tu gdung khang yod khar/sa ngos su bzo bkod kyang yod/ de'i phyi dbyibs skas dbyibs gru bzhi'i rdo'i rkub stegs sheg dang mtshungs phyir/ tshang mas smyo mā si tha rmā ’ (6loX3)(rdo'i rkub stegs)zer/e jib(2679 tshi1)ni gna' bo'i rgyal po'i rgyal khab dus skabs kyi rgyal rabs gsum par bslebs rjes/ h+pha rog gi dbang cha je che nas je cher song bar/ kho tshos 6 mā si tha phu 7dang rang gi mchog gyur go gnas ha cang do mi mnyam par 'dod/ rgyal rabs 'di'i h+pha rog dang po rdzo ser(204nga stsa7)gyis shes yon sna 'dzoms can e mu te the phu(77lo80)gdan drangs nas rang nyid la bang so jus 'god byed du bcug ye mu he the phu yis thog mar rdos bzos pa'i 8 mā si tha rmā ’ chen po zhig jus 'god byas par/ rje ser gyis de 'dra rngam brjid che ba zhig ma yin par snyam nas/ de'i phyir rjes sor de'i steng du rim pa gcig las gcig chung ba'i smyo mā si tha hā lnga bsnan/'di ltar/ e jib tu gtor gzugs mchod rten dang po byung / gtor gzugs mchod rten 'di'i bzo dbyibs ni rim pa gcig nas rim pa gcig bstar mar yod pas/ 66skas dbyibs gtor gzugs mchod rten ’ yang zer/gtor gzugs mchod rten 'di ga da lta'i e jib kyi sā kha la(967)nas ba~Xs shing / mtho tshad la smi 61dang / rting zhabs kyi lho byang tshangs thig la

smi 107 4dang / shar nub kyi ring tshad la smi 123bcas yod phyir/ brjid chags ldan pa zhig red/ mchod rten gyi 'og tu dong zab mo zhig yod pa sa 'og gi bar khyams dang khang pa la sbrel yod/ mtha' 'khor du skabs de'i rgyal po'i mkhar gyang la dpe bltas nas ra skor zhig bzos yod/ ra skor nang du mchod 'bul byed sa'i tshoms khang zhig bzhengs yod/ sku drag rang ga ba'i mā si tha hā dang mi 'dra ba'i bang so 'di ni srid dbang sger gcod kyi rgyal po zhig gi bang so chen po las ma 'das so//rgyal rabs bzhi par(spyi lo sngon gyi 2713wa spyi lo sngon gyi 2498)bslobs pa na/ e jib(2679 )kyi h+pha rog tshor ches brjid nyams ldan pa'i gtor gzugs mchod rten bzo skrun byed par spro sems kyis brtas yod/rgyal rabs bzhi pa'i rgyal po dang po si ne+e h+pho ru(glo lko )yis rang nyid la bsdoms pa'i gtor gzugs mchod rten gsum bzhengs/ h+pha rog de'i bu khu phya (55575lo spyi lo sngon gyi 259)waspyi lo sngon gyi 2568lor srid bzung)yis dbang bzung ba nas bzung / e jib(2679 )kyi rji rdza mtho sa(612 zlo lo7)(deng sang khe ro'i nye 'dabs su yod)ru ches che ba'i gtor gzugs mchod rten zhig bzhengs pa de ni skad grags che ba'i khu rmu gtor gzugs mchod rten zhes pa de red/ ches che ba'i gtor gzugs mchod rten 'di bzhengs ched rje dpon khu spru yis e jib kyi mi thams cad btsan gyis 'u lag la rgyug tu bcug khos e jib yongs kyi ngal rtsol pa mi 'bum re 'dzin grwa gcig tu phye nas/ 'dzin grwa rer zla ba gsum la 'u lag rgyug tu bcug ste phan tshun res mos brje spor byas/bcoskrun 'go btsams rjes/ mi skor zhig lung ba'i nang gi rdo rko sar mngagasanas rdo dbor du bcug kho tshos thog mar rdo rko sa nas rdo ba ne+e le gtsang bo'i shar 'gram la skyel 'dren byas pa dang / de nas grur bcu/ /sa

gtsang bo'i nub rgyud la dbor zhing / nub rgyud nas las sar skyel 'dren byed/las sar dbor ba'i rdo ha cang lci zhing che bas skyel 'dren yo byad rjes lus yin pa'i gnas tshul 'og skabs de'i e jib pas rdo 'degs dbyug pa 'i stonga'i bzhag nas mi 'am phyugs kyis drud/ 'on kyang / rdo ljid cing che ba bzhag pa'i 'degs shing sa bde mo zhig yin na ma gtogs 'gro mi thub/ de'i phyir/ lo bcu'i ring la rdo 'drud sa'i rdo lam zhig bzo skrun byas/ lam bzo ba'i mtshungs su/ bzo ba skor zhig gis gtor gzugs mchod rten gyi sa 'og gi bang so dang sa 'og gi bar khyams bzo skrun byas/ bzo ba rnams krong nger langs mi thub pa'i bar khyams nas tsha gdung gi mnar zhing / sra mkhregs min pa'i zangs 'bigs kyis brag rdo brkos pas rngul khrag grangs med bzhur/lam bzo ba dang sa 'og gi bang so bzhengs pa'i bzo skrun gyi bya ba 'grub rjes/ gtor gzugs mchod rten skrun mgo bcoms/ gtor gzugs mchod rten che ba'i bzo skrun ni ha cang dka' ngal che zhig red/ nam rgyun mi 'bum gcig gis tsha gdug chen po dang las dpon gyi dbyug lcag gi btsan skul 'og ngal rtsol byed bzhin yod/ yang bskyar lo ngo nyi shu'i dus tshod spyad nas da /zod gtor gzugs mchod rten che ba grub/ bzo skrun spyir snga phyir lo sum cu nga / khu spru gtor gzugs mchog rten gyi mtho tshad la smi 146 5(deng sang de'i rtse mor phal cher smi 10tsam rul nas gog)zhabs ngos gru bzhi kha gang ma zhig yin la/ mtha' re'i ring tshad la smi 230yod/ gtor gzugs mchod rten la bskor ba gcig rgyag dgos na phal cher spyi le gcig gi lam thag la 'gro dgos/ mchod rten ha lam rdo che chung mi gcig pa khri 230yis brtsigs pa yin zhing / cha snyoms rdo re'i ljid tshad la tun 2 5yod/ rdo 'di dag phan tshuX sdur du ar 'dam sogs 'byar bag ci yang med par/ rdo gcig rdo

gzhan zhig gis mnan te brtsigs yod/ rdo brdar ba ha cang ngos mnyam pas/deng sang yang mi rnams kyis zha smyug gzhog byed kyi rno gri leb mo tsam yang rdo srubs la 'jug mi nus/ bris nas mtshams 'dir thon tshe/ mi tshos 'di ltar 'dri nges te/ skabs der ljid 'degs 'phrul 'khor med la/ tha na lcags dbyug cig kyang med pas/ rdo ljid mo de tsho ci ltar brtsigs pa yin zhe na/bshad tshul ltar na/ thog mar sa ngos nas rdo rim pa gcig brtsigs pa dang /de nas de dang mtho tshad 'dra mtshungs kyi sa 'bur brtsigs nas mi rnams kyis sa 'bur gsog 'khyog de brgyud nas rdo yar skyel ba red/ rtsig rim gcig brgyab tshe sa rtsig je mthor thengs gcig gtong bar brten/ gtor gzugs mchod rten gyi mtho tshad ga 'dra mtho na sa rtsig kyang de bzhin mtho/ mchod rten bzo skrun tshar rjes/ sa rtsig ri chen po zhig tu gyur yod/ de bas sa rtsig kānas sduzhan la spor na/ da gzod gtor gzugs mchod rten gyi gzi nyams mas khu zlo yi/ gtor gzugs mchod rten gyi snyan grags 'dzam gling du 'bar ba ni phyi'i rnam pa rgya che zhing brjid chags pa kho nas ma yin par/ de'i nang gi bzo bkod ha cang sna mang sne 'dzing dang zhib phra che ba des yin/ de bzhin du phyi rabs pas 'di ga gna' bo'i 'dzam gling khyad mtshar byung ba bdun gyi thog mar bzhag par yang gnas lugs shig los yod/ gtor gzugs mchod rten gyi nang na dur khang gsum yod kyang 'jug sgo gcig las medapa de mchod rten gyi byang ngos sa ngos las smi 13gyis mtho ba'i sa na yod/ sgo nas 'dzul te mi gcig gi mtho tshad tsam yod pa'i bar khyams brgyud de smi 18tsam song na rdo khang zhig la 'byor/ rdo khang de'i dbyibs gru bzhi nar mo yin la mtho tshad la smi 3tsam yod/ ngag rgyun ltar na dur sa 'di khu rmu yi blo la ma babs pas/'jug sgo las bar thag smi 20yod pa'i thur lam bar khyams der gye/ snam

bar khyams sheg bzos/ de smi drug tsam mtho ba'i dur khang la thug yod/ mi la las 'di ru btsun mo'i pur bcug yod par 'dod la/ de la 6 btsun mo'i bang so zhes kyang 'bod/ 'o na khu rmu yi bang so de gang na yod ce na/ gyen lam bar khyams ded de mu mthud du song na mtho tshad la smi brgyad yod pa'i bar khyams chen po zhig yod la/ khu spru yi bang so bar khyams chen po de'i phugs mtha' ste sa ngos las smi 40yod pa'i gnas na yod/ gdung khang gi mtho tshad la ha lam smi drug tsam yod cing de'i nang na rdo'i ro sgam zhig yod/yin na'ang / khu spru yi spur skam po (75775)sngar nas rdo'i ro sgam nang na med/ khu spru gson dus mi las dgu las mang pos mi dmangs sdug la sbyar phyir/ kho 'das rjes/ mi dmangs kyis 'os langs byas nas gtor gzugs mchodarten chen po'i nang du brgyugs te/ kho'i spur skam spur sgam las ton nas de sa gtor gnam gtor byas/rji rdza'i (zlo )nye 'dabs na da dung brjid nyams ldan pa'i gtor gzugs mchod rten gnyis yod la/ de ni so sor khu spru yi sras kha h+pho ra(5617 077)dang kha spro ra'i sras me khu re(50057570rtsa ṣ+ṭha)gnyis kyi yin/de'i nang du kha h+pho ra gtor gzugs mchod rten ni khu rmu gtor gzugs mchod rten las smi gsum dma' yang / khongs gtogs bzo bkod ha cang 'thus tshang / mchod rten gyi nye 'dabs su lha khang gong ma dang zhol ma gnyis bzhengs yod/ lha khang zhol ma'i nub byang phyogs su steng na kha h+pho ra yi mgo dang 'og na seng ge'i gzugs yod pa'i rdo bskos sku brnyan chen po zhig yod la de ni ming grags che ba'i 6 seng ge mi yi gdong ba can ’ yin/ rdo brkos sku brnyan 'di shar phyogs su 'khor zhing mtho tshad la smi nyi shu dang ring tshad la smi lnga bcu nga bdun yod/ kha h+pho ra yi rna gcig gi mtho tshad la smi gnyis yod/ngakā/na du nā pho lun(sa jiX/600)gyis e jib la btsan 'dzul byed dus/

seng gzugs mi gdong pa can la me phyogs 'phangs nas de'i nang gi 'jug sgo btsal na'ang 'jug sgo ma rnyed par seng ge mi yi gdong ba can gyi bzhin ras la gtor skyon thebs pas da lta'i btsog po de 'dra rang chags song / ma gzhi sengage mi yi gdong ba can gyi sku brnyan hril bo ni rang byung gi brag rdo chen po zhig gi stong du brkos yod pa red/gong gsal gtor dbyibs mchod rten 'di gsum po bzhengs pas na/e jib kyi rgyu stobs yongs su 'dzad par byas pa dang / mi dmangs la mnar gcod dang god chag phon chen po khyer 'ongs/ bshu gzhog myong ba'i bran g.yog dang dbul phongs sdug mnar gyi so nam pas bzod thabs bral te 'os langs yang yang byas pas/ e jib kyi rje dpon gyi srid dbang sger gcod la brdung deg tshabs chen po thebs/ rgyal rabs bzhi ba'i rjes su/ rje dpon gyi dbang sgyur nyams dmas su gyur te gtor gzugs ma chod rten bzo ba yang je chung nas je chung du phyin/gtor gzugs mchod rten gyi bzo bkod rnam pa byung ba dang 'phel ba/rgyad pa sogs kyis gna' bo'i e jib kyi lo rgyus steng lo ngo chig stong lhag gi rgyun bsrings/ spyi lo sngon gyi 1550lor bslebs dus/ e jib mi dmangs kyi 'os langs dang dur brku'i bya 'gul tshabs che ba sogs gzhi byas nas e jib kyi rje dpon dag gis kyang gtor gzugs mchod rten bzo ba mtshams bzhag ste/ ri lung 'gol bor gsang ba'i bang so bsko ba las thabs ma byung /mtshams 'dir slob grogs la las/ gna' bo'i e jib kyi rje dpon dag gis ci'i phyir gtor dbyibs mchod rten bskrun pa yin zhes 'dri na'ang srid/ 'di ni snye sgrung zhig gis 'grel dgos/ngag rgyun ltar na/ gna' rabs kyi e jib na ming la o si re si(03103chopotsholo)zer ba'i h+pha rog cig yod la/ kho'i ma ni gnam gyi lha dang 2lha ni

sa yi lha yin/ o si re si ni 'jon po kun shes shig yin pas/ khong gis mi rnams la sa zhing rmo lugs dang bag leb bzo stangs/ chang stol thabs/gter rko tshul dang lcags btso sbyang gi gdams pa bslab pas dmangs sems yongs su bkugs/ yin na'ang / kho'i nu bo se thi(57 zojurnyes)yis kho la phrag dog byed pa ma zad sngar nas ham sems 'chang ba'i rgyal po'i go gnas de 'phrog byed/zhiskog gasbya rten jus kyis kho bgrong rtsis byas/pha bo da/nga pa'il ga/ sol tshiga~X — 51nga — po ma ༵ gdan drangs pa ma zad — —————tsho — hro r+bhejo r+ṣa 3———mgron po mang po bos/ dgung sgo ste tshigs gsol skabs/ se thi ——— ——rmong wa nga—yis mi mngags nas sgam 2 2 77late cimadzes sdug yid du 'ong ba zhig nga tho —〉ngalke nel —shā sbyi dris ‘ /sa sga byinga'//'i // shā gtor gzugs mchod rten/shong na de ༵ gnang bar bya zhes bshad/ lkog jus byas pa'i mgron po tshos o si re si la tshod lta byos zhes ngan skul byas/ kho rang sgam nang la 'dzul ma thag se thi/ rogs pa rnams kyis sgam la zwa brgyab nas ne le gtsang bo'i nang la g.yuzlo si /re si si bgrongs rjes kho'i chung mas phyogs so sor btsal btsal bar/ mthar khyo ga yi ro rnyed byung / se thi yis gnas tshul de shes rjes/mtshan brgyab nas bem ro brkus te dum bu bcu bzhir gtub ste phyogs so sor gtor/ o si re si'i chung mas yang bskyar bem ro'i dum bu btsal nas so so ga~X rang du sbas/

ba dang / 6 rnyed zin pa'i ’ h+pha rog gi bem ro la rgyal mo dang rgyal sras kyis sku gdung dngos yin min la 6 zhib bsher mi byed/ der mthud nas gdung 'khrud mdzad sgo ste bem ror gshag bcos byas nas spur skam 66rma sme ’ bzo ba red/ skabs der e jib tu rmongs dad kyi lta ba zhig yod pa ni bem ro nyar tshags byas pa bzang na da gzod rnam shes 'khor sa yod pa red/ de'i phyir mi rnams lnga lam du chas rjes/ thog mar 'das po'i klad zho dang nang khrol phyi ru bton nas/ de'i tshab tu khog la shing tsha dang spos dkar sogs bsung rdzas blugs te legs par btsem tshar rjes/ bem ro rul 'gog gsher rdzas rigs shig gi nang la sbangs la/ nyi ma bdun cu'i rjes su/ bem ro blangs nas bskams te gso ma'i ras kyis btums pa dang phyi ngos su thang chu byugs/skabs der bslebs na 6 rma sme ’ da gzod bzos tshar ba red/ go rim gsum pa ni 'das log mdzad sgo yin la gto ba bos nas gzungs sngags bzla ru bcug ste/ 6 rma sme ’ yi mig 'byed pa dang / sna 'byed pa/ rna 'byed pa/ kha 'byed pa bcas byas za ma kha nang du 'jug pa red/ bshad tshul de ltar byas na/ 6 rma sme ’ mi gson po nang bzhin dbugs 'byin la/ skad cha bshad pa dang za ma bza' bar byed/ mtha' ma ni bang sor 'jug pa'i mdzad sgo ste/6 rma sme ro sgam la bcug nas gtor gzugs mchod rten bang sor skyel gshes/ gtor gzugs mchod rten ni h+pha rog tsho'i shi nas 'das log rgyag sa'i dus gtan gyi pho brang yin la/ kho tsho'i 6 rma sme ’ pho brang nang rtag tu gnas na'ang kho tsho'i rnam shes ni bya bye'u ji bzhin lha yul dang mi yul bar rang dbang gis 'gro 'ong dang lha dang mnyam du 'phur skyod byed pa red/da lta/ nga tshos gna' rabs e jib kyi rje dpon tshos gtor gzugs mchod rten bzo skrun byed pa'i dmigs yul ni 8 dus gtan gyi pho brang ’ la brdo/ nas kho tsho'i tsa dus gtan gyi dbang sgyur 7rgyun 'khyongs byed 'dod pa

dang / gtor gzugs mchod rten gyi brjid nyams kyis mi tshor rje dpon gyi sger gcod dbang sgyur la gus shing dngangs te ngo rgol byed mi thub par bzo ba de yin pa shes dgos/'onakyang 'di ni rmi lam tsam las ma 'das te/ e jib kyi h+pha rog gi dus gtan du rgyun 'khyongs 'dod pa'i bran g.yog lam lugs kyi dbang sgyur de snga mo nas lo rgyus kyi shul rdzas tsam du gyur cing / de ring no le gtsang bo'i smad rgyud kyi nub ngos su krong nger langs pa'i gtor gzugs mchod rten ni gna' rabs e jib h+pha rog gi gdug rtsub sgos mi dmangs bran bkol byas pa ther 'don byed pa'i ches bzang ba'i lo rgyus dan rtags yin la/ gna' rabs e jib mi dmangs kyi dka' spyad ngal rtsol dang shes rab bla na med pa'i dran rten rdo ring zhig kyang yin no//

ji khe nā thon gyibacosagazur dang 'am kha/hrin kri bkang /gna' bo'i i cib ni rgyal rabs bco brgyad pa la(spyi lo sngon gyi 157)wa spyi lo sngon gyi 1320lo bar)bslebs dus/ rgyal po gsar ba'i dus skabs(ha lam spyi lo sngon gyi 1570wa spyi lo sngon gyi 1085lo bar)su zhugs pa'i 'go brtsams pa red/ rgyal rabs 'di ni gna' bo'i e jib lo rgyus steng stobs 'byor ches dar ba'i dus yin te/ dmag don gyi 'thab rtsod khrod/ e jib lho byang yang bskyar gcig gyur byas shing h+pha rog gi dbang cha sngar las je cher song ba dang / bran g.yog lam lugs kyi dpal 'byor dar rgyas su song ste yongs khyab tu li chas bkol ba ma zad lcags chas kyang yod par gyur/ phyi la dmag 'khrug mang po brgyab nas e jib kyi mnga' khongs byang du si ri a(55pa mas ༅)yikhaho smi si(rdo sko6)dang lho nas ne le gtsang bo'i 'bab chu bzhi ba la rgya bskyed nas bran g.yog lam lugs kyi dmag don rgyal khab cig tu gyur/rgyal rabs bco brgyad pa'i skabs su/ bran g.yog spyi tshogs kyi rtsa ba'i 'gal ba ste bran g.yog gral rim dang bran bdag gral rim gyi 'gal pa ha cang dza drag tu gyur/ de yang dbang sgyur gral rim de nyid kyang gros don gcig gyur min par 'gal bas khengs su yod/ the sbe si a mon(166 cas70 spo༅ 3)lha khang gi btsun pa'i dpon po(mchod dpon yang zer)'go gtso yin

pa'i lha khang gi bran bdag sku drag ni bran bdag gral rim nang khul gyi stobs shugs ches che bar gyur/ kho tshos 6 a mon ni e jib kyi nyi ma'i lha dang the sbe si yi srung mar bkur zhing / a mon lhas h+pha rog la rgyal kha stsol ba dang / e jib rgyal khab de a mon lha la brten na da gzod g.yul las rgyal thub pas a mon ni rgyal khab kyi lha ches che ba yin zhes zhud kyis bstod par/ h+pha rog gis rang nyid 66a mon gyi sras yin zhes chos lugs la brten nas rang nyid kyi sger gcod dbang bsgyur de lha chos dang bsre ba'i re ngan bcangs/ ming la thu the smu si(155 6704 lo sgomo)sku phreng gsum pa zhes pa'i rje dpon zhig yod pa de chung dus a mun lha khang du btsun pa byed myong la/ phyis su a mon lha khang gi btsun pa tshogs pa'i rgyab skyor 'og khos srid dbang blangs/ khos a mon btsun pa tshogs pa'i bka' drin la thugs rje che zhu ched/ dmag don rgyang 'dul gyi rgyal kha tshang ma a mon lha'i srung skyob la brten nas byung zhes bsgrags pa ma zad/ rgyun du a mon lha khang la 6 ye jib gong 'og gi sa gzhi ches legs po dang gser dngul mang po/ bran g.yog sogs zhal 'debs gnang / h+pha rog gzhan pa tshos kyang de bzhin bgyis/ der brten/ a mon btsun pa tshogs pa'i dbang stobs je cher song nas ches phyug pa'i bran bdag tshogs par gyur/ de rgyun du rgyal khab kyi chab srid la zhugs pa dang des chab srid la shugs rkyen thebs par byed/ skabs rer sa gnas rgyud 'dzin sku drag dang mnyam 'brel byas te h+pha rog gtso byas pa'i dkyil snying srid dbang la ngo rgol byed pa yis/ chos lugs lha dbang gis rje dpon srid dbang la 'jigs snang skul ba'ang byung / zla rog gtso byas pa'i mi skya'i srid dbang dang a mon lha khang gi btsun pa sku drag gtso byas pa'i lha dbang bar gyi 'gal ba nyin rer dza drag tu song ba de/ rgyal rabs bco brgyad pa'i dus phyi'i bran bdag gral rim nang khul gyi 'thab rtsod kyi nang don gtso bor gyur/ 33

chung ba la gtan/ a smen ho the pheb srid khrir bsdad rjes/ e jib lha khang bran bdag sku drag gi rgyab rten las thar ba dang srid dbang je brtan du gtong ched/ thog mar chos lugs bcos bsgyur lag bstar byas te/ nyi ma'i lha gcig pu la dad pa des srol rgyun gyi a mon lha dang lha gzhan pa la dad pa'i tshab byas pa de ni lo rgyus steng gi lha gcig smra ba ang dang po yin shas che/dang thog a mon ho thu phu'u sku rabs bzhi ba yis cung 'jam pa'i thabs shes spyod par 'dod de/ he ra khu re o mkhar grong ( ṣ+ṭha༅(577)gi 6 re (7)(50'ams )lha(gna' bo'i nyi ma'i lha zhig)bkur nas the spe si ('a 77)yi a mon lha la 'gran slong ched/ rgyal sa the sbe si nas re lha khang bzo bskrun byas shing rang nyid re lha yi btsun pa'i thu bo yin par bsgrags/ 'on kyangakhyed thabs 'di la 'phral du the sbe si lha khang btsun pa'i tshogs pas ngo rgol drag po thebs/ gnas tshul 'dis a smen ho the pheb sku rabs bzhi bar khong khro gting nas langs su bcug khos a mon lha khang btsun pa'i tshogs pa dang rtsa ba nas 'brel thag gcod pa'i chod sems dam du bcangs/ dus mtshungs su/ srol rgyun gyi lha gang zhig bkur kyang e jib kyi ches mtho ba'i lha gcig pu byed pa mi thub pa dang / nges par du chos lugs gsar ba zhig bton nas a mon lha la ngo rgol byed dgos pa'i nges shes kho la thob/de nas/ chos lugs gsar ba khyab bsgrags byas byung / des bstan don/ nyi ma'i lha a thon(sa ༷sa mcho)ni rgyal yongs kyi dad pa byed sa'i lha gcig pu yin zhing / yul lha gzhan pa dag la dad pa byed pa tshang ma rtsis med gtong dgos pa dang / a thon ni e jib yongs kyi yin pa ma zad 'jig rten khams kyi lha gcig pu yin la/ h+pha rog rang nyid ni a thon gyi sras yin la/ a thon las stobs shugs thob kyi yod/ de na a thon ni ji 'dra zhig yin zhe na/de ni 'od zer phyogs kun la 'phro zhing gson nyams dod pa'i nyi ma sgokā snar

zhig tu bris yod la/ 'od zer gyi mjug ni phyag yin zhing / phyag rtse 'di dag gis e jib mi dmangs dang rgyal po la tshe srog dang bde thang dang bde skyid stsol bar byed/ a smen ho the pheb sku rabs bzhi ba rang nyid kyis bsgrigs pa'i 〈〈a thon bstod tshig〉〉nang du/ spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang lha a thon gyi gzi rngam dang yon tan la bstod pa bgyis pa 'di lta ste/6 gnam mtha' nas khyed kyi mdzes sdug gi gzugs dbyibs rnam par mngon byung / lha a thon lags/ khyed ni tshe srog gi 'go rtsom sa yin ang / skya rengs shar dus/stukhyed ni gnam mtha' nas ga ler 'phags yong / khyed de/ lha a thon/ nyin mor 'od lhang nger 'tsher/ khyed kyis mun nag rgyang du bskrad de 'od zer lam mer bkrams/ e jib gong 'og zhin mo re rer dga' mgu'i dpal la rol/o/ lha gcig pu ya/ khyed la 'gran bzod pa ni su zhig yod ang / khyed kyis dngos gnas sku nyid kyi 'dod mos bzhin 'jig rten bskrun byung / khyed ni 'gro ba mi yongs rdzogs kyi bdag po nyag gcig yin zhing / khyed kyis kho tsho'i ched dka' tshegs grangs med myong / khyed ni nor 'dzin ma'i bdag po yin la rtag par de'i ched du 'phags yong / nyin dkar gyi lha a thon/rlabs che ba'i khyab bdag khyed kyis rgyang thag ring ba'i phyi'i rgyal khab yod tshad bdag tu 'dzin la/ khyed kyis de dag la tshe srog gi rgyu ba stsol chos lugs 'di 'dra la/ lha khang bran bdag sku drag tshos ches dza drag pa'i skyon 'dzugs dang ngo rgol rang thebs yin pa smos med red/ yin na'ang /a smen a the pheb sku rabs bzhi bas mgo ma bsgur bar/ khos btsan thabs drag por brten nas a mon lha khang dang lha khang gzhan pa'i sgo brgyab cing de tsho'i btsun pa mthar bskud btang ba ma zad/ rgyal yongs kyi sa cha so sor(de ru the sbe si(166613'a lo)dngasi ri ya(3771 tshelko1༅)nuspim(sa'i61 za/cho༅)sogs kyang 'du)a thon gyi lha khang 'bor chen bzhengs bskrun byas

shing / lha a thon la zhing sa dang phyugs zog lag rtsal las ra sogs gnang /a mon mi rnams kyi sems ngos nas gtsang sel byed ched/ khos mi tshogs 'du sa dang sger gyi dur sa'i 6 a mon ’ zhes pa'i yi ge tshang ma med par bzo dgos pa'i bka' phab/ khos tha na rang gi ming las 66a mon zhes pa'i tshig(a mon ho the pheb ni ru a mon yid tshim pa zhes pa'i don)de 66a thon tu bcos shing / ming la 6 yi khe nā thon ’ zhes btags shing 6 a thon gyi gzi 'od ces pa'i don yin no//i khe nā thon gyi chos lugs bcos bsgyur khyab spel byas pa thal drag phyir/the spe si grong khyer nas 'dug bzod med par gyur/ de nas/ kho'i a mon btsun pa'i tshang rnying bskyur te/ the spe si'i byang phyogs su spyi le 300yis chod pa'i yod pa'i sil mo(skopo )mkhar grong gi nye 'dabs(deng sang gi thel yel a mar nā 16131 sal la rngoloṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha༅༅776)ri mtho g.yang gzar gyis bskor ba'i gshongs sa mthong yangs sheg rnyed la/ de ru rang nyid la gsar zhing rgyas spros che ba'i rgyal sa gsar ba zhig btsugs nas/ ming la tsa ye khe tha thon ( smo'i ༷sa)te tsa a thon gyi mthong rgya zhes pa'i don/grong khyer gsar ba'i mtha' mtshams kyi sa khongs a thon gyi rgyu nor yin pa khyab bsgragasakhyas/ sa khongs 'di'i rgya khyon la ha lam spyi le gru bzhi ma 180yod/rgyas spros gyi pho brang dang blon chen sku drag gi gzim shag rgyal khab kyi las khungs dang a thon gyi lha khang sogs bzo bkod mang po zhig rgyal sa gsar ba ru krong nger 'gying 'dug 'di ni bran g.yog 'bum phrag du ma'i ngal rtsol las thon pa'i rlabs chen gsar btod cig yin/i khe nā thon dang lhan du rgyal sa gsar ba ru spo mkhan khrod kho'i blon po dang lha a thon gyi btsun pa las/ da dung sgyu rtsal pa mang po zhig yod/ kho tsho'i skye khungs sku drag yin min la nges pa med kyang / rang dbang mi ser 64rdo sna'u

khu yi khrod nas bdam thon byung ba'i stobs ldan dpon gsar ba red/ mi 'di dag gis rtag par rang gi khyim rgyud mtho ba mi ngoms par/ kho tsho'i go sa spar mkhan h+pha rog gi bka' drin yin pa ngoms par byed/ mā e zhes pa'i blon chen zhig gis rang gi zangs yig tu 'di ltar bris yod de/ 6 nga rang de snga ni rgyu nor med pa'i mi zhig yin/ pha ma gnyis kyi cha nas bshad na ne+e mu'u khu zhig las ma 'das/ da lta rgyal pos nga rang bskrun byung / rgyal pos nga la bstsal cing gnang ba dag ni bye ma ji bzhin bgrang gis ga la longs bdag gi a thon bzhin mkhyen dpyod yangs shing / bden don yo med skyong ba'i rgyal po ya/ khyod kyi bslab bya dang gdam pa snying la sim pa dag gis ni ji 'dra'i bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba rol bzhin 'dug ang / i khe nā thon gyis mā i dang rigs gyur pa'i 6 mi gsar ba ’ la brten nas sku drag dpon rnying dag la ngo rgol byas te bcos bsgyur khyab spel btang /i khe nā thon gyis dus mtshungs su rtsom rig sgyu rtsal skor gyi bcos bsgyur la'ang blo phyogs te/ ji bzhin brjod pa'i lam nas 'jig rten 'bri bzhengs byed pa dang srol rgyun gyi rnam pa tshang mar ngo rgol byas te/ rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gsar rtsom la sngar med rang dbang stsol ba'i blang bya bton/ lha a thon la sngar bas dad 'dun byed du 'jug ched/ i khe nā thon gyis rtsom rig sgyu rtsal pa rnams la lha a thon gyi bstod glu dang a thon dang i khe nā thon gyi snang brnyan mtshon pa'i dngos srid ring lugs kyi brtsams chos(dper na〈〈a thon gyi bstod smon〉〉dang i khe nā thon dang btsun mo ne+e h+pher the tha (2〉po(4)yi 'jimabarnyan dang ri mo gzhan pa sogs lta bu)rtsom par skul ma chen po byas/mi rnams kyis dpon po'i dur ldebs ngos su/ i khe nā thon gyi khyim tshang 'tsho ba mtshon pa'i ri mo rnyed la/ de ru kho dang btsun mo/ sras mo tsho shing rtar ba/kā de nyi ma'i lha mchod du 'gro ba'i ri mo dang / da rung kho dang sras mo

gnyis rtsed mor rol ba'i ri mo'ang yod/ sgyu rtsal pa tshor i khe nā thon gyi snang brnyan 'bri dus 'tsher snang ci yang med de/ dur ldebs ngos su i khe nā thon gyisakho'i pang du bsdad pa'i bu mo la 'o byed pa'am khos byis pa la kha rtse pa/yang na za ma hab za byed pa dang lag tu sha chen po bzung yod pa sogs bris yod/ sgyu rtsal brtsams chos 'di dag srol rgyun shugs rkyen gyi bkag rgya las thar te/ ri mo dang rdo brkos sogs gson nyams dod pa'i dngos srid ring lugs phyogs la 'phel rgyas byung yod pas/ gna' bo'i rgyal rabs skabs kyi gu dog bag 'khum gyi lag thabs las grol te rjes phyogs kyi e jib kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi 'phel rgyas la shugs rkyen chen po thebs par byas pas/ dus rabs kyi mtshams dbye ba'i don snying ldan/i khe nā thon gyi bcos bsgyur la goms srol ltar na 6 chos lugs bcos bsgyur ram mu chos lugs gsar brje zhes zer/ chos lugs kyi thad du i khe nā thon gyis lha gcig mchod pa'i chos gtan 'bebs byas la/ de'i dmigs yul ni rgyal po'i srid dbang sger gcod kyi dbang gcig chod pa btsugs te/ the spe si btsun pa tshogs pa'i nyin rer rgyas bzhin pa'i stobs shugs la rdung deg dang nyams dmas su gtong rgyu de yin/ 'on kyang / i khe nā thon gyi bcos bsgyur de kho na las mtshams bzhag pa zhig min par/ des btsun pa'i tshogs pa rnying ba'i mnga' khongs dang rgyu nor 'phrogs la/ 6 mi gsar ba dpon chen la bskos shing dngos srid ring lugs kyi sgyu rtsal gsar rtsom la skul ma btang ba la sogs pa'i byed thabs rab dang rim pa 'di dag chos lugs bcos bsgyur kho na'i khyab khongs las 'gongs pas chab srid gsar bcos kyi 'gul skyod cig tu gyur yod/ yin yang / bcos bsgyur gyi rgyal kha ni re zhig tsam las sra brtan rgyun 'jags sheg ma yin/ i khe nā thon 'das nas cung ma 'gor bar kho'i bcos bsgyur kyang mjug gril/ 3/'i

rigs sras sam rgyal rgyud 'dzin mkhan thu'u than kha mon(15 tha ji'i sku ba)kyis yab kyi bcos bsgyur kyi rgyun ma bsrings/ the spe si btsun pa tshogs pa'i gnon shugs 'og tu/ thu'u than kha mon gyis sgrig srol rnying ba dang lha a mon la dad pa byed pa slar gso byas shing / rgyal sa'ang the spe si la gnas spor byas/rang gi ming las 6 a thon zhes pa 66a mon la bsgyur te 6 thu'u than a mon zhes bos shing / de ni 8 a mon gyi snang brnyan gson po ’ zhes pa'o//dmag dpon las byung ba'i kha rem khe spu(ṣ+ṭhasto/)lo rko) (spyi lo sngon gyi 1342lor)yis srid dbang bzung rjes/ i khe nā thon gyi bcos bsgyur rtsa ba med par bzos/ chos lugs kyi phyi gos g.yogs pa'i dbang sgyur gral rim gyi nang khul 'thab rtsod de mtha' mar the sbo si btsun pa tshogs pa rnam par rgyal nas mjug rdzogs so//de na/ i khe nā thon gyi bcos bsgyur ci'i phyir pham par dbye zhib byas na rgyu rkyen gtso bo gnyis yod de/ dang po/ a mon lha khang btsun pa'i tshogs pa dang de'i rgyab skyor mkhan tsho'i chab srid steng dang bsam blo'i steng gi stobs shugs ni ha cang che la g.yo med mkhregs 'dzin yin pas/ kho tshos bcos bsgyur la sdang zug che tsam dang zhe 'khon drag tu 'dzin pa ste/ tha na h+pha rog i khe nā thon yang gsod grabs byas/ i khe nā thon 'das nas cung ma 'gor bar/ kho tshos 'phral mar stobs shugs rtsa 'dzugs kyis ngo rgol bgyis te bcos bsgyur yin log tu sgrub la/ i khe nā thon ni tsa gnam 'og gi nag nyes can yin zhes bshad/ lo rgyus yig tshang ltar na/ i khe nā thon rgyal sa gsar bar spo dus/ kho'i pha ma gnyis lhan skyod byed ma 'dod par the spe si yi pho brang rnying ba ru bsdad/ zhi khe nā thon gyis srid dbang lo bcu gnyis la bskyangs ring / a mon ho the pheb sku rabs gsum pa tshe las 'das pa dang /rgyalas sbyam tha'e yis (cho7)rgyal nang gi 'thab rtsod 'jags ched/ rgyal sa

gsar bar phebs nas i khe nā thon la bcos bsgyur mtshams 'jog dgos tshul gyi kha ta byas/ de las tha na i khe nā thon gyi pha ma gnyis kyis kyang bcos bsgyur la 'khang ra dang ngo rgol byed pas na bcos bsgyur la mdun lam legs po zhig med pa zhir la rtogs thub/ gnyis pa/ bcos bsgyur ni mi nyung shas shig gis btsan gyis spel ba yin phyir rgya che'i dmangs tshogs kyi rgyab skyor thob med/ i khe nā thon gyi sems shugs gtso bo chos lugs bcos bsgyur steng la bzhag nas rgyal srid la do snang ma byas pas/ rgya che'i mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba la legs bcos spu tsam yang ma byung ba dang / ar las bzo skrun rgya che la grangs mang ba ste rgyal bo'i pho brang dang gzim shag lha khang sogs gsar bzhengasabyas khar rgyal sa gsar ba rgyan spras pa/ bran g.yog bdag po chung 'bring las byung ba'i sku drag gsar bar gtang rag mang du gnang bas/ mi dmangs kyi khur po je lci ru mi 'gro rang 'gror song / de'i phyir/ bcos bsgyur la mang tshogs kyi rmang gzhi med tshe de ni mi rtag sgyu ma'i rmi lam dang gnyis su med do//yis nā thon gyi bcos bsgyur pham song na'ang / srid khrir bzhugs ma thag pa'i dbang bsgyur pa gsar bas kyang byed thabs re 'ga' spyad de/ bran bdag gral rim nang khul gyi 'brel ba legs sgrig dang / i khe nā thon gyi rgyab rten bran bdag chung 'bring gi khe phan la dbugs dbyung dang srung skyob mi byed ga med byung / de'i dmigs yul ni bran g.yog dang zhing pa'i ngo rgol 'thab rtsod la drag gnon nus ldan byed phyir yin/ de bas 'di dag ni rgya che'i bran g.yog dang zhing pa mang tshogs kyi sdug bsngal dang gnya' gnon gyi 'byung khungs su gyur yod/ 41

gna' mi'i dbe cha ste/ 'jim dpar so phag dang shog rtswa/lug wags dang cag leb/son hran/ya thog gi mi la yi ge med/ yi ge byung ba la snga gzhug yod na'ang phal cher gral rim spyi tshogs dang lhan du byung ba zhig red/ yi ge yod tsa na de 'brel du 'ongs pa ni 'bri byed kyi yo byad kyi gnad don yin/ rgyu cha ci zhig bkol nas 'bri ba de tshad nges can zhig gi steng nas rang byung khams kyis khyod la ci zhig mkho sprod byas pa dang / mi'i rigs kyis rang byung khams la rgyus lon ga chod byas yod par rag las yod/gna' bo'i gtsang bo gnyis kyi 'bab rgyud(deng sang gi yi rag chakhrims khul)kyi dpal yon gsar gtod byed mkhan ni su sme ri a(357011 2ba smor+sālo)pa yin/ kho tshos phal cher spyi lo sngon gyi 40)lhatha bzung / the gu ne+e si (1180321 rngu ṭhaṣ+ṭha༅7)gtsang bo dang le'u h+pha re dzi(249618 0 mkhri' )gtsang bo'i smad rgyud du gtan sdod byas yod/ spyi lo sngon gyi 300)lo yas mas su mkhar grong rgyal khab skor zhig btsugs pa dang bstun nas yi ge'ang byung /'di ru rang byung thon khongs ha cang dkon pas shing dang rdo ba sogs mang shos sa cha gzhan nas dbor dgos/ 'on kyang / de na spus legs pa'i 'dam sa zhig yod pa des rdza chas bzo thub pa ma zad/ rtswa ldum bsres nas sa phag bsdidī na khang pa brtsigs chog su sme ri pas tha na sa 'dam 'di spyad nas yi

ge'ang 'bri bar byed de/ kho tshos nam rgyun sa 'dam des sa leb mthug po min pa bzo zhing rlon pa yin sgang la shing gzhog nas smyu gu rnon po bcos te de'i steng du yi ge'i brda rtags 'dra min 'bri ba dang / de rjes 'dam leb de skom pa'am yang na bsregs nas 'jim dpar so phag tu bsgyur/ de bas na stong yangs la zhabs dog pa'i khyi'u dbyibs yi ge bstar ma re re shar mar mngon yong / yi ge 'di la 6 yi ge khyi'u dbyibs ma ’ zer la/ mdzer mgo dang cung 'dra phyir zhe yi ge mdzer mgo ma mi yang zer/ yi ge khyi'u dbyibs ma 'di dus phyi'i sba sbi lon(2 skya/00 ༅77)pa dnga.a si ri ya(433711 ༅7)pas dang len byas pa ma zad/ gtsang bo gnyis kyi 'bab rgyud phyi rol gyi rgya che'i sa khul la'ang shugs rkyen thebs par byas te/ dper na/ nyi tha'i thi si (51 1 63blo a she ya chung ba'i gna' bo'i rgyal khab cig)dang si ri ya/dbyi rang(178bakhya 7)sogs sa khul gyis de ga rang gi skad yig mtshon byed kyi yo byad byed myong / yi ge khyi'u dbyibs ma ni spyi lo sngon gyi nyis stong lo nas spyi lo sngon gyi chig stong lo'i dus dkyil bar gyi e sha ya nub ma'i spyi spyod pa'i yi ge yin la/ gtsang bo gnyis kyi 'bab rgyud dang hi tha'e thi si rgyal pos gal te e jibat+pa rog bar phan tshun 'phrin yig bskur ba'am phyi 'brel gyi yig cha brje res byed tshe spyir btang du yi ge khyi'u dbyibs ma'i 'jim dpar so phag h+pha rog gi pho brang du dbor nas lo tsā bgyi'o// bgrang bya stong phrag 'ga'i ring la/bgrang gis mi lang pa'i 'jim dpar so phag mang po snga mo nas sa 'og tu byings/ gna' rdzas brtag dpyad rig pa'i dka' spyad 'bad brtson kyis 'jim dpar so phag 'di dag yang bskyar mi tsho'i mthong lam du drangs/gna'aphas sngog 'don byed na ched las shes bya 'dzoms dgos pa ma zad bya ba'i brgyud rim yang ha cang zhib tshags yin/ 'di nas dus rabs phyed ku'i sngon dbyin ji'i gna' rdzas brtag dpyad rig pa ba char le si wo li(rku//114

67bgo yoX/05 tshom )yis phur(pung po)gna' mkhar sngog 'don byas pa dper drangs na/ lur zer ba ni yi'u h+pha ra dzi gtsang bo'i smad rgyud nub 'gram du chags la spyi lo sngon gyi lo rabs sum stong pa'i dus mjug gi su sme ri ya ba'i grong khyer stobs shugs can zhig yin/ 1922lo nas bzung /wo li yis sne khrid pa'i gna' rdzas brtag dpyad ru khag gis gnas 'di nas bya ba lo bcu lhag la bsgrubs te/ pho brang dang lha khang / de min dur sa stong lhag sngog 'don byas par/ shul rdzas 'dra min sna tshogs dang yi ge khyi'u dbyibs ma can gyi 'jim dpar so phag mang po rnyed pa red/ 'jim dpar so phag de dag ma gzhi sra mo yin yang sa nang du sbas nas lo ngo stong phrag du ma 'gor bas/detsho sngog 'don byas dus ha lam tsa sran snyigs ’ ji bzhin sob sob yin la bsgul tu mi btub par gyur yod/ da lta ci byas na 'grig gam/ yig gzugs kha tshang ba nyar tshags byed ched/ gna' rdzas brtag dpyad rig pa bas thabs bkod legs po zhig 'then pa ni/ sa snum gyi zo ba mang po bsdus nas sems chung ngang 'jim dpar so phag re re bzhin zo ba'i nang la bcug cing / bye mas zo ba'i nang gi stong gseng tshang ma gsab/ de nas me chen sbar nas drag tu bsregs/ 'jim dpar so phag 'di rigs kyi sngar yod kyi 'byar sa'i nus pa nyams med pas sngar gyi sra tshad sor chud byung / de ltar thum brgyab nas yo rob gling du dbor zhing / yi ge khyi'u dbyibs ma mkhyen pa'i ched las mkhas pa tshor lo 〈(yig rigs 'di dus rabs bcu dgu ba'i dus dkyil la lo tsā byed thub song)byed du bcug gna' rdzas brtag dpyad rig pa bas wur(67)tsam ma zad/ sa cha gzhan yang yi ge khyi'u dbyibs ma brkos yod pa'i 'jim dpar so phag rnyed de/ dper na a si ri ya yi gna' bo'i rgyal sa rnying ba ne+e ne we(deng sang gi i rag smo sul(50301chakhrim lo7)gyi / shāragram)nas spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs bdun pa'i a si ri ya btsan rgyal

gyi 6 a si ri ya bha ne+e pho dpe mdzod khang ’ rdzog 'don byas/ de'i nang du yi ge khyi'u dbyibs ma'i 'jim dpar so phag khri gnyis lhag sbas yod/ gna' bo'i sba sbe lon dus rabs kyi snyan rtsom grags can yang 'di las rnyed pa red/ hi tha'e thi si'i gna' bo'i rgyal sa rnying ba ha thu sa si(deng sang tur ki'i pho sga tsi khu i lha(777547)7)nas rnyed pa'i yi ge khyi'u dbyibs ma'i pa'i 'jim dpar so phag nang du spyi lo sngon gyi lo rabs nyis stong gi dus dkyil gyi hi tha'e thi si rgyal khab kyi khrims srol dang phyi 'brel yig cha sogs mchis/ nye ba'i lo la/ gna' rdzas brtag dpyad rig pa bas si ri ya byang phyogs kyi a leb pho'i(sa/'batso lo77)nye 'gram du e sbi lā(2618 777)gna' mkhar gyi shul rjes sngog 'don byas par yi ge khyi'u dbyibs ma'i 'jim dpar so phag khri phrag 'ga' rnyed/ ched las mkhas pas thog ma'i zhib 'jug ltar na/spyi lo sngon gyi lo rabs sum stong pa'i dus mjug la e sbi lā yis sa khul de ru go gnas gal che ba zhig bzung yod/ tag tag 'jim dpar so phag gi dpe cha 'di dag gis nga tshor nye shar gna' bo'i lo rgyus la zhib 'jug byed pa'i rgyu cha /gal chen po mkho sprod byas/ dpe cha de tsho'i rin thang ni yi ge ma yin pa'i lo sgyurgyus rgyu cha gang gis kyang 'gran bzod pa zhig ma yin/ nga tshos 'jim dpar so phag dpe cha de tsho 'bri mkhan gyi rtsom pa po tsho brjed mi nyan mod kyi/ 'on te nga tshos de tsho su yin pa ci ltar shes thub/gna' bo'i e jib kyi yi ge'i byung ba ni phal cher gtsang bo gnyis kyi 'bab rgyud las kyang snga/ e jib tu rdo 'bor chen yod pas/ chos lugs kyi rang bzhin nam dran rten gyi rang bzhin yod pa'i yi ge mang che ba rgyun du rdo ngos su bko ba red/ deng sang gi ljongs rgyu ba tshos rngam brjid ldan pa'i the sbi si'ikhar nā khe (5lhangs 'a mo pom)lha khang (a mon lha khang) dang gtor gzugs mchod rten nang du rdo'i ka chen dang brag ngos su gas/sa

yi ge khye'u dbyibs ma can gyi 'jim dpar so phagadabyibs rnam pa sna tshogs kyi 'dra gzugs yi ge mang po bris yod pa mthong thub/ tshode dag ni thob dka' ba'i sgyu rtsal brtsams chos su grub tshar gshis//ste/ /ste/ //shā /sheg (re//sgro1 snye/ji /ste/ /ste/ /15nga da lag sa mkhas pa ra bsngags ba da dbang da du 'a ra thabs med pa yin/ 'on kyang gna' bo'i e jib yi ge(lhag par du rjes sor :rdo tshor 15 (spothe/ /de she2/tshe sheg mig shegi :go skyesgom 'gyur byas pa' ra yang ) ga ba ga rtswa' nga du sa da/shog rtswa ni ne le gtsang bo'i zur gsum gling gi na 'dam du skyes pa'i 'dam rtswa ring mo zhig las thon zhing rtse mor spu shad chen po zhig btsugs yod pa dang 'dra/ e jib kyi ldebs ris su gna' bo'i e jib pas gru chung bskor nas na 'dam nas 'dam rtswa 'thu ba'i ngang tshul ri mor bris yod/ 'dam rtswa 'di la bkol sa mang po yod de/ khu ba 'thung chog la cod pa za chog cing / de'i tshi sna ha cang sra mkhregs yin phyir spyang grung ldan pa'i e cib pas de yis lham dang gru chang bzo ba ma zad shog ba'ang bzo ba red/ gna' bo'i e jib pa'i 475 ra rang

shog bu ci ltar bzos pa yin zhe na/ kho tshos 'dam rtswa'i rtsad pa gri rtse'am khab mgos gzhog cing / bzhogs zin pa'i rtswa'i khod ji 'dra yangs na de 'dra bzang bar brtsi/ de nas bzhogs pa'i rtswa leb re re bzhin mthud de sdong spyin gyis sbyar nas drang blangs te skem par byas na shog bur gyur pa yin la/ de nas rus pa'am nya lcibs kyi phyi skogs kyis brdar nas 'od 'don/ shog rtswa gcig la ring tshad khru tsi 'ga' 'am bcu phrag 'ga'/ ring bar khru tsi brgya phrag yod/ ched gnyer gyi 6 zin bris mkhan tshos de'i steng du byang cha ldane pa'i ngang yi ge 'bri thub/ sprug gu ni 'dam rtswa'i sog ma'i rtse mo bzhigs nas grub pa yin/ snag tsha la bsgres(dud khung gi thal ba la sdong 'gyig gam 'gyig chu bsres pa)nas yi ge 'bri/ shog rtswa ma gzhi nas cung 'jam pa dang snag tsha 'di yang mi legs pas yi ge bris na tshos mdog yal sla ba red/ ya mtshar ba ni 'dam rtswa'i sog ma kho na bzhogs na smyug gur mi 'gyur bas da rung rtse mo phyed gnyis su gshag dgos/ gal te srubs ka chung ngu 'di med na snag tsha snyoms por bzhur mi thub/ khyod kyis thengs dang por smyug rtse phyed gnyis su gshag mkhan de ni gsar gtod pa chung chung zhig ma red ces bshad thub bam/shog rtswa'i shog bu ha cang ring phyir mi tshos chod tshan bgos nas yi ge 'bri dgos byung / shog rtswa la skyon cha zhig yod pa ni lteb dka' la lteb pa na gas hral byung sla ba de red/ de bas e jib pas shog leb kyi mtha' ma der dbyug pa zhig btegs nas bsgril(krung go'i srol rgyun gyi ri mo ji bzhin)bar byed/'di ltar yi ge 'bri ba dang klog pa/ bsnams pa sogs cung stabs bde bar gyur/ shog rtswa sgril ma gcig gam kha shas kyis dpe cha zhig 'grub thub la/ mi rnams kyis shog rtswa sgril ma phon chen sle bo ru bcug nas rgyab la 'khur ba'am phrag tu khur nas 'gro chog shog rtswa ni gna' bo'i e jib kyi khyad thon dngos rdzas shig yin zhing / shog rtswa bzo skrun byed pa'i lag shes bzo khang dkā spyag

rtswa'i tshong gnyer ba'i las don ni srid gzhung gis mi mngags nas do dam byed kyin yod/ shog rtswa ༷ 95'o(nga bzang ngan byin dbye ba pethotham de/ bshadathothoshā5 / riltar na 'dam rtswa'i tsan pa ni ches bzang la de yis / ṇi bzos pa'i shog bu'ang sra zhing 'jam pas 6 lha dpe zho// ('bri shog ces 'bod/ e jib kyi shog rtswa ni khyim mtshes rgyal khab so sor btsong ba ma zad/ rjes sor yo rlob gling du gtos chen po dbor 'dren byas par/ ke re si ba dang ro ma bas dus yan ring po gna' bo'i e jib pas zhig la shog rtswa rgyun spyod kyi 'bri shog byas/ shog rtswa shog rtswa btu bzhin pa/yi ming ngo ma ni 662897go3 yin la deng sang gi dbyin skad du 6628tshong (shog bu)dang / h+pha ran si dang 'jar man gyi 66289161 (shog bu)zhes pa dang / u ru su'i skad yig nang gi 66289ji (bathabastu shog leb)tshang ma yi ge de las byung ba yin/ gna' rdzas brtag dpyad rig pa bas e jib kyi gtor gzugs mchod rten dang sa 'og gi dur khang las shog rtswa'i dpe cha pod mang po rnyed(gna' bo'i e jib yi ge dus rabs bcu dgu pa nas tshur sgyur byed thub song)/ de ru gna' bo'i e jib spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i phyogs so so bris yod la mang che shos ni chos lugs rmongs dad dang 'brel ba yod/ shog rtswa la zhib 'jug byed rgyur ched gnyer gyi shes yon zhig grub yod cing de la phu shog rtswa rig pa ’ zhes brjod/ de ni gna' bo'i lo rgyus rig pa la med du mi rung ba'i ram 'degs tshan khag zhig yin/ghi ri si can du bsgyur pa'i dus rabs(spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs gcig pa nas bzhi ba'i bar)la slebs dus/ e jib ni tho lu me'u rgyal rabs kyi dpa~X bsgyur skabs yin la/ dus der/ zur gsum gling nub phyogs kyi a le

sge gzan sder grong khyer 'phel rgyas su song ste sa dbus rgya mtsho'i shar khul gyi rig gnas kyi lte ba ru gyur yod/ phu tho le smo si(2 0107403677)rgyal rabs ni chab srid dang dpal 'byor thad ha cang stobs 'byor ldan la/ rgyal po rim byon gyis yon tan pa la gzengs bstod byed pa dang / a le sge gzan sder grong khyer gyi dpe mdzod khang du shog rtswar bris pa'i dpe cha pod 'bum drug nas bdun lhag nyar yod la/ 'jon ldan mkhas dbang mang po ma bos rang 'du byed pas na/ don dngos su skabs de'i rgyal spyi rang bzhin can gyi slob grwa chen mo tshad la bslebs yod ces brjod chog yin yang / spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs gsum pa'i skabs e sha ya chung ba ru pher sga mum(26728757 7meb6)zhes pa'i rgyal khab cig byung la/ de gas chab srid dang dpal 'byor thadas jib dang 'gran ya mi yong na'ang rig gnas sgyu rtsal thad 'jon thang ngoms nas/ rim bzhin phu tho le smo si rgyal rabs kyi do zla ru gyur/ pha ca mā yis ghi ri si'i sgyu rtsal srol rgyun rgyud 'dzin byas pas bzo bkod brkos ris thad la mtho tshad gsar ba zhig tu son cing khyad chos khyad par can zhig gsar gtod byas/ lhag par du rgyal sa pher sga mum grong khyer tu dpe mdzod khang zhig bzhengs la der nyar tshags byas pa'i dpe cha phun sum tshogs pas mtshan snyan grags skad cig gis rgyas shing de'i shugs rkyen nyin re bzhin je cher song /phu tho le smo si rgyal rabs de la thugs ma dgyes par rig gnas steng gi sger sdem go gnas rgyun 'khyongs byed ched bkag 'gog byed thabs lag bstar byas te/ e sha ya chung bar shog rtswa skyel 'dren byed pa gtan 'gog bya ba'i bka' phab/ de ni pher sga mum rgyal rabs la mtshon na rdung ldeg cig yin pas thabs shes gzhan mi 'then ka med byung bar/ kho tshos shog rtswa'i tshab tu lug lpags kyi shog bu gsar gtod byas/ pher sga mum gyi rgyal pos ko mnyen mkhan byang ma(gna' dus lag rtsal 'di la nam rgyun mthong chung byed//da
