pa'i bka' phab nas yun ring po ma 'gor bar 'bri shog gsar ba zhig gsar gtod byas/ kho tsho'i bzo thabs ni 'di ltar yin te/ lug lpags rdo thal gyi rgyu yod pa'i chu yi nang du sbangs nas bal dang pags pa snyi mor gyur tshe chu nas phyir blangs shing / gri yis bal bzhar nas rdo thal dkar po btab nas mnyed 'phurabyas te mthar drang len 'od 'don gyi rim pa brgyud na lug lpags kyi shog bu zhig da gzod thon thub pa red/ lug lpags kyi shog bu la rtswa shog las bzang cha mang po yod de/ lteb sgril byas chog pa dang chag hral 'byung mi sla ba/rtswa shog gi ngos gcig la ma gtogs yi ge 'bri mi thub na'ang lug lpags kyi shog bu'i ngos gnyis kur 'bri thub pa/ rtswa shog sgril pa tsam las byed mi thub na'ang lug lpags kyi shog bu gtub nas dpe deb tu bzo chog la 'khyer rgyu yang ha cang stabs bde mo yin/ pher sga mum rgyal rabs ni spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs gnyis pa'i dus mjug la nub(ro mas gtor) mod/ 'on kyang de rjes kyi lo mang po'i ring la sngar bzhin lug lpags shog bu'i thon khungs gtso bo ru gyur/ shog bu rigs 'di la lo rgyus steng du 6 pher sga mum gyi shog bu ces ming thogs yod/ lug lpags shog bu la'ang bzang ngan gyi dbye ba yod la ji 'drasab la ji 'dra 'jam na rin gong yang de dang de 'drar mtho phyir/ lu gu'i lpags pas bzos pa'i lug lpags shog bu ni 'bri shog rtsa chen po ru gyur/lug lpags shog bu'i ma rtsa mtho bas rtswa shog lta bur kun khyab tu song med pa smos ma dgos/ ro ma'i dus skabs dang dus rabs bar ma'i yo rob tu lug lpags shog bu la rin gong ches mtho bas dpon chen mi drag tshos ma gtogs spyod thub kyi med/ sku drag la las lug lpags dpe cha'i steng du gser skud dngul rgyan dang / rin po che'i phra rgyan bkod de/ kho tsho'i stobs dang 'byor phyug ngoms par byed/ rtswa shog tu bris pa'i dpe cha'i las dbang de 'dra bzang rgyu swāhā/sa 'og tu bcug yod pa'i rtswa shog gi dpe cha mang po zhig rul la/ a

le sge gzan ༅7 sder grong khyer gyi dpe mdzod khang mes 'tshig nas tshar)la/ lug lpags shog bur bris pa'i dpe cha'i las dbang de bas kyang ya mtshar te/ gna' nas nyar pa'i lug lpags shog bur bris pa'i dpe cha mang po med khar de dag ni gna' rabs 'dzam gling gi rtsa che ba'i rig gnas shul rdzas shig yin na'ang / gna' bo'i dus rabs bar ma'i skabs la bslebs tshe gnam bdag chos tshogs kyis lha smra ba'i dbang grags 'dzugs phyir/ gna' rabs kyi tshan rig rig gnas 6 lta log ’ tu brtsis nas gtor skyon tshad med byas la lug lpags shog bur bris pa'i dpe cha'ang god chag de las thar ma thub/ chos tshogs kyi lug lpags shog bur bris pa'i dpe cha bsub bcos rgyag pa'i ched las grwa pa skor zhig gsos yod la/ don dngos su grwa pa 'di dag ni gna' rabs kyi rig gnas rtsa med du gtong ba'i lag dmar yin/ stabs legs pa zhig la lug lpags shog bu ngos kyi snag tsha ni ci ltar bsub kyang rjes shul tsam lus 'gro bas/ gal te rdzas 'gyur gyi sman chu ge mo'i nang la bzhag tshe ma yig skor zhig mngon nas yong ba red/ yin yang mnar gcod de dag myangs tshar rjes de'i tshe thag kyang phal cher mtha' la son tshar 'dugakrungago ni dpal yon ldan pa'i gna' bo'i rgyal khab cig yin/ spyi lo sngon gyi nyis stong lo yas mas(zha rgyal rabs)nas yi ge byung yod/ krung go'i gna' rabs su 'bri thabs la rnam pa cung mang po yod/ yen hrang skabs kyi dbang bsgyur mkhan gyis 6 rus brkos mo yig (mo 'debs pa'i yi ge)rus sbal gyi shun skogs dang rus pa'i steng du brkos yod pa de la 6 rus skogs yi ge ’ zer/ yen krug skabs su zangs yig(mi r+sā yang zer)cig yod la de ni yi ge li chas kyi ngor blug pa'am brkos pa de'o/ 'di dag ni lo rgyus zhib 'jug bya ba'i thog ma'i rgyu cha yin yang de dpe cha ngo mar brtsi mi rung / rang rgyal gyi lo rgyus ches ring ba'i dpe deb ni 6 smyug leb dpe cha 7yin la 5ni ge

smyug ma'i steng du bris pa de'o/ smyug ma gcig deng sang nga tsho'i shog leb gcig dang mtshungs shing smyug leb mang po zhig thag pas bsdams tshe dpe deb cig tu grub yong / han rgyal rabs kyi sngon du dar 'jam gyi steng du yi ge 'bri ba'ang yod/ yin yang dar gos rigs 'di gong mtho bas mang tshogs phal ba'i nang bkol thub mkhan med/ smyug ma mang che ba 'bri chu'i lho phyogs nas thon yang 8 smyug leb dpe deb sa phyogs kun tu khyab yod/ dper na ming du grags pa'i〈〈smyug deb lo rtsis〉〉ni ho nan ci con 77 gyi kun ko'i skabs kyi bang so nas thon pa red/ bshad tshul ltar na smyug leb kyi dpe deb rlangs 'khor bcu phrag lhag thon zer/ 'di ni krung go'i gna' rabs kyi cung 'thus tshang ba'i lo rim lo rgyus (yid phangs pa zhig la ma dpe da lta ming gi lhag mar gyur)shig yin/ han rgyal rabs kyis chos dpe 'bri dus smyug leb kyi dpe deb kyi ring tshad la phal cher li smi lnga bcu nga lnga yod dgos pa dang / bka' lung 'bri dus de las cung ring dgos pa gtan la phab/ nam rgyun smyu gu'i yi ge ma bris gong smyug ma me la cung bsro dgos pa ma zad/ nang gi chu bskams shing smyug ma'i rtsad pa med 71par bzos rjes da gzod steng du yi ge 'bri nus/ 'di ni yi ge 'bri bde ba sprug deb/dang 'bus za ba 'gog ched yin zhes bshad srol yod/ gong du mtshams sbyor byas pa'i gna' rabs kyi 'bri shog gtso bo 'ga' ste 'jim dpar so phag dang rtswa shog lug lpags dang smyug leb sogs gang yinana'ang bed spyod byed dus stabs bde bo min/ nan tan gyis bshad na deX snang nga tsho'i spyod bzhin pa'i shog bu dang yang 'brel ba mang po med/

deng sang bkol khyab che ba'i shog bu ni shog bu bzo ba'i lag shes nas byung la shog bu bzo ba'i lag shes ni krung go nas byung ba yin/ spyir btang gi ngos zin la/ spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs dang po'i zhi han nas bzung rang rgyal gyis gso ma'i rigs kyi tshi sna spyad nas shog bu bzo 'go brtsams/ tong tan an gong ma'i dus la bslebs tshe hu'u nan gyi mi tsha'o lon gyis shog bu bzo ba'i lag shes je legs su btang ba ste/ khos tshod lta thengs mang brgyud nas sdong shun dang gso mgo rus rnying / nya rgya rnying pa sogs rgyu cha byas nas rtsi shing gi tshi sna'i shog bu bzos/ shog bu 'di rigs kyi rgyu cha rnyed sla la gong yang dma'/de nas bzung shog bu thon skyed kyi tshad ches cher je mang du song / shog bu bzo pa'i lag rtsal gsar gtod byas pas 'bri byed yo chas thad kyi dus rabs gsar ba zhig gi 'go bcoms/ mi rnams kyis krung gos gsar btod byas pa'i lag shes kyi shog bu bzo ba'i lag rtsal 'di'i rtsa ba'i rigs pa ni dus hā'i 'phrul 'khor gyi shog bu bzo ba'i ma dbyibs ngo ma yin pa khas len gyin da/ lo rgyus kyis nga tshor bshad don/ yo rob gling gi ghi ri si ba dang ro man pas rtswa shog dang lug lpags shog bu bed spyod byed bzhin pa'i dus su/ shar phyogs kyi krung go bas shog bu bzo ba'i lag rtsal 'di mi'i rigs kyi rig gnas las don la phul gnang mdzad yod/ 53

gna'aca'i sga ze 'og gyiphan thum khrimasa'ag/licanago/gtsang bo gnyis kyi 'bab rgyud la sme so pho tha me ya(54༷jiX chi41 thar+sār+sāpo7sko༅)yang zer la/ mi'i rigs kyi dpal yon dar sa'ang yin/gna' bo'i sba sbi lon sa khul gnas 'di ru chags yod/gtsang bo gnyis kyi 'bab rgyud kyi byang phyogs ni a si ri a(433771 ༅snu)dang lho phyogs ni sba sbi lon rna ya yin/ gna' snga mo'i spyi lo sngon gyi lo rabs bzhi stong gi dus mjug nas bzung / gtsang bo gnyis kyi 'bab rgyud du bran g.yog lam lugs kyi mkhar grong mnyam 'brel gyi rgyal khab mang po chags yod/ mkhar grong mnyam 'brel gyi rgyal khab ni nam rgyun mkhar grong gcig lte bar bzung ba'i mtha' 'khor ni zhing las sa khul yin pas grong khyer gyi rgyal khab ces kyang 'bod/ gtsang bo gnyis 'bab rgyud kyi dbang cha rtsod ched rgyal khab 'di dag gi bar du rgyun du dmag 'khrug mang po langs kyi yod/ ag kha sde a( smosmo 61 mardo )rgyal khab dang wur (67)rgyal rabs gsum pas(spyi lo sngon gyi 2113 spyi lo sngon gyi 2006lo)snga gzhug tu gtsang bo gnyis 'bab rgyud kyi lho phyogs gcig gyur byed myong / thengs gsum par sa 'di gcig gyur byed mkhan ni a mo ri the pa(sa700 4༅ lko1)yin/ sba sbi lon grong khyer ni le'u h+pha ra dze gtsang bo'i shar 'gram(6 sba sbi lon zhes pa ni lha tshokāswā 'du sa zhes pa'i don yin)na yod la/ gzhing rab tu gshin la 'grim

'grul shin tu stabs bde bas/ dpal 'byor dang rig gnas 'phel rgyas kyi cha rkyen legs po 'dzoms yod/ spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs bcu dgu ba'i dus 'gor/ se mu(5075yangan5071 spyos lo)rigs kyi a mo ri the pa rnams kyis sba sbi lon rgyal sa byas nas gna' bo'i sba sbi lon rgyal khab kyi rgyal rabs dang po btsugs(spyi lo sngon gyi 1894lo nas spyi lo sngon gyi 1595lo bar)shing /rgyal po drug pa han ma'o la bas kyi dus la(spyi lo sngon gyi 1792lo nas spyi lo sngon gyi 1750lo'i bar)bslebs tshe/ rgyal khab so so'i bar lo mang por g.yul 'khrug byung nas phan tshun nyams dmas su song yod pa'i glags dang bstun nas/ lo mang por dmag 'thab brgyab pa brgyud de gtsang gnyis 'bab rgyud gcig gyur byas te dkyil snying dbang cha gcig sdud can gyi bran g.yog lam lugs kyi rgyal khab stobs dang ldan pa zhig btsugs/ham mu ra pis(577751891 tshojoṣ+ṭha7)kyis srid skyong skabs kyi las 'gul chen po zhig ni khrims gzhung gtan la phab pa de red/ khrims gzhung 'di'i ma yig khyi'u dbyibs yi ge'i lam nas rdo ba'i ka zlum 'jong 'jong zhig gi steng du brkos te/ sba sbi lon grong khyer gyi brjid nyams ldan pa'i mar tu'u khu(sba sbi lon grong khyer gyi srung ma)lha khang chen po'i nang du bslangs yod/ khrims gzhung 'di ka zlum steng du brkos yod phyir mi rnams kyis de la〈〈ka zlum khrims lugs〉〉zer la/ rgyal po ham mu ra pis kyis gtan la phab pa yin pas〈〈rtam mu ra pis khrims gzhung〉〉yang zer/ham mu ra pis kyis khrims gtan la phab cing rdo ring btsugs pa ni rang nyid kyi dbang bsgyur srung 'dzin dang de la shugs snon rgyag pa las gzhan/kho'i rgyud 'dzin pa tshos kho pas gtan la phab pa'i khrims lugs kyi rtsa don ji bzhin lag bstar byas nas gna' bo'i sba sbi lon rgyal khab tshe tshe rabs rabs su dar zhing rgyas te sra zhing 'bas pa zhig yong rgyu'i re ba bcangs pa rdo /da/

yinana'ang / rgyal po ham mu ra pis tshe las 'das rjes/ gna' bo'i sba sbi lon de dmag 'khrug gi g.yang sar lhung ba ma zad/ stobs ldan du gyur pa'i a si ri a pa dang kha se the si ba'i(54ca 03 ༅7)rdung deg rtag tu bzed dgos byung bas/ rgyal khab kyi stobs shugs rim gyis nyams rgud du gyur/ ha lam spyi lo sngon gyi 1595lor/ gnar bo'i sba sbi lon gyi rgyal rabs dang po ni hi tha'e the si pas(51 1 /0lha 7)rmeg med du btang / de'i rjes su/gtsang bo gnyis kyi 'bab rgyud kyi bdag po thengs mang por brjes shing sba sbi lon grong khyer la yang gtor bshig thebs/ lha khang nang du bslangs yod pa'i ka zlum khrims yig gi rdo ring de'ang gar song cha med du gyur/lo ngo nyis stong brgya phrag lhag 'das pa'i rjes te spyi lo 1901lo'i zla dang po nas spyi lo 1902lo'i zla gnyis pa'i bar/ h+pha ran si'i gna' rdzas brtag dpyad ru khag cig gis i ran lho phyogs kyi su'u sa(5032smo )zer ba'i sa cha zhig tu gna' rdzas sngog 'don byas/ nyin zhig kho tshos sa 'og nas me grub brag rdo nag po zhig bton pa dang / nyin 'ga'i rjes su slar yang gnyis sngog 'don byas la/ rdo gsum po mnyam du bsgrigs pa na rdo leb 'jong 'jong zhig tu grub cing / rdo 'di'i ring tshad la li smi 225dang 'jong tshad la li smi 180yas mas yod/ rdo leb kyi mgo la 'bur brkos spus dag cig yod la mi sna'i snang brnyan gson nyams dod cing / rdo leb kyi rnga mar khyi'u dbyibs yi ge brgyad stong lhag brkos yod la yig gzugs legs shing gsal/ ched mkhas pas/ 'di ni rgyal po ham mu ra pis kyis mar sdu khe'i(577756 6los )lha khang chen mo ru bslangs pa'i ka zlum khrims yig gi rdo ring yin pa gsal 'byed byas/ su'u sa ni gna' bo'i sba sbi lon gyi shar phyogs na yod la sba4 lon grong khyer dang rgyang thag ring bas/ ka zlum khrims yig kyi rdo ring 'ardo sdu 'dir ci ltar slobs she na/ ma gzhir/ sa cha 'dir e lam(2137

ṣ+ṭha༅)zhes pa'i rgyal khab cig yod la bar skabs shig la ha cang dar stobs che ba byung / spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i dus 'gor/ sba sbi lon rgyal khab de hi tha'i the si rgyal khab kyis bsnubs nas lo sum brgya 'gor rjes/e lam pas gtsang bo gnyirme 'bab rgyud kyi lho phyogs la btsan rgol byas nas sba sbi lon grong khyer dang grong khyer gzhan pa bcom/ phal cher skabs der e lam pas ka zlum khrims lugs kyi rdo ring dmag thob dngos rdzas la brtsis nas rang nyidakyi rgyal sa su'u sa la khyer ba yin snyam/ kho tshos ma gzhir rdo ring steng gi 'bur brkos dang khrims lugs kyi don tshan dag bsub nas rang nyid kyi byas rjes bsko bar 'dod mod/ ci'i phyir yin pa mi shes mod mthar nyung ngu zhig las ma bsub la yi ge gsar pa'ang brkos med/ bsub zin pa dag gi nang don 'dam bzos dpe deb kha shas kyi nang nas kha gsab byed thub song / de las ldog tshe ji 'dra'i blo pham che ba bshad ma dgos/ka zlum khrims yig gi rdo ring bton rjes/ mi rnams kyis de ru ka zlum khrims yig gi las kyang gtan 'khel byas pa'i dus snga ba'i ba'i khrims yig gi yig cha hral hrul sngog 'don byas/ yig cha 'di dag cha kha ya sdeb yin pas de nang nas shes bya re gnyis tsam las thob mi thub phyir rin thang mi che/ de yang ka zlum khrims yig nyar tshags byas pa ha cang 'thus tshang yin pas gna' rabs sba sbi lon gyi spyi tshogs dang gna' rabs spyi la zhib 'jug byed pa'i ches rtsa che ba'i rgyu cha dang po yin/ ka zlum khrims yig gi rdo ring sngog 'don byas pa ni skabs de'i 'dzam gling yongs su skad grags khyab pa'i gna' rdzas brtag dpyad kyi gsar 'gyur zhig tu gyur yod/ h+pha ran si'i gna' rdzas brtag dpyad ru khag la de bas kyang dga' spro tshad med skyes shing / kho tshos dgun 'khyag grang ngar la ma 'jom par rdo ring lam seng h+pha ran si ru bskyal te ham 'dzinabyas/ da bar du ka zlum khrims yig gi rdo ring de pha ri si grong pa/ lte

ba'i lu'u h+pher(205516tshe lo)dngos mang 'grem ston khang du nyar yod/ka zlum khrims yig de le tshan gsum du bgos yod de/ gleng gzhi dang gzhung dngos/ mjug gi gtam mo// gleng gzhi thogasarnyesasnga radang mjug gi gtam snyan ngag gi rnam pa'i sgo nas ci 8 29 d+ku bris yod cing shog grangs yongs kyi lnga cha'i gcig 2kyi / zin/ gzhung dngos la don tshan nyis brgya dang brgyad cu gya gnyis yod/ brjod bya khyab che la phyogs so so nas gna' bo'i sba sbi lon gyi spyi tshogs kyi rnam pa mtshon yod pas/ gna' rabs kyi gtsang bo gnyis 'bab rgyud kyi spyi tshogs dang chab srid/ dpal 'byor la zhib 'jug byed pa'i rgyu cha yang dkon zhig yin/gna' bo'i sba sbi lon rgyal rabs ni bran g.yog lam lugs kyi rgyal pos srid dbang sger 'dzin byed pa'i dpe mtshon rgyal khab cig yin/de ru rgyal pos ches mtho'i dbang bsgyur go gnas bzung yod/ khos srid 'dzin dang khrims ham mu ra pis khrims 'dzugs/ khrims 'dzin/ dmag don bcas kyi yig rdo ring /dbang cha sger 'dzin byas yod cing blon chen bsko 'jog gis srid don la ram 'degs dang / am ban mngags nas sa gnas bdag skyong byed du 'jug krung dbyang dang sa gnas kyi zhi drag blon chen tshos thadakar rgyal po'i bka' la nyan dgos/ ka zlum khrims yig gi gleng gzhi'i nang du/ rgyal po ham mu ra pis kyis rang nyid kyi bla na med pa'i dbang cha de 'u༄ /ga byas yod la/ khos 6 an nu'u7(gnam gyi lha)dang 6 in ler

(su'us ri ya'i sa bdag)sogs lha yis rgyal khab rang la sprad nas dbang skyong byed du bcug phyir/ kho ni lha'i ngo tshab yin la/ 6 rgyal bo'o nang gi rgyal po ’ dang 6 su'u sme ri ya dang ag kha sde la 'od stong 'gyed pa'i sba sbi lon gyi nyi ma yin ces 'ud sgrog byas yod/ ka zlum khrims yig gi rdo ring gi rtse mo'i 'bur brkos su 6 rgyal po'i dbang cha lhas gnang ba'i gnas tshul gson nyams ldan par bris yod de/ g.yas phyogs su drang mor bsdad yod pa ni nyi ma'i lha hra ma si dang de'i kha sprod du gus pa'i ngang yar langs pa ni rgyal po ham mu ra pis yin/ nyi ma'i lhas rgyal po'i dbang cha mtshon byed kyi dbang rtags te ham mu ra bas la gnang bzhin yod/ 6 rgyal po'i dbang cha lhas gnang ba'i stong bshad ni rgyal po ham mu ra bas kyis rgyal khab dbang bsgyur byed pa'i bsam pa'i drag chas yin/gna' bo'i sba sbi lon rgyal po'i rgyal khab ni bran g.yog lam lugs kyi rgyal khab yin pas/ mi dang mi'i bar 'dra mnyam gtan nas min/ ka zlum khrims yig gis 'dra mnyam min pa 'di khas len gsal bo byas yod/ khrims gzhung du gzhis sdod pa de bran g.yog dang rang dbang can gyi mi gnyis su bkar yod la/ rang dbang can gyi mi yang rigs gnyis su bkar yod de/gcig ni rbad de rang dbang yod pa'i rang dbang can gyi mi yin la der a we lum((40/57 lo jo)zer zhing / cig shos ni dbang cha re 'ga' yod pa'i rang dbang can gyi mi ste de la mu'u si khe nam(553ji ba57 757)zer/ rang dbang can rigs 'di gnyis kyi khrims lugs kyi dbang cha'ang mi mtshungs/ khrims gzhung gtan khel byas don/ gal te a we lum yi yan lag bsnad par byas na de mtshungs yan lag la chad pa gcod pa dang / mu'u si khe nam yi yan lag bsnad par byas na thag gcod byas yod pa'i chad pa'i sgor mo phar sprad tshe gyod gzhi gril 'gro yang dper na/ sman pa zhig gis likā /ba

byung yod pa'i a we lum zhig la gshag bcos byas te legs 'grub byung tshe dngul hre khe le bcu'i/hre khe le gcig khe3 416yin)yon thob thub la/ gal te nad pa ni mu'u si khe nam zhig yin na yon la dngul hri khe le lnga las mi thob/bran bdag phal mo che a we lum ru gtogs shing gtso bo btsun pa dang sku dragazhi drag blon po dang tshong las kyi skyed lci'i bu lon gtong mkhan sogs yin/a we lum yi nang na bran bdag las da dung rang gi sa zhing rmo 'debs byed mkhan dang rang rkya 'pher ba'i lag shes bzo las pa yang yod/ mu'u si khe nam mang che ba dpal 'byor steng nas rgyal po'i pho brang la brten yod cing /la la ni pho brang la brten nas sa zhing dang khang pa sogs thob nas yar la 6 phyag rten 'bul mkhan ’ dang de tsho'i rjes rabs pa yin/ la la ni sa zhing dang khang pa thob kyang rgyun grabs dmag dpung gi dmag mi yin/ kho tsho'i go gnas ni gtan 'jags min zhing lan rer ma rtsa rdib nas bun g.yog dang lan rer bran bdag tu 'gyur shas kyang che/khrims gzhung du bran g.yog ni rang dbang can gyi rim pa gnyis kyi gzhug gi rim pa gsum pa ru bkar yod/ de'i 'byung khungs gtso bo ni tshur nyos pa'i bran g.yog dang yang na bun lon can gyi bran g.yog yin la/ de las kyang phyi ma de dus skabs 'dir 'phel rgyas chen por byung yod/ 'di'i rgyu mtshan ni gna' bo'i pa pu'u lun dus skabs kyi tshong rdzas dngul lor gyi 'brel ba dang skyed lci'i bu lon gtong mkhan myur drags kyis 'phel rgyas byung ba'i mjug 'bras yin/ bran bdag chung 'bring gis bran g.yog gsum dang lnga'i yan nam bcu lhag bdag bzung byas yod la/ rgyal po dang zhi drag blon chen/btsun pa thob thang mtho ba/ gzhan bran bdag chen po sogs kyis bran g.yog mang po bdag bzung byas yod la/ bran g.yog dang bran bdag gral rim ni gna~X bo'i sba sbi lon spyi tshogs kyi rtsa ba'i gral rim yin/

bran g.yog spyi tshogs kyi khyad chos gtso bo zhig ni bran bdag gis thon skyed rgyu cha yod khar/ thon skyed byed mkhan te bran g.yog kyang bdag bzung byas yod pa de red/ ka zlum khrims yig gis mngon gsal du bsgrags don/bran g.yog ni bran bdag gi sger nor yin phyir/ gang 'dod du btsong ba'am bshug chog la/ gta' mar kyang bzhag chog bran g.yog gcig gi khrom tshong rin gong ni spyir btang du dngul hru khu lu nyi shu yin la/ rin gong de ni skabs de'i ba glang gcig gi rin gong dang 'dra mtshungs yin/ bran g.yog la khrims lugs steng du dbang cha ci yang med/ bran g.yog gsod pa'am bsnad pa ni rmo phyugs sam dngos rdzas gang rung zhig brlag pa nang bzhin khrims 'gal gyod don la mi brtsi zhing nyes 'gan yang 'khur mi dgos par/ bran g.yog gi bdag por dpal 'byor gyi skyin tshab cung zad 'jal bas chog pa red/khrims gzhung du thag gis bcad don/ su zhig gis bran g.yog gi mig zhar du bcug na bran g.yog de'i rin gong gi phyed ka tsam bran bdag la skyin tshab tu sprad pas chog la/ de ga ba glang zhig gi mig zhar du bcug dus kyi chad pa dang gcig mtshungs yin/ bran g.yog gi tshe srog dang bde thang la khag theg ci yang med pa ma zad/ bran g.yog gis bran bdag la phog thug cung tsam btang tshe gtum drag gi chad pa nan mo gcod nges/ khrims gzhung du ltar na/ bran g.yogagacig gis rang gi bran bdag la 6 khyod rang nga yi bdag po ma yin zhes lab tshe/ bran bdag gis de'i rna ba gnyis bcad chog pa red/ bran g.yog gis gnyen sgrig byed chog la byis pa'ang skye chog yin yang bran g.yog gi bu phrug kyang bran g.yog yin/ bran g.yog bros byol byed pa 'gog ched khrims gzhung du bran bdag gis bran g.yog gi lus su bsregs tham rgyag rgyu chog la/ kho tsho'i skra yang bzo lta khyad par ba zhig tu bzhar chog ces bkod yod/ de lta na'ang / bran g.yog bros byol gyi don dag rtag par 'anārdo ba

red/ de ga ci ltar thag gcod dgos she na/ ka zlum khrims yig gis yang thag gcog gsal por byas yod de/ dper na/ skra bzhar mkhan gyis gang bsam du bran g.yog gi skra yi bzo lta bsgyur na mdzub gu gcod pa ma zad/bros byol byas pa'i bran g.yog bzung tshe nges par du bdag po sngon ma de la sprod dgos/ bran g.yog brku btsong byed pa'am sba skung byed mkhan tshang mar srog khrims gcod dgos pa sogs so//ka zlum khrims yig gis bran bdag gi bran g.yog bdag dbang la srung skyongakhyed pa ma zad bran bdag gi rgyu nor gzhan pa'i bdag dbang yang srung skyong byed/ khrims lugs de ru/ su zhig gis bran bdag gi sgo phyugs sam 'bru rigs/ ca lag sogs brkus tshe tshang mar chad pa lci mo gcod dgos shing / lha khang ngam pho brang gi rgyu nor brku mkhan la srog chad dang / lug dang ba glang / bong bu/ phag gru sogs brku mkhan la brkus dngos kyi ldab bcu nas sum cu yi dngul chad gcod pa dang / dngul chad sprod rgyu med tshe srog chad gcod dgos pa gtan la phab yod/gna' bo'i sba sbi lon spyi tshogs kyi khyim tshang ni bran g.yog lam lugs kyi khyim dpon lam lugs kyi khyim tshang yin/ ka zlum khrims yig shes thub ni/gnyen sgrig ni nyo tshong gi gnyen sgrig yin la/ gnyen sgrig ma byas gong mag pas sgyug po la mna' ma nyo ba'i sgor mo dang nu rin sogs la legs skyes nges can zhig sprod dgos/ chung ma la khyim tshang nang du rang rkya 'pher ba'i rang tshugs nges can zhig yod na'ang khyo shug gi 'brel ba ni 'dra mnyam min/ khyo gas khyim tshang nang du bran bdag tshul du bya 'gul spel ba dang / khyo ga'i bun chad nas 'jal ma thub tshe chung ma'am bu phrug bun tshab tu sprad nas bun bdag la bran bkol byed du 'jug chog62ka zlum khrims yig gis gna' bo'i sba sbi lon gyi sa zhing gi gnas tshul

yang mngon par byas yod de/ rgyal po la sa zhing mang po dbang zhing sa zhing mang che ba 6 phyag rten 'bul mkhan ’ la bgos nas rmo ru bcug ste khral bogs bsdu len byed/ da dung kha shas sku drag dang dpon po/ dmag mi sogs la bstsal nas 'gan bzhes pa'am dmag skul dang len gyi gla phogs kyi tshab byed/sde ba'i zhing sa phal cher khyim tshang nyung shas kyis bdag bzung byed cing shul du lus pa'i spyi la dbang ba'i sa zhing de'ang rim bzhin gong rim pas bdag 'dzin byed/ gzhan yang lha khang gi sa zhing dang sger la dbang ba'i sa zhing yang yod/ sba sbi lon du sa zhing nyo tshong byed chog pas sger la dbang pa'i sa zhing lam lugs mu mthud du 'phel rgyas byung zhing / bogs mar gtong ba'i 'brel ba dar khyab tu song yod/ ka zlum khrims yig gis bran bdag gis dud chung la bshu gzhog byed pa de la rgyab skyor byed de/ khrims lugs de ru dud chung gis lo rer yong sgo'i phyed ka yas mas zhing bogs su sprod dgos pa gtan la phab yod/ wu pār hra ma hre zhes pa'i zhing chung zhig yod pa des bran bdag gi zhing sa chung ngu zhig bogs 'debs byas te/ bza' tshang gang bos lo gcig la dka' ngal chen pos las ka las nas ston sdud dus la thon nas lo tog breg ma thag zhing bdag dang tshong pa tsho bu lon 'dedad du yong la/ wu par hra ma hres bun sprad la bu lon dang khral ngan sna tshogs 'jal tshar rjes lo gcig gi ngal rtsol la 'bras bu ci yang med par gyur 'gro bas/ rjes phyogs kyi 'tsho ba rol thabs bral/ mdun du lhags pa ni bu phrug bran g.yog tu btsong ba'am kho rang nyid yang bun bran tu 'gyur shas che/6 rnam gcig 'khon lan slog thabs te dgra la dgra lan dang ki la ki lan bed spyod pa ni khrims lugs de'i khyad chos gzhan zhig yin/ thabs shes 'dis gong rim gyi rang dbang can bar gyi rtsod gzhi kho na thag gcod pa yin/dper na/ khrims lugs su gtan 'khel ya mtshar zhig yod de/ gal rdo zlozo

skrun mkhan gyis khang ba bzo bskrun byas pa de sra brtan ma yin par brdibs nas khang bdag gi bu mo bsad na bzo skrun mkhan gyi bu mo de la srog khrims gcod dgos/ ka zlum khrims yig gis skabs 'gar lha yi stobs shugs la brten nas 6 gnas tshul ngo ma ’ la brdar sha gcod pa ste/ dper na dogs yod nyes can chu'am me nang du bcug nas ma shi tshe kho la nyes pa med par brtsi la de las ldog tshe nyes pa yod/ 'di ni gdod ma'i khrims lugs nang gi 6 lha'i khrims gcod kyi lugs ngan srol lhag yin/ ka zlum khrims yig gis gtan la phab pa'i nyes khrims ni ha cang gdug rtsub che ba zhig red/ de ru nyes chad la rigs mang na'ang bkag skyil btson 'jug byed pa med/ srog chad gcod pa'i khyab rgya che ste rgyal khab la ngo log pa dang / srog blangs pa la srogacad gcod pa ma zad brku 'phrog dang ma nyes kha g.yog la'ang srog chad gcod shas che/ka zlum khrims yig ni da bar du rnyed pa'i mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus steng gi cung cha tshang ba'i yig ngos su bkod pa'i khrims gzhung ang dang po yin la/de'i gna' rabs e sha ya lho nub kyi bran g.yog khrims lugs gtan 'bebs kyi 'phel rgyas khrod du go gnas gal che ba bzung yod la/ de'i phyi'i e sha ya nub ma'i khrims 'dzugs bya 'gul la shugs rkyen chen po thebs par byas/

'dzom gling gi 'o rgyas snyan com snga zhos ste 〈 la sga sme sinyi/ku'u shu'e cegana' rabs 'dzam gling rtsom rig lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo'i khrod du mthong ba kun smon gyi snyan ngag brtsams chos gtos chen mang po byung myong /de'i nang gi〈〈rjel sga sme se〉〉〈〈611637036〉〈tshipo r+sā6〉)ni 'dzam gling gi ba'i dpa' bo'i don brjod snyan rtsom chen mo snga shos yin la/ gna' rabs sba sbi lon gyi rtsom rig gi grub 'bras ches mtho shos kyang red/ sgrung gtam chen mo 'di ga'i phun sum tshogs pa'i bsam blo'i nang don dang tshad stutho'i sgyu rtsal mtshon byed kyis snyan grags 'dzam gling yongs la khyab par byas da/ sgrung gtam chen mo de ni 'jong gzugs yi ge'i lam nas 'jim dpar so phag leb mo bcu gnyis kyi steng du brko 'bri byas yod la tshig rkang sum stong lhag yod/ mkhas pa tshos rtog dpyod zhib klog byas mthar de ni mi che ge mo zhigashi brtsams chos ma yin par/ ma gzhi spyi lo sngon gyi bgrang bya sum stong ring dar khyab che ba'i su'u sme ri a ba dang ag kha sde'i dmangs khrod kyi glu gzhas yin la/ de ga rgyun 'byams gzhung bsrings byas pa phal cher gna' rabasasba sbi lon rgyal rabs dang po'i skabs su da gzod deb tu bkod par snang / de ni gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i〈〈ho mer snyan rtsom chen mo〉〉dang kruX 5go'i

〈〈snyan ngag gi bstan bcos〉〉las kyang shin tu snga ba red/gna' rabs kyi gtsang gnyis 'bab rgyud kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos khrod du rtag par ngo mtshar pa'i chos lugs kyi shas che ba'i lha sgrung dang ngag rgyun mang po yod la/ de dag gis lha yis mi yul gyi thams cad dbang du sgyur cing /'gro ba mi tshang mas yod tshad lha la gtad pa las/ de la rgyab 'gal byed mi rung ba gsal bsgrags byas yod mod/ 'on te 〈〈rjel sga sme se〉〉ni gzhan dang mi mtshungs par/ de ru mi sna gtso bo rjel sga sme sis mi dmangs la bde skyid bsgrun ched lha la ngo rgol byas tshul dang / 'tshol zhib byed spobs pa'i dpa' bo'i 'thab rtsod bsam blo zhib 'bri byas yod pa ma zad/ de bzhin du khos blangs pa'i 'od stong 'bar ba'i byas rjes la bstod bsngags gnang yod/snyan rtsom chen mo des mi sna gtso bo 'di 'dra zhig ci'i phyir zhib 'bri byed dgos pa yin zhe na/ nga tshos lo rgyus snyan rtsom du bshad pa'i 6 chu log gi gru chung gi gtam rgyud de nas bshad 'go rtsom/gtam rgyud de ni 'di lta ste/ gna' snga mo'i dus su/ lha rnams mi'i rigs kyi 6 nag nyes la khong khro langs nas chad pa gcod chen/ 'jig rten khams su chu log phab ste mi'i rigs rmeg med du gtong grabs byas/ skabs der/ su'u lu'u sba khu(ma ༅7)(sme so pho tha smi ya'i(503090 6418za0rko 7sko༅)gna' mkhar)yi dpa' bo u the nā phi si them(pu ba89136 17sdo smos sgo ñtsa)lha la rab tu dad phyir lha yi thugs rjes slebs la khad kyi chag sgo de ma byung sngon rtogs nas/ chung ma dang bu phrug gser dngul rgyu nom/ srog ldan skye dngos yod tshad tshang ma khyer nas grub ma thag pa'i gru gzings de la bsdad/ chu log bri rjes/ mi yul gyi srog ldan skye 'gro tshang ma theg med du song tshar gshes/ u the nā phi si them tshang rkyang rkyang srog thar byung zhing6 sbya'i rigs kyi mes po ru gyur te tshe ring 'chi med kyi 'tsho ba rol gyin

mchis/gtam rgyud 'dis mi rnams la bshad don no/ 'jigs yer ba'i rang byung nus pa ste gtsang bo gnyis 'bab rgyud kyi chu log mched 'byams kyi mdun du 'tsho bzhes gnang rgyu ni ji 'dra'i dka' ngal che ba zhig yin pa dang / lha la mi phyed dad mos byas na da gzod sdug las thar thub pa de'o// yin yang don dngos mang po zhig gis lha la dad mos che ba kho nas sdug bsngal las thar mi thuba'i dka' sdug gi las dbang las kyang thar mi thub pa'i bslab bya gnang phyir/ kho chos rim bzhin 66lha yis yod tshad la dbang sgyur ba'i ’ chos bshad la dogs pa zos/ snyan rtsom chen mo 〈〈rjel sga sme sa〉〉ni dogs gzhi 'di rigs trī brten nas rim bzhin lha la ngo rgol byed phod pa'i sgyu rtsal mtshon byed cig da/ rjel sga sme si ni gna' rabs gtsang bo gnyis 'bab rgyud kyi lo rgyus steng du dngos su byung myong ba'i mi zhig yin la/ de ni u ru khe/pulaji ma)rgyal rabs dang po'i mi rabs lnga ba'i smyo yen zhi7 (rgyal po'am srid 'dzin)yin/ kho'i rlabs chen mdzad rjes la mi rnams kyis gong bkur byed/ dus yun ring bo'i ngag thog gi gyer len khrod du kho la ya mtshar ba'i 'char yan gyi rnam pa bstsal cing / 〈〈rjel sga sme sa〉〉zhes pa'i snyan rtsom chen mo 'di'i nang du 6 sum cha'i gnyis lha yin la sum cha'i gcig ni mi yin pa'i lha min mi min gyi mi sna zhig tu gyur pa red/snyan rtsom chen mo de'i 'go ru/ rjel sga sme sis u ru khe stobs 'byor ldan pa zhig byed ched du/ 'bangs mi rnams la btsan gyis mkhar dang lha khang bzo skrun byed du bcug nas mi 'bangs rnams 'tsho ba rol thabs med par bzos phyir/ sku drag dang 'bangs mi tshor khong khro gting nas bslangs/ kho tshos lha la gtug bsher byas pa na lha yis e khi sdu/stubasmo175 sa sa/ltos

pa'i dpa' rgod cig gsar bskrun byas te rjel sga sme sir ngo rgol byed du bcugadapa' bo gnyis kyis shi 'thab byas par rtsal stobs 'dra mtshungs yin pas rgyal pham gyi dbye ba 'byed dka' bar gyur/ de bas kho rang gnyis phan tshun gyi dpa' ngar la yid smon shor zhing mdza' bshes zab pa'i grogs po gyur nas mi'i rigs la gnod sel bde bskrun byed pa'i lam chen du zhugs/ kho rang gnyis kyis mnyam du 'tsho ba rol zhing 'thab rtsod byas nas rlabs chen gyi byas rjes mang po bzhag la/ gtso bo ni ya ma gzugs hong sba sba bsad cing lha mo ye'u si ta la ngo rgol dang / u ru khe yi 'bangs mi la gnod 'tshe byed pa'i gnam gyi ba glang bsad pa sogs so//hong sba sba ni mtha' 'khob lung kyog gi thang shing ra ba srung mkhan yin la/kho ni ha cang gdug rtsub che ba'i mi 'ig ste/ ngar skad ni rlung 'tshub drag po g.yug pa dang 'dra zhing / 6 kha gdangs pa tsam gyis me skyug cing kha rlangs phog pa tsam gyis srog gcod par byed/’ khos sdong bo 'thu bar song ba'i u ru khe yi 'bangs mi brnyas gsod byas khar gzhan pa'i nyes pa'ang mang po bsags/ rjel sga sme sis dmangs don du gnod pa rtsa med du gtong ba'i sems thag bcad la/ brtan brling 'gyur med ngang ru gal te nga rang 'thab ra nas shi dgos byung na snyan grags bskal brgyar gnas nges zhes bshad pa ma zad/ en khe sdu la lhan tu g.yul sbran par 'gro rgyu'i bskul ma btang bar kho yang 'thad pa byung /yun ring por bde thang nas bsdad pa'i mi gsom pa dang shug pa'i sdong bo'i rtse mo gnam la gzengs pa'i nags tshul du 'byor na tshor ba ji 'dra zhig yod pa tshang mas mkhyen gsal red/ rdzob cing stug la gnag pa'i nags tshal gyis mi sems 'dar bar byed cing / mun khrod kyi zer mas hang sang par byed6 spya yang dpa' bo gnyis ka phyir nur ma byas/ phan tshun skul cag dang

dngangs skrag khyad du bsad de ya nga ba'i dmag 'khrug brgyud nas hong sba sba gshag gsod byas te 'bangs kyi gnod pa yongs su bsgrad/dpa' bo gnyis kyis rnam par rgyal ba'i dga' spro khyer nas u ru khe grong du phyogs/ lam bar du/ lha mo ye'u si ta rjel sga sme si yi pho sgo la yid dbang shor nas kho la gnyen slong re zhu byas shing / gal te mo'i brtse dung dang du blangs na 'dzad mtha' med pa'i rgyu nor dang snyan grags longs spyod byed chog ces bshad/ yin yang rjel sga sme si yis i si sda de kha yang spyod yang yin pas brtse dung la blo gcig min pa shes pas/ gnas de nas dang len ma byas pa ma zad sngon chad mos dga' rogs g.yug pa'i spyod ngan la kha rdung btang stabs/lha por zhe spo gting nas langs shing brnyas bcos chen po phog song snyam nas/rang gi yab 6 lha thams cad kyi lha a nu'u yi mdun sar song nas mo'i don du 'khon lan slog dgos pa'i re ba bton/ a nu'u yis thos ma thag rab tu khros te/ mi phal ba zhig gis lha mo'i brtse dung dang len ma byas pa thal drags snyamanas lha'i ba glang zhig u ru khe ru mngags/ 'di ni ya ma gzugs shig yin la de'i rwa co gcig gi ring tshad la mus gnyis yod cing dbugs gcig 'byin na mi mang po gsod thub pas/ 'bangs mi chos mthong nas skyi g.ya' bar gyur/ 'on kyang gang la'ang mi skrag pa'i rjel sga sme si yis en khi sdu yi ram 'degs 'og lha'i ba glang dang 'thab 'dzing byas/ nyin der lha zog brgyug yong dus dpa' rgod tsho zur la g.yol ba dang / en khi sdu skabs de dang bstun nas yar mchong ste gnam zog gi rwa co nas bzung zhing / rjel sga sme si yis ba glang gi ske la shugs kyis gri brgyab nas lha'i ba glang bsad de rwa co blangs/ lha mo i si sda yis 'khon lan slog mi thub pa mthong nas kha skyengs shing rlung langs nas u ru khe grong mgor yong nas skad chen pos dpa' bo gnyis la ngan sngags btang / dpa' bo gnyis kyi de la kha ya gtan /sdu ma

byas shing rang gi rgyal kha la dga' ston byas pa las lha'i dbang cha la snang chung byas pa'i 'thab rtsod kyi bsam blo mngon par mtshon yod/ 'bangs mi tshor yang dga' spro rab tu brtas nas skad chen po'i sgo nas bstod glu 'di ltar blangasam/dpa' bo'i khrod kyi gzi brjid che shosagazhig yin zhe na/gang zhig mang po'i khrod kyi pho sgo can de gang yin zhe na/rjel sga sme r+shani dpa' bo nang gi dpa' bo yigano lo/tshe'i sdu ni pho rab dpa' mdzesazla med yin no gosayinayang / lha rnams kyis 'khon lan slog pa'i mtshams ma bzhag par/en khi sdu la 'chi nad btang nas gsod rtsis/ dga' ston mjug gril ma thag para.en khi sdu la rmi ltas ngan zhig byung nas kho rang myur du shi rgyu red ces bshad/ ma 'gyang bar kho rang la dngos gnas 'chi nad phog dbugs chad la nye ba'i yen khi sdu yis rjel sga sme si la 'chi bdag gis kho la'ang sgug yod par lab/ rjel sga sme sis gtam de thos pa na sems skyo tshad med skyes shing /khosaskyo gdung gi ngang nas grogs po yen khi sdu yi brang kha la dbugs dbyung gis byil byil gnang nas ches mtha' mjug gi skyel ma mdzad/enakho sdu glo bur sku gshegs pa des rjel sga sme si la rdung deg chen po thebs shing / yid sems blong blong bor gyur pa khos 'chi ba ni mi'i rigs kyi skyo gar ches che ba yin bsam la/ mdzad rje4bla na med pa can dag kyang mtha' mar 66'chi ba'i mal khri'i steng nas nyal dgos pa ni ldog thabs med par 'dod/ ji 'dra byas na da gzod mi'i rigs 'chi bdag gi kha nas thar te bskal ba'i bar gnas thub bam/ kho rang gis lha gyur zin pa'i mes po u the nā phi si them yid la shar zhing de la skye 'chi'i gsang ba dris nas nam yang mi nudī ༵'i tshe srog 'tshol rgyu thag bcad/ de nas kho rang la rgyag thang brgal gyi

'thab lam gsar bar zhugs/'di ni yun ring kyag kyog gi brgyud rim zhig red/ 'on kyang yid ches brtan pos kho la rgyab skyor byas yod/ kho rang g.yang gzar zhing 6 kla klo'i lung pa 7ru 'bod pa'i mā hri ri bo la slebs shing / 'di ni nyi ma nub sa yin la/u the nā phi si them gyi bzhugs sa ste 66'jig rten gzhan pa ’ la 'gro dus mi brgyud thabs med kyi lam yin/ de ru khos ri rtsa bsrung ba'i seng ge bsad pa dang / ri sgo bsrung ba'i 6 mig mdas mi gsod nus pa'i hra so li yi mi cham la phab ste mun nag mthug pa'i lung khog la zhugs/ lung khog mun nag de ru nyinagacig zhag gcig la song rjes/ khos zhen chags ci yang med par 'od stong rab tu 'bar zhing rin po che'i sdong bo rnam par bzhad pa'i bde ba can gyi zhing khams brgyud la/ mu mtha' mi mngon pa'i rgya mtsho yang mthong / rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi lha mo si tu'u lis kyis kho la 'di ni 6 'chi ba'i chu bo yin phyir/ mi phal ba reg ma thag shi 'gro ba red/ de bas phyir log nas dga' mgu'i dpal la rol na mi dga' 'am zhes lab/ yin yang rjel sga me si 'jigs skul dang bslu brid snang med du bzhag ste mthar gru pa'i rogs ram 'og 6 'chi ba'i chu bo ’ brgal te dmigs sar 'byor/u the nā phi them kyis dga' spro'i ngang rjel sga me si la sne len byas/ phyi mas snga ma la 6 khyod kyis ci 'dra byas nas tshe brtan pa thob nas lha rnams dang 'dra bar gyur zhes dri ba bton tshe/ khos chu log dang gru'i gtam rgyud bshad cing / lha ni kho rang gi tshe brtan pa yong bar byed mkhan yin la da ni go skabs de 'dra yod mi srid ces lab/ 6 su zhig gis khyod kyi don du lha rnams gdan 'dren byed/ khyod kyis 'tshol ba'i tshe srog de gang du song nas 'tshol dgos/ mesapo tshos bsgrags pa'i lhas 6 shi ba dang tshe srog sgrub pa'i nyalas dbang smra ba'i lta ba des rjel sga me si yi tshe brtan pa 'tshol rtog byed pa'i 'dod gā /ga

po de gzhom ma thub/ khos 6 ngas ci zhig byed dgos/ u the nā phi them lags/ nga gang du 'gro rgyu red/ :ces dris par/ u the nā phi them kyis snying rje chen pos rjel sga sme si la 6 gsang ba'i man ngag cig gdams pa ste/ nye 'gram gyi rgya mtsho'i nang du lha yi rtswa mchog cig yod la de ga btogs tshe na tshe srog thob thub pa'o// rjel sga sme sis gtam de thos ma thag mtsho gting du 'dzul zhing dka' las chen po myangs mthar da gzod lha yi rtswa mchog de btogs thub/ kho la dga' spro dpag med skyes shing / rtswa de bsnams nas mi gzhan dag dang mnyam du longs spyod byed rtsis byas/ yin yang khos lam bar gyi rdzing bu zhig tu khrus rgyag bzhin pa'i sgang la sbrul chen zhig 'jab yong nas khos logs su bzhag yod pa'i lha yi rtswa mchog de khyer song phyir kho'i dga' spro don med du gyur/rjel sga sme si phangs sems dang skyo gdung drag pos mnar bzhin phyir u ru khe la log tshe ring rtag brtan gyi re ba 'bras med du gyur cing / 'das grogs dran pa'i gdung pa nyin re las nyin re je drag tu song ba na/ mthar lhas rogs ram byas 'og kho dang en khi sdu yi rnam shes mjal 'phrad byung /khos grogs po la 6 phyi ma'i yul gyi sgrig lam bshad dgos pa'i re ba bton/'on kyang en khi sdu yi dris lan ni skyo nyams kyis khengs pa des mi tshe ni rtag pa ma yin pa'i las dbang smra ba'i lta ba mngon par byas/ khos ngu ngag dang bcas shi bos 6 dmyal yul nas mnar gcod ya nga ba myong tshul zhu gtug byas shing / kho rang nyid gleng dus gnas tshul de bas skyo ste/6 kye ma ltosashig khyod kyi mdza' gcugs blos thub grogs por ltos/'bu dang srun bus kho la rmugs tshe rul myagasar shun 'dra/khyod rang byil byil gtong bar dga' ba'i gcesapa'i lusaphung yang spyo73da masasardul dag tu gyur nas stong ba'i khams suthor/7

lo rgyus snyan rtsom chen mo'i ma yig mtshams de nas rdzogs song la/ rjel sga sme sis 'chi med rtag brtan gyi 'tshol zhib de yang pham kha'i ngang mjug gril/kho rang nyid kyi mtha' mjug gi tshang mal kyang en khi sdu dang 'dra bar 'chi ba las ma 'das/ lo rgyus snyan rtsom chen mos 'di ru mi rnams la las dbang la sdug sgur dgos pa'i skyo ba'i las dbang smra ba'i bsam blo khyab bsgrags byas da/ gong nas nga tshos klog pa po la lo rgyus snyan rtsom chen mo de'i nang don gtso bo mtshams sbyor byas zin/ spyi'i 'khyer so ltar na/ 〈〈rjel sga sme sa〉〉ni ngo ma snyan rtsom chen mo brjid nyams can zhig yin pa ma zad/ de'i nang du rjel sga sme si yi bstod bsngags kyis go gnas gtso bo bzung yod/ lo rgyus snyan rtsom chen mo des bsam blo'i cha dang sgyu rtsal mtshon tshul gyi cha gang gi steng nas kyang grub 'bras gzegs su thon pa blangs yod/ snyan rtsom chen mo 'dis cung tsam gdod ma yin yang yid dbang 'phrog pa'i gtam rgyud kyi zhib 'bri brgyud de/ gna' bo'i dus skabs kyi gtsang bo gnyis 'bab rgyud kyi mi dmangs kyis rang byung khams kyi gdug rtsub dang spyi tshogs kyi gdug rtsub sogs la 'thab rtsod byas pa'i gnas tshul ga se mo mtshon yod cing / mi dmangs kyi don du byas rjes bzhag pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' rtags la bstod bsngagasaganang yod/ tshad nges can zhig gi steng nas gna' bo'i sba sbi lon pas rang byung gi chos nyid ngos 'dzin byed pa dang lha'i bka' la ngo rgol byed pa/ dpa' ngar zhum med ngang mi tshe'i gsang ba 'tshol rtog byed pa'i 'thab rtsod kyi spobs pa sogs mtshon par byas yod la/ de ni lo rgyus snyan rtsom chen mo 'di'i bsam blo'i rang bzhin dang mi dmangs rang bzhin gyi mngon tshul red/ sgyu rtsal steng nas snyan rtsom chen mo 'di ru phyogs mang po nas mi dmangs kyis ngag thog nas gsar rtsom byas pa'i khyad chos sor 'jokā sdus

yod pa dang / 'char yan dang sgra rgyan/ bsdus brjod/ sgro 'dogs sogs sgyu rtsal gyi mtshon thabs bkol yod pa dang / cung gson nyams ldan pa'i ngang mi sna dpa' bo'i snang brnyan bkod de mi sna'i bsam blo dang snying stobs gsal ston byas yod/ yin na'ang lo rgyus snyan rtsom chen mo de ru mi 'dang sa'ang mi nyung ba zhig yod khar dus rabs kyi bkag rgya rang bzhin lhag tu gsal/dper na lha rlabs che tshul dang mi yi stobs shugs chung lugs/ mi phal bas lha yi bka' dang las dbang gi bkod sgrig la mgo sgur dgos pa sogs skor gyi zhib bris ni khas len byed mi nyan no/ zhib 'bri 'di rigs ni rjes phyogs kyi bran bdag dbang bsgyur mkhan dang btsun pa'i tshogs pa'i chos lugs dril sgrog nas byang ba shas ༈ phyir 'dor bar rigs so//74

rigs rgyudaṣ+ṭhagim lugs dang bram me'i chos lugs/wang 64khorgya gar ni 'dzam gling gi dpal yon dar snga ba'i gna' rabs rgyal khab kyi nang gses shig yin/ rang rgyal gyi han rgyal rabs kyi lo rgyus yig tshang du de la 6 yon tu'u(zo(558ba)6) 'am 6 the'an kru'u((4) zhes 'bod la thang rgyal rabs dus su 6 nyin dhi(lnga ) ru bsgyur/ ming 'di ni e sha ya lho ma'i skam sa chen po phal ba'i steng gi gtsang bo zhig stewa wanyin dhe gtsang bo las byung la/ma spyi lo sngon gyi lo rabs nyis stong pa'i dus dkyil la/ e sha ya dkyil ma'am kho khi si a(6750831866me'iphrardo)phyogs nas yong ba'i a ri an skad rgyud(hin snyi yo rab kyi skad rgyud) skad rgyud la gtogs pa'i mi rgyud dkar po'i tsho ba zhig gis rgya gar nub byang gi ri nyag nas btsan 'dzul byas shing / nyin dhe gtsang bo'i 'bab rgyud kyi dpal yon gsar gtod byed mkhan te sa de'i ya thog yul mi gda' ra we sdi'i mis(21871 thabacu 77 lko4)dbang du bsdus/ btsan 'dzul pas rang la tsa ar+ya na (sa0thabacu lko)0)an zhes 'bod cing nang don ni khyad du 'phags pa yin la/ gdong pa nag pa'i yul mi gda' ra we sdi'i mi la 6 gda' sā (79) zhes 'bod cing dgra bo zhes pa'i don yin/ ar+ya na pa ni dang thog rtswa chu bsnyeg nas spo skyod byed pa'i 'brog pa yin na'ang / btsan 'dzul byas rjes gda' ra we sdidī sbya'i

dpal yon dang len byas te rim gyis 'brog las bskyur nas zhing las gnyer/kho tshos mi rabs nas mi rabs bar gda' ra we sdi'i mis rmo 'debs byas pa'i zhing sa 'phrog cing / btsan gyis dbang du bsdus pa'i gda' ra we sde'i mi rnams la sa zhing rmo 'debs byed du bcug 'di ltar gda' ra we sdi'i mi rnams rim bzhin tshe tshe rabs rabs su a ri an par g.yog las byed pa'i gral rim ste bran g.yog dang g.yog por gyur/spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs bcu bzhi bar ar+ya na pas rgya gar btsan bzung byas rjes/ rgya gar gyi lo rgyus de rig byed dus rabs zhes par bslebs/rig byed dus rabs zer don yang skabs 'di'i lo rgyus bris pa'i yig tshang gtso bo ni〈〈rig byed〉〉( rig byed mini 'phags shes zhes pa yin)ces pa de yin la/ de ni ma gzhi rgya gar gyi ches snga ba'i chos lugs kyi yig tshang dang rtsom rig brtsams chos kyi spyi ming yin la/ rjes su bram ze'i chos lugs kyi bstan bcos su gyur/ 〈〈rig byed〉〉khrod kyi bstod glu zhig gis thog lha'i dbang bo brgya byin la 'di ltar bsngags brjod byas yod de/6 khos skye dngos thams cad g.yo 'gul byed nus shing / rda sā war nā dbang du'ang 'jug nus/ o/ mi rnams ya/ khong lha'i dbang bo brgya byin yin/7 klu'i nang gi na war na(5thangs 7776) zhes pa'i tshig 'di ar+ya na pa'i skad cha'i nang gi snga ma'i go don ni 6 kha dog 7gam 6 rgyu spus yin yang / skabs 'dir 6 rim pa yi don du gyur yod/ 6 rna sā war nā 7zhes pa ni bran g.yog gral rim gyi gda' rawe sdi'i mi la go rang rgyal gyi gna' rabs kyi legs sbyar skad lo tsā byed mkhan chos 6 war nā zhes pa'i ming tshig de'i nang don smyo rigs rus zhes su bsgyur yod/ ar+ya na pas 6 rda sā ni mi gtsang ba yin phyir de tshor gnyen sgrig pa gtan 'gog byed/ gna' rabs rgya gar du dbang bsgyur mkhan ar+ya na lha spyang dbang bsgyur myong mkhan gda' ra we sdi'i mi gnyis ni ches thog mar

rigs rgyud 'khyer so yod pa'i 6 war nā gnyis yin zhes bshad choga.ar+ya na pas ni gda' ra we sdi'i mi dbang du bsdus rjes nang khul du gral rim gyi dbye ba byung / tsho ba phan tshun bar sa zhing dang dmag thob dngos rdzas 'phrog rtsod byed ched nam rgyun dmag 'khrug rgyag la/ dmag 'khrug gi mtha' 'bras ni chos lugs kyi mchod 'bul bya 'gul spel ba'i mchod gnyer tshogs pa/ tsho ba'i 'go ba gtso bo yin pa'i dmag don gyi sku drag dag gis rgyu nor dang bzung dmag mang po dbang du bsdus phyir khyad dbang gral rim gnyis su gyur pa red/ 〈〈rig byed〉〉nang du dmag 'khrug gi rjes su grwa pa zhig la tsho dpon las gser leb brgya phrag lhag dang rta nor grangs las 'das pa/ bran mo sdod pa'i dmag 'thab 'khor lo bcu thob pa sogs bris yod/ gna' rabs rgya gar du/ gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi dad mos shin tu dar la lhag par ma he la mchod dad byed pas/ nam rgyun du dmag 'khrug la 6 ma he thob par re ba zhes brjod cing / de'i slad du bsgrub pa'i chos lugs kyi cho ga la'ang nyog dra ha cang che la gsang ba lkog gyur yin par brten/ grwa pa'i go gnas sngar las je mthor btang / dper na/ dgra 'dul g.yul rgyal dang lha la 'dod gsol smon 'dun zhu ba sogs kyi byed na'ang / mchod dpon brgyud de lha 'dre la mo rtsis byed dgos pa ma zad/ de 'brel gyi chos lugs cho ga 'dra min sna tshogs bsgrub dgos stabs/ gsol mchod ched las yin pa'i grwa pa'i tshogs pa rim gyis chags pa las bram ze'i rigs rgyud chags/ gsol mchod sger 'dzin dang rang nyid kyi khyad dbang go gnas mthor 'degs yong ched/bram ze ba dag gis gsol mchod kyi kun 'jon nus pa 'ud brjod chen po byas shing / bram ze khyad par ba kho nas da gzod cho ga'adi bsgrub thub ces 'ud bstod byas/ rjes sor/ chos lugs kyi dbang chen bzung ba ma zad dpa' rtuX la blo bkod 'then mkhan gyi bram ze dang / rgyu nor 'bor chen7 ḍing

dbang cha chen po 'dzin mkhan 'di dag rigs rgyud dang por gyur/ rgyal po dang dpa' rtul/ dpon chen sogs ni rigs rgyud gnyis pa yin/ar+ya na par gral rim dbye ba dang bran g.yog lam lugs chags pa'i brgyud rim khrod du/ rim pa gzab nan yin pa'i 6 rigs rgyud bzhi grub pa ste/ rim pa dang po ni grwa pa dang sku drag yin pa'i 6 bram ze'i rigs 7yin la/kho tshos lha dbang bzung yod la rig gnas kyang sger 'dzin byas yod pas go gnas ches mtho/ rim pa gnyis pa ni dpa' rtul dang sku drag ste 6 rgyal rigs yin/ kho tshos dmag don dang srid 'dzin gyi dbang cha bzung yod/rim pa gsum pa ni rang dbang yod pa'i mi te 6 rje rigs yin la gtso bo zhing pa dang lag shes bzo las pa/ tshong pa las grub/ rim pa bzhi ba ni 66gdolaba'i rigs 7yin la de tsho ni dbang du tshud pa'i yul mi dang dbul phongs pa/ ma rtsa dib pa'am sa zhing shor mkhan yin la de'i nang gi mang po bran g.yog yin/ a ri an pas nam zhar yang dbang du tshud pa'i gda' ra we sdi'i mi las rang nyid lhag pa yong ched/ bram ze'i rigs kyis gdol ba'i rigs 6 sa thu la la zhugs pa'i dbang cha 'phrog sa thu la ni chos lugs steng slar skye ba'i slar skye cho ga yin phyir rigs rgyud sngon ma gsum por gtogs pa'i a ri an pa la 66slar skye rigs zhes 'bod la/ gdol ba'i rigs chos lugs kyi steng nas slar skye mi nus pas 6 skye gcig rigs 7zhes zer/ rigs rgyud 'di bzhi po las gzhan yul sdod grangs nyung mi rigs dang rigs rgyud mi gcig pa'i pho mo phan tshun gnyen bsgrigs nas skyes pa'i byis pa tsho rigs rgyud lnga ba ste 6 dmangs rigs so// kho tsho ni 6 mi'i nang gi ches tha shal ba ’ yin/rgyagar gyi rigs rgyud lam lurges kyi snying po ni grwa pa sku drag bram ze'i rigs la rang nyid kyi bla med dbang cha chen po bed spyod byed par khag theg yod ༵ byed ched yin la/ bram ze'i chos lugs dang / bstan bcos gaXr

bzung nas gtan la phab pa'i khrims lugs mang po stewa 66rda ma gnyis ni gna' rabs rgya gar gyi rigs rgyud lam lugs srung 'dzin byed pa'i srog shing chen po gnyis yin no//bram ze'i chos lugs ni ha lam spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs bdun par chags zhes grags/ des rigs rgyud lam lugs kyi 'byung khungs lha la gtugs shing bram ze'i rigs rgyud kyi dbang cha bla med khyad 'phags can du btang / de'i phyir grwa pa sku drag bram ze'i rigs ni kho tsho'i go gnas bla med srung 'dzin byed pa'i bsam blo'i lag cha nus ldan du brtsi/ bram ze'i chos lugs ltar na/ 'jig rten byed po lha tshangs pas ya thog gi gyad mi bha ra sa dum bur gcod dus/ kho'i lus phung gi gnas mi 'dra sa nas rigs rgyud mi 'dra ba bzhir bgos pa ste/ mchu sgros bram ze'i rigs su gyur ba dang /dpung ba gnyis ka rgyal rigs dang brla gnyis ka rje rigs su gyur cing / mi gtsang ba'i rkang mthil nas gdol pa'i rigs thon/ der ma zad da dung bram ze'i rigs dang rgyal rigs/ rje rigs bcas slar skyes rigs 'di gsum po'i rang rang gi las gnas/ 'os 'gan dang longs spyod nus pa'i khe phan yang lha yis thag bcad pa yin zhes sgrog la/ gdol ba'i rigs ni tshe gang bor smyo slar skye rigs 7kyi bran g.yog kho na byed rgyur thag bcad yod/ bram ze'i chos lugs kyis 'di ltar gral rim gnya' gnon gyi don dngos sbas skung byas shing / spyi tshogs kyi 'dra mnyam min pa sogs la chos lugs dang lha'i bka' yi gsang ba'i phyi shun zhig gis g.yogs par byas/ bram ze'i rigs kyi dbang bsgyur sra brtan dang ngo log 'byung ba sngon 'gog byed ched bram za'i chos lugs kyis ya thog gi skye dngos thams cad la srog ldan pa dang rnam shes 'pho ba'i lta ba spyad de bram ze'i chos kyi khyad chos ches cher ldan pa'i chos kyi snying po 6 'khor ba gludang 6 las rgyu 'bras kyi lta ba bton/ bram ze/ /sa

kyis mi shi rjes rnam shes skye dngos gzhan pa zhig tu gnas 'pho zhing la la mir skye zhing / la la bya/ nya/ 'bu/ gcan gzan sogs su'o// 'di ni 'khor ba zhes pa yin la/ 'khor ba gtso bo mi gson dus kyi bya spyod de 6 las rgyu 'bras la rag las yod/ rigs rgyud dma' ba'i mi zhig yin tshe sdug skad ci yang med par gang nus gang lcogs kyis kho rang gis rigs rgyud dang mtshungs pa'i 'os 'gan sna tshogs bsgrub tshe skye ba phyi mar bram ze ru skye thub/ de las ldog na las rgyu 'bras ngan pa 'khor nas tshe phyi mar tha na srin 'bu zhig tu skye nges/ bshad tshul 'dis don dngos su mi dmangs mang tshogs la sdug bsngal thams cad bzod pa byas nas nam yang bshu gzhog dang gnya' gnon gyi gnas bab kyi go gnas su gnas dgos pa de'o// 'o na/ mi rigs rgyud dma' ba zhig gi ci 'dra byas tshe da gzod kho'i rigs rgyud dang mtshungs pa'i 'os 'gan khur pa red ce na/ bram ze'i chos lugs kyi bshad tshul ltar phyogs sdom byas na rim pa gsum yod de/ dang po ni cho ga bsgrub pa/ 〈〈bram ze'i chos gzhung〉〉du smyo lha la'ang sngon chad shi ba yod/ kho tshos mchod pa bsgrub par brten nas tshe ring thob pas lha dang mnyam du mchod pa byed mkhan mi tsho'ang tshe ring thub mi zer/bram ze'i chos lugs kyi mchod pa'i cho ga ha cang rnyog 'dzing yin/ stabs bde shos kyi thabs shes ni bag leb dang bzhus mar gyi cho ga bsgrigs te 〈〈rig byed kyi gzhung〉〉skyor 'don byed zhor du shing thom gnyis kyis yar 'jog mar 'jog byas nas lag tu bzung nas mar mgo ru blugs pa de'o// mchod pa'i cho ga 'di thengs re la nyung mtha' yang nyi ma lngar rgyun 'khyongs byed nges/ bram ze'i rigs kyi mchod pa'i cho ga da dung ha cang gdug rtsub che la/ la lar mi gson po bsad nas mchod pa byed/ gdug spyod 'di dus rabs bcu dgu ba'i bar la rgyun bsrings/ gnyis ni dka' thub sgos sgru1rdong byed pa/ rnal 'byor sbyong pa'i mis nges par khyim phud nas nags

tshal lam brag khung du song te skra ring po bzhag nas ljon pa'i lo ma'am gcan gzan gyi pags pa gyon nas/ rtsi shing gi rtsad pa za ba'am slong mo la bsten nas 'tsho ba rol dgos/ kho tsho'i sgrub sbyong byed dus nges par du rkang 'dzub btsugs nas yar langs dgos shing tsha drod dus tshugs la nyi ma tsha ba'i 'og tu phyogs bzhi bor me btab te sreg par bzod dgos/ grang dus nges par du rgyab la gon pa rlon pa gyon dgos/ bram ze'i chos lugs kyis rigs rgyud ches dma' ba'i mi yin yang dka' spyad sgrub sbyong byas na tshe phyi mar ches mtho ba'i rigs rgyud thob ces bsgrags/ mchod pa dang sgrub sbyong las nges par bsgrub dgos pa'i 'os 'gan ni 6 rna ma srung dgos pa'o// bram ze'i chos lugs kyis gtan la phab pa'i khrims lugs sna tshogs su ches dpe mtshon ldan pa ni ha lamathi lo sngon gyi dus rabs gsum par bsgrigs pas〈〈rmā nu'u(57ba5 smo)khrims gzhung〉〉yin/ bram ze'i chos lugs kyis de ni lha tshangs pa'i sras mā nu'u yi rigs rgyud so so'i rim pa dang de'i 'os 'gan gsar par byed ched bton pa yin/ 'di ltar bram ze'i rigs la'ang kho tsho'i dbang cha srung 'dzin byed pa'i lag cha ste khrims lugs byung ngo //〈〈mo'u no'u yi khrims gzhung〉〉na rigs rgyud ches mtho ba'i bram ze'i rigs la dbang cha khyad par yod la 'os 'gan dang / khral 'u lag dang lus chad tshang ma med par bzos rgyu gtan la phab/ kho tsho'i nyes chad ches lci ba ni skra gcod pa(skye pho'i skra gcod pa'i nyes chad cig)yin/ bram ze'i rigs sheg gis gdol pa'i rigs sheg bsad na lus po gtsang sbra zhig byas pa'i chogakhrims gzhung du rgyal po'i 'os 'gan gtso bo zhig ni rje rigs dang gdol pa'i rigs gnyis kyis rang nyid kyi ngal rtsol bya ba gnyer du 'jug rgyu de yin pa gsal por gtan 'khel byas yod/ da dung rigs rgyud dma' ba'i mi lam du bram ze'i rigs la thug tshe nges par g.yol dgos shing / rigs rgyud mardo di'i

mir thug tshe kho tsho la 6 sku ngo 7dang rang nyid la 6 bran g.yog ces 'bod dgos pa gtan la phab yod/ rigs rgyud ches dma' ba'i gdol pa'i rigs la sger nor nyar ba'i dbang cha med/ chos gzhung du 6 gdol ba'i rigs la rgyu nor ci yang med dgos la de tsho'i bdag pos tshang ma khyer na chog ces bshad yod/ 〈〈rmā nu'u yi khrims gzhung〉〉du rigs rgyud bzhi la ma tshud pa'i mi dman pa la de bas mthong chung byed/ khrims gzhung du mi dman pa'i sger nor ni khyi dang sprel yin la kho tsho'i gyon pa ni shi bo'i phyi lu yin/ kho tshos mi gzhan pa'i za lhag dang 'thung lhag las 'thung mi chog lcags ni kho tsho'i rgyan cha yin/ mi dman pa'i bem po 'khur ba'am khrims chad gtong ba/ shan pa/ bshang 'dru ba sogs 6 mi gtsang ba'i ’ bya ba las gnyer mi chog pa gtan la phab/ rigs rgyud yod pa'i mi de lhag par 6 slar skye ba'i mi ’ de tsho la thug ma thag btsog pa'i bslad par 'dod phyir khrims gzhung du kho tsho 6 sde ba'i phyi nas sdod 7kho na chog pa gtan 'khel byas/ gal te grong khyer du 'gro dgos na lag pas shing nya brdung nas brda rgyag dgos/ sa khul la lar mi dman pas spyi spyod khul du kha lud 'phangs pa'ang kha dbugs bslad pa'i nyes don zhig la brtsi phyir mi dman pa tsho sgor 'gro dus ske ru nges par du rdza ma zhig 'dogs dgos pa ni kha lud 'phen par bde ba'i ched yin/ de las lhag pa ni bram ze'i rigs kyis mi dman pa'i rgyab gzugs kyis kyang rang nyid bslad par 'dod pas/ bram ze'i rigs shig sgo ru 'gro dus nye sar gnas pa'i mi dman pa tshang ma nges par du thang la log dgos pa ni nyi mas rang nyid kyi rgyab gzugs sa la mi 'phro ba'i chen yin/ gdol pa'i rigs dang mi dman pa'i rigs kyi ngo rgol gyi bya 'gul 'gog ched〈〈rmā nu'u yi khrims gzhung〉〉du 66gdol pa'i rigs dang dman pa'i rigs kyi yan lag bzhi bo'i gang gis rigs rgyud mtho ba'i mi la bsaḥshā na nges par yan lag gi cha de gcod dgos/ gal te bram ze'i rigs

la lab gling sna tshogs byas na snum tsha bo kho'i kha dang rna nang du blugs dgos —pa gtan la phab yod/ gzhan yang khrims gzhung du yang rigs rgyud mi gcig pa'i mi cog tse gcig tu za ma bza' mi chog cing mnyam du sdod mi chog la/khron pa gcig nang gi chu yang 'thung mi nyan zhes gtan la phab yod/ 6 slar skye ba'i rigs dang 66slar mi skye ba'i rigs bar la gnyen sgrig byed mi chogabasdoms nas bshad na/ rigs rgyud kyi lam lugs ni rgya gar gyi spyi tshogs su gral rim rmang gzhir byas pa'i gral rim gyi lam lugs khyad par pa zhig yin/ 'on kyang gral rim gyi 'brel ba gsal po gral rim gyi dbye ba'i nang du sbas yod phyir de'i gral rim gyi dbye mtshams sog por bzo sla/ ngal rtsol mi dmangs bar du 'gal ba dang gdong thug bslang pa kho tsho'i bar gyi mthun sgril la mi phan/ rigs rgyud lam lugs dus yun ring por chos lugs dang khrims lugs kyis rgyab skyor thob pa las da gzod gnas thub pa byung ngo //lo rgyus kyis rigs rgyud lam lugs kyi gnas thub pa ni rgya gar gyi spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas dal ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo zhig yin/spyil sngon gyi dus rabs drug par grong khyer rgyal khab kyi dar rgyas dang dpal 'byor mu mthud du gsar spel dang lo mang por dmag 'khrug brgyab pas spyi tshogs kyi 'gal ba je drag tu song nas/ mthar rigs rgyud lam lugs dang bram ze'i chos la ngo rgol gtsor dmigs pa'i rigs rgyud la ngo rgol byed pa'i las 'gul byung / las 'gul 'di las dmag don sku drag yin pa'i rgyal rigs dang 'byor phyug ldan pa'i rje rigs kyi mtho rim pa'i rang nyid kyi go gnas dman par blo ma tshim pas/ kho tsho'i khe phan mtshon zhing bram ze'i chos lugs kyi dbang cha khas mi len pa'i chos lugs gsar bawa sangs rgyas chos lugs de dang bstun nas byung ngo //83

zasagatsang rgyal sras sangs rgyas tshul/wangalisakho/rgya gar gyi bran g.yog lam lugs kyi 'phel rgyas brgyud rim khrod/ bram ze'i chos lugs kyis srung skyob byed pa'i rigs rus lam lugs nyin re bzhin log spyod du song bar/ mi dmangs kyis ngo rgol byed pa ma zad/ chu bo gaṅgā'i 'bab rgyud du stobs dang ldan par 'gyur bzhin pa'i rgyal rigs dang rje rigs sogs kyis kyang blor ma babs/ spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs drug par/ rgyal rigs dang rje rigs kyis bram ze'i rigs la ngo rgol byed spyad kyi chos lugs te sangs rgyas bstan pa de chu bo gaṅgā'i bar smad rgyud nas dar rgyas byung /spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs drug par/ ri bo hi ston pa shākya thub pa/ma la ya'i 'dabs rol du/ shākya'i rigs kyis dbang sgyur byed pa'i grong khyer ser skya(da lta'i ne+e pa la ) chags yod la/ grong khyer 'dis bram ze'i chos lugs la dad pa byas nas rigs dus lam lugs lag bstar byed cing / rgyal bo zas gtsang ni rgyal rigs su gtogs/ rgyal bo zas gtsang la mtshan dpes brgyan zhing dpa' mdzangs ldan pa'i na gzhon rgyal sras shig yod pa'i rus go ta ༵ byin zhing mtshan la don kun grub pa(spyi lo sngon gyi 566lo nas spyi lo sngon

gyi 486lo bar) zer/ ya mtshar zhig la/ rgyal sras de rgyal bo'i rgyal rgyud 'dzin mkhan yin pa ma zad/ khyim mtshes rgyal khab kyi rgyal po shākya lag na be+e con can gyi sras mo grags 'dzin ma btsun mor bsus yod na'ang 'di dag gis kho'i sems kyi skyo gdung sel thub kyi med/ kho rang srid dbang dang stobs 'byor la khyon nas mi dgyes par/ 'jig rten 'di'i skye 'gro mtha' dag gi gsang ba'i khungs lung 'tshol rgyur ha cang thugs spro byung nas/ rtag tu 'gro ba mi'i rigs 'di'i 'dra mnyam min pa'i snang tshul sna tshogs la mno bsam gtong ba ste/ mi rnams rigs rus bzhi ru bkar dgos don ci yin nam/miyin pa'i cha nas tshang ma 'dra 'dra yin pa la ci'i phyir mi la la bram ze'i rigs yin zhing la la rigs rus gzhan yin dgos byung ba yin/ bram ze'i phyi rabs pa ci'i phyir sngar bzhin bram ze yin nam/ gdol ba'i rigs kyi phyi rabs pa nam yang gdol ba'i rigs yin pa ci yin nam/rgyal sras de nyid pha mtha' med pa'i skyo gdung dang yi mug las thar ched/rgyal sras rang lo nyer dgur bslebs pa'i dus te/ spyi lo sngon gyi 538lor/rgyal bo zas gtsang gis bka' phab ste rgyal sras la yid 'ong skyed mos tshal zhig bzhings skrun byed du bcug la/ ngo mtshar lta na sdug pa'i mdzes ljongs kyis rgyas sras la dga' spro khyer yong ba'i re ba bcangs nyin zhig sku srung ba dag gis shing rta 'khor lo drangs nas/ rgyal sras don kun grub pa skyed mos tshal du gdan 'dren zhus/ lam bar du rgyal sras kyis/ gon pa ngan ngon gyon pa'i 6 gdol ba zhig brel 'tshub ngang lam du 'gro zhor sdug pa'i cho de 'don pa dang / de mur sku srung ba zhig gis lcag tshan gyisagatum brab byas nas gdol ba khrag gis bsgres na'ang ngo rgol tsam yang byed mi phod pa mthong /6 kye ma/ 'jig rten na 'di 'dra'i 'dra mnyam min pa'ang gakāX ba

la/ rgyal sras kyis don dag 'dir bsam gzhig btang bar/ sems skyo'i grib nag gis mdzes pa'i bzhin ras yongs su g.yogs/shing rta 'khor lo zhing kha ru bskyod dus/ tsha gdug che ba'i nyi ma'i 'og tu so nam pa dag gis lus po sgur nas zhing tshigs su ngal dub myong la/ re re bzhin lus zungs zad de skam por gyur yod cing / lcag tshan gzhus pa'i ba glaji dag gis thong gshol drud de dka' tshegs kyis mdun du skyod pa'ang ma nga ‘/6sdug pa la/ rgyal sras kyi zhal las dbang med du skad shor/ kho rang skyed mos tshal du 'grim 'dod ye nas ma byung bas pho brang du phyir ldog pa'i bka' phab byung / shing rta 'khor lo grong khyer gyi mkhar sgo'i nang du 'dzul ma thag rga ba'i khur gyis non pa'i bgres song skam rid cig bang du tsog ste 'gro lam bcad/ bgres po de'i kha na so mu tig tsam yang med la/ mig 'gram nas rnag chu shar mar brdol 'ongs/ rgyas sras kyis de mthong nas dngangs 'dar zhig brgyab nas na re/ 6 kye ma/ mi thams cad skrag gin pa'i rga ba'i sdug bsngal ni 'di 'dra ba zhig red ang /mi nyi ma kha shas 'gor rjes/ rgyal sras yang bskyar phyi rol du ljongs rgyur phebs/ khong gi ru khag mi 'tshub che ba'i thang chen du 'byor dus/ glo bur du dur skyel ru khag cig dang 'phrad/ bem ro rengs por gyur pa zhig mi rnams kyis btegs nas 'gro ba dang / dur skyel ba tshos brang rdung rkang deb kyis ngu ngag chen po dang ag skad ring mo bton pas bar snang gshag par byed/ rgyal sras don kun grub pas de dag mthong ma thag re zhig sems mi dga' zhing //shā mdog skya bor gyur/ sku srung ba dag gis 'phral mar kho rang pho brang du 86dus de nas bzung / rgyal sras bsam gzhig gting zab mo'i g.yang du

byings pa ma zad/ 'khor ba las mngon par 'byung ba'i spobs pa'ang 'khrunga~X /de'i zla ba 12pa'i tshesaḥnyin gyi dgong mor/ rgyal sras don kun grub pa sdong po'i 'og tu rdo rje'i skyil krung gis ting 'dzin la bzhugs pa ni srog gi rgyu ba bral ba'i 'bag sku zhig dang gnyis su ma mchis/ glo bur du/ pho brang nangagi zhal ta ma zhig dga' mchong dang bcas khong gi mdun du 'ongs nas/sras mo grags 'dzin ma la sras shig bltams pa zhus/ rgyas sras kyis mgo bo yar la bkyags tshe/ pho brang du sgron 'od rnam par bkra zhing mi tshogs mang po dga' ba'i glu dang skyid pa'i bro la rol te rten 'brel zhu bzhin pa da gzod mthong / 'dar yom zhig dang bcas te khong gis phyag zung gis zhal ras bkab cing / gdung yus chen pos/ 6 kye ma rmongs shing snying rje ba'i mi rnams/ nga'i bu chung skyes par rten 'brel zhu rgyu ga re yod/ kho rang skyes ma thag nas skye rga na 'chi'i sgrog tu tshud pa mi shes sam/ zhes gsung zhor/dbang med sgos yar bzhengs la chung ma dang bu phrug gi brtse dung gis sras mo'i pho brang phyogs su khrid/ 'on te gom pa kha shas spos rjes 'gro mtshams bzhag ste/ 6 mi rnams bdag 'dzin gyi sgrog las thar te bden don 'tshol rgyu ni ji 'dra ba'i sla mo zhig ma red ang /7zhes dngan pa 'then/ khos blo thag rbad kyis bcad de/ mtshan mo der rgyal srid dang / bu dang chung ma bskyur te chos 'tshol lam la zhugs/rgyal srid sras la gtod rgyu thag bcad pa'i rgyal bo zas gtsang gis/rgyalasras bros song ba'i gnas tshul thos ma thag mtshan mo der phyogs bzhir 'tshol mi mngags/ lo phyed 'das pa'i rjes su/ rgyal sras 'tshol ba'i ru khag cigagis/ nags tshal zhig gi dkyil du/ skra bzhar nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i btsun pa don kun grub pa rnyed la/ kho tshos phyir pho brang la phebs hā/sa

pa'i zhu ba ji 'dra byas na'ang / don kun grub pas 6 nga'i bla na med pa'i 'gan 'khri ni skye rga na 'chi dang 'dra mnyam min pa las rnam par rgyal ba byed rgyu de yin pas/ dmigs yul ma 'grub na gtan nas phyir mi 'gro zhes gdamaḥl/ sras kyis grong khyer ser skya dang ma gha dha gnyis kyi sa mtshams kyi nags tshal khrod du/ ring 'phur zer ba'i dka' thub spyod pa grags can zhig bzhugs pa thos pas/ de la bsten nas mi tshe'i mnar gcod kyi bden pa 'tshol rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ lam bar du don kun grub pas 'khyag ltogs kyi dka' ngal mang po myangs pa dang / rkang pa'i mthil brdol te khrag dmar 'dzar ba byung na'ang snying rus bskyed pas/ mtha' mar brag phug cig gi sgo nas ring 'phur dang mjal/ dus yun yud tsam 'gor rjes/ ring 'phur ba'i lta ba ni ci yang med pa'i skye mched ces pa ste/ gsang ba lkog gyur gyi phyi shun 'og tu/ nyog dra che ba'i chos lugs cho ga mang po dus bcad ltar bsgrubs nas/ mi phyed dad pa brtan pos lha la dmar mchod byas na rnam shes lhayul du 'pho thub par bzhed pa las ma 'das/ de ltar na chos 'dis mya ngan las mi 'da' ba dang sdug bsngal zad par mi 'gyur bar dgongs nas/rtogage ba gdams ngag che bar grags pa lhag spyod ces par bsten nas srid rtse'i snyom 'jug mngon du mdzad kyang de ga'ang thar pa'i lam du mi 'gyur bar gzigs te/ chu bo nirañdza na'i 'gram du byon te dka' ba lo drug spyad/bsam gtan mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin la gnyam par bzhag ste lus sems tshar bcad cing gzir bas/ rgyal bu'i sku lus rdzob po mig gis mi bzod par gyur cing / dbu sku'i gseb tu bye'us tshang yang bzos pa byung / yin na'ang lo mang dka' ba spyad pa'i 'bras bu ni sgyu ma'i rmi lam lta bur gyur song / nyin zhiswā /gas blo rbad de pham pa'i rgyal sras chu klung 'gram du phebs nas khrus

gsol sgos blo spobs bskyed par dgongs nas sku lus gtsang mar bkrus ma thag 'tsho bcud kyis ma 'dang ba dang lus shugs 'dzad drags pas dran med du brgyal/ stabs legs pa la grong ba'i bu mo su dza ta las mthong ste 'o ma la 'bras sar pa btab pa'i lde gus bsnyen bkur byas stabs/ sku lus kyi mthu brtas shing stobs bskyed pa byung / grong pa'i bu mor thugs rje che zhus rjes/chu bo ne+e rañdza na dang gyes te wā rā ṇa sī dang rgyang mi ring ba'i ri bo ga ya'i phyogs su byon/ de ru byang chub kyi ljon pa chen po zhig mthong ba'i drung du bkra shes rtswa mchog gdan du btings nas skyil mo krung bcas sku drang mor bsrang ste dran pa mngon du bzhag ste zhal shar du phyogs par bzhugs nas/ 6 stan 'dir bdag gi lus 'di skam pa'am// pags pa rus pa'i tshogs rnams zhig gyur kyang // bskal mang rnyed dka'i byang chub ma thob bar// stan 'di las ni lus bskyod mi bya'o// zhes dam bca' mdzad/ de ltar rgyal sras kyis slar yang 'tshol zhib gsar ba zhig gi 'go brtsams so//ngag rgyun ltar na/ byang chub ljon pa de'i 'og tu nyin zhe dgu la ting 'dzin dam por bzhugs mthar mngon par byang chub pa'i mdzad pa bstan/'jig rten du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dam bcas/ ma gha dha'i rgyal po gzugs can snying bos rgyal bu don kun grub pa mngon par byang chub pa thos nas chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram rgyud kyi grong khyer wā rā ṇa sī'i nye 'gram gyi ldang brang gi tshal du gdan drangs nas chos 'khor bskor du bcug de nas bzung dgung lo so lnga bzhes pa'i rgyal sras don grub pas bgrang bya bzhi bcu zhe lnga yi ring la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i 'go brtsams pa dang / khong gis mtho ba rgyal po dang sku drag dma' bsna mi ser sprang slong yan gyi bu slob mtha' yas chos kyis bskyangs shing / thengs shig sku yul du phebs nas rang gi sras tha chung sgra gcan 'dzin yang slob 'khor du nyar/ rjes 'jug pa rnams kyis ༵༵ la

4shākya mu ne+e zhes 'bod cing / de'i nang don ni shākya'i rigs su 'khrungs pa'isgo gsum mi dge ba dang nyon mongs pa las yang dag par bsdams pa'i dam pa zhes pa'o// dus der rgya gar pa'i ngos zin la dus yun ring po re'i mtshams su/ 'jig rten gyi de nyid rtogs pa'i rnam dpyod can te4sangs rgyas mire 'byon pa dang de yis mi yul la thabs dang shes rab bsnams yong bar 'dod/ der brten shākya mu ni'i rjes 'jug pas khong la sangs rgyas zhes kyang 'bod la khong gis gsar gtod gnang ba'i chos lugs la sangs rgyas chos lugs zer/sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dgongs pa'i gnad ni bden pa bzhi zhes rno yin zhing de'i go don ni gnas lugs bzhi zhes pa'o/ / bden bzhi zhes pa dang po/ sdug bsngal bden pa ste/ shākya mu ne'i dgongs par/ 'jig rten gyi yod tshad mthar gtug na sdug bsngal las ma 'das/gnyis pa/ kun 'byung bden pa ste/ sdug bsngal thams cad skyed byed kyi rgyu ni las dang nyon mongs pa yin la/ 'dod pa thog tu ma babs na sdug bsngal 'byung ba sogs gsal bshad byed/gsum pa/ 'gog pa'i bden pa ste/ sdug bsngal gyi skyed byed gang yin gsal bor nges rjes/ spang bya kun 'byung las nyon mongs gtan du mi skye bar byas te spangs par gdams pa'o// sangs rgyas chos lugs kyis 'di la myang 'das zer ro/ /bzhi ba/ lam gyi bden pa ste/ kun 'byung spong byed kyi gnyen por zag med las bsgom pa ste/ de la gtso bo chos la thos bsam dang tshul khrims bsrung ba/ ting 'dzin la gzhol ba sogs 'du/laston pa shākya thub pa sa phyogs mang por byon nas chos bden pa bzhi'i mi

'khor lo bskor/ spyi lo sngon gyi 486lor/ dgung lo brgyad cu bzhes pa'i shākya mu ne bgres po'i khur gyis non nas sku bskungs shing / zla gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin/ rang gi bu slob la shing drung sa la zung gi bar du mnal ba'i khri bca' nas bla gos bting du bcug rjes glo g.yas pa sar phab nas gzims shing / rtse gcig chos kyi snying bor gzhol nas sangs rgyas bstan pa khyab par spel ba'i zhal chems tha ma bstsal/ rjes sor/ dad ldan slob ma rnams kyis khor+sha gi skuso drin snying du bcangs nas dgon pa'i nang du ston pa glo nyal gyi sku ba nga/ nga /thog/ sangs rgyas chos lugs la lha khang med la sku rten sogs mchod bya yang med/ ston pa shākya thub pa gshegs rjes/ dad ldan slob mas khong gi sku gdung zhugs la sbyangs pa dang / shul du lus pa'i gdung rus dang gdung thal ni(sangs rgyas chos lugs pas ring bsrel zer/)sa cha so sor bzhengs pa'i tsita(mchod rten)ru bcug nas nyar tshags byas/ de'i rjes la da gzod dgon pa dang sku rten byung ba yin zhing / ston pa shākya mu de'i 'bag sdo ni phal cher spyi lo'i dus rabs dang po'i rjes la byung ba bston du med shākya mu nes gsar gtod gnang ba'i sangs rgyas chos lugs kyis/bram ze'i chos lugs kyi dbang grags rtsis med btang ba dang rigs dus lam lugs khrod kyi bram ze'i khyad par can gyi go gnas la dgag pa brgyab nas/skye 'gro thams cad 'dra mnyam yin pa'i 'dod tshul bzung ba ni/ skabs der mtshon na yar thon gyi don snying ldan mod/ 'on kyang de nyid mthar gtug na bran g.yog spyi tshogs srung skyob byed pa'i chos lugs yin pa ma zad rigs rus lam lugs med par gtong ba'i 'dod blo mi 'dzin par/ ldog ste rgyal rigs kyi go gnas de spyi tshogs kyi yang dang por 'jog pa'i 'dod tshul 'ardo/ pa

dang / 'gro ba mi'i sdug bsngal gyi 'byung rtsa bshad pa'i tshe na gral rim gnya' gnon gyis sdug bsngal bskyed pa btang snyom du bzhag la/ sdug bsngal las grol ba'i ched du 'dod sred med par gtong ba dang 'thab rtsod rgyang du dor te sgyu ma lta bu'i myang 'das 'tshol snyeg byed du bcug pa ni/ dbang sgyur gral rim gyis mi rnams sbrid 'thom dang dbang sgyur byed pa'i lag char gyur/ rjes su sangs rgyas chos lugs de rang rgyal dang e sha ya shar ma dang lho ma'i rgyal sdob khag tu dar nas 'dzam gling gi chos lugs chen po gsum gyi gras su tshud 92

6 rlabs cheba'i silamang rgyag mkhan mthe ne khe a'i mi/sonatran/gna' dus su/ sa dbus rgya mtsho'i shar 'gram ste/ de ring gi rgyal khab le pa non(2668bzhes ༅smo )dngase ri a(5708chu(lko1༅)yi mtsho 'gram sa khul du rgyal khab cig yod par h+phe ne+e khe a(2647 01 chis/76)zer/ spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo rabs sum stong pa ru/ h+phe ne+e khe a ba ni zheng dog cing dkyus ring ba'i yul khongs de ru 'tsho ba rol bzhin 'dug yul khongs de'i shar nub kyi zhing tshad la spyi le 10nas 20tsam las med cing / lho byang gi gzhung tshad la spyi le 200la nye ba yod/ nub phyogs yongs rgya mtshor 'brel ba dang /le lnga non(606820ba stsakha )ri bor shug sdong spus legs skyes pa de gru gzings bzo byed kyi rgyu cha bzang po yin stabs/ h+phe rna khe a ba la thog ma nyid nas rgya mtshor skyod pa'i cha rkyen gzhan las lhag pa zhig ldan/ h+phe ne khe a ba yis 'bru rigs mang po mi 'debs na'ang / kho tshos ri ldebs su rgun 'brum gyi shing dang shing skyu ru ra 'debs pa'i goms srol yod cing / lo re'i lo legs thob pa'i dus tshigs su dga' ston rten 'brel gyi tshogs chen tshogs shing lha mo a si ḍa tha la thugs rje zhu ba'i mchod 'bul byed/ kho chos snyal ba'i rgun chang dmar po dang / btsir len byas pa'i a ru ra'i snum ni nye shar sa khul du skad grags khyab yod/ h+phe ne+e kha a'i tshong pa rnams kyis dang po nyid nas rang yul las thon pa'i snum dang chang / lag bzos dngos po sogasdu /ra

nas yul gzhan du song nas 'bru rigs dang dngos po gzhan la brje res byed/kho tshos sems la de ni phyug por 'gyur ba'i thabs lam ches legs po zhig red snyam gyi 'dug gle ne+e khe a ba la da dung dmigs bsal gyi dngos po zhig yod pa ni mtsho 'gram gyi chu gting zab sa las blangs pa'i 'grom bu zhig yin te/phyi ngos nas bltas na 'grom bu dkyus ma dang khyad par med mod/ de'i khog las kha dog kham smug can gyi gsher khu thig pa 'ga' len thub cing gsher khu de sbyar nas ras la tshos brgyab na/ bkrag mdangs che zhing nyi 'od dang char rlungagang la 'phrad kyang kha dog nam yang mi nyams pa red/ de'i phyir ghi ri si'i mi yis h+phe ne khe a la kha dog dmar smug —can gyi rgyal khab zer ro/h+phe ne+e khe a yi yul khongs chung rung de ni thog ma nyid nas gcig gyur gyi rgyal khab cig min zhing / spyi lo sngon gyi 200)lo yas mas su rgya mtsho'i 'gram yul du snga gzhug tu mkhar grong rgyal khab 'ga' shas chags/ grong khyer re la rang rang gi do dam las khungs yod cing de'i nang gtso bo rgan gras gling dang 'bangs mi tshogs pa/ rgyal po bcas 'du/ rgyal po de ni srid dbang sger gcod kyi rgyal po min pas/ thabs jus gal chen du ma ni don dngos su tshong pa phyug po las grub pa'i rgan gras gling gis bkod cing / 'bangs mi tshogs pa ni gros don la 'os mthun byung sa yin la dngos kyi dbang cha med/ sku drag nyung shas ni rgyal khab kyi bdag po dngos su gyur 'dug pas/ rgyal khab 'di'i srid dbang gi sgrig srol la sku drag nyung ngus dbang bsgyur pa'i srid dbang sgrig srol zer/ h+phe ne+e khe a la sngar nas bzung yul khongs gzhan dag gcig gyur byed thub pa'i stobs shugs shig byung ma myong la/ dus mtshungs su/ stobs shugs che ba'i khyim mtshes rgyal khab kyi shugs rkyen 'og tu gnas pas/ rgyal khab gcig gyur byed rgyu gang las kyang dka' por gyur/ khyim mtshes rgyal khab nadī /bas shugs che ba la e jib dang / a si ri ya/(43374 thasgro 7)sba spe

lon/(2mne7100 3667)sogs yod/ spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs drug par slobs pa'i dus su/ e jib dang a she ya nub ma'i sa khul phal che ba par zig (26731 lnga'i46)①btsan rgyal gyi mnga' khongs su bsdus shing h+phe ne khe a yang par zig gis bzung na'ang / dus skabs mi 'dra ba kha shas la h+phe ne+e khe a ru shin tu dar ba'i mkhar grong rgyal khab 'ga' shas byung myong / de nang lhag tu skad grags che ba ni spyi lo sngon gyi lo rabs nyis stong pa'i smad du dar ba'i si sgron(51 60ba spyo145) zhes pa'i rgyal khab(deng skabs kyi le lnga non gyi se ḍa(byam sku rngo7)zhes pa'i yul du yod)dang thi re(1170 77)zhes pa'i(deng gi le lnga non gyi sur(501 77)zhes pa'i yul du yod) mkhar grong rgyal khab 'di gnyis ni h+phe ne khe a'i yul du snyan grags che ba ma zad da dung dkyil skor rgya mtsho'i yul 'khor gyi lo rgyus gar stegs thog kyang mig dbang 'phrog pa'i 'khrab ston pa bgyi myong ngo spyoglezhe khe a ba ni gna' bo'i dus kyi 'dzam gling gi tshong byed mi rigs shig yin pas kho tshos tshong brin po rgyag shes la/ lhag par du mtsho thog nas dngos po sna tshogs skyel 'dren byas te khe spogs chen po len thub pas/ mi rigs gzhan ni de yi do zlar mi 'ongs par 'dug kho tsho'i mtsho gru ni de 'dra chen po min yang dri zhim shug pas bzos shing steng du thang chu dang tshos byugs pas/ rul dka' zhing mig la'ang mdzes/ mtsho gru de rigs gru khar slebs pa na mi rnams kyis h+phe ne+e khe a ba slebs pa shes thub/ h+phe ne+e khe a ba rgya mtsho la bskyod pa'i lam phyogs gnyis yod de/ gcig ni sa'i phar si((79las 07)gling phran stetha las a she ya chung ba'i lho 'gram brgyud e jin mtsho(sa06082 568 〈sna )la zhugs nas/ byang gi he le si phon tho si① bod skad du ta gag stagagazigazer pa'iyalade'i sngon ma'i 'bod stangagashigaredage ra/shā

(5050390ba 03 77lo7)dang mtsho bhi la kho(2175 568 lo)yi 'gram khul la song zhing / 'di ni phal cher si zlon(51 70ba spyo1:smo)gyi mtsho skyod pa'i lam phyogs yin pas/ ghi ri si ba'i gna' bo'i gtam rgyud du si zlon gyi mi'i skor brjod pa mang la h+phe ne+e khe a'i mi'i skor brjod pa zhung bas kyang gnas tshul der ra 'phrod 'dug 'on kyang e rjin rgya mtsho'i sa khul du ghi ri si'i ba'i stobs shugs je cher song ba dang h+phe ne+e khe a'i mi la 'bud 'ded btang bas/ kho tsho rim bzhin mtsho skyod lam phyogs de blos mi gtong ba ka med byung / lam phyogs cig shos ni gling chen a h+phe ri kha'i byang 'gram nas e jib dang li bhi ya(21 6kro lko/7༅)brgyud de gang 'dod bzhin nub phyogs su skyod pa red/ mtsho lam 'di ru brel bzhin pa rnams ni thi re ba yin la/ kho tshos gling chen a h+phe ri kha'i byang khul dang dkyil skor rgya mtsho'i nub phyogs kyi gling phran kha shas steng mi ser spel yul gyi tshong ra du ma btsugs shing de'i nang ches che shos ni deng skabs kyi thu ni si a(15ba131 74khu467)yi mtsho khug gi khar gzi ji((22 6860787)zhes pa red/ khar gzi rji ni spyi lo sngon gyi814lor thi rdo(sras mo i li bza')yi rjes su 'brangs pa'i thi re'i yul 'ongs pa rnams kyis btsugs zer skad/ sa de'i yul bab bzang ba dang thon dngos phun sum tshogs pas myur du tshong las gru kha zhig tu chags/ spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs drug par slobs tshe/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i nub yul gyi rgyal khab stobs ldan zhig tu gyur/ h+phe ne khe a ba rnams kyi phyug po 'gyur ba'i 'dod pa khongs rgyu med de/ kho tshos sa dbus rgya mtsho'i yul khams ni da rung chung song snyam nas/ he ra khi le si(50136123 khri777)rdo ring(rji bhi ro thur mtsho 'gagaci ngal 010161ma 21)brgal zhing / e bhi ri kha gling phran phyed ma'i(se phan)nub phyogs mtsho 'gram brgyud de/ byang phyogs su thad kur dardiswā g+ne lan ḍi ru skyod pa red/ sa khams kyi shes bya med cing bzo rtsal zhan

pa 'di lta ste/ ḍa ma si ((66)ba yis khyod kyi las ka mang ba'i steng khyod la rgyu nor sna tshogs kyang mang pas he phen zhes pa'i chang dang lug bal khyod la btsong / wi tan ( khri)pa dang ya wan pa ( zal)yis bkal zin pa'i skud pa dang lcags 'od can(lkoṣ+ṭha)/ shing tsha(ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha)/ mu ra (sbyo )sogs khyod kyi dngos po la brje/ thi ḍan (༅khri)pa yis kum pa li mchog dang sgarlangs tshags kyis khyod dang dngos po brje len byed/ a rab (༅756)kyimi dang snyi ḍan (77)pa yis lu gu dang / sha gzan/ ra pho sogs kyis khyod la tshongabyed/ si lha'i (ṭha༅)tshong ba dang la sma'i (77)tshong bas kyang khyod dang tshong rgyag ste/ kho tshos dri zhim gyi rdzas spus legs dang rin po che'i rigs sna tshogs/ gser sogs khyod kyi dngos po la brje/ tha se ba'i gru gzings ni ltar la bsgrigs nas khyod kyi dngos po skyel 'dren byed cing / khyod rang rgya mtsho'i steng du dpal yon dar zhes so// 'di ru brjod pa'i mi rigs mang po zhig ni deng skabs gang yin mi gsal mod/ de las h+phe ne+e khe a ba slebs sa'i rgya khongs ni ji 'dra'i chen po yin pa mtshon yod cing / spyir bshad na/ kho tsho'i brje res byas pa'i dngos po'i rigs sna yang ha cang 'dzoms por 'dug tsom pa po kha shas kyis dgod bro ba'i ngang h+phe ne+e khe a ba rnams ni gna' bo'i 'dzam gling steng gi rlabs che ba'i sil tshong rgyag mkhan red ces bshad par gnas lugs med pa ga re yin/ yin na'ang / gna' bo'i dus su h+phe ne khe a ba la ngan spyod tha shal pa'i ming yang thog yod/ kho tshor g.yo sgyu che ba ma zad gdug rtsub kyang che/ dngul len pa'i ched du thabs ngan gang la'ang brten pas/ rgyun du mtha' khobs yul dang yang na yul sdod pa'i sde ba'i nang song nas/ rin thang chung ba'i ca lag chung chung ste dper na bud med kyi 'dogs cha dang phru gu'i rtsed spyad sogs bstan te/ mi rnams la ya mardokā bslangs nas gser dngul dang / rin po che/ dri zhim rdzas/ ba so

sogs rin thang can gyi dngos po la brje res byed/ zhor du bshad rgyu zhig la h+phe ne khe ba yis ches thog mar shel gsar skrun byas pas/ kho tshos kha dog sna brgya bkra ba'i shel bzos dngos po bzo zhing / ma gnas mthon po mi dgos pa'i dngos po de ca lag dngos mar brje ba dang / 'phro ru gzhan la btsong nas khe spogs chen po len/ mi tshong rgyag pa ni h+phe ne+e khe a ba rnams kyi g.yo rtsal zhig yin la de ni ches khe spogs can gyi zhor las mishig kyang red/ kho tshos mi rnamasakyi dogs zon lhod par bstun nas phru gu gru gzings steng slu khrid byas nas gar song cha med du bros 'gro/ bshad rgyun la skabs shig e jin rgya mtsho'i sde lo si(26103 47)gling phran steng h+phe ni khe a ba'i bran g.yog btsong mkhan gyis srang lam zhig khor 'dzin byas nas bran g.yog gi tshong rgyag gin yod zer/ h+phe ne khe ma'i gru bdag rnams la bran g.yog bkol ba'i thabs ya nga ba zhig yod pa ni bran g.yog tsho gru'i thog tu bgyigs nas skya ba brgyab nas gru gtong gi 'jug pa de yin la/ las ka der ngal tshegs shin tu che ba ma zad/ rlung chen dang mtsho rlabs drag por 'phrad tsa na gru bdag tsho rang srog thar e thub thub byed pas/ gru la bkyigs pa'i bran g.yog tsho ni mtsho la lhung nas lnga ba'i lam la mi 'gro ka med yin/h+phe ni khe a'i mi'i rgya mtshor skyod pa'i nyams myong 'di la rgyal khab du ma'i dbang sgyur pas mthong chen byas/ a si ri a'i rgyal po dang par zig gi rgyal po yis h+phe ne khe a ba'i stobs shugs la brten nas kho tsho'i mtsho dmag dar spel btang ba dang / e jib kyi h+pha rog gis h+phe ne khe a ba tsho dang 'brel gtugs byas pa de bas kyang mang / spyi lo sngon gyi 600lo yas mas su/ e jib kyi dpal 'byor la 'phel rgyas chen po byung zhing h+pha rog ne khe lkogazhes pas gling chen a h+phe ri kha'i lho rgyud la rtog zhib byed pa'i 'char gzhi bzos nas/h+phe ne+e khe a'i mtsho skyod la mkhas pa'i mi dang gru pa mang po bkug cing / sdi /ra
