bar phebs nas sa khul so so'i gna' shul gnas mchog tu mar mjal myong ba dang / gna' rabs ghi ri si'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba dang tshan rig pa the le si(16163 677)sogs dang grogs por gyur/ rjes su so lon dang mkhas pa de dag la gna' rabs ghi ri si'i skye bu dam pa bdun zhes 'bod/ gong smos 'gro skyod nang shes rgya je cher song ba'i thog 'og rim mi ser dkyus ma'i sdug bsngal la'ang rgyus mnga' zab mo lon/ khong ni chab srid steng rus rgyud sku drag gi ham shed sger gcod la yi ma rang pas rim bzhin bzo tshong bran g.yog bdag po'i phyogs su 'khor/so lon ni phul du byung ba'i snyan ngag pa zhig yin pas/ khong gi snyan tshig nang du rang gi gshes spyod dang 'dun pa mtshon par mkhas/ da dung snyan tshig nang mtshan nyid rig pa'i legs bshad dang chab srid kyi lta stangs bsres nas/ mi rnams 'thab 'dzing dang chab srid 'thab rtsod la zhugs rgyur skul 'ded btang / lo rgyus steng a then dang khyim mtshes rgyal phran smo kha la ( meb7)gnyis kyis gling phran sa la smi si(57771 bya khrichi)brtsad de dmag 'khrug rgyag myong / sa la smi si gling phran ni a then gyi nub phyogs mtsho 'gram la nye bas de'i sgo chen du gyur 'dug gling phran de sngar a then la dbang mod/dus yun ring por smo kha la yis bdag bzung byas/ a then kyis thengs 'ga' la dmag drangs nas phyir len snyam rung dmag pham nas ma lon/ blun rmongs nus med kyi gdung rgyud sku drag tshos mtsho phyi'i tshong las la sems khur gtan nas byed kyi mi 'dug da dung mi sus kyang yi ge steng ngam ngag thog nas sa la smi gling phran 'phrog len du 'gro ba'i gros gzhi 'don mi chog ste/ gal srid sus da lta byas tshe gsod chad gcod rgyu zhes pa'i khrims kyang bzos/ so lon ni de lta ba'i mgo sgur gnyod chung gi spyod par shin tu ma dga' bas/ drang bzhag med pa'i khrims lugs de dang mi 'gal la/ a then gyi 'bangasdu 4/ la

spobs pa'ang spel thub pa'i thabs shes shig 'tshol dgos snyam/ khong nam rgyun smyo khul byas nas/ tshong rar song nas mi mang po'i mdun du khong gi snyan tshig blor 'don pa dang / khong gi snyan tshig sheg tu/nga tsho salasmi ru 'gro/yid 'ong gling phran 'di yi ched du 'thab 'dzing byed/sha lan len ched sal smi ru 'gro/cha zhes skul ma btang bas/ a then pa rnams kyi rgyal gces spro sems spel ba dang mi rigs kyi la rgya'i me lce sbar du bcug de nas gzhung gis bkag khrims kyang mi dgos pa bsgrags/ a then pa rnams kyis dmag shugs bskyar sgrigacos pa dang so lon bkod 'doms pa la bskos/ spyi lo sngon gyi 60)lo yas mas su/ so lon sku ngo mas blos blangs dmag dpung khag cig khrid nas thabs kyis sa la smi si gling phran blangs/ de nas bzung so lon gyi mtshan snyan grags phyogs bzhir khyab pas a then ru ches skad grags can gyi mi la gyur/'og rim mi ser dkyus mas khong la rgyab skyor byas nas/ kho tsho dka' sdug gi khrod nas bcings 'grol gtong par re mos byas/ mi ser dkyus ma'i gong rim pa tshos khong la gus bkur byas nas/ bzo tshong las rigs dang phyi phyogs tshong las rgya cher spel bar mos 'dun bcangs/ spyi lo sngon gyi 594lor mi ser dkyus mas rgyab skyor 'og so lon ni dbu bzhugs srid skyong mkhan la bskos pas/ khrims 'dzugs pa'i ches mtho'i dbang cha bzung ngo // lo der so lon gyis khrims lugs gsar pa khyab bsgrags byas shing / de la nang don gtso bo 'di dag yod de/ gcig nam yang zhing chung dang de dag gi bu bu mo bran g.yog tu btsong mi chog zhing chung gis bu lon chad pas bran g.yog tu gyur pa thams cad phyir bcings bkrol byed dgos shing phyi yul la /30 g.yog tu btsong ba rnams rgyal khab kyis phyir blu len byed pa dang bun

yig med par bzo dgos/ de nas bzung a then ru dom ldan bran g.yog lam lugs gtan med btang ba red/ gnyis/ rgyu nor gyi mang nyung ltar spyi dmangs rim pa bzhi ru bgos shing / rim pa so sor 'os bstun gyi dbang cha mi 'dra ba yod/ rim pa dang po dang gnyis pa'i spyi dmangs(gdung rgyud sku drag dang bzo tshong bran g.yog bdag po)kyis srid skyong mkhan sogs dbang mtho'i go gnas 'dzin chog spyi dmangs rim pa gsum par(spyir btang du zhing chung dang lag shes bzo las pa mang che ba rim pa 'di la gtogs)rim pa dma'aba'i go gnas 'dzin chog spyi dmangs rim pa bzhi bar(gla ba dang dbul phongs spyi dmangs sogs)go gnas gang yang 'dzin pa'i dbang cha med/'di lta na rgyu nor gyi khyad dbang gis rgyud 'dzin khyad dbang gi tshab byas pas/gsar byung bzo tshong bran g.yog bdag pos chab srid kyi dbang cha len par thabs lam zhig btod pa red/ gsum/ sku drag tshogs 'du la tshod 'dzin byas zhing / spyi dmangs tshogs chen slar 'dzugs byas thog de'i nus pa je mthor btang / da dung las khungs gsar pa gnyis btsugs pa dang de ni mi bzhi brgya can gyi tshogs 'du dang spyi dmangs 'dri gcod las rogs khrims khang red/ mi bzhi brgya can tshogs 'du ni spyi dmangs tshogs 'du la 'dra ba'i rgyun gnas las khungs shig yin zhing a then ru tsho ba bzhi yod pas tsho ba re nas mi 100'dems nas grub/ rim pa gsum pa'i yan gyi spyi dmangs nang 'dems dgos la/ rim pa bzhi ba'i spyi dmangs de'i nang zhugs mi chog spyi dmangs 'dri gcod las rogs khrims khang ni a then gyi ches mtho'i khrims 'dzin las khungs yin zhing spyi dmangs su yin yang 'dri gcod las rogs par 'dems nas gyod gzhi zhib gcod byed par zhugs chog pa red/ bzhi/dngul lon gyi lam lugs bcos bsgyur byas nas/ lag shes bzo las dang tshong las/ phyi phyogs nyo tshong sogs gong spel gtong bar skul lcag byas/151

so lon gyi bcos bsgyur byas pa'i khrims lugs kyi yig cha ni rdo ring dang shing leb steng brkos te/ 'khor bzhin pa'i shing sgrom gru bzhi ma'i nang sprad de tshong ra'i nye 'dabs kyi rgyal don khang du bzhag nas mi yongs la bsgrags byas yod/ khrims lugs gsar pa de spyi tshogs steng tshur snang lan cha chen po byung /so lon gyi bcos bsgyur ni dngos gnas spyi tshogs kyi bsgyur bcos chen po zhig yin pas/ des dpal 'byor dang chab srid steng rus rgyud sku drag gi dbang sgyur la rdung rdeg byas pa dang / a then gyi spyi dmangs nang khul gyi dom can bran g.yog med par bzos nas sger dbang lam lugs 'phel rgyas su je mgyogs su btang ba dang / phyi yul gyi mi dang bran g.yog la khyad par yod pa'i a then gyi spyi dmangs tshogs spyi grub par skul 'ded byas nas/ a then gyi dpal 'byor mgyogs por 'phel rgyas yong ba dang dmangs gtso'i chab srid lam lugs gtan la phabs par thog ma'i rmang gzhi bting ba red/'on kyang so lon gyi chab srid lam phyogs ni cis kyang gsar byung bzo tshong bran g.yog bdag po'i lam phyogs yin pas/ phyogs mang po zhig nas sku drag gi khe phan sngar mus su bzhag so lon gyi snyan tshig shig tu/kho bos 'bangasal sbyin pa 'osashing 'tshams/kho tsho'i mtshan snyan la'ang khe gyong med/rgyu nor longasaspyod can yang de bzhin du/gyong dang gnod pa med par byed/kho bo'i phugachen bzung nasaphyogs gnyisasrung spyogang gi phyogs kyang g.yo dang slu brid med pa byed// ces bkod par bltasan/ so lon gyi bcos bsgyur la 'os med 'grig thabs kyi rang bzhin yod pa shes thub/ so lon gyis spyi tshogs kyi tshabs che'i gnad don te/gardidī /da sku drag la rdung deg thebs par sems ma shi bar kha log rgyag pa

dang / rgya che ba'i mi ser dkyus ma 'og rim pa rnams kyis sa zhing yang bskyar bgo dgos pa'i re ba zhus pa sogs thag gcod mtha' 'khyol byed mi srid pas/don dag zhig la kha g.yar nas phyi rgyal du yul skor du phyin/so lon rang gi mes rgyal la kha bral rjes/ e jib dang se phu ru si/(95943 chi mo) a she ya chung ba sogs yul khams su lo ngo bcu lhag la bskor 'grim byas/ lo rgyus yig cha ru bkod pa ltar na/ so lon gyis a she ya chung ba'i nub khul gyi li sde ya(65cha 8 bla༅༅)rgyal po'i rgyal khab lā bcar 'drir phebs nas/ rgyal khab de'i gong ma khe ro i so si (mchi mo)dang thug 'phrad gnang myong ba dang de'i skor gtam rgyud kyang mtshar po yod de/nyin zhig gong ma de'i mchor nyams can gyi gyon pa bsnams shing gser dang rin po che'i rgyan cha spras nas so lon dang thug 'phrad gnang ba dang / rang gi gser dngul rin po che'i mdzod khang gi sgo phye nas rgyu longs spyod ngom ngom byas rung / so lon gyis mthong chung gi rnam 'gyur bstan/ khe ro i so si yis khong la/ a then gyi mgron po lags/ khyed la blo rig pa rno ba'i skor gyi gtam ni gang mang thos myong / khyed kyis shes bya 'tshol ba'i ched du phyi rol du phebs nas rgyal khams 'grim pa'i skor yang go yod/ da lta kho bos khyen la 'dri rgyu ni mi gang 'dra zhig ni bde skyid kyi dpal la rol pa'i mi yin nam zhes dris shing /rgyal po de'i sems la rang nyid kho na ni 'dzam gling steng ches bde skyid ldan pa'i mi yin pas rang las skyid pa'i mi zhig 'dzam gling du med du snyam rung /yin na'ang so lon ni gzhung drang rngam med cig yin pas/ ngo bstod ci yang med pa'i sgo nas na re/ rgyal po lags/ bdag gis bltas na a then gyi the le si(16163 cha mo)ni ches bde skyid can gyi mi zhig red/ gcig na khong gi grong khyer la dar rgyas mnga' thang ldan pa ma zad/ khong la da dung phul du byung ba'i bu phrug kyang yod/ gnyis pa ni khong gis mi tshe gang bor bde sbyotā kyi

'tsho ba bskyal yang mtha' mjug mes rgyal gyi ched du rang srog phul/ a then gyi mi yis khong nyid grongs pa'i gnas su rgyal khab kyi 'das mjug mdzad de khong la mtshan snyan gyi thob thang mthon po phul zhes brjod tshe/ khe ro i so si cung ma dga' bar mu mthud du so lon la/ 'o na/ de min gzhan ches bde skyid ldan pa'i mi ni yod dam zhes dris pa dang da ni kho bo yin kho na red snyam na yang / bsam yul 'das pa zhig la/ so lon gyis de ni ar sgo si'i (lo 7)khi le a sbi si (2sto/)ma lo)dang sbi don (70)phu nu gnyis red/khong gnyis kyi lus phung la shugs stobs che la/ lus rtsal 'gran tshogs steng bya dga' thob myong / de'i thog lhag tu bstod dgos pa zhig la phu nu gnyis kyis rang gi ma yum la bsnyen bkur byed pa de red/ a sgo si'i mi yis lha mo he ra(501 lkoṣ+ṭha ཿ ri si'i lha sgrung nang gi lha chen po'i btsun mo)la rgyas spro'i mchod 'bul byed pa'i dus chen nyin/ khong gnyis kyi a yum nam rgyun glang 'then shing rta'i nang bzhugs su bcug nas lha khang nang 'gro na'ang / de'i nyin par ba glang dus thog tu khyim la 'ded ma thub pas/ phu nu gnyis kyis shing rta'i 'drud thag gnya' la gon te drud nas ma yum lha khang nang mchod 'bul du bskyal yang / phu nu gnyis ni ngal dub che drags pas tshe las 'das/a sgo si'i mi rnams kyis phu nu gnyis ches phul du byung ba'i mi la bkur nas/phu nu gnyis la 'dra sku bzhengs nas sdel spre(221961 0lo4)lha khang nang gdan drangs yod ces gsungs pa dang / de'i 'phror so lon gyi khe ro i so si (4777)la bde skyid skor gyi gnas lugs gang mang gsungs nas/gnas skabs kyi bde skyid la rang rlom dang nga rgyal bya mi rung bar mi tshe gang bo'isnga mjug la blta dgos par/ tshe gang por bde skyid rgyun 'khyongs byed thub na gzod ches bde skyid can gyi mi yin tshul mang po gsungs/ li sde si'i gong1 /sna skad cha de dag go ba na thugs shin tu mi spro bar gyur pas/ mdun

logs kyi mi kha shas kyis so lon la kha yag ngo bstod kyi tshig 'ga' shod cig ces bskul na'ang/ so lon gyis lan du/ de 'dra gtan nas byed rgyu min/ngo bstod kyi skad cha nyung nyung 'chad dgos shing phan ldan gyi skad cha mang po shod dgos zer/ so lon gyi skad cha de dag nas khong gis rgyu longs spyod las mi'ispyod pa dang bsam pa bzang por mthong chen byed pa gsal por mtshon yod/ don dngos su so lon gyi bsam blo 'di khong gi snga mo'i dus kyi snyan tshig shig las mtshon yod de/gshes ngan g.yo can la rgyu nor mang spyospyod bzang gzhung drang rnams ni dbul zhing phongs/'on kyang spyod bzang nor la mi brje kho thag chodaspyobazang po'isbyod pa nam yang gang sa gang du gnas/rgyu dang nor gyi bdag po nyin rer brje bar byed/gang ltar kyang rgyu nor la brten pa'i chos la dad pa'i khe ro i so si la mtshon na gnas lugs de'i nang don ha go dka' ba red/ khos rang nyid ni 'dzam gling steng bde skyid ldan shos dang rlabs che shos kyi mi yin par snyam nas rang rlom che rung / spyi lo sngon gyi 546lor par zig gi rgyal po rji ru shis (ṭha cha)kyis cham du pham nas btson la bzung ste me khrims bcad/ khrims chad gtong khar da gzod sad rtogs thob pas so lon gyi gsung la ma nyan pas pham kha myong bar 'gyod pa skyes nas/ rje ru shes dang par zig gi dmag gi mdun nas skad mthon po'i ngang kye ma so lon lags zhes so lon gyi ming nas thengs gsum bos te so lon gyi gsung rje ru shes dang par zig gi dmag mir bshad/rje ru shes la'ang yid 'gul thebs nas khe ro i so si (mchikhya mo)khrims las bkrol te tshe thar btang / kha cig gis bshad na/ so lon gyi gsung gis rgyal po zhig gi srog bskyabs shing rgyal po gzhan zhig la bslab bya gnang ze/ 5zhung /

mi ser dkyus ma'i gtso 'dzin ge si' ra tho si/hring kri kong /rtsom yig gong ma'i nang nga tshos so lon gyi bcos bsgyur mtha' 'khyol ba zhig min pas/ mi ser dkyus ma rnams kyis sa zhing bskyar du bgo dgos pa'i re ba skong ma thub pa'i thog rus rgyud sku drag la 'khon sems bslangs pas/gru gzings bsdad de phyi rgyal du mi 'khyam ka med byung tshul gling myong / so lon phyi rgyal du phebs rjes/ a then gyi spyi tshogs 'thab rtsod mu mthud dza drag tu gyur/ 'thab rtsod de gtso bo spang thang pa'i tshogs pa (sto.a la)dang /mtsho 'gram pa'i tshogs pa( sgo la)/ ri sdod pa'i tshogs pa (77 la)gsum bar gyi 'thab rtsod red/ tshogs khag gsum pos gral rim mi 'dra ba'i khe phan gyi 'thus tshab byas yod de/ spang thang tshogs pa'i mi rnams sa yangs thang bde ru sdod la/ sa gshin rgya chen po bzung yod pas rus rgyud sku drag gi 'thus tshab yin stabs/ so lon gyi bcos bsgyur sngon gyi lam lugs slar gso byed dgos zer/ mtsho 'gram tshogs pa'i mi ni mtsho 'gram sa khul du sdod cing bzo tshong bran g.yog bdag po'i 'thus tshab yin pas so lon gyi bcos bsgyur la dga' bsu byas nas kho tshos srid dbang 'dzin dgos pa'i re ba bton/ ri sdod pa'i tshogs pa'i mi mang che ba ag kha sde(sa ji cha tha mchordo)yi shar byang rgyud kyi sa zhan ri khul du sdod la/ tshogs pa de zhing chung dang lag shes bzo las pa/ gter 'don bzo ba sogs 'og rim mi ser dang khrag rgyud ༵ /dra

no si zer zhing kho tsho'i dbang sgyur la the ran no si'i chab srid zer/ don dngos su shod tshul de dang lta ba de 'grig po red ces bshad dka'/ nye rabs kyi mkhas pa du mas ghi ri si'i dus snga mo'i the ran no si'i chab srid ril lo rgyus kyi byas rjes yod par dgongs/ 6 the ran no si de dag gis rgya che ba'i 'og rim mi ser gyi rgyab skyor 'og tu/ 'dems bsko'i thabs lam mi spyod par drag pos thabs kyis gdung rgyud sku drag gi srid dbang 'phrog nas mi ser dkyus ma'i srid dbang btsugs pas/ lo rgyus sngon skyod byed du bcug pa 'di ni dngos gnas don yag po zhig yin la/ skabs de'i dza drag che ba'i 'thab rtsod kyi dgos mkho zhig kyang red ces dgongs shing de la gnas lugs kyang ldan no// phe si thi ra tho si ni de lta bu'i dbang sgyur mkhan zhig red/ khong ni6 the ran ne+e si red zer ba ni srol rgyun gyi phyogs zhen gyi lta tshul yin zhing /de ni mdzad rjes can gyi mi ser dkyus ma'i gtso 'dzin zhig red ces bshad na lo rgyus kyi gdeng 'jog dang mthun pa red/phe si thi ra tho si ni ha lam sbyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs7pa'i smad du a then du sku drag gi khyim rnying ming grags can zhig tu sku 'khrungs shing / khong gi pha yi ming la hi pho khi ra the si (lkoṣ+ṭha༅777)zer zhing khong gi ma yum ni so lon gyi a ma'i pha spun gyi a ce red/ phe si thi ra tho si ni skabs bstun gyi thabs jus la mkhas shing dpa' mdzangs rtul phod can zhig yin/ spyi lo sngon gyi 570lo'i sme sga ra(506818 meXṣ+ṭha)dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha thob pa nas bzung khong la dbang thang rgyas 'go btsams/ dmag 'khrug khrod du khong gis bkod 'doms mdzad par brten a then gyi mi yis ne se a grong khyer (2 sgroyoyi)blangs pas byas rjes chen po bzhag rjes su tshogs pa gsum gyi dbang rtsod 'thab rtsod dus skabs su ri khul tshogs pa'i mi la dka' khag sel rgyu khas blangs nas de dag gi gtso 'dzin du gyur/ 'og rim mi ser dkyus ༵༵ ni

gal srid phe si thi ra tho si the ran no si byas na/ gom gang sngon spos gyis dus rgyud sku drag tshogs pa'i stobs shugs la rdung rdeg byas nas/ kho tshor sa zhing thob thub par snyam nas phe si thi ra tho si la rgyab skyor byed 'dod skyes shing / de lta bu'i nyin zhig slebs 'ongs te/ spyi lo sngon gyi 560lo'i nyin zhig la phe si thi ra tho si yis rang lus la rang gis rmas skyon btang ba dang / khong gi shing rta 'drud byed drel 'ga' grong khyer dbus kyi thang chen la ded de mi rnams la/kho bo'i srid dgra tshos kho bo zhing sder phebs pa'i lam du kho bo gsod rtsis byas zhing en tsam ma gtogs srog shor song zhes khyab bsgrags byas shing / kho bo ni byas rjes can gyi mi yin pa brjed mi rung bas da lta gnas tshul tshabs chen 'ogadapung sde khag cig gis kho bor srung skyob byed dgos zhes bsgrags pa la/ri khul tshogs khag gis khong gi re 'dun la rgyab skyor byas/ rjes su spyi dmangs tshogs chen gyi dngos su phe si thi ra tho si'i re zhur chog mchan bkod de/ khong la dbyug pa bzung ba'i bral med srung dmag 4tshiyod na chog pa byas/ phe si phi ra tho si la srung dmag yod tsa na/ skabs der phyi rgyal nas phyir phebs gnang ba dang sku na bgres pa'i so lon gyi zhal gsung la ma nyan par/srid 'gyur bslangs nas btsan mkhar phab nas ghi ri si'i dbang sgyur mkhan dugyur/ khong gis the ran no sa'i spyod pa spangs nas spyi don thag gcod byas/’ so lon la'ang dgongs yangs gnang nas sngon byas la rtsad gcod ma byas par go skon blo 'gug byas mthar tshur bkug pa red/ 'on kyang phe si thi ra tho sis a then du dbang bzung ba'i dus tshod mi ring ste lo lnga tsam gyi rjes te spyi lo sngon 556lor spang thang tshogs khag dang mtsho 'gram tshogs khag mnyam 'brel byas nas khong nyid phyir skyod btang ngo //yin na'ang cung ma 'gor par a then gyi tshogs khag so so'i dbang rtsod je zhi~X tu song zhing / mtsho 'gram tshogs khag gi gtso 'dzin smo sga khe li si (cha

meXm mo)ni dbang rtsod 'di la thabs zad pas/ spyi lo sngon gyi 549lor phe si thi ra tho si phyir a then du gdan drangs nas dbang 'dzin du mi 'jug ka med byung / 'on kyang cha rkyen zhig yod pa ni smo sga khe li si'i bu mo phe si thi ra tho sis chung mar len dgos pa de red/ cha rkyen de la phe si tho ra thi si yid 'thad yod khul byas rjes/ khong gnyis mnyam du phe si tho ra thi si dpon sar bskyar 'god byed pa'i don la gros mol gnang nas/ dang thog phe si tho ra thi si la rgyab skyor byed mkhan kha shas kyis a then grong khyer nang du lha mo a the nā(me 60ba r+sā mas)yis phe si thi ra tho si phyir a then mkhar du khrid 'ongs nges red ces khyab bsgrags byed du bcug pa dang / rjes su ming la h+phe i (7khya)zer ba'i rdzi re si'i (67lo)bu mo me tog btsong mkhan zhig lha mo a the nā ru brdzus nas shing rta gcig gi nang phe si thi ra tho si dang mnyam du a then mkhar du phebs rgyu byas shing rjes su thabs shes te yongs su grub/ phe si thi ra tho si yang smo sga khe li si'i bu mo dang gnyen sgrig mi byed thabs med byung rung / chung ma de la phru gu ma skyes pas/ smo sga khe li si shin tu ma dga' bar slar yang spang thang tshogs pa dang lag sbrel nas phe si thi ra tho si la ngo rgol byas/phe si thi ra tho sis gnas tshul de shes rjes lo der slar yang phyi rgyal du mi 'bro ka med byung / phe si thi ra tho si thengs gnyis par srid dbang bzung ba'i dus tshod ni lo gcig tsam yang 'gor med do//slarayang srid dbang len pa'i phyir/ phe si thi ra tho sis phyi rgyal du lo bcu lhag la phyogs mang po nas gra sgrig byas/ khong dzi re si'i si tha li mun (moṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha )gtsang po'i shar 'gram gyi phan kho u si ( 〉kyi mo)ri bo'i sa khul du gser gyi gter kha brkos nas rgyu nor pa mang po bsags pa dang rjes su ma dngul btang nas glas dmag bsdus/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas khong gis snyi ri si'i grong khyer gyi mtho rim mi sna mang por grogs po bsgrigs pas/ nā /ga

gis khong la rgyab skyor gnang / ha lam spyi lo sngon gyi 539lor phe si thi ra tho si ni the sa li a'i mi(1623376tha tshe lko/༅la) dang the spe si'i mi/(16663'a mol) na kho so si'i (smosam mo)mi/ ar sgo si'i (ma lo)mi/ u le thi re a'i srid dbang sogs kyi rgyab skyor 'og tu dmag dpung khrid nas/a thi kha (4 1 07) la dpung 'jug byas pa dang 'phral du ma ra sung (577tha 600 677)blangs/ de dang bstun ri khul tshogs pa'i mis kyang dang len byas nas mi mang po 'ongs nas rgyab skyor byas pas stobs shugs chen po zhig tu gyur/ de nas phe si thi ra tho sis stobs shugs gang yod sgos a then gyi phyogs su dmag drangs/ skabs der a then gyi spyi dmangs dmag mi rnams kyis dros ja btung tshar tsam yin la/ mi kha shas kyis rus sbag rtse bzhin yod pa dang / mi kha shas gnyid nyal nas 'dug dmag dpung 'di lta bus phe si thi ra tho si'i dmag dpung 'gog ma thub par la 'thor lung 'thor du song /de dus phe si thi ra tho sis nang dkrug kha gtor dang mang che ba tshur 'gug pa'i thabs jus bkol te/ a then gyi dmag mi tshos mtshon cha dor nas so so sems lhod de rang khyim du log na bzang ba'i bka' khyab gnang ba dang /dalhag mi tshos kyang dang du blangs nas mtshon cha sprad nas phe si sbra ra tho si la ma ba//sa/ 'dir phe si thi ra tho sis srid dbang dngos bzung bas rang nyid skugashegs pa'i bar lo ngo 13tsam la srid dbang ma shor ba red/ gal srid sngar thengs gnyis su dus thung thung la srid dbang bzung ba'i dus khar bsnan na bsdoms pa'i lo 19tsam la srid dbang bzung / khong gis thengs gsum par dus tshod cung ring por srid dbang bzung ba'i skabs su dpal 'byor dang chab srid/ bsam blo/ rig gnas sogs phyogs so sor dmangs kyi se/sdu zlo dang mthun pa'i srid jus mang po bzos pa dang khyab spel byas shing /

de dag la so lon srid jus las lhag tu drag skyod kyi rnam pa ldan pa gtso bo gsham tu gsal/gcig sngar gyi bslab bya blangs nas/ rbad de khong gi dgra ru gyur pa'i rus rgyud sku drag skor cig gi tshur rgol la drag gnon byas/ phe si thi ra tho sis srid dbang bzung ba'i dus tshod shin tu thung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/gsar brje'i thabs jus kyis sku drag gi ngo rgol la phar rgol ma byas pa ni rgyu mtshan gtso bo yin/ rjes su khong gis nyams myong gi bslab bya spyi bsdoms byas nas/ dmag dpung rtsa 'dzugs byas pa dang / 'og rim mi ser gyi rgyab skyor 'og tu/dmag 'khrug brgyud de gdung rgyud sku drag rdul du brlag ste srid dbang phrogs/phyir a then du slebs rjes/ khong gis 'phral mar sku drag gis dbang bzung ba'i drag chas stobs shugs phab nas/ sku drag kha shas la drag gnon byas pa dang / 'bro dbang ma yod pa'i sku drag gi bu phrug mi gtar bzung nas nā khe so si gling phran steng bskyal te rang gi 'thab grogs nā khe so si'i (smos r+sāmo) the ran no si le sgo sda sme si (༅༅777)la sprad nas bdag gnyer byed du ṭīnāg ste sku dragā tsho la 'jigs skrag bskul nas/ kho pa tshos dkrig slong bgyi da /snyi gās blo// stobs che skyed sgos log spyod gdung rgyud sku drag gi sa zhing gzhung bzhes btang nas/ sa zhing med pa'am nyung ba'i zhing ba(de'i nang6 drug gcig zhing pa jimang po 'du ba)la gnang nas/ kho tsho phyir rang yul du log nas so nams kyi las su zhugs te thon skyed spel du bcug pas/ de tsho rang tshugs khor gnyer byed pa'i zhing chung du gyur/ da dung zhing bar dngul bun gtong ba'i srid jus lag bltar byas te/ zhing ba dbul pos bzo tshong la phan pa'i shing skyu ru ra dang rgun 'brum 'dzugs gnyer byed par rogastu snar

/sa/ de yang phe si thi ra tho si 'di so lon las lhag pa'i dge mtshan zhig yin bcos bsgyur pa so lon gyis skabs de'i a then gyi gnad don chen po ste sa zhing gi gnad don thag gcod ma thub pa red/ so lon gyi srid dbang bzung ba'i dus su gdung rgyud sku drag tsho'i dpal 'byor rmang gzhi ste sa zhing la phog thug gtong ma thub/ rgya che ba'i 'og rim mi ser ni bu lon gyi sdug bsngal las thar na'ang / mang che shos la sngar bzhin sa zhing med pa'am sa zhing nyung bas/ las ngan drug gcig zhing par gyur pas/ kho tshor thon skyed 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i spro sems chen po ma skyes/ phe si thi ra tho sis dbang bsgyur pa'i skabs su/ 'og rim mi ser gyis gdung rgyud sku drag gi lag nas sa zhing phrogs nas/ zhing chung dpal 'byor btsugs pas thon skyed spel ba'i brtson sems che ru bskyed/ rnam pa yag po 'di 'dra byung ba ni mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis 'thab rtsod byas pa'i mjug 'bras yin la/ phe si thi ra tho si'i dpal 'byor srid jus kyi 'bras bu'ang yin pa smos med red/ gna' rabs ghi ri si'i grong khyer mang che ba'i dpal 'byor rmang gzhi ni zhing chung dpal 'byor yin zhing / a then gyi gnas tshul yang de las ma 'das/ yin na'ang /rmang gzhi 'di thog ma nyid nas yod pa zhig ma yin te/ phe si thi ra tho si yi mi ser chab srid7brgyud da gzod a then du dngos su dpal 'byor rmang gzhi 'di chags pa yin no//gsum/ zhing chung gi dpal 'byor khur po mngon gsal du je yang la btang / kho tsho'i lag nas thon tshad kyi bcu cha gcig tsam gyi zhing khral ma gtogs mi len pa red/ phe si thi ra tho sis de ltare mdzad pas/ phyogs gcig nas zhing chung gi dpal 'byor la rgyab skyor byas te dar spel btang /phyo/sdusazhan zhig nas yong sgo de dag spyi dmangs yongs kyi khe phan du bkol/

khong gis a then gyi spyi dmangs re re'i rang gi rgyu nor gyi bcu cha gcig gzhung la sprod dgos/ de ni nga rang nyid la sprod pa ma yin te/ spyi pa'i mchod 'bul dang yang na spyi pa'i las 'gul nang spyod dgos la/ yang na dmag 'khrug la 'phrad pa'i skabs spyod chog ces gsal por gsungs so//phe si thi ra tho si yis tha na sa rgyu zhan pa'i sa zhing 'debs pa'i zhing ba dbul pos zhing khral sprod mi dgos pa gnang / thengs shig khong phyi yul du gzigs skor la phebs dus/ zhing pa zhig gis zhing rmo bzhin yod pa dang 'phrad/ zhing pa'i rmos pa'i sa zhing nang rdo yis khengs pa mthong nas/ ya mtshan skye bzhin du/ sa zhing 'di'i nang 'bru rigs gang dag skye thub ces dris tshe/ zhing pas khong la ci yang skye mi thub/ 'di ru sdug bsngal dang na zug ma gtogs ci yang med ces lan btab/ phe si thi ra tho sis tshig de go ba dang sems shin tu skyo nas zhing pa de'i zhing khral ci yang sprod mi dgos pa gnang ngo //bzhi/ chab srid khrims lugs la brten pa/ khong nyid dus rgyun zhing sder phebs nas gnas tshul rtog dpyod dang dmangs khrod kyi gyod gzhi thag gcod byed/ da dung sa khul so sor bskor skyod khrims ra btsugs pa dang zhing sder song nas gyod don zhib gcod byed du bcug phe si thi ra tho si'i thabs jus 'di yang so lon gyis lag bstar byed ma myong ba zhig red/ so lon gyi skabs su btsugs pa'i spyi dmangs tshogs chen dang / spyi dmangs 'dri gcod las rogs kyi khrims ra gnyis kyi tshogs chen tshogs yul ni grong khyer nang yin la/ zhing chung dang gdung rgyud sku drag la gyod don byung nas gtug bshed byed skabs zhing chung tshos lhag gi las ka bskyur nas grong khyer nang rgyug dgos pas/zhing chung la mtshon na shin tu stabs mi bde ba zhig red/ de bzhin du dus yun ring po 'gor na khrims lugs kyi dbang cha gdung rgyud sku drag gis sger gcod byed pa smos ci/ gnad don de la dmigs nas phe si thi ra tho ༵ dis

snying stobs chen po'i ngang khrims 'dzin lam lugs la gong smos kyi bsgyur bcos byas pa des zhing chung gi dus tshod dang lus stobs/ sems shugs sogs gron chung byed thub pa'i ma tshad/ shin tu gal che ba zhig la rgyal khab kyi khrims 'dzin dbang cha de dus yun ring por gdung rgyud sku drag gis lag tu bzung ba'i zhing sde'i nang du thon pa byas pas gdung rgyud sku drag gi stobs shugs la rdung rdeg btang nas zhing chung gi khe phan la srung skyob byas so//nges par du ston dgos pa zhig la/ phi si thi ra tho si yis srid skyong khrims la brten pa ma zad/ khong rang gis kyang 'go khrid nas khrims lugs la srung skyong byed/ lo rgyus kyi yig char bkod pa ltar na/ nyin zhig mi zhig gis phe si thi ra tho sis mi bsad song zhes skyon 'don zhu gtug byas pas/ phi si thi ra tho si yang sku drag tshogs chen steng phebs nas 'dri zhib byed dgos zhus/khong gis gnas tshul de thos rjes/ khong khro dang lhan du gtug mkhan de 'dzin bzung ma byas par/ dngos su khrims rar song nas khrims la brten nas dag (bud gnang bas na/ 'dri rtsad byed mkhan la skrag snang skyes nas bros song ba da/ lnga ba/ rig gzhung gong 'phel du btang ba/ snyan ngag pa dang sgyu rtsal pa mang po gdan drangs pa dang / a then grong khyer yang 'dzugs skrun chen po byas nas ghi ri si'i rig gnas kyi lte gnas gal chen du bsgyur pa red/drug pa/ bzo tshong las rigs dang mtsho steng las rigs 'phel rgyas su btang zhing skul spel gnang / de ni bzo tshong las rigs bran bdag gis skul spel byas pa dang bral thabs med/ de dag gis rgyab skyor 'og phe si thi ri tho si yis mtsho dmag gi dmag gru'i ru khag btsugs pa dang / stobs shugs chen po bskyed de gru bzo ba dang phyi gling nyo tshong las rigs 'phel rgyas su btang nas/te/ ༵ phon tho si(5050390ba 03 cha lo7)mtsho 'gag gi mtsho 'gram

gnyis ka bzung nas sbi la khe rgya mtsho'i tshong las la shugs snon byas/ e rjin rgya mtsho'i phyogs kyang khong gis de ga'i grong khyer so sor mdza' mthun mnyam gnas kyi 'brel ba btsugs nas/ rgya mtsho'i steng gi tshong lam de dgra bo'i lag tu 'chor bar sngon 'gog byas/ dus mtshungs su/ phe si thi ra tho si yis stobs shugs chen po'i ngang lag shes bzo las te lhag par rdza chas thon skyed gong 'phel du btang nas do zla che shos kho ren tho si(500ba 603 777)grong khyer gyi rjes su chod cing mthar mjug de las brgal nas sa dbus rgya mtsho dang sbi la khe rgya mtsho'i sa khul so sor kho tsho'i rdza chas btsong thub pa byung /phe si thi ra tho si 'og rim mi ser gyi gtso 'dzin yin na'ang / khong gis ci'i phyir bzo tshong las rigs kyi bran g.yog bdag po'i las don bsgrubs she na/ phe si thi ra tho si'i srid dbang ni rus rgyud sku drag la ngo rgol byas pa'i 'thab rtsod khrod btsugs shing / skabs der rus rgyud sku drag la ngo rgol byed mkhan nang rgya che ba'i 'og rim mi ser yod pa ma zad/ bzo tshong bran g.yog bdag po yang 'du ba red/ mi ser ni phe si thi ra tho si srid dbang gi rmang gzhi dang brten gzhi gtso bo yin la/ bzo tshong bran bdag ni srid dbang de'i mna' mthun pa red/ a then rgyal khab kyi stobs shugs cher song ba dang sbrags bzo tshong las don dang phyi phyogs mi ser spel yul/ tshong don las 'gul myur du rgyas pas/ bzo tshong bran bdag gi khe phan dang re ba mngon gsal du phyir 'don pa'ang ldog tu med/ phe si thi ra tho si'i srid jus drug pa ni de tsho'i re ba bzhin du gtan phab byas shing / srid jus des phyogs gcig nas a then gyi tshong rdzas dpal 'byor gyi 'phel rgyas la skul 'ded byas pa dang / phyogs gzhan gcig nas phyi phyogs su rgya bskyed btsan 'dzul byed pa'i rtags tham thebs rgyu yang byol med red/phe si thi ra tho si'i tshe gang bor phyogs bsdus kyi blta zhib byas na/16/nga

branagayog bdag po'i gral rim nang gi mdzad rjes can gyi chab srid pa zhig yin zhing / khong gis srid jus kyi spyi'i phyogs sa ni 'og rim mi ser gyi stobs shugs 'phel bar rgyab skyor byed rgyu de red/ khong gis 'og rim mi ser la ched du bsgrubs pa'i las don ni bzo tshong bran bdag la bsgrubs pa las mang bas khong gi srid dbang la lhag tu 'og rim mi ser gyi srung skyong dang rgyab skyor thob/ phe si thi ra tho si yis mi ser dkyus ma'i chab srid spel bas/ a then la mgyogs por stobs 'byor mnga' thang rgyas nas/ skabs der a then gyi mis6 khe ro nu si'i (༅lhostoblolo)rdzogs ldan dus rabs 0zhes zer/ de'i rkyen ñtsā sna /dri sdidī /bying snya/ zlodro sna /spyi ṭā kā / ṭ+wāṃ byi ri~X ༵ //lha/sa shākya dṛ dang / srid dbang yang khong gi bu hi pha a si (tho〉shāstugrang46)dang hu pha khu si (na〉snyesaspro'i46)gnyis kyi lag tu shor la/ de gnyis kyis lo bcu bdun ring dbang sgyur byas shing / dang thog phe si thi ra tho si'i rgyal khab skyong ba'i byed phyogs ltar rgyal khab la bdag gnyer byas mod/ rjes su bag med longs spyod (lha 41bra34)la g.yeng bas/ mthar thug mi gzhan gyis de gnyis kyi srid dbang gi mgo rting bslogs na'ang / phe si thi ri tho sis btsugs pa'i rang zhing rang 'debs kyi zhing chung dpal 'byor la gtor brlag ma thebs par a then dar rgyas yang rtser son pa'i dus kyi dpal 'byor rmang gzhi ru gyur/ rang dbang zhing chung dang lag shes bzo las pa 'bor chen zhig yod pa 'dis a then bran bdag gral rim gyi 'og rim gras shig grub cing / de dag tshang mas rjes kyi (khu ༷sdu )bye〉//sdo /shātānā rno/ /nga n+d+ra tā shātsholda 1zlo sna sdi sgro mi tram̐ marlob/zhit+nakā//zlosakhe/ rnyirnyi/ sdir+sha ཿshā shā g+ni /da rmi t+na /snyu sa/shā // sdo ṣ+ṭa (54 sna/ h+pho gurādzo〉 〉 rdotā sna ju /sdo /zlo 〉〉〉pa/nā shād+dhirdoXrdo byi/ las/ skabs de'i za ser dkyusama'i chab srid 'di mi'i semasal babasapa dga' bsu thob yod pa
ma bo 6spre tā

rang dbang dang rangagatsan srungali'i ma ra sung dmag 'khrugahring kri kong /par zig gi (77)rgyal po rdi re si yis si khi the(byajig 13 poṣ+ṭha༅)'dul bar rgyang skyod byas par pham d+ku chen po zos na'ang / phyir log pa'i lam du e jin rgya mtsho'i byang 'gram gyi rdzi re si'i sa rgyud btsan 'dzin byas nas/ sbi la khe rgya mtsho'i phyir bgrod sa khul dbang 'og tu bsdus pas/ ghi ri si la nyen kha chen po bslangs/ rgyu mtshan ni mtsho de'i 'gram ngogs ni a then sogs snyi ri si'i mkhar grong rgyal khab kyi 'bru rigs dang bran g.yog thon yul gtso bo dang tshong zog btsong sa yin pas red/ yul de par zig gi dbang 'og tu shor tshe/ a then(me'i 003)dang ghi ri si'i bzo tshong mkhar grong rgyal khab gyi dpal 'byor bya 'gul la rdung deg chen po thebs pa ma zad/ da dung ghi ri si yongs(de'i nang si phar tha sogs lho phyogs ghi ri si'i grong khyer yang 'du ba smos med red)par zig gi btsan 'dul thebs pa'i nyen kha byung / rdi re si la mtshon na 'char gzhi rjes ma ni ghi ri si 'dul rgyu de red/ ghi ri si'i mi la mtshon na/ rang dbang dang rang btsan gyi ched du par zig gi mi dang ༷thab rgyu ni ches dgos gtug che ba'i 'thab 'dzing las 'gan yin pa smos da du spyo zlo sngo/ na gyi 5)'ar par zig gi mis dbang bsgyur pa'i a she ya chung bzhi 30 khul gyi ghi ri si'i mkhar grong rgyal khab smi le tho sis(5 70 03 chos/

sa)'os langs byas pa ma zad/ ghi ri si'i mkhar khrong rgyal khab so sor rogs skyob skyabs zhu byas par/ a then dang e re thi ri a(276 18 477༅༅u sbi a gling phran (74༅lo)steng gi mkhar grong rgyal khab cig) gnyis kyis dmag gru bcu phrag 'ga' mngags nas rgyab skyor byas/ a she ya chung ba'i byang 'gram sa rgyud kyi ghi ri si'i mkhar grong rgyal khab gzhan kyis kyang de dang bstun nas 'os langs byas/ a then gyis smi le tho si la rogs ram byas tshul de di re si yis go rjes khong khro bzod dka' ba zhig langs pas/ a then gyi mi la dgra sha rtsod rgyur mna' skyel dam 'jog byas te/ gong ma des nang 'khor rnams la nangs zas za skabs rgyal po lags/ khyed kyis a then gyi mi thugs la zungs zhes thengs gsum 'bod dgos pa'i bka' phab/ de las khong gis a then ma btul tshad med yin pa'i sems thag bcad pa shes thub bo//rjes su rdi re si yis dmag dpung mang po bsdus nas/ spyi lo sngon kyi 494lor smi le tho si btsan len byas shing / a she ya chung ba'i ches 'du 'dzi che ba'i tshong las grong khyer de la me btang ste thal shul tsam tu bsgyur la/ sdod dmangs mang che ba dmar gsod btang zhing / shul tu lhag pa'i mi rnams rgyang ring yul gyi thi gi ri si(11 60 3 lo ༅7)chu bo'i mdo ru rgyang skyod btang /par zig pas smi le si'i mi la btang pa'i mnar gcod dang gtum spyod des snyi ri si yongs la zhe sdang chen po bslangs/ a then gyi snyan ngag pa phu li si khe sis (r+sāṣ+ṭhakhu77)bcoms pa'i zlos gar gyi gzhung smi le tho si dgra lag tu shor ba〉zhes pa a then du 'khrab ston byas rjes/ zlos gar la blta mkhan yongs la sdi semapa dang khong khro drag po skyes pas/ dbang med du ngu skad dang mchi ma 0ra ba spyi ༵ /sngon gyi 492lor di re si sku phreng dang pos/ a then dang e re thi ri a (tshom tsho༅)gnyis kyi dmag dpung gas smi le tho si la rogs 1/sdus

byas par kha g.yar nas/ a then la dmag dpung 'bor chen drangs pas/ lo rgyus steng ming grags che ba'i lha ri si dang par zig gi dmag 'khrug gi 'go brtsams pa red/ dmag 'khrug 'di spyi lo sngon gyi 449lo'i bar te lo ngo 49ring brgyab ma tshar ba dang / de ni snyi ri sis par zig gi btsan 'dzul la ngo rgol byas pa'i drang bden gyi dmag 'khrug cig yin la dmag 'khrug de dus tshanaganyis su dbye chog dus tshan dang po ni spyi lo sngon gyi492—479bar yin/ par zig ni btsan 'dzul pa yin la/ snyi ri si'i mkhar grong rgyal khab so sos gdung bsus nas 98thab par btsan 'dzul pa la ngo rgol byas pa'i ngo bo yod/ dus tshan gnyis pa ni spyi lo sngon gyi 479snye449lo'i bar yin la/ a then gyis ghi ri si'i mkhar grong rgyal khab so so dang mnyam 'brel byas nas/branagayog lam lugs kyi rgyal khab chen po par zig las rgyal ba ma zad rang gi stobs shugs kyang je cher btang / ma ra sung dmag 'khrug ni dus tshan dang po'i nang byung ste/ snyi ri si'i dmag dpung gis nyung ngu mang po las rgyal ba dang nyams chung stobs ldan las rgyal ba'i ma dpe'i dmag 'khrug ming grags can zhig yin/di re si'i nub phyogs 'dul ba'i las don der thog ma nyid nas jus nyes byung / spyi lo sngon gyi lo 492lo'i dbyin kur di re sis par zig gi dmag dpung skam chu gnyis su bgos nas snyi ri si'i steng dmag 'dren pa'i bka' babs/ blo yul las 'das pa zhig la par zig gi mtsho dmag ni snyi ri si'i gling phran phyed ma'i a tho si mtsho zur du char rlung drag po dang 'phrad pas/dmag gru 300lhag rgya mtsho'i nang nub pa dang dmag mi nyis khri lhag gi tshe srog shor/ skam dmag la'ang dzi ri se sa rgyud kyi mi dmangs kyis ngo rgol drag po byas pas phyir mi ldog ka med byung / rdi re si'i rgyang skyod dang po ni de lta bur mjug rdzogs pa red/172

phyi lor di re sis ghi ri si'i mkhar grong rgyal khab so sor pho nya mngags nas chu dang sa bslangs shing / de ni ghi ri si'i mis cha rkyen ci yang med par mgo bsgur te rang sa rang yul 'bul dgos pa'i don bstan pa de red/ par zig gi dzig nyams chen po mthong nas/ mkhar grong rgyal khab kha shas skrag nas mgo sgur rgyur khas blangs mod/ yin na'ang ghi ri si'i stobs shugs che shos rgyal khab a then dang si phar tha gnyis kyi gnya' ma sgur bar rbad de ngo rgol byas pa red/ si phar tha'i mis par zig gi pho nya khrom pa'i khar drud nas khrom pa'i nang bstan nas/ khrom pa'i nang chu dang sa yod de khyod ji 'dra len snyam na de 'dra longs zer nas khrom pa'i nang g.yug a then gyis par zig gi pho nyagayang gzar steng drud nas gcung rong du dor bas/ rdi re si la khong khro bzod dka' ba zhig langs nas/ dmag 'khrug gi nyams myong shin tu 'dzoms pa'i dmag dpon rgan pa sda thi si dmag dpon chen mor bskos nas ghi ri si 'dul ba'i rgyang skyod thengs gnyis pa'i 'go bcoms pa dang / rgyang skyod dmag gis nges par du a then dang e re thi ri a len dgos pa'i bka' yang bzlo ༵ /sngon gyi ༵masa'i dbyar dus su/ par zig gi dmag gru'i dpung chen gyis e rjen rgya mtshor 'phred du bcad de e re thi ri a (47644)btsan len byas pa dang / cung ma 'gor bar a then gyi nye 'gram gyi sme re son thang chen nas skam sar babs/nyen kha che ba'i gnas tshul de 'dra'i 'og tu a then gyi mi la dngangs 'tshab chen po skyes pa dang / thag ring la rgyug mkhas pa'i dmag mi h+phe sdib phe sde si(26161991663 7767lo)nyin mtshan ltos med du si phar tha la brgyugs nas rgyab rogs kyi re ba zhu bar mngags/ h+phe sdib phe sde si ni nyin gnyis nang si phar tha la thon pa dang / de ga'i srid gzhung la a then gyistu sad

tshos rogs ram bgyi dgos pa'i re ba zhu bzhin 'dug khyed tshos bltas bltas rig rig tu snyi ri si'i ches lo rgyus ring ba'i mkhar grong rgyal khab 'di mtha' 'khob gzhan mi'i btsan 'og tu lhung bar mi 'jug pa zhu zhes zhu ba zhus kyang / si phar tha'i dbang sgyur pa rnams kyis rgyal pham gang yong la ltad mo blta 'dod las gzhan gyi dmigs pa med pas/ nya gang zla ba'i dus la babs tshe da gzod dmag dpung rogs ram la gtong ngo zer/ h+phe sdib phe sde si phyir log nas gtam ngan 'di a then gyi srid gzhung la zhus skabs/ de ga'i dmag dpon rnams kyis da dung grong khyer srung dgos sam sgor bud nas 'thab dgos min la rtsod pa rgyag bzhin 'dug mthar thug 'thab dgos par gleng ba'i dmag dpon smi the a sde si'i(57 18663 chishāsgro ce)bsam 'char la yid 'thad byung bas/ myur du dgra bo'i gdung bsus nas 'thab rgyu byas/ a then gyi srid gzhung gis smi the a sde si dmag spyi la bskos nas dmag mi chig khri khrid de zla)pa'i tshes 12nyin sme re son la song nas ngag rgyun du dmag mi chig 'bum yod par bshad pa'i par zig gi dmag dang 'thab dgos pa'i bka' phabs/ khyim mtshes rgyal khab phu la thi a (074༅)yis kyang drag chas chen po can gyi dmag mi chig stong a then la rogs ram du mngags/'thab 'khrug gi 'go bcoms ma thag a then gyi dmag gis sme re son ri ngogs kyi sa btsan sa bzung zhing / de ni phyogs gsum ri yis bskor la mdun du sa gzur che tsam yod cing / thang chen steng gi par zig gi dmag sgar chen po yongs su mthong ba'i sa bab zhig red/a then gyi dmag dpung la bkod 'doms byed mkhan smi the a sde si ni 'thab 'khrug nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa'i dmag dpon zhig yin te/khong gis thugs su dgra bor stobs shugs che la rang phyogs zhan pa'i gnas tshupa // thad kur gdung thug brgyab na rang phyogs rdul tsam du brlag 'gro ba

kho na yin pas thabs jus ngang rgyal kha len dgos snyam/ khong nyid lo na gzhon pa'i dus su par zig gi dmag dpung nang dmag mi byed myong pas/par zig gi dmag mi thang chen stong 'thab par mkhas shing / thog mar g.yul sa'i dkyil nas rgol zhing brlag pa'i 'thab jus la goms yod pa shes pas/dmagasgar ri ngogs su brgyab nas a then gyi phyogs su bgrod pa'i lam srung dgos pa'i bka' gnang la/ g.yul ra'i zheng cung tsam che ru brkyangs nas/rkang dmag hrag po gzhogs gnyis su bkod cing / dkyil du khrab mthug can gyi dmag dpung gru bzhir bsgrigs nas par zig gi dmag dpung gis tshur rgol 'gog pa dang / de nas go skabs gang legs la bstun nas gzhogs gnyis kyi dmag dpung gis dgra bo bskor nas tshar gcod byed pa'i bkod 'doms gnang ngo //dmag mi'i ngar shugs la skul 'ded byed rgyu ni shin tu gal che la/dmagadapon sme the a sde sis kyang dmag mi'i sems shugs 'di rgyal pham gyi 'gag rtsa zhig yin pa mkhyen yod pas/ khong gis zla)pa'i tshes 12nyin gyi zhogs par dmag 'khrug gi 'go ma btsams gong dpon dmag yongs la spro sems 'khol ba'i gsung bshad gnang ste/ a then la bran g.yog gi lcags sgrog thebs na bzang ngam/ nam yang rang dbang 'og gnas na bzang / gtso bo khyod rang tshor rag lus yod ces gsungs pas/ skul 'ded rang bzhin gyi gsung skad 'dis dpon dmag tshos rang gi rgyal khab srung ba'i chod sems de je brtan du btang / sme tha a sde sis lag 'gyog snga na bzang dgongs nas mdun phyogs kyi dmag dpung la bka' babs te glog 'khyug pa bzhin par zig gi g.yul sar rgol bar brgyugs/ par zig pa rnams la dang thog dngangs skrag dang brel 'tshub skyes mod/ rjes su tshur rgol gyi ghi ri si'i dmag mi'i grangs shin tu nyung ba ma zad/ da dung thog ma byas nas tshur ༵༵ du

mchong 'ongs pa mthong nas dmag mi de tsho smyos song ngam/ rang srog rang dor du yong ba ma yin nam snyam/ cung ma 'gor bar par zig gi dmag gis ghi ri si'i dmag dpung gi lte ba'i 'thab ra'i dpung sde gtor ba dang rjes snyegs nas mi gtong ba byas shing / ghi ri si'i dmag gis 'thab zhor dang 'bro zhor byas/ de nas par zig pa rnams kyis da ni rgyal kha ni rang tshor dbang ngo snyam pa'i sgang la lho byang ri ngogs su bskung ba'i snyi ri si'i khrab ldan dmag dpung gis ki sgra ldi ri ri sa yom 'dra ba dang sbrags mtshon sna chogs dgung la 'phyar nas gzhogs gnyis nas par zig pa'i dmag dpung steng la btab te bskor nas 'thab/ par zig pa tshos snyi ri si'i dmag dpung snyeg 'ded byed par thag ring du song drag pas 'thab phyogs ring che stabs/ phyogs gsum nas rdung ga thebs pas/ mgo rnga gnyis kyis phan tshun rogs byed ma thub par pham ste brel 'tshub dang 'jigs skrag ngang kha phyir 'khor nas bros bshol byas la/ g.yul sar ro dang rmas ma grangs med bor/ ghi ri si'i dmag dpung gis ma btang bar snyeg deg dang drag 'thab byas shing / mtsho khar thon pa dang par zig gi dmag dang dmag gru 'phrog res kyi 'thab 'khrug drag po byas/ming la rje nar hwa po zhes pa'i snyi ri si'i dmag mi zhig yod pas dmag gru 'phrog pa'i skabs dgra bos kho rang gi lag pa g.yon pa dmar gtub byas kyang lag pa g.yas pas slar yang dgra bo'i dmag gru bzung zhing / mjug mthar 'thab grogs tsho dang mnyam du dgra bo'i dmag gru tshur phrogs pa red/ rje nar gyi dpa' stobs ni sus kyang bsngags 'os pa zhig yin la/ de dang 'dra ba'i dpa' bo'i byas rjes ni snyi ri si'i dmag mi'i nang gang mang yod/ ma ra sung ghi ri si'i dmag mi'i nang du gang mang yod/ ma ra sung dmag 'khrug khrod/ghi ri si yis dgra bo'i dmag gru bdun tshur 'phrog len byas/ par zig gi dam1kā ḍi g.yul sar bam ro yoslobaskyur yod rung / snyi ri si'i dmag mi ni

192tsam las ma shi bas rgyal kha chen po blangs so//smo the a sde sis rgyal kha thob pa'i 'phrin bzang 'di myar du a then gyi grong khyer nang gi spyi dmangs rnams la 'khyer ched/ slar yajo h+phe sdib phe sdi si (47977)'dems nas gzi brjid kyi las 'gan 'di sgrub du bcugargyug la mkhas pa'i phor gsar 'dis dmag 'khrug mjug rdzogs rjes rang lus kyi rmas skyon la sman bcos kyang bya khom ma byung par/ ches mgyogs pa'i goms stabs ngang g.yul sa nas a then grong khyer gyi lte gnas thang chen du thon nas de ga'i dmag 'khrug gi mtha' 'bras ci yin la re ltos bya bzhin pa'i mi rnams la rang shugs yod tshad sgos skad mthon por tshang ma dga' dga' spro spro gyis dang / nga tshor rgyal kha thob song :zhes 'phrin bzang 'di bshad ma thag thang chen du dga' ba'i bro dang skyid pa'i ki sgra yis khengs/ yin na'ang h+phe sdib phe sdi si ni rmas skyon lji ba dang ngal dub drag che pas sa 'gyel nas rang srog blos btang ba red/ma ra sung dmag 'khrug dang h+phe sdib phe sdi si la dran gso byed pa'i ched du/ 1896lor a then ru tshogs pa'i o lim phe khi ( cha༅7)lus rtsal 'gran bsdur tshogs chen steng 'gran bsdur gyi rigs gsar pa zhig kha snon byas pa ni/ lus rtsal pa tsho ma ra sung nas rgyug 'go brtsams te/ ha lam h+phe sdeb phe sdi si dang thog rgyug myong ba'i lam ded de a then la thon dgos pa de yin la/ de'i rgyug thag ni spyi le 40dang smi 200yin/ 1920lor slar yang rgyug thag de la tshad thig zhib dag blangs shing de'i bar thag ni spyi 40dang smi 195yin/ 'di ni deng skabs kyi ma ra sung rgyang rgyug gi 'byung khungs yin no//ma ra sung dmag 'khrug la don snying shin tu che ste/ gzhan gyi btsan 'dzul la ngo rgol dang rang btsan la srung skyob byed ched 'thab pa'i a then gyi dmag mi nyung ngu des khong tsho las ldab du ma las mang pa'i par zig gi1 hā/ga

dpung las rgyal ba ni/ snyi ri sis par zig gi btsan 'dzul la ngo rgol byas par rgyal kha chen po blangs pa thog ma yin pa ma zad/ lo rgyus stong btsan 'dzul la ngo rgol byed pa'i dmag 'khrug khrod nyung ngu mang po las rgyal pa'i 11 ཿdza :sgostuno skyob :do :ji /)/sto:rdocas :gro'adra/ra na ma na da ga kyang na la/ sa sa par ga las rgyal pa'i dmag 'khrug so sor rgyal kha thob rgyur shugs rkyen chen po bzhag yod/ma ra sung dmag 'khrug gi rgyal kha 'dis/ snyi ri si mkhar grong rgyal khab so so rdog rtsa gcig sgril byas pa na/ rang srung rgol lan sprod thub pa dang / rgya khongs dang stobs shugs che ba'i par zig las rnam par rgyal thub pa mtshon yod/ de snga ji re si la gnya' sgur bar khasablangs pa'i snyi ri si'i mkhar grong rgyal khab de dag kyang slar yang rang btsan byas pa khyab bsgrags byas shing /sba sbi lon dang e jib sogs sa khul gyis kyang skabs de dang bstun nas par zig gi dbang sgyur la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod kyi 'go btsams pa red/178

dala' ngararigazhanga'ad skyori dgams che pa'i thubasgon 'gag gi dmag 'khrugam ra sung dmag 'khrug gi rjes su/ mi mang po zhig gis pho gzis btsan 'dzul thebs pa'i nyen kha da dung 'dzad med snyam par 'dug a then gyi bran bdag nang gi dmangs gtso phyogs khag gi gtso 'dzin the smi si tho ge li (zlojimo4 mor+sha lko1)ni chab srid kyi mig rgyang ldan pa'i mi zhig yin te/ khong gis ma ra sung dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha thob pa 'di 'go brtsams pa tsam yin la/ snyi ri si dang par zig gnyis bar cis kyang da dung dmag 'khrug rgyag nges pa mkhyen nas/ mtsho dmag dar spel du gtong bar hur 'bad byas nas/ ghi ri si'i mtsho dmag ni skabs de'i 'dzam gling yang rtser son pa'i mtsho dmag zhig tu bsgyur/dngos gnas tshod dpag byas pa de las ma 'das par/ ghi ri sis dmag 'khrug la gra sgrig byed dus su/ par zig gi rdi re si yis kyang gra sgrig byed bzhin yod/ khos snyi ri si 'dul ba'i sems ngan ma shi bas dmag shugs bskyaralhag byas te/ slar yang snyi ri si la btsan 'dzul bya rgyu blo thag bcad na'ang / gang ltar las dbang zhig tu lam 'gror ma song bar spyi lo sngon gyi 485lor glo bur du nad phog nas tshe las 'das stabs/ snyi ri si ru rgyang skyod byed pa'i 'char gzhi de kho rang gi rgyal po'i go sa rgyud 'dzin byas pa'i bu ste gzir zi se(5075031 777)zhes pas sgrub dgos pa byung / gzir zi se par zig gi rgyal por bsdad rjes/ a then rdul du brlag rgyu dang rdi ༵ si

yongs su btul nas/ ma ra sung du pham kha myong bar dgra sha len rgyu'i dam bca' bzhag gzir zi se yis rgyang 'dul du skyod rgyur lo ngo bzhi la gra sgrig byas pa dang / par zig btsan rgyal yongs kyi dmag dpung la skul slong byas/gzir zi se yi rgyang skyod dmag gi nang rkang dmag dang rta dmag mtsho dmagarnga mong gi dmag shing rta'i dmag skyel 'dren dmag sogs sna kha yod rgu 'du/ dmag mi mang che ba ni btsan bsdu byas nas 'ongs shing de'i nang mi rigs mi 'dra ba du ma 'du ste/ dper na par zig gi mi dang / smi rdi a'i mi/(51 cha 8chi la) ya si ri a'i mi/ sba khe the ri a'i mi/ kho re jom gyi mi/rgya gar gyi mi/ a rab kyi mi/ se phu ri si'i mi/ e jib kyi mi/ h+phe ne+e khe a'i mi/ pha le si than gyi mi/ i ran shar ma'i tsho ba so so dang / a she ya chung ba dang nye 'dabs gling phran stong gi sdod 'bangs/(de'i nang ghi ri si'i mi yang 'du ba) rdzi re si'i mi sogs yod pas/ dmag dpung gi grub cha la rtog dra shin tu che/ mi rigs de tsho'i gyon chas mi 'dra ba dang skad cha mi 'dra ba'i steng lagaca yang rnam pa sna tshogs red/ de'i nang par zig pa tsho'i nang las mi chig khri 'dems shing ming la 'chi med ru khag mi'abod pa ni ches 'thab 'dzing gi stobs shugs ldan pa'i dpung sde yin la/ kho tsho'i dmag chas sgrig sbyor cha tshang ba'i thog 'tsho ba yang bzang po 'dug par zig yongs kyi dmag dpung gi stobs shugs la mtshon na/ tshod dpag byas pa ltar na/ dmag mi'i spyi grangs la 'bum lnga yas mas tsam yod cing dmag gru brgyad stong tsam yod/gzir zi se yis dmag dpung chen por lta zhib byas rjes/ dga' 'tsher 'tsher ngang / da thengs ghi ri si'i mi thams cad dang nub phyogs kyi mi yod tshad phyogs bsdus byas kyang / bdag gi phar rgol 'di 'gog thabs gtan nas med ces lab/18/ lo sngon gyi 480lo'i dpyid kha/ gzir zi se yis lag shes pa tsho la he

le si phon tho si (07lo7)mtsho 'gag tu gru gzings 300re shar mar bsgrigs nas steng du rtswa gdan dang sa 'dam bting nas/ log gnyis su 'gog dngos yod cing rkang dmag dang dmag mkhos dngos rdzas 'dren lam bzo dgos pa'i bka' babs pa dang / zam pa 'grub rjes dmag dpung chen po khrid nas yo rob gling du thon pa red/skabs der dgra bo'i nyen khas ded pa'i gnas tshul 'og ghi ri si'i mkhar grong rgyal khab so so mnyam 'brel byas bas/ mkhar grong rgyal khab 30lhag gis par zig la ngo rgol byed pa'i mna' mthun tshogs skor zhig grub par/ si phar tha yis ghi ri si'i mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gi spyi dpon mdzad pa dang / a then ni mnyam 'brel dmag gi rtsa 'dzugs byed mkhan dngos byas/de ni ghi ri si la sngar byung ma myong ba'i phyi'i dgra bo'i btsan 'dzul la ngo rgol spyad lha'i dpung ba mnyam gshib kyi bya 'gul chen po zhig red ces bshad kyang ga lo/ de'i zla drug par par zig gi dmag dpung ni ghi ri si'i byang phyogs kyi ther mo phi le'i(16611097182 77)'gag 'phrang du thon nas der yod ghi ri si'i srung dmag dang gdong thug rgyab/ yul de'i rgyab phyogs ri dang mdun du rgya mtsho yin zhing 'phrang 'gag mdo ru mu zi'i chu tshan yod pas/ de la chu tshan 'gag ces kyang 'bod/ 'phrang 'gag de ni ghi ri si la skyod tshe nges par du brgyud dgos pa'i 'gag lam btsan po 'ba' zhig yin pas/ gna' nas bzung dmag dpung so sos 'phrog rtsod byed yul du gyur/ de'i lho phyogs ni g.yang gzar gcong rong yin pas lam med cing / shar phyogs ni thad kur mtsho 'gram du 'grel ba'i na 'dam yin pa de'i dkyil du dmag gi shing rta gcig kho na bgrod thub pa'i lam phran zhig yod/ sngar ghi ri si dbus pa tshos ghi ri si byang pa rnams kyi btsan 'dzul la ngo rgol bya chen sa de ru srung 1hā/ga

'dug myong / mkhar rdzong de'i nang dpung sde chung chung zhig gis srung bas na/dgra dpung chen po 'gog thub pas/ g.yul rdzong shin tu btsan po zhig tu gyur/skabs der 'gag 'phrang srung ba'i ghi ri si'i mnyam 'brel dmag gi dmag dpon ni su yin zhe na/ de ni ghi ri si mnyam 'brel dmag gi rkang dmag gi spyi khyab bkod 'doms pa ste si phar tha'i rgyal po le o ne sda si(26001 741 /mtha 7lospyi lo sngon gyi 508—480)yin/ khong la dpa' ngar dang snying stobs ldan zhing 'thab 'dzing gi nyams myong shin tu 'dzoms pas/ par zig gi dmag gis ghi ri si'i dbus khul la btsan 'dzul bgyi mi thub ched/ ghi ri si mnyam 'brel tshogs chen gyi 'thab jus bkod 'doms bzhin du khong gis sku ngo mas/ gal chen 'gag gnas te chu tsha 'gag sgo 'di srung ba'i 'gan khur bzhes yod/le o ne sda si 'gag 'phrang du slobs tsa na/ thog mar dmag dpung la bkod 'doms byas nas lo du mar zhig ral du lus pa'i mkhar rdzong slar gso byed du bcug pa dang dmag shugs sgrig bkod gnang / khong gi phyag 'og tu dmag mig000lhag yod pa dang / de'i nang mi 4000ni phe phon ne+e so si'i(2690bab130345༅lkotsho )mi yin la(de'i nang 'thab 'dzing gi stobs shugs che ba'i si phar tha'i spyi dmangs 300'du)dmag mi 1100ni phe o thi a'i mi yin zhing / dmag mi 107ni h+pho se si'i mi red/ de'i nang da dung ro khe li si'i mi yang 'du/ ghi ri si'i dpung rogs ma thon pa dang par zig gi dmag dpung 'gag 'phrang de la je nye je nye yin skabs/ phe lo phon ne+e si'i mi rnams kyis par zig gi dpung chen mthong nas da ni dmag dpung 'phral mar phyir 'then byas na bzang zhes bsam 'char bton yang / snyi ri si dbus khul gyi mi rnams ni dgra dang ma 'thab gong du phyir bros bgyi bar gtan nas yid 'tha1hā sna byung / le o ne sda sis kyang yul de'i sdod 'bangs kyi lugs mthun

re bar rgyab skyor gnang nas/ mthar thug bar du dmar 'dzing bgyi rgyu'i sems thag bcad/par zig gi dmag dpung ni sod dang rdung dang zhes pa'i ngar sgra gnam sa g.yo ba'i rnam pa dang mnyam du tshur rgol bar brgyugs 'ongs rung / le o ne sda si la 'jigs snang ci yang med par phyogs gcig nas dmag mi tshor 'thab 'dzing gi gra sgrig bgyi dgos par skul 'ded gnang zhor dang / phyogs gcig nas mi mngags nas mkhar grong rgyal khab gzhan par brda brgyab nas dmag rogs yong dgos ba'i re ba zhus/ skabs der sdod mi zhig 'ongs nas par zig dmag dpung ni gnam sa la bkab pa 'dra ba zhig yod pas/ kho tshos gzhu bkang nas mda' 'phangs na sprin nag bzhin nyi 'od kyang sgrib nges pa red ces zhus tshe/ le o ne sda si sogs si phar tha'i mi rnams gad mo bgod zhor de lta bu na da dung shin tu legs/ nga rang tshos bsil grib 'og dgra bo tshar gcod thub pa red ces ku re brtses so//gzir zi se'i dpung chen pos chu tshan 'gag 'phrang mdun du dmag sgar brgyab pa dang / sems su cung mi 'gor bar ghi ri si tsho skrag nas bros 'gro ba smos med red snyam mod/ nyin mtshan 'ga' 'das kyang ghi ri si'i dmag phyir 'bro ba'i tshul ni mthong rgyu ma byung / gzir zi se yis dus ring ma bsron par rta dmag myul zhib pa zhig pha rol po'i ci byed la blta ru mngags/myul zhib pa phyir log nas ghi ri si tshor brel zing ci yang med par sems lhod por lag cha mnyam gcig tu spung nas la las rtsal sbyong byed pa dang la las skra bshad kyin 'dug ces zhus tshe/ gzir zi se ya mtshar ste de don gang yin ma shes par lus so// la las si phar tha la de 'dre'i goms srol yod de/ tshe srog la nyen kha che ba'i dmag 'khrug la zhugs thengs re re'i sngon la/ rang gi skra nyar las byed dgos zer/ gzir zi se'i skad cha de go rjes shin tu ma~X pa

zos pas nyin der 'gag phreng la dmag dpung drangs nas/ spyi ri si'i dmag mi rnams gson 'dzin byed rtsis brgyab sod/ phar rol la rgol thengs rer pham kha myong bas kho'i re ngan stong zad du song ngo //de nas par rig gi rgyal pos 'dang rtsis che ba'i dpung sde 'chi med ru khag 'thab 'khrug nang zhugs su bcug mod/ de dag gis 'gag 'phrang dag mor stobs shugs phud mi thub pas/ skor dang skor ma byas nas si phar tha'i dmag mi'i mdung ring kha ru tshe srog shor/ gzir zi ses tshul de mthong bas na/ ngo tsha ba'i steng khong khro me ltar 'bar bas khri'i thog nas thengs gsum du gnam la mchongs nas ngar skad brgyab/phyi nyin yang par zig gi dmag dpung gis pham kha zos pas gzir zi se lhag tu khros pa dang 'u thug nas rkang bas sa la rdab rdab byed pa las thabs gzhan ci yang ma rnyed/ skabs der ghi ri si'i blo log pa ming la e phe a thi si (ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭhalo lo)zer ba zhig yod pa 'ongs nas gzir zi se la/ lam chung zhig yod pa ded nas chu tshan 'gag gi rtag rgyab du 'gro thub/ bdag gis rgyal por lam khrid de si phar tha'i mi rnams pham par rgyag rogs bya 'dod yod ces zer bar/ par zig gi rgyal po shin tu dga' ba dang 'phral du e phe a thi si la lam khrid du bcug pa dang / 6 'chi med ru khag gis mtshan rgyab nas phyin/ kho tsho chu phran zhig la brgal ba dang g.yang gzar la 'dzeg nas nam ma langasagong ljon shing gis khengs pa'i ri rtser thon ma thag h+pho se si mkhar grong rgyal khab nas 'ongs pa'i so dmag 1000tsam la gdung thug brgyab pas dang thog par zig pa rnams la 'jigs skrag chen po skyes kyang / blo log pa lam khrid mkhan des kho tshor/ khyod tsho skrag mi dgos/ de tsho si phar tha'i mi min la h+pho se si'i mi red/ nged cag gis de tsho pham par gtong thub zer/ de bas na pa/ hā/ pa tshos blo stobs che ru bskyed nas phar rgol byas te h+pho se si'i mi

rnams rgyang ring du bskrad/ de'i 'phror kho tsho 'gog srung 'thab rags las brgal nas thad kur ghi ri si'i dmag sgar chen po'i stong brgyugs/si phar tha'i rgyal po le o ne+e sda sis par zig gi dmag rgyab phyogs nas thon pa'i gnas tshul go rjes/ da ni 'thab na pham kha myong ba las gzhan lam med snyam mod/ khong ni zhim med dpa' ngar ldan pa'i dmag mi zhig yin pas/dmag dpung gi stobs shugs srung skyong bya ched dmag dpung mang che ba phyir 'then bgyi dgos pa'i 'phral mar bka' babs/ khong sku ngo mas si phar tha'i mi 3rtsidang / thi phe si'i (677)mi 77 dang the si pha a'i mi)krokhrid nas dpa' bar ldan pa'i ngang 'thab 'dzing la zhugs nas ri mgo'i g.yul ra btsan srung gnang / khong chos 'gan khur gtso bo ni nus pa gang yod kyis par zig gi dmag dpung bkag nas snyi ri si'i mtsho dmag ar smi thi si ang (༅po skopo )nas phyir 'then dang snyi ri si'i rkang dmag dpung chen gzhan pa tsho phyir 'then byed par 'gebs srung bgyi rgyu de yin no//nyinagasum pa'i snga dro/ par zig pa rnams kyis drag tu tshur rgol byas/dgra bo mang la rang dmag nyung ba'i gnas tshul 'og dpa' ngar ldan pa'i ghi ri si'i dmag mi ni g.yul sa brtan du srung nas phyir gom pa gang tsam yang ma bsnur par mdung ring chag na ral gris bsnun pa dang / gri kha brtul pas na so dang khu tshur lag cha byas nas par zig pa dang dmar 'dzing byas/ si phar tha'i rgyal po le o ne+e sda si ches sngon ma byas nas dgra bo dang 'thab cing / khrab rmog khrag gis brtal kyang da rung dgra bor dmar 'dzing byas te mthar thug g.yul sar rang srog blos btang ba red/ rgyal po le o ne sda si'i sku gdung phyir 'phrog ched/ snyi ri si'i dmag gis thengs bzhi la par zig gi dmag gi tshur rgol pham par bzos/ skabs de ru snyi ri si'i dmag mi gson po je nyung je nyung yin la/ rgyub phyogs nas 'jab rgol byed mkhan gyi par zig gi1 hā/ga

dpung yang thon pas/ snyi ri si'i srung dmag la mdun rgyab gnyis nas rdung deg thebs/ rgyal kha len rgyur re ba med na'ang / khong tshos dpa' ngar ngang dgra bo dang 'thab te dmag mi yongs rdzogs dpa' nyams sgos g.yul ngor rang srog blos btang ba'i bar mgo sgur mkhan dang phyir bros rgyag mkhan gcig kyang ma byung pa red/ dmag 'khrug de'i nang par zig gi dmag dpung la'ang gyong gud chen po byung / dmag mi nyis khri lhag shi ba'i steng gzir zi se'i gcung po gnyis kyi yang tshe srog shor/ gzir ze se yis dgra sha rtsod pa'i ched nā le o ne sda si'i mgo bcad nas mdung sne sprad de mi mang khrod khrom ston byas /ra zig gi dmag gis chu tshan 'gag 'phrang blangs rjes/ thad kur lho phyogs su brgyugs nas a then blangs kyang de ni grong khyer stong ba zhig yin te/rgyu mtshan ni a then gyi sdod dmangs tsho de'i sngon grong khyer de nas yul gzhan du gnas spos pas red/ cung ma 'gor ba'i dus te spyi lo sngon gyi 480lo'i stonakhar/ thi smi si tho khi li yis rgya bskyed cing dar spel byas pa'i ghi ri si'i mtsho dmag gis rgya mtsho'i steng gi mdag 'khrug khrod nus pa chen po bton nas/mtsho'i zheng dog pa'i sa la smi si rgya mtsho'i steng par zig gi mtsho dmag rdul du brlag nas ming gi lhag ma tsam du btang bas/ dmag 'khrug yongs kyi gnas tshul gyi kha lo bsgyur nas snyi ri si'i rgyal kha len par rmang gzhi bting ba red/ngag rgyun du bshad pa ltar na/ chu tshan dmag 'khrug gi mjug rdzogs rjes/ si phar tha'i mi gnyis la don dag gzhan zhig yod pas 'thab 'khrug la ma zhugs zer la/ gcig ni nad phog pas dmag 'khrug la ma zhugs shing /cig shos ni gong gi bka' bzhin tha sa li a (mo lko/sgro)ru pho nyar phyin nas lam bar du 'gor bas dmag 'khrug la zhugs ma thub zer/ mi de gnyis ma shi /spyan por phyir si phar tha ru log pa dang / pha yul gyi mi rnams kyis kho

gnyis la mthong chung byas nas sus kyang kho gnyis la skad cha mi bshad pa ma zad kho gnyis sdar mar brtsis/ de'i nang gi mi gcig gis mi rnams kyi mthong chung 'phya smod ma bzod par rang srog bcad/ mi gcig rjes kyi par zig par 'thab pa'i dmag 'khrug gzhan zhig tu dpa' ngar sgos dgra bo bsad cing mthar mjug rang srog blos btang yang / si phar tha'i mi rnams kyi kho gnyis dmag 'khrug nang rang srog phul ba'i dpa' bo'i dur sa ru dur 'jug bya ru ma bcug de las kyang si phar tha'i dmag gi sgrig lam ci 'dra'i btsan po zhig yin pa nga tshos shes thub bo//snyi ri si'i mi rnams kyis le o ne sda si dang khong gis bkod 'doms byas pa'i dmag mi'i gzi 'od 'phro ba'i mdzad rjes la dran gso byed ched/ chu tshan 'gag gi 'dabs su khong tsho'i bang so bzos pa dang dran rten gyi rdo ring yang btsugs/ rdo ring steng ghi ri si'i skad grags can gyi snyan ngag pa si smo ne+e sde yisabyang yig bris nas brkos te/ chu tshan dmag 'khrug nang rang srog blos btang ba'i ghi ri si'i dpa' bo rnams la dran gso dang rjes rabs pa rnams la skul 'ded byas yod/rdo ring gcig tu gsham ltar bris yod de/phasa'adi'i nang le o ne+e sda si ste/sgo kho ne+e a'i rgyal po khyed rang dang / 'thab 'dzing khrod tshe srog phul ba'i gzi brjid kyi dpa' bo rnamasabazhugs shing/'dir+sha dpa' rtul de dag la par zig gi mda' char dang rta rgod kyi mig pa'i drag rlabs/ yang dang yang du grangasamed thebs/7zhes brisashing / chu tshan 'gag mdor rdo'i seng ge zhig yodapa'i steng / dzibadag da ltapha bong mthon po'i steng du mi 'di srung bzhin yod la/gal da khong ni seng ge zhig red ces brjod tshe/ bdag kyang de yi do zlar ga la yong /khong gi dur sa'i steng bdag gis sder mo brdar tsam bya ga la phod/7ces bris yod/rdo ring gzhan pa zhig gi stong du/ 66gzhan yul nas slobs pa'i1 sdu/na

po tsho/ khyed tshos si phar tha yi mi la 'di ltar shod dang / nga tshos nam yang sbyong rdo'i re smon bzhin/ 'di ru dus yun ring por gnas nges yin/’ zhes sa tā /tshan 'gag gi dmag 'khrug nang byung ba'i ghi ri si'i dpon dmag rnams kyi snying stobs la/ rang rgyal gyi phul du byung ba'i gsar brje pa dang rtsom rig pa sku zhabs lu'u zhun gyis spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang bston bsngags gnang myong / khong gis brjid chags chu tshan 'gag tu/ sa yi go la ma 'jig bar du si phar tha'i 'thab 'dzing pa'i snying stobs ji srid bar du gnas so zhes gsungs/ le o ne+e sda si sogs dpa' rtul rnams kyi rgyal gces ring lugs kyi snying stobs dang rang srog blos btang ba'i snying stobs/ kho rang tshos khyon yongs la bsam blo gtong ba dang / nyen khar thug kyang skrag snang mi skye ba/'khur bsam rnam dag gi gshis rgyud ni rjes rabs pa rnams kyis slob sbyong byed pa'i mig dpe yin no//188

de'akhi' si dngarna then gyi dmangs gtso/6kyi.enaphe/snyi ri si dang par zig gi dmag 'khrug gi mjug rdzogs rjes/ a then gyi dmangs gtso'i chab srid la dar rgyas mngon gsal byung / spyi lo sngon gyi 433—429lo'i bar ni phe ri khi le sis(2600703 40lko122)srid 'gan bzhes pa'i skabs yin zhing / a then gyi dmangs gtso'i chab srid dang /dpal 'byor/ rig gnas sogs dar rgyas chen po byung bas dpal phun sum tshogs par rgyas/ mar khe sis kyang / ghi ri si'i nang khul du ches dar rgyas che ba'i dus skabs ni phe ri khe le si'i dus skabs red ces gsungs/ phe ri khe le si'i dus su a then ru gzigs skor du phebs byung ba'i rtsom pa po zhig gis kyang / gal srid khyod kyis a then mthong ma myong na/ khyod blun po zhig yin te/ gal srid khyod kyis a then mthong ba'i tshe spro ba tshad med cig ma skyes na/ khyod ni bong bu zhig red/ khyod nyid rang 'gul du a then dang kha bral na/ khyod ni rnga mong zhig red ces gsungs/ de'i nang don ni a then ni ghi ri si yongs kyi nying bcud du gyur pas/ gnas der phebs pa'i mi thams cad a then gyi gra rgyas phun sum tshogs pa'i tshul de la sems mi 'chor pa gcig kyang med cing /khyod kyis a then la sems ma shor tshe/ khyod bong bu bzhin du blun po dang rnga mong lta bu'i brtse dung med pa'i mi zhig red ces pa de'o//phe ri khi le si(spyi lo sngon gyi 495 —42sngon gyi9lo'i bar)ni a zlo/ gyi

khyim chen skad grags can zhig tu 'khrungs shing / khong gi yab khe shan thi phu si(5thab 619953 77777)ni spyi lo sngon gyi 479lo'i smi kha le (chi sto 1)mtsho thog dmag 'thab skabs kyi a then gyi dmag gru'i spyi dpon yin zhing /khong gi yum a sga ri si the (khu1mebaspri146lha'i)ni a then dmangs gtso'i chab srid kyi mtshon byed mi sna'i nang gi gcig ste khi le si the ne si(51613 'i0ba bya mas/lo77)yi tsha mo red/ khong la chung ba'i dus nas phyogs so so'i slob gso gang legs thob/ skad grags can gyi mkhas chen sda mon dang rje no gnyis kyi mdun du rol dbyangs dang chab srid kyi gzhung lugs/ mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blo sogs sbyong myong ba'i ma tshad skabs de'i skad grags can gyi mi sna du ma dang 'brel ba dam po yod de/ dper na mtshan nyid rig pa ba a nu khe si sgo ra si(sab5582010 7smokhyimarga 77)dang / snyan ngag pa so h+pho khi li si/(509607163 r+sās/mas/lo) sgyu rtsal mkhas pa h+phi sdi a si(261cha tsho po'isgro46)sogs dang 'gro 'ongs dam po yod/ dge rgan dam pa dang grogs mchog rnams kyi bag chags bzang po'i shugs rkyen 'og/ phe ri khi le si la shes bya rgya che zhing gting zab po yod pa ma zad/ rtsod gleng la rab tu mkhas pa'i steng kun las lhag pa'i sgyu rtsal gzigs dpyad kyi nus rtsal yang ldan pas/ khong gis gsung bshad gnang skabs khyad mtshar can gyi skad cha mang ba dang yid sems 'gug pa'i tshig snyan brjod pas/ dus rgyun nyan mkhan rnams kyis mig chu dbang med du phe ri khi le si/'chor ba red/ de'i phyir a then gyi mi dmangs 190

kyis khong la o lim phe si ri bo'i lha zhes shābod do//phe ri khi le si lo na gzhon pa'i dus su/ a then gyi spyi dmangs byed dus/lhag bsam rnam dag ngang dmag don las ka legs sgrub byas shing / hur thag sgos par zig gi btsan 'dzul la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab 'dzing la zhugs/ phe ri khi le si yis rang gi mes rgyal la dga' zhen bcangs shing a then gyi spyi dmangs yin pa'i spobs sems la brten nas a then gyi chab srid gar stegs steng du 'jogs/ khong nyid 'tsho ba dbul yang rang lus rang gces byed pa'i e h+phi al the si(2961ma 63khyar+sā༅po0)dang mnyam du sbrel nas/ sku drag tshogs chen gyi dmigs bsal can gyi dbang cha la tshod 'gog byed pa'i 'thab rtsod byas pa'i steng/ khong gis spyod pa gtsang pa dang / lhag bsam rnam dag gis gzhung don bsgrubs shing / khong ni gzab brling sgos bden rdzun dbye 'byedabyed par mkhas la/ shes yon sna tshogs ldan pa'i mi zhig yin stabs/a then gyi spyi dmangs khrod mtshan snyan grags shin tu che/ khong ni chang gi gsol ston la mi zhugs la mi ga'an pa'i khyim du gsol mchod kyang mi bzhes pa red/ lo ngo 30ring thengs gcig kho nar khong gi gnyen mi zhig gi gnyen ston la zhugs myong ba tsam yin la/ thengs de la yang mgron po rnams kyis chang 'thung 'go ma brtsams gong gsol ston las bral ba red/ khong nyid la byung rgyal du khong khro mi skye ba'i spyod bzang yod/ thengs shig khi no h+phel sdi (7) char+sāpoglo)zhes pa'i sku drag cig khong gi rjes su dam por 'brangs nas/ kha en tsam sdod khom med par phe ri khi le si'i chab srid ni spam rdzu ston zhor du tha shal 'bangs mi dang e mthun mthun byas pa red ces dang / phe ri khi le si ni2 blun po blun nag ci midang smyon pa zhig red ces gshe gshe btang na'ang /phe ri khi le si yis lam gang bor ci yang mi smra bar sku drag de'i sdigs smod la nyan pa dang / rang khyim du thon pa dang sems lhod po'i ngang bran g.yokā zlog

bos nas sgron me bzung ste sku drag kla klo pa de phyir skyel dgos pa'i bka' gnang / phe ri khi le si'i gshes spyod la/ khong gi grogs po bzang po ste lo rgyus smra ba pa zi'u khe sdi sde si(1650571 703)yis phe ri khi le si'i shes bya dang khog rgya/ kun gyis khas len pa'i gshes spyod bzang po la dmangs kyis dga' bsu thob la/ khong nyid ni spyod yon rnam dag dang gzhung drang sger sems med pa'i mi zhig yin pas mang tshogs la do dam byed skabs gnong ci yang med pa red ces ba/ ṭā kārdo k+ta~X ༵)lo yo /sa/ spyi lo sngon gyi 424gror phe ri khi le si yis a then gyi ches mtho'i go gnas tewa dmag dpon chen po bcu'i nang gi ches mtho'i dmag dpon gyi las 'khur bstud 'dzin byas shing / rkang dmag dang mtsho dmag la bkod 'doms bya dgos pa ma zad/ phyi 'brel gyi bya ba'i 'gan yang 'khur dgos pas/ rgyal khab de'i dngos don 'go khrid pa ru gyur/ dus skabs de ni a then rdzogs ldan dus rabs su zhugs pa'i dus su gyur pa red/phe ri khi le si'i dus rabs su/ a then rgyal khab kyi chab srid las khungs sngar bzhin las 'dzin dpon po dang mi lnga brgya'i tshogs chen dang /①spyo dmangs tshogs chen/ spyi dmangs 'dri gcod las rogs kyi khrims ra sogs las grub mod/ 'on kyang sngar dang mi 'dra sa ni/ spyi dmangs phal ba'i chab srid dbang cha'i nus pa mu mthun du je cher song bas/ a then gyi spyi dmangs tshogs chen kyis don dngos su rgyal khab kyi ches mtho'i dbang cha'i las khungs kyi las 'gan legs sgrub byas la/ de ni a then gyi dmangs gtso'i chab srid kyi ches rtsa ba'i khyad chos yin no// rgyal khab kyi nang srid dang phyi 'brel gyi kha de'inaX rgu // mi/rtsi'i kāswā gā rmi g+ni snyo 35 shā/ ṭā chi sbyi r+shanā yi ni d+dhi rā sab pa/kā ཿnā sdi sna rnyi )sdo tāt+na rdo / bye 〉〉〉pa hār+shasna sprildanā hāzlo ཿཿ sa yisna sna/'i nang na mi lnga bcu ra bdamasanasagrub cing / da na mo

phyogs dang srid jus te/ dper na chings yig 'bri rgyu dang / dmag 'khrug rgyag min sogs kyi gnad don/ dpon po'i go gnas bsko 'then/ nyes can la srog khrims nyes chad gcod rgyu la sogs pa'i don chen ni spyi dmangs tshogs chen gyi gros bsdur byas nas gros thag gcod dgos/ spyi dmangs tshogs chen ni nyin bcu rer tshogs 'du thengs gcig bsdu dgos shing / a then gyi skyes pa dar ma thams cad zhugs chog la brdas thag gcod dbang yang yod/ srid gzhung gi rim pa so po'i dpon gnas kyang spyi dmangs sus kyang bzung chog cing dmag dpon chen po bcu ni lag pa bkyags nas gros thag gcod dgos pa las/ go gnas gzhan pa'i dpon po ni rgyan rgyag pa'i thabs la brten nas byungab red/ spyi dmangs las rogs kyi khrims ra ni spyi dmangs kyis khrims srid kyi dbang cha spyod pa'i las khungs yin la/ rang tshugs sgos 'dri gcod byed pa'i rtsa don ltar/ yongs grags su rtsod gling byed pa'i zhib bsher chog mchan 'god pa'i go rim lag bstar byed/ dpon sa rgyud 'dzin bya mi chog par 'dems bsko'i lam lugs lag bstar byas nas tshe gang por dbang 'dzin pa'i lam lugs med par bzos te/ res bskor nas srid 'dzin pa dang go gnas 'dzin pa'i dus tshod ni lo gcig yin la/ bstud mar bdams pa na slar yang 'gan bstud 'dzin bya chog spyi dmangs kyis gzhung las mi sna 'dems bsko bgyi ba'i rtsa don ni su la shes yon 'jon thang ldan na de kho na bsko bzhag byed rgyu de red/ gzhung gi las 'gan 'khur mkhan rnams kyis nges par du rgyal khab la blo sems dkar ba dang khrims lugs la 'gan 'khur dgos/ a then gyi khrims srol shin tu 'thus tshang zhing / khrims lugs lag bstarabyas pa shin tu nan mo yin pas/ phe ri khi le si lta bu'i mi yin rung dmigs bsal med par/ rjes kyi phe lo phon ne+e so si(26109006303 4khrirma777)dmag 'khrug skabs rgyal khab kyi rgyu nor 'phro brlag tu btastu sbyang

zhes skyon brjod byas thog dngul 'bor chen zhig gi chad pa bcad shing / re zhig dmag dpon chen mo'i go sa yang blangs pa red/phe ri khi le si yis spyi dmangs rnams bran g.yog dmangs gtso'i chab srid la zhugs par skul 'ded bya ched/ gzhung las la zhor phogs ster rgyu lag bstar byas/ 'dri gcod las rogs khrims dpon gyis nyin rer a sbor ( ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha)(gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i sgor mo la o sgor zer zhing / o spor gcig ni mi gcig gi nyin re'i 'tsho ba skyel ba'i 'gro song dang mnyam pa)gnyis re len chog cing / srid 'dzin dpon pos nyin rer o sbor bzhi dang / mi lnga brgya'i tshogs chen kyi tshogs mis o sbor lnga len chog gzhan yang phe ri khi le si yis dbul phongs spyi dmangs re re la 'khrab thengs gcig tu zlos gar gyi zhor phogs sbyin nas de tsho rgyal khab kyi rig gnas 'tsho bar zhugs par rogs ram byas/ yin na'ang gron dngul de dag ni a then gyi rgyal nang bran g.yog la bshu gzhog dang phyi'i rgyal khab kyi khe dbang btsan 'phrog byas nas thob pa red/phe ri khi le si ni chab srid pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ gna' bo'i snyi ri si'i rig gnas gong bkur byed cing dar spel gtong mkhan zhig kyang red/ khong gi phugs bsam dang 'dun pa ni a then gyis snyi ri si yongs kyi kha lo bsgyur mkhan byed rgyu ma zad/ ghi ri si yongs kyi slob grwa ru bsgyur rgyu de yin zhing /phe ri khi le si'i dus skabs ni snyi ri si'i gna' bo'i rig gnas ches yang rtser son pa'i dus skabs yin te/ snyi ri si yongs su mtshan snyan grags che ba'i mkhas pa dang sgyu rtsal mkhas chen tshang ma a then du phe ri khi le si'i mtha' 'khor du 'dus nas/ slob khrid gnang ba dang bden legs mdzes gsum 'tshol ba/ 'jig rten gyi gsang ba dang mi tshe'i bden don la mnyam zhib byed bzhin yod/ byis pa tsho la chung ngu'i dus nas phyogs so so'i slob gso byas na//94kho tshos a then gyi mi re rer nges par du dgos pa'i nus rtsal dang yon

tan sbyong dgos pa red/ rtsom rig dang rol dbyangs/ zlos gar yang mgyogs por dar rgyas gong 'phel byung / phe ri khi le si yis zlos gar zhor phogs ster ba dang / dus chen gyi rol mo'i 'gran bsdur dang rol mo'i tshogs khang gsar skrun byed pa sogs kyi thabs shes la brten nas/ spyi dmangs rnams kyi bsam blo dang rig gnas 'tsho ba phun sum tshogs par btang nas kho tsho'i nang la mthun sgril yong ba byas/a then la rgyan spras pa'i ched du/ spyi lo sngon gyi 447lo nas bzung / phe ri khi le si yis rgya chen po'i ngang a then gyi mkhar rdzong gi tshogs 'dzugs skrun byas/ de bzhin du a then gyi gzi 'od 'phro ba'i gzugs brnyan gsar bzhengs byas stabs/ snyi ri si yongs kyi mi rnams kyis re mos byed yul du gyur/ phe ri khi le sis srid dbang bzung ba'i dus skabs su/ phyogs gcig nas drag chas la brten nas rgya rmetsho'i steng gi do bral rgyal khab btsan po btsugs shing / phyogs gzhan zhig nas shugs gang yod sgos btsan rgyal gyi khongs rgya je cher btang / de lta na snyi ri si ham 'dzin byed 'dod yod pa'i si phar tha dang 'gal ba je cher 'gro ba ni bshol med dngos don zhig yin pas/mthar thug phe lo phon ne so si'i dmag 'khrug brgyab pa red/ (spyi lo sngon gyi 431 sngon gyi slo1lo'i bar) dmag 'khrug 'go tshugs pa'i lo dang por/phe li khi le si yis dmag 'khrug nang rang srog btang ba'i dpon dmag rnams la rgyal khab kyi 'das 'jug byed pa'i mdzad sgo'i steng / lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan pa'i gtam bshad gnang nas/ dmangs gtso'i chab srid 'ud sgrog byas te/ rang rlom chen po'i ngang nga tsho'i lam lugs la dmangs gtso'i lam lugs zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ srid dbang ni spyi dmangs yongs la dbang la mi nyung shas la mi dbang ba'i rkyen gyis red/ mices gsungs/ 'on kyang lo1 /spras

tsam 'gor rjes khong gi tshe srog nad yams kyis phrogs dus yun ring por sdomag 'khrug brgyab mthar a then pham nas si phar tha'i mnga' 'og tu lhung a then gyi bran g.yog bdag po'i dmangs gtso'i chab srid lam lugs ni dngos gnas phe li khi le sis gsungs pa bzhin du/ bde skyid ldan zhing 'thus tshang pa'i lam lugs shig yin nam zhe na ma yin te/ lam lugs 'di bran bdag nyung ngus dbang bsgyur pa'i lam lugs dang sger gcod lam lugasalas sngon thon yin pas/ a then gyi dpal 'byor dang rig gnas kyi 'phel rgyas phyogs skul spel nus pa bton/ yin na'ang a then gyi dmangs gtso'i lam lugs ni khongs rgya chung chung nang lag bltar byas pas/ ag kha (mchordo)sde'i sdod dmangs bzhi 'bum khrod/ bran g.yog dang yul gzhan gyi mi las gzhan da dung bud med dang skye bo lo na ma son pa rnams la spyi dmangs kyi dbang cha med/ spyi dmangs kyi dbang cha yod mkhan ni a then gyi rang dbang can gyi 'bangs mi'i nang gi skyes pa dar ma kho na red/ bsdom rtsis byas pa ltar na de tsho mi bzhi khri tsam las med/ phe ri khi le si'i dus skabs su/ spyi dmangs kyi 'os bab la chod 'dzin nan mo byed kyi 'dug spyi lo sngon gyi 445lo'i khrims lugs nang / pha ma gnyis ka a then gyi mi yin tshe da gzod a then gyi mir brtsi zhing de la spyi dmangs kyi dbang cha yod ces thag gcod byas yod/ khrims lugs de'i rkyen du gzhan gyis ther 'don byas pa'i mgo skor gtong mkhan gyi nag nyes can gyi khyim tshang lnga stong lhag byung / spyi dmangs kyi nang yang dngos gnas chab srid kyi dbang cha yod mkhan ni mi nyung shas yin la/ zhing pa dang lag shes bzo las pa/ dbul po mang po ni 'tsho gnas kyi ched du brel bas/ nyin gcig gi las ku'i yong sgo blos btang nas nyin ༵༵ rer thengs gcig 'tshog pa'i tshogs chen la zhugs khom med/ chab

srid steng dbang cha dngos su 'dzin mkhan ni bzo tshong las rigs kyi bran g.yog bdag po dang rim mtho'i spyi dmangs rnams yin la/ don dngos su dbang cha 'dzin mkhan ni dmag dpon chen mo red/ dmag dpon chen mo dang dpon gnas gzhan pa mi 'dra ste/ rgyan brgyab nas byung ba ma yin par lag pa yar bkyags nas 'dems bsko byas shing zhor phogs kyang med/'dems sko'i go rim nang bzo tshong las rigs kyi bran g.yog bdag po dang rim mtho'i spyi dmangs rnams kyis rgyun du 'dems bsko kha lo bsgyur nas go sa gal chen 'di sger sdom byed pa red/ phe ri khi le si ni bzo tshong las rigs bran g.yog bdag po'i gral rim gyi ches stobs shugs can gyi 'thus mi yin la/khong gis lo ngo bco lnga'i ring bsdud mar gtso bzhugs dmag dpon chen mo'i las 'gan bzhes nas a then gyi srid gzhung la dbang sgyur byas/ a then gyi dmangs gtso'i chab srid ni a then gyi bran g.yog dpal 'byor dang a then gyi bran g.yog bdag po'i gral rim la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i dmangs gtso'i chab srid red/ de ci ltar dmangs gtso can du bsgyur na'ang rang dbang can gyi 'bangs mi'i nang chab srid kyi dbang cha'i bcos sgrig tsam byas pa las ma 'das la/ de'i ngo bo la 'gyur ldog ci yang byung med par sngar bzhin du bran g.yog dang spyi dmangs min pa'i mang tshogs la ya nga ba'i dbang sgyur byed rgyu de yin pas/ nga tshos a then gyi bran g.yog bdag po'i dmangs gtso'i chab srid la gdeng 'jog byed pa'i dus ngo bo de brjed mi rung ba yin no// 197

gna' rabs kyi0sko tham rig lus rtsalalhunagran chogs/〉enaphe/deng rabs o lim phig (017191 khu lko42)lus rtsal 'gran tshogs ni gna' bo'i o lim phig lus rtsal 'gran tshogs kyi rmang gzhi'i steng grub cing 'phel rgyas byung ba red/ 'o na gna' bo'i o lim phig lus rtsal 'gran tshogs kyi 'byung khungs dang skabs de'i 'khrug po che ba'i gnas tshul gang 'dra zhig red zhe na gsham du zhu'o//gna' rabs o lim pheg lus rtsal 'gran tshogs kyi 'byung khungs ni gna' bo'i snyi ri si red/ gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i mkhar grong rgyal khab kyi dus skabs su/ rtag tu rgyun chad med pa'i dmag 'khrug byung bas/ dmag 'khrug rgyag pa dang bran g.yog gi 'os langs la drag gnon byed par 'phrod pa'i gzugs thang zhing shed che la dka' ba thub cing bde lcag 'khyug po'i spyi dmangasaskyed bsring bya ched/ lus rtsal sbyong brdar ni gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i mi'i 'tsho ba'i gal chen grub cha zhig tu gyur/ ghi ri si'i sa khul mang po ste/dper na o lim phi ya (017191 tha cho༅༅)dang / sdel h+phi/(261961 7lo4)kho rin tho si (500ba 603 777)sa 'gag sa khul sogs su dus rgyun du lha mchod kyi nyin la lus rtsal 'gran tshogs rgyas po tshogs nas lha rnams la gus sems 'bul ba red/ de'i nang skad grags ches che ba ni lhag par du o di/8 phi a ru lha chen rdzi'u si(265bya mo)la mchod pa'i o lim phig lus

rtsal 'gran tshogs zhes pa de yin no/gna' bo'i snyi ri si'i snyan ngag pa phan ḍa(21 ba77 67)yis khong gi bstod pa'i snyan tshig tu gna' bo'i o lim phig lus rtsal 'gran tshogs kyi 'byung khungs brjod skabs/ snyi ri si'i e li si(2smo cu lko17)mkhar grong rgyalakhab kyi rgyal po i no ma si (shā 7blozalhami⑥)la blo mdzangs shing mdzes sdug ldan pa'i bu mo zhig yod pa'i ming la rji po sda smi a (lkoṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭhasko༅)zer/gzhon nu mang po 'ongs nas kho mor gnyen bslangs kyang / yab rgyal po la bu mos gnyen sgrig byas tshe yab grongs nges yin zhes pa'i lha'i bka' lung thob myong bas/ rgyal po i no si yis gnyen slong mkhan rnams kyis nges par du khong dang dmag 'thab shing rta'i steng 'gran bsdur byed dgos shing / gal srid gnyen slong mkhan gyi shing rta'i rjes zin pas na khong gis mdung ring gis de'i srog len rgyu yin zhes khyab bsgrags byas/ mtsho lha pho se ldon(2032160b.lo4lhasalha()gyi bu phe lo phu si (lo tshe1ste:46)yis sras mo gnyen ma bslangs gong pho gsar bcu gsum rgyal po i no ma si'i mdung mgor shi/ rji po sda smi a yi mdza' dung lhad med thob ched/ dpa' rtul phe lo phu si la 'jigs snang ci yang med par/ rang gi yab rgyal po pho se ldon gyis gnang ba'i ming la nam yang ngal dub mi shes zhes pa'i rta bzhi can gyi shing rta'i kho lo bsgyur nas 'gran bsdur nang zhugs/ khog tu phe lo thu si la sems pa shor ba'i sras mo rji po sda smi a yis kyang rgyal po'i shing rta 'ded mkhan la lkog rngan sprad de rgyal po'i shing rta'i 'khor lo'i steng gi mdzer gtan gsang ba'i ngang 'bal du bcug 'gran bsdur byed 'go brtsams pa dang / rgyal po i no ma sis shugs gang yod bton nas phe a phu si'i rjes snyeg pa dang / glo bur du shing rta'i 'khor lo lhung ste sar 'gyel nas tshe las 'das/phe lo phu sir rgyal kha thob par dga' ston rten 'brel zhu ched/ / tsāspem
