thon skyed ngal rtsol khrod gal che ba'i go gnas med pa ma yin par/ phe la tho la bran bdag gral rim gyi phyogs zhen che bas/ bran g.yog mi ru mi brtsi ba dang /byin /yog la dbang cha gang yang med pas spyi dmangs nang mi the bas rkyen gyis na / la tho yis jus bkod byas pa'i drang bden gyi rgyal khab de mngon du 'gyur thub bam zhe na/ de'i phyogs phe la tho rang nyid la'ang yid ches chen po med/ khong gis phugs 'dod la mngon du 'gyur pa'i nges pa med kyang /mngon du 'gyur ma thub rung de ni bzang don zhig yin par khas mi len pa'i dgos pa med de/ dper na mdzes ma do zla med pa zhig ri mor bris shing /'jig rten steng gi mdzes ma su yang de la ma do na/ kho mo mdzes ma ma red ces su yis 'chad thub bam/ de bzhin du phe la tho yisatshorang la 'phya smod byed mkhan la dgag lan btab/ 'di yang phe la tho yi tshul gyi 'khyog bshad red ces kyang shod chog drang por bshad na/ phe la tho yi phugs re'i rgyal khab ni khungs med rtog bzo byas pa ma yin te/ de ni gna' rabs si phar tha(5981 8lo༅7)yi spyi tshogs chab srid lam lugs dang 'dra sa mang po yod/'on kyang spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs bzhi ba'i snyi ri si'i bran g.yog lam lugs kyi malar grong rgyal khab la nyams nyen byung ba dang / spyi tshogs kyi 'thab rtsod la dza drag che bas/ nam rgyun brtan po yod pa'i si phar tha yang nyams nyen gyi klong 'khor nang lhung / gnas tshul de lta bu'i 'og phe la tho yis phugs re'i mkhar grong rgyal khab 'dzugs pa'i jus gzhi bton na'ang de ni mngon du 'gyur thabs med pa'i stong sems shig yin no//252

kun shes mkhas pa chena'asgo45'a si tho thethun si/son hran/a ri si tho the le si(sa03 0 21632246za41spyi lo sngon gyi 384:spyi lo sngon gyi 322lo'i bar)ni gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i rlabs che ba'i bsam blo pa dang shes bya kun 'dzoms kyi mkhas dbang zhig yin/ khong gi dgongs pa dang gsung rtsom ni shes rig gi khyab khongs chen por 'brel ba yod pas/ en khe sis (ṣ+ṭhacha46)kyang rig gzhung phyogs mang por grub 'bras yod pa'i ches shes bya ldan pa'i mi zhig red ces gsungs/ rjes rab sa pa tshos khong la gcig gyur gyi lta tshul med rung /cis kyang a ri si tho the le sis rjes rabs pa la bzhag pa'i shugs rkyen ni shin tu zab po yin par khas len pa red/ tha na lo ngo nyis stong rjes kyi de ring yang khong gi rig gnas brtson zhib kyi snying stobs dang rig gzhung phyogs kyi mdzad rjes la da dung bsngags brjod byed bzhin yod/ a ri si tho the le si/spyica sngon gyi 384lor/ a ri si tho the le si ni e rjin rgya mtsho'i byang 253

'gram gyi ghi ri si pas mi ser spel yul gyi grong khyer si tha rje ra mo/lha'izhes par sku 'khrungs/ grong khyer de ni khar lji sde kho rdolotshims gling phran phyed ma'i steng yod cing byang phyogs kyi sme se don ne a(57068218 4291)dang khyim mtshes yin/ khong gi pha yab rna khi ma kha si(smo1 077067bya khurnya/yīlo)ni sme se rdon ne+e a'i rgyal po'i em chi byas myong / khong gi ma yum h+pha i si the ṣ+ṭha7mo ni a then shar phyogs kyi gling phran chen mo yu'u lha'i a(20 68744)gling phran steng gi khal khe si(khustumakhu1 3 rdolor+shalo)grong khyer du sku 'khrungs/ a ri si tho the le si chung ba'i dus pha grong bas khong gi lta skyong byed mis bdag skyong byas te nar son/ ha lam pho lo bcu bdun steng ghi ri si'i rig gzhung lte gnas a then du bskyal nas phe la tho yis btsugs pa'i a kha sdi smi a ru slob sbyong byed du bcug pa dang / khong gis de ru hur brtson lhod med sgos lo ngo nyi shu ring rig gzhung sna tshogs la slob sbyong byas/ slob ma mang po'i nang khong la skyes stobs kyi shes rab ldan zhing rang rkya 'pher ba'i sgo nas bsam gzhigasaXmid mkhas pas kun las lhag pa zhig tu thon/ phe la tho yis snga sa nas rang gi slob bu 'di la 'dul midaka' ba'i gshes ka yod pa mkhyen yod kyang / a ri si tho the le si ni slob ra'i nang gi mchog gyur snying bcud red ces gsungs/ spyi lo sngon gyi 347lor phe la tho sku gshegs rjes/ pho lo 37la slobs pa'i a ri si tho the le si a she ya chung ba'i a so grong khyer du gnas spos shing yul de'i dbang sgyur pa hor smi a phon ni khong gi slob grogs yin pas sku mgron gal chen lta bur sne len byas pa ma zad/ rang gi tsha mo phe sdi a (tshe'im:yonā)zhes pa'ang a ri si tho the le si la mna' mar gnang / lcam mo de la bu bu mo gcig 'khrungs/ rjes su hor smi a phon ( posko༅)ni par zig gi rgyal pos lkog gsod btang bas/ a ri si tho the le si'i sems la skyo gdung tshaX ṭā/ skyes te/ khong rang le si sbo si(263 3 14mos)gling phran steng gi

smi thi le ne grong khyer(5kro 70ba sko447)nang gnas spos/ skabs der phe sdi a tshe las 'das nas yun ring 'gor bas a ri si tho the le si dang rang gi g.yog mo gnyis khyim gcig tu bsdad pa dang bu zhig skyes pa'i ming la ne khi ma kha si zer/(a mes kyi ming dang 'dra ba)spyi lo sngon gyi 343lor sme se rdon gyi rgyal po h+phe li phu sku rabs gnyis pa'i lo bcu gsum can gyi lha sras e legs gzan rdar (41057ba6103 ༅77lko)la dge rgan tshad mthun zhig gdan 'dren rgyu byas shing / shes rgya chen po can gyi a ri si tho the le si ni der mthun 'os mi la gyur pas/ h+phe le phu sku rabs gnyis pas a ri si tho the le si la gdan 'dren phyag yig gnang nas/rang gi bu ni a ri si tho the le si'i dus rabs nang 'khrungs pa 'di las dbang bzang pas red zer ba las kyang rgyal po des a ri si tho the le si la shin tu dad gus byed pa mthong thub/ a ri si tho the le si ni sme se rdon(57070ba6༅r+sā)du lo du mar bzhugs/ khong gis a li gi gzan sder(ma 'ongs pa'i rgyal po)zhes pa'i phru gu spyod rtsub mide la shugs rkyen ga 'dra zhig bzhag par tshod dpag bgyi khag kyang / mkhas pa kha shas kyis bshad na/ a ri si tho the le si'i slob ston gyis e legs gzan rdar gyi gshis ka dang spyod pa grub par thag gcod rang bzhin gyi nus pa thon yod zer la/ yang mkhas pa la las bshad na nus pa ci yang thon med zer/ rjes su e legs gzan rdar dang dge rgan gyi 'brel ba ga 'dra yin pa mi shes mod/ khong gis dge rgan la yun ring gus bkur byas pa dngos don du snang / shod tshul la e legs gzan rdar gyis66bdag skye mkhan ni pha ma yin zhing / bdag la 'tsho ba ci ltar rol na rin thang yod med kyi mdzub ston byed mkhan ni bdag gi dge rgan a ri si tho the le si red/mi zhes gsungs myong zer/spyi lo sngon gyi 336lor h+phe le phu gzhan gyis lkog gsod byas pa ༵༵ e

legs gzan rdar rgyal po'i khri la bzhugs nas shar phyogs 'dul bar gra sgrig byas/ a ri si tho the le si a then ru phyir log slebs mdzad pa dang spyi lo sngon gyi 335lor a then shar byang gi grong 'dabs kyi li khem(270077 277)lus rtsal khang du slob grwa zhig btsugs pa dang ming la li khem zhes btags nas/de sngon phe la tho yi btsugs pa'i a kha sdi smi a yi kha gtad do zlar langs pa'i tshul byas/ a ri si tho the le si yis li khem gyi gtso 'gan lo ngo bcu gsum la mdzad cing phyogs gcig nas slob khrid dang phyogs gcig nas gsung rtsom brtsams/ de ni khong nyid kyi las don phyogs su yongs yang rtser son pa dang grub 'bras chen po blangs pa'i dus skabs yin pas/ rjes rabs la bzhag pa'i gsung rtsom mang che ba ni skabs der legs grub byung / khong gi slob ma chu tshad kyi mtho dma' ltar 'dzin grwa gnyis su bgos/ khong gis nyin re'i snga dror 'dzin grwa mthon por slob khrid gnang/ de la mi grangs cung nyung / slob tshan la mtshan nyid rig pa dang / dngos lugs rig pa/ rtsod sgrub rig pa sogs yod/ phyi dro 'dzin grwa phal bar slob khrid gnang zhing slob tshan la brda sprod rig pa dang tshig sbyor rig pa/ chab srid rig pa sogs yod/ a ri si tho the le si yis slob bu skor zhig khrid nas slob ra'i skye tshal khrod du bag yangs ngang slob khrid gnang bas/ rig gzhung gi grub mtha' 'di la phe li pha the thi si(26298 0 1 0byamatsho༅7) zhes pa'i ming thog cing de'i nang don bag yangs pa'i grub mtha' mizhes pa red/ a ri si tho the le si yi zhib 'jug bya ba la shar 'dul bgyi bzhin pa'i e legs gzan rdar rgyal pos yid mthun rogs ram gnang / shod tshul la e legs gzan rdar gyis ched du mi stong phrag du ma mngags nas a ri si tho the le si la zhabs 'degs byed du bcug cing / de'i nang rngon pa dang nya ba/ sbrang rtsi bsdu mkhan/ bye'u gso mkhan so~X sbyad pas ghi ri si'i sa khul so sor khyab cing / mi de dag gis dmar

dpe rnam pa sna tshogs bsdus nas a ri si tho the le si la dngos mang bkram ston khang zhig 'dzugs rogs byas par bshad/ e legs gzan rdar gyis da dung khong gi dge rgan la dngul mang po zhig gnang nas zhib 'jug gi gron dngul du btang / bshad tshul 'di dag nang gi gnas tshul phran bu tshang ma dngos don yin par rlom dka' mod/ che phyogs ha lam dngos don yin rgyu red/ a ri si tho the le si dang sme se rdon gyi rgyal blon dbang sgyur tshogs pa dang 'brel ba zab pas/ a ri si tho the le si la bkra mi shis pa'i snga ltas shig shugs su chags/spyi lo sngon gyi 323lor rgyal po a le shin sder shar phyogs sba sbi lon du glo bur la grongs/ gnas tshul de go ba na ghi ri si pa rnams kyis slar yang rang btsan bgyi bar re ba bcangs/ a then gyi mi rnams kyis sme se rdon la skyes pa'i khong khro de si tha rje ra'i mi yi stong spos pas/ a ri si tho the le si la lha lagus pa mi byed pa'i nag nyes jiyod ces zhu gtug byas/(skabs der de ni nag nyes chen po zhig red) a ri si tho the le si yis rang la chag sgo rkyen ngan yong ba mkhyen nas 'phral mar rgya mtshor brgal nas phyir khal khi si ru slebs pa dang / khong gi yid mug cing skyo ba skyes drag pas cher ma bzhugs par lo de'i phyi lor dgung lo 63stong sku grongs so//a ri si tho the le si yis tshe gang por gsum rtsom po ti 400brtsams yod(bshad tshul gzhan zhig la po ti 10)nyiyod kyang zer)da lta mthong rgyu yod par gsum rtsom 47las med/ de'i nang rang byung tshan rig gi rig gzhung du ma dang gtan tshigs rig pa/ mi chos rig pa/ chab srid rig pa/ rtsom rig gzhung lugs sogs 'du ba red/ phyi rabs su brgyud nas ma bor pa'i khong gi gsung rtsom nyung ngu 'di ha lam gna' bo'i snyi ri si'i sna mang kun 'dzoms kyi dpe tshogs su gyur yod/ a ri si tho the le si ni gtan tshigs rig pa'i(phyi tshul gtan tshigasdu /ga

pa)srol gtod mkhan yin zhing / khong gis yang dag pa'i sgo nas bstan don/mi'i bsam gzhigs ngo ma dang rdzun ma yin min de bsam gzhigs gtong yul gyi don dngos dang mthun mi mthun la blta dgos shing / don dngos las brgal bar mi bsam dgu bsam byed pa'i mi su la'ang shes bya ngo ma zhig thob rgyu ma red zer/ khong gis phyogs bsdus dang rnam par 'byed pa'i thabs shes gnyis bton zhing / phyogs bsdus ni bye brag gi dngos po las spyi'i rtsa don rigs 'ded byed pa yin la/ rnam par 'byed pa ni spyi'i rtsa don las byed brag gi dngos po gleng pa de yin/ rags rim gyi rnam 'byed rigs dpag ni sgrub byed gsum ldan gyi spyi 'gros te/ sgrub byed snga ma(mi thams cad shi 'gro ba red)dang / sgrub byed phyi ma/(krang san ni mi red) sdom tshig(krang san 'chi nges red)gsum las grub/ shes rtog gi ma mtha'i 'gro lugs 'di dag ni a ri si tho the le si yis thog mar spyi bsdoms byas nas thon pa red/ khong gis da dung bsam gzhig gi gzhi rtsa'i chos nyid de gcig gyur gtan srol dang 'gal ba'i gtan srol/ bar gnas phyir 'bud gtan srol sogs zhib bshad gnang ba ma zad/ don spyi la rigs chen po bcu bgos(dngos yod bya dngos kyi phyogs so so nas bsdus pa'i gzhi rtsa'i don spyi)pa 'di lta ste dngos gzugs/ grangs tshad/ ngo bo/ 'brel ba/ gnas gzhi/ dus tshod/ rnam pa/ yod tshad/ 'gul skyod/ phog 'khel bcas red/ a ri si tho the le si yi gtan tshigs rig pa la gna' rabs dang gna' bo'i dus rabs bar ma'i dus su mthong chen dang zhib 'jug byas yod pa'i ma tshad/ da lta yin yang khong gis gtan 'khel byas pa'i rtsa don dang rigs gras/ tha na khong gis sngar spyod myong ba'i ched las tha snyad kha shas ni gtan tshigs rig pa'i slob deb du spyod bzhin yod pa red/25sdu ri si tho the le si yis srog chags dang rtsi shing phyogs kyi gsung rtsom

mang po bcoms shing / srog chags kyi rigs 500lhag zin bris su phab/khong sku ngo mas srog chags 50lhag la gshags dpyad mdzad cing da dung mi yi sbrum rten la'ang gshags dpyad bgyi myong / a ri si tho the le si yis tshan rig tshod lta byed par mthong chen gnang ba'i snying stobs 'di phe la tho yis mig nang du ma bzhag de bas na khong gi snying stobs de lhag tu 'gangs che ba zhig yin pa shes thub/ dbyin ji'i skye dngos rig pa ba sdar wen((681163 20 7 28741 ba774)gyis a ri si tho the le si'i zhib 'jug thabs shes dang skabs de'i cha rkyen 'og blangs pa'i grub 'bras la bstod bsngags chen po gnang yod/ gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i skabs su/ rang byung tshan rig gi sde khag mang po la dus yun ring por rigs sna 'byed de zhib 'jug byas med pa dang /phra mthong che shel dang rgyang shel med pa ma zad/ 'phrul 'khor du 'bod chog pa'i dngos po yang med cing / mi rnams la skye lugs rig pa'i shes bya shin tu dkon pas/ klad gzhung gi byed nus ci yin mi shes la/ tha na sdod rtsa dang 'phar rtsa yang 'byed mi thub/ gnas tshul 'di lta bu'i 'og a ri si tho the le si yis rgyud 'ded rig pa'i steng gi gnad don la do snang mdzad de/ snyi ri si'i bud med cig mi nag cig gi chung ma byas pa'i phru gu mi dkar yin yang de'i rgyud rabs 'phro ma mi skyi lpags nag po can du gyur/ rgyud rabs gnyis pa'i khadog nag po'i rgyu de gang du yib par khong gis bsam gzhigs btang yang thag gcod ma thub/ gzhan yang a ri si tho the le si yis dngos lugs rig pa la'ang zhib 'jug gnang myong yang / khong la bsam yul las 'das pa'i nor 'khrul zhig byung ba ni/ dngos po zhig gnas gcig nas mar lhung ba'i tshe mar 'bab pa'i mgyogs tshad ni ljid tshad dang mthun bsdur yin zer ba de red/spyi 'gros 'di la dus yun ring po'i nang dogs snang skye mkhan ma byung ba dang /spyi lo 1590lor sga li le(675khu1 khri24 151—192)yis i ༵ byi'i

phi sa(21 4 79 )yul gyi gseg pa'i mchod rten stong tshod lta byas pa brgyud da gzod yo bcos byas pa red/a ri si tho the le si lo rgyus steng mtshan snyan grags che ba'i rgyu mtshan ni khong nyid mtshan nyid rig pa ba zhig yin pas yin pa smos med yin/ khong gis phe la tho la skyon brjod gnang phod pa dang / phe la tho yi mtshan nyid rig pa'i skyon ches che shos ni/ dngos yod 'jig rten gyi dngos gnas rang bzhin la btsan gyis khas mi len pa ma zad/ khungs med du 'du shes( e sdi a )kyi 'jig rten zhig gsar bzo byas pa'i steng dngos yod 'jig rten ni 'du shes 'jig rten gyi 'dra bzo'i dngos po red zer ces bstan no// a ri si tho the le si yis rang gi dge rgan gyi dpag dka'i rig pa la bstod pa ma byas par/dngos yod 'jig rten ni dngos su yod par khas len te/ khong bis dper na dngos don 'tshol ba'i mi su yin yang rang nyid sdod sa'i khang pa de dngos su yod med la dogs snang skye don ci yod zer/ de'i phyir a ri si tho the le si yis gsal por bstan don/ bye brag khang pa re re'i phyi rol du da dung khor rkyang du yod pa'i4spyir btang gi khang pa zhig yod ces zer srol med cing de la rtsa ba nas khas kyang len mi thub ces gsungs/ khong gis bdag rang gi dge rgan(phe la tho)la dga' zhen che mod lhag tu bden don la dga' zhen che zhes gsungs pa ni bskal pa ji srid bar gyi gtam snyan ma dpe ru gyur yod/ a si si tho the le si yis dngos yod 'jig rten gyi dngos gnas rang bzhin la khas blangs pa ma zad/ da dung mi rnams kyis dngos yod kyi 'jig rten(phyi rol gyi — bya dngos sna tshogs)'di la reg thug dang tshor ba/ shes rtogs byed dgos shing / shes bya thams cad ni de las thob pa red ces gsungs/ a ri si tho the le si yis tshor ba med phyir shes bya med ces pa'i yang dag gi lta ba rgyun 'ju~X byas stabs le nying gis kyang khong rang dngos gtso ring lugs la nye

ba red mices gsungs myong ngo spyoyin na'ang a ri si tho the le si yis khong gi dngos gtso rig lugs kyi lta ba mtha' 'khyol bar rgyun 'khyongs bgyi ma thub par/ khong gis phe la tho la skyon brjod byas pa dang chabs cig tu rang gi mtshan nyid rig pa'i lta ba spel/gtso bo ni ma rgyu dang rnam pa'i bar gyi 'brel ba'i skor gyi rig gzhung yin la/ma rgyu ga re red ce na/ bya dngos shig gi dngos po'i phyogs red/ rnam pa ni ga re yin zhe na/ bya dngos shig gi dbyibs kyi phyogs yin la/ bya dngos gang yin yang dbyibs dang dngos kyi phyogs gnyis med mi rung ste/ dper na rdo ka ru ma las bzos pa'i lha a phol lo'i sku brnyan zhig la mtshon na/ rdo ni dngos po de'i ma rgyu dang a phol lo'i gzugs brnyan ni de'i rnam pa red/ a ri si tho the le sis gsungs don/ rnam pa ni ma rgyu(dngos po)dang bral nas kher rkyang du gnas mi thub(lha sku rdo las bral mi thub pa)zer yang / de ni bden thog tu 'khel la khong gis rnam pa ni ma rgyu las lhag tu gal 'gangs che zhes nan bshad gnang bar yang don snying de las che'o/ khong gis rdo ka ru ma ni rang byungagi dngos po zhig byas na phan med dngos po zhig yin te/ de'i steng du shas che ba'i rang bzhin zhig yod pa tsam red/ rdo rko mkhan gyis las ga'i rkyen las a phol lo yi lha sku zhig grub pas na da gzod rdo de phan yod can(don snying can du gyur pa)du gyur pa dang shas che ba'i rang bzhin de mngon gyur rang bzhin du gyur ces gsungs/ de bzhin du rigs 'gres na dngos po gang yin yang de la don snying zhig tu(gnad don zhig gsal bshad bgyi thub pa)gtong mkhan ni de'i rnam pa red/ mthar gtug na rnam pa ni ma rgyu las gal che ba de red/ a ri si tho the le si yis bya dngos la 'gul skyod dang 'gyur ldog yod par khas len na'ang / 'gul skyod dang 'gyur ldog de ni bya dngos rang las thon pa ma yin par rnam pas skul spel la rag las pa re)6 sbyor/

gong du bshad pa ltar/ a ri si tho the le si yis rnam pa ma rgyu dang 'bral mi thub pa(rdo med na rdo bzos lha sku gang nas thon)la khas len mod/ khong gis mu mthud du bstan don/ ma rgyu las brgal pa'i steng ma rgyu la 'gul skyod byed du 'jug mkhan dang rnam pa gtan 'khel byed mkhan yang rnam pari yin pas/6 rnam pa ni dngos po thag gcod mkhan yim la/ dmigs yul gyis yar 'phel thag gcod byed de/ dngos po ma yin pa'i bya dngos shig ni 'jig rten gyi mtha' ma'i sgul shugs yin par gsungs pas/ de ni phar g.yo tshur g.yo byas nas cadangos po gnyis pa yin par smra ba'i sems gtso ring lugs su phyogs pa ma yin nam/ don dngos su yang de lta yin te/ a ri tho the le si ni dngos gtso ring lugs dang sems gtso ring lugs kyi bar du g.yo bzhin pa'i6 rgyu gnyis smra ba yi mtshan nyid rig pa zhig yin no//ari si tho the le si yi chab srid kyi dgongs par gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i mkhar grong rgyal khab rmang gzhi byas yod/ khong la skad grags can gyi gsungs shig yod pa ni mi ni lhan skyes su chab srid kyi srog chags red ces pa de yin la nang don ni mi ni skyes pa tsam nas mkhar grong rgyal khab kyi 'tsho ba rol dgos(phyi gling gi yi ge'i chab srid ces pa'i yig 'bru gnyis ni mkhar grong rgyal khab ces pa las thon) pa dang / mkhar grong kho nas da gzod spyi dmangs la spus legs kyi 'tsho ba zhig ster thub zer ba ma zad/ tha na mkhar grong rgyal khab las bral pas na de ni gal srid lha zhig ma yin tshe dud 'gro zhig yin no zhes kyang gsungs myong / mkhar grong rgyal khab la chab srid lam lugs(srid dbang gi rigs dbyibs)gang 'dra zhig btsugs na 'phrod ce na/ chab srid kyi lam lugs mang po'i dge skyon bsdur rjes/ a ri si tho the le si yis bran bdag chung bas dbang bzung ba'i zhi 'jam gyi dmangs gtso'i chab srid ladī sdugs ni ches 'tshams shing 'os pa red ces dgongs/ khong gis mi

gcig gam mi nyung shas kyis srid dbang sger 'dzin byed par(phe la tho yis gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i rgyal po yang de'i nang 'du ba)ngo rgol byed pa dang ham sems can gyis dmangs gtso'i chab srid thal drag tu khrid pa la'ang ngo rgol byed/ a ri si tho the le si ni bran bdag bsam blo pa mang po dang 'dra mtshungs yin pas bran g.yog la gral rim gyi brtan zhing g.yo ba med pa'i phyogs zhen lta tshul bzung yod pas/ 'jig rten skrun pa po yis mi la rigs gnyis bskrun zhing / gcig ni rang dbang can gyi mi yin la/ cig shos ni bran g.yog yin la/ bran g.yog ni lhan skyes su rang dbang can gyi mi dang 'dra mnyam min par bran bdag gi rgyu nor yin zhing skad cha 'chad shes pa'i las ga'i yo byad red zer/ khong gi sems su bran g.yog bdag pos bran g.yog la gnya' gnon dang bshu gzhog byas pa ni drang bden dang yongs su mthun 'phrod byung yod snyam zhing/ de ni bran g.yog lam lugs kyi ched du bsher rtsod byas kho na yin no//ci 263

sme se don gyi rgyalawo' legasagazan rdar/spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs bzhi bar/ ghi ri si'i bran g.yog lam lugs kyi mkhar grong rgyal khab nyams rgud du 'gro bzhin pa'i skabs/ ghi ri si'i byang khul gyi rgyal khab sme se rdon(570660ba zasgoji11)la dar rgyas chen po byung /spyi lo sngon gyi 338lor ghi ri si dbus ma'i kha ro ne a mkhar grong 'gram du sme se don gyi rgyal po h+phe le phu sku rabs gnyis pas dmag dpung khrid de khu rin thu si(5511ba 55314lo7)dang the sbe si( smos633 'a 66lo)a then bcas kyi ghi ri si'i mkhar grong rgyal khab kyi mnyam 'brel dmag dpung rdul du brlag pas/sme se don gyis ghi ri si la dbang bsgyur par rmang gzhi btang la/ ghi ri si'i mkhar grong rgyal khab so so'i bar phan tshun 'khrug rtsod byed pa'i lo rgyus kyang mjug bsgril pa red/ h+phe le phu yis blo khengs yid tshim sgos shar phyogs su dmag drangs par gra sgrig byed pa'i dus te/ spyi —lo sngon gyi 336lor rang gi bu mo'i gnyen ston tshosteng gzhan gyis lkog gsod btang / de nas 1phebasnorgyal po'i go gnas pho lo nyi shur son pa'i rgyal ske sras e legs gzan rdar gyis rgyud 'dzin —3gnang ngo // ri sna phra.e legs gzan rdar (412732661 ༅ na stso( phro774 spyi lo sngon gyi 356 sngon gyi 323lo'i wa rmeb/ // phugs 'dun chen po bcangs pa'i e legs gzan rdar/

gzhon nu zhig yin zhing / chung ngu'i dus nas 〈ho mer gyi lo rgyus snyan rtsom〉klog par spro pas/ a si le lta bu'i dpa' bo(a si le ni lo rgyus snyan rtsom nang gi thi ro i dmag 'khrug nang gi lha ri si'i mnyam 'brel dmag gi dmag dpon yin)zhig byed rgyu'i phugs sems yod/ khong pho lo bcu gsum steng sme se rdon gyi rgyal po'i pho brang du snyi ri si'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba chen po a ri si tho the le si dge rgan la brten nas/ sngon thon gyi snyi ri si'i bsam blo dang rig gnas kyi bag chags bzang po thebs yod/ e legs gzan rdar pho lo bcu drug la slebs dus/ h+phe le phu rgyun du phyi yul du dmag 'khrug rgyag par song bas/srid don kha shas bu la sprad nas bkod sgrig byed du bcug mod/ rgyal bu de'i ches dga' phyogs ni dmag dpung dang mnyam du dmag 'khrug rgyag par 'gro rgyu de yin zhing / g.yul sar slebs pa na nya mo chu la zhugs pa bzhin thun mong ma yin pa'i dpal ngar dang blo gros ldan pa mngon du thon/ kha ro ne a'i dmag 'khrug nang khong gis sme se rdon gyi dmag dpung gi g.yas ru la bkod 'doms gang legs mdzad pas dpa' dang rig pa gzengs su thon pa zhig thog mar phyi la mngon/ shod tshul la khong skabs skabs su pha h+phe le phu yis rgyal kha blangs par 'khang ra byed de rgyu mtshan ni de lta yin na rang gis 'dzam gling 'dul ba'i gzi brjid kho na rang nyid la thob mi thub pas red zer/ h+phe le phu shi rjes lo rgyus kyis ched du bkod sgrig byas pa bzhin e le gi gzan sder la dpa' rtsal gang yod 'don pa'i go skabs sheg thob pa red/h+phe le phu lkog gsod btang ba'i gnas tshul ghi ri si ru grags pa dang /ghi ri si'i mkhar grong rgyal khab so so'i nang rang btsan brtson len byed pa'i re ba byung bas/ the spe si yis a then sogs mkhar grong rgyal khab dang mnyam 'brel byas nas sme se don la ngo rgol byas/ e legs gzan rdar gyis gcig bsad kun 'dul gyi byed thabs spyad de the sbi si yi mi la drag gno/ 6rdo po

btang / lha khang dang phen snar gyi khyim tshang (phen snar ni e legs gzan rdar gyis gus 'dud byed pa'i the sbe si'i snyan ngag pa zhig red)ma gtogs the sbi si grong khyer rtsa ba nas gtor pa dang / sdod mi dmar gsod brgyab cing gson po rnams bran g.yog tu btsong / e legs gzan rdar gyis mgyogs myur du ghi ri si'i ngo rgol 'gul skyod snying 'jags su btang / don 'di'i steng nas gzhon gsar rgyal po de'i gnad don 'phral thag 'phral gcod byed thub pa'i spyod pa mthong thub la/ snying rje ya nga med pa'i gshis ka yang mtshon yod pa red/ rgyang ring du bskyod nas par zig la dpung 'jug byed rgyu ni h+phe le phu yis snga sa nas gtan la phab pa'i dmigs 'ben yin pas/ e le gi gzan sder gyis sgug long med pa'i ngang dmigs 'ben mngon du bsgyur snyam la rgyu mtshan ni de ni rang gis byas rjes chen po 'jog pa'i go skabs yag po yin pa'i rkyen gyis red/ de nas khong gis par zig la dgra sha rtsod du 'gro ('di ru sngar par zig yis snyi ri si la btsan 'dzul byas par dgra sha len pa bstan)zhes 'bod tshig 'og e legs gzan rdar gyis shar phyogs la btsan 'dzul rang bzhin gyi rgyang skyod bgyi 'go brtsams so//spyi lo sngon gyi 334lo'i dpyid kur e legs gzan rdar gyis blon po an thi pha ther(sab 198 67lnga ༅6)la khong gi tshab tu rgyal khab kyi srid don sgrub tu bcug rjes/ rgyal sa phe la(2628tshilta'i)nas rgyang 'dul lam du chas/khong gi dmag shugs la rkang dmag 30000dang rta dmag 5000dang /dmag gru 160yod/ sme se rdon gyi dmag dpung ni he le si phon tho si(5050390ba 03zlochicakyi167)mtsho 'gag brgal nas a she ya gling du slebs/sge ra ne khu si(67thab1 053777)chu bo'i nye 'gram du par zig gi gdong len dmag dpung la 'phrad pa dang 'thab pas rgyal kha thog ma blangs/ par rikā spya 6dmag pham nas bros pa dang dmag mi stong phrag du mar shi rmas phog

e legs gzan rdar la god kha chung ngu tsam las ma byung / de nas sme se rdon gyi dmag dpung rgyal kha blangs par bstun nas a she ya chung ba brgyud lho phyogs su bskyod/ mkhar grong mang po zhig par zig gi mis g.yog tu bkol nas sdug bsngal nang lhung yod pas/ de dag gis e legs gzan rdar ni mgon skyabs su brtsis pas lam bar du de la ngo rgol bgyi mkhan shin tu nyung stabs/bde blag ngang a she ya chung ba'i shar lho dang 'brel ba'i si ri a(57gothams/༅)sa khul du thon pa dang de ga'i i so si(13303 cha smo)grong khyer gyi nye 'gram du par zig gi rgyal po rdi re si(700 53 lam )sku rabs gsum pa dang gdong thug brgyab/ rgyal po de ni rang 'dod btsan bkol byed cing blun rmongs nus med cig yin la/ shod tshul la khos dmag dpung sa ya gsum dang 'bum drug khrid yod pas/ rang la pha rol zil gyis gnon pa'i stobs shugs yod par rlom nas sme se don gyi dmag dpung gi 'thab nus la shin tu mthong chung byas zer/ spyi lo sngon gyi 333lo'i zla 10par dmag dpung gnyis kyis i so si 'khrug chen (13303 7 smo)rgyag pa'i 'go brtsams/ e legs gzan rdar gyi rkang dmag gis sa mtho sa blangs pa dang / rta dmag chur brgal nas ngar stobs gang yod sgos par zig gi dmag dpung la rgol par brgyugs te/rdi re si'i dmag sgar steng thon pas/ rdi re si yis gnas tshul mi legs pa shes nas 'tshab 'tshub ngang mtshon cha dang rgyal po'i lu ring yang g.yug ste shar phyogs su bros/ mjug mthar par zig gi dmag dpung pham te dmag mi chig 'bum tsam gyi chag sgo myong zhing lhag ma thams cad rdza ri chen po'i nang bros/e legs gzan rdar brgyugs nas di re si'i shom ra can gyi dmag sgar du thon skabs/ par zig rgyal po'i ma yum dang btsun mo/ bu mo gnyis sogs e legs gzan rdar gyi bzung mi ru gyur/ 'on kyang khong gis bzung mi de dag la brnyas bcos dang gnod pa ci yang ma byas/ g.yul chen po brgyab cho~X ltas

sme se rdon gyi dmag la par zig gi dmag dpung gi lag nas dmag mkho'i dngos mas dang 'bru rigs mang po thob pa red/e legs gzan rdar gyis thad kur shar phyogs su bros pa'i di re si'i rjes ma snyeg par si ri a'i byang phyogs nas sa dbus rgya mtsho'i shar 'gram ded nas lho phyogs su bskyod/ de lta byas na phyogs cig nas rgyab phyogs sra brtan dubatang ste par zig gi skam dmag dang mtsho dmag gnyis so sor kha bkar thub pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas gna' bo'i gtor gzugs mchod rten can gyi e jib la dmag skyod bgyi thub pas red/ e legs gzan rdar sa cha de la yid mos nas yun ring 'gor yod/ thon sa thon yul du rang nyid6 bcings 'grol mkhan du brtsis shing / grong khyer mang po zhig 'thab ma dgos par mgo bsgur/ yin na'ang / sme se rdon gyi dmag dpung h+phe ne+e khe a'i the ro(110777)grong khyer du slebs skabs the ro pa rnams kyis mkhar rdzongabatsan por brten nas ngo rgol drag po byas te gtan nas mgo ma bsgur/spyi lo sngon gyi 332lor e legs gzan rdar gyi the ro la bskor rgol byas nas zla bdun tsam 'gor ba'i rjes/ mkhar gyang rdab deg byed spyad kyi shing sdong dang mkhar rdzong la btsan rgol bgyi ba'i stegs bu sogs mtshon cha spyad pas da gzod mkhar grong de phab pa dang / mkhar nang gi sdod mi la rdog rol chen po sgyuthob nas miḥ000lhag dmar gsod btang zhing mi 3000lhag bzung nas bran g.yog tu btsong / e legs gzan rdar the ro du sdod pa'i skabs/ rdi re si yis pho nya mngags nas mthun 'grig gi 'dum bgyi ba'i re ba bton nas/yi'u h+pha ra the si chu bo'i nub rgyud kyi mnga' khongs(don dngos su sme se rdon gyi dmag gis blangs zin pa)dang 'jal skyin gyi dngul 'bor chen zhig ster rgyu khas len byas/ e legs gzan rdar gyis ci byed snga sa nas sems nang thag gardotā /sa kyang / yin mdog kha po'i ngang dmag don tshogs 'du zhig bsdus

nas don de gros sol byas/ dmag dpon phal smi lde'u yis rdi re si'i re ba de dang len byas na legs zhes kha ta byas nas rang nyid rgyal po e legs gzan rdar yin tshe de lta bgyi kho na yin zhes bshad/ e legs gzan rdar gyis nga rgyal chen po'i sgo nas bdag phal smi ne'u yin yang dang len bgyi nges yin zer/khong ni gong ma chen po e legs gzan rdar yin pas par zig gi yul khongs khag cig lon pa'i ci la chog khong gis a she ya yongs len pa dang de'i 'phror 'dzam gling yongs 'dul rgyu yin no//e legs gzan rdar pha le si than brgyud skabs sga rdza(647 meba'i/ )grong khyer la mer btang / spyi lo sngon gyi 332lo'i dgun kha e jib la thon pa dang de ga'i dge 'dun dang sku drag tshos dga' bsu thob/ khong gis smem h+phe si(567961 3rtsa47)grong khyer du e jib kyi lha rnams la mchod 'bul byas pa dang / lus rtsal dang rig rtsal gyi 'khrab ston yang byas/ e jib pa rnams dga' po yong ched e legs gzan rdar ched du li sbi a byang thang khrod kyi si wa bye thang spang ljongs su nyi lha a mon gyi lha khang la mjal du phebs pas/ gces thob dga' 'dzer du song pa'i e jib kyi dge 'dun rnams kyis e legs gzan rdar ni a mon gyi bu red ces khyab bsgrags byas pas khong rang e jib kyi h+pha rog(2681806 76)gsar par gyur/ de rjes e legs gzan rdar ne le gtsang bo(sa 70 77)brgyud de mar bskyod pa dang zur gsum gling phran gyi nub phyogs kyi chu'i yan lag gi mgo stod du sa bab yag po yod pa mthong nas de ru grong khyer gsar pa zhig bskrun dgos pa'i bka' phab pa dang mo bas kyang yul de dbyar mtsho ltar dar rgyas yong nges red zer/ e legs gzanarar sku ngo mas grong khyer de'i 'char gzhi bzos shing ming yang rang gi ming btags/ de ni da lta'i e legs gzan rdar grong khyer gyi 'byung gzhi red/sme se don gyi dmag dpung la e jib du ngal gso dang dag ther/ kha 2/sdub

byas rjes e legs gzan rdar gyis da ni rdi re si 'ded rdung bgyi ran la bab 'ongs snyam mo//spyi lo sngon gyi 331lor e legs gzan rdar slar yang shar phyogs su bskyod/ rdi re si yis 'dum 'grig byed ma thub pas/ mthar thug gting thag gcod pa'i dmag 'khrug rgyag rgyur gra sgrig byas/ zla bcu ba'i zla mgor phyogs gnyis kyis thi gi re si chu bo'i stod brgyud kyi shar yul sgu dga' sme la(675674013 me'ilkoṣ+ṭha)zhing sde ru g.yul bsham nas drag tu 'thab pa dang / rdi re sis dmag 'khrug shing rta yis sme se rdon gyi dmag dpung nang drag tu skyod rgyu'i bka' phab pa dang / e legs gzan rdar gyis mtshon cha chen po can gyi dpung sde la lam phye ru bcug nas/ phyogs gnyis nas mda' ba rnams kyis mda' 'phen du bcug pas mda' ni char bab pa bzhin par zig gi shing rta'i dmag la phog pas de dag la shugs rtsal chen po 'don du ma bcug skabs der sme se rdon gyi rta dmag dang mtshon cha chen po thogs pa'i dmag dpung gis skabs bstun gyi drag rgol byas pas/ par zig gi dmas/ gi dpung sne 'thor bas pham bros byas pa dang sme se rdon gyi dmag gis sgu dga' sme la zhing grong gi shar lho'i a sbe ra zhes pa'i yul du thon pa'i bar 'ded rdung tsha po byas stabs par zig gi dmag dpung la shi rmas thebs pa dang 'dzin bzung byas pa 'bum phrag du ma yod zer skad/ 6 sgu dga' sme la dmag 'khrug(la las a spe ra dmag 'khrug kyang zer) gis par zig gi glas dmag ni khwa ta'i khyu tshogs lta bu'i nus med mi tshogs shig yin pa gsal bshad byas pa dang par zig btsan rgyal 'jig pa'i sngon brda yang btang / rdi re si sku rabs gsum pa shar phyogs su bros pa dang rjes su sba thi ri a(28 08 3ma ༅༅deng skabs kyi a rmu kun gyi byang phyogs)yi spyi dpon sbe so si(263303 5lkolo/byi/ bkrongs/

par zig gi rgyal po ni gna' rabs rgyal po'i nang gi rgyal chen zhes pa dang / bag med rgyas spro'o longs spyod gnyis las 'dzam gling yongs su grags/e legs gzan rdar ni rgyal kha can gyi rnam par par zig gi rgyal po'i pho brang du gzigs skor la phebs pa yang ya mtshar skye dgos pa'i don zhig ma yin no//par zig la rgyal sa gtso bo gnyis yod cing su'u sa ni gna' bo'i rgyal sa yin padang pho si sbo le si ni rjes su bskrun pa'i rgyal sa gsar pa sdod/ yul de gnyis tsam nas e legs gzan rdar la gser dngul tha lan the(tha lan the gcig ni phal cher spyi rgya sum bcu dang 'dra)chig 'bum lhag lon zhing /gser dngul de dag ni dbang sgyur tshogs khag gis zhing chen so so nas ham 'phrog byas pa'i 'bangs kyi sha khrag red/ rin thang can gyi rgyu nor yod rgu 'phrog len byas rjes/ brjid chags mdzes sdug ldan pa'i pho si sbo le si pho brang la me btang nas bsregs/ sba sbi lon dang e khi sba than na(yul de gnyis su par zig rgyal po'i byes bzhugs pho brang yod)gnyis su yang rgyu nor mang po 'phrog rjes de'i nang gi skor zhig dmag thob dngos rdzas byas nas dmag dpon dang dmag mi tshor bya dgar gnang zhing kha shas phyir sme se rdon dang ghi ri si ru skyel 'dren byas/de'i rjes su e legs gzan rdar gyis shar phyogs 'dul rgyu'i las don la de 'dra'i rlung rta ma brgyugs te/ i ran mtho sgang gi shar phyogs kyi tsho sde mang pos sme se don gyi mi ni nub phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i rkun jag la brtsis pas/ dus rgyun du de tshor bsam yul las 'das pa'i 'jab rgol byas/dka' ngal dang nyen kha mang po dang dmag 'khrug du ma brgyud rjes kyi spyi lo sngon gyi 329lor sme se rdon gyi dmag dpung a she ya dbus mar thon nas a mu(875 77)chu bor brgal te so gi sdi a na'i(506 thab r+sā lko.as)mnga' khongs su slebs/ yul de nas rang gi rgyal po gsod mkhan spra 7rdo si

bzung nas srog khrims bcad/ sme se rdon gyi dpung chen sda sil chu bo'i stod brgyud du phyin skabs/ kho tsho'i rgyab phyogs kyi so gi sdi a na'i mi dmangs kyis 'os langs byas shing / de tsho'i gtso 'dzin si phe tha man gyis nges med rgol rdung dmag 'khrug gi 'thab jus dang cha rgyus che ba'i sa bab la brten nas dgra bor rdung deg byas pas sme se don gyi dmag gis rgod lan sprod khag por gyur/malegs gzan rdar gyi dmag dpung de ru lus te 'dam rdzam zab po'i nang lhung ba'i gcan gzan lta bur gyur pas lo ngo gnyis la dka' gnas las thar ma thub/ spyi lo sngon gyi 327lor sme se don gyi dmag hin sdu khu hri ri bo(51 ba75ji536 ༅ sgo6)dngakhasgol(5lo7 677)sa khul brgyud rgya gar phyogs su bskyod/ skabs der rgya gar nub byang du rgyal khab chung chung dang tsho sde shin tu mang la phan tshun bar mthun po med par 'gal bas khengs 'dug stabs/ e legs gzan rnar la ngo rgol cung tsam byas pa las drag po'i ngo rgol ci yang ma thebs/ yin na'ang khong gis mu mthun du rgya gar gyi lte gnas sa khul 'dul dgos snyam pa'i skabs khong gi dmag dang dmag dpon tshor cis kyang sngon du skyod ma 'dod/ lo ngo bdun ring g.yul 'gyed rgyang skyod byas nas le bar lnga khrir bskyod pa dang / lam bar du yul khams so po'i mi dmangs kyis ngo rgol byas rkyen/ e legs gzan rdar gyi btsan 'dzul dmag dpung ni dus de dang yul de ru shugs rdzogs la khad kyi mda' mo lta bur gyur yod/ dmag mi tsho rgya gar gyi tsha drod can gyi gnam gshes la ma 'phrod pa'i stong dmag mi mang po'i tshe srog kyang nad yams kyis 'phrog pas/ dmag mi'i ngar shugs nyams pa ma zad/ tha na dmag mi'i bsam phyogs kyang brtan po ma cin par gyur/ e legs gzan rdar gyis u tshugs mthar skyel sgos gtam bshad cig gnang rung dang len byed mkhan nyung bas thabs zad de dmag phyiX ༵༵na bya rgyu thag bcad/ don dngos su e legs gzan rdar gyi snyan

grags kyang sngon chad lta bu mthon po mi 'dug ste rgyu mtshan ni rgyal kha du ma blangs pa dang sbrags rim bzhin nga rgyal je cher song bas/ shar phyogs kyi sger gcod rje bo rnams kyi bzo lta la lad mo byas te/ rang nyid dang mi mthun pa'i bsam 'char 'chad phod pa rnams ni/ rang gi dam grogs dang byas rjes can gyi dmag dpon gang rung yin yang dmar gsod gtong ba red/ de'i nang khong hā srog skyob myong ba'i khi re tho dang a ri si thod kyi tsha bu kha le si sogs 'du /spyi/ lo sngon gyi 325lor sme se rdon gyi dmag dpung chu lam dang skam lam gnyis su bgos nas/ gcig ni mtsho dmag gi spyi dpon ne+e ar khu si(sa0870553 ༅༅sgomo)yis khrid de i ran mtsho 'gram ded de par zig mtsho khug brgyud sba sbi lon la slebs/ cig shos e legs gzan rdar sku ngo mas khrid de a rab mtho sgang nub khul gyi mtha' khob bye bang brgal nas nub phyogs su bskyod de spyi lo sngon gyi 325lor su'u sa ru slebs/ e legs gzan rdar gyis yul de ru khong gis dmag mi dang dmag dpon gyis a she ya'i bud med chung mar len dgos pa'i bka' phab/ shod rgyun la gnyen ston gzab rgyas shig gi steng dmag dpon80dang dmag mi 1 sa shar phyogs kyi bud med chung mar blangs zer la/ e legs gzan rdar rang yang de'i nang zhugs nas di re si sku rabs gsum pa'i bu mo che ba sba shis ne+e dang gnyen sgrig byas zer/(lo gnyis kyi sngon la sba khe thi ri a'i sras mo ro gi gzan nā nga2058ba rmam 〉chung mar bsus) gzhan yang e legs gzan rnar gyis da dung sme se don gyi mi dang ghi ri si'i mis shar phyogs kyi mi dang gnyen sgrig byed par skul 'ded byas/ khong gi thugs su de lta byas na nub phyogs dang shar phyogs gnyis mnyam 'dres gcig gyur yong nges pas sme se rdon gyis shar phyogs dbang sgyur byed rgyur phan pa yod snyam/ de dang mnyam du sme se // gyi

dmag dpung nang a she ya'i mi mang po bsdus nas kho tshor sme se rdon gyi g.yul jus gru bzhi ma sbyong du bcug/ chos lugs phyogs e legs gzan rdar gyis shugs gang yod kyis snyi ri si'i lha thams cad dang shar phyogs kyi de dang 'brel ba yod pa 'dra ba rnams zung du sbrel nas sa khul so sor lha khang mang po bzhengs/ spyi lo sngon gyi 324lo'i dpyid kur e legs gzan rdar gyis dpung chenapo khrid de phyir sba sbi lon grong khyer du slebs/ khong gi thugs su gna' bo'i rgyal sa 'di ni rang gi btsan rgyal gyi chab srid lte gnas bgyi bar shin tu thos snyam/ rgyal po de sba sbi lon la slebs pa dang lo ngo bcu lhag gi rgyang skyod dmag 'thab kyi mjug sgril zhing sngar yod ma myong ba'i e legs gzan rdar gyi btsan rgyal chen po yang btsugs zin/ de ni shar gyi mtha' mtshams hin rdu chu bo la gtug cing / lho'i mtha' mtshams ne+e le gtsang bor slebs pa/ nub kyi mtha'amatshams sbal khan(2ma thab por)la thon pa/ byang gyi mtha' mtshams kha si phe an(6491 thab tsho )rgya mtsho dang a she ya dbus mar thug pa'i btsan rgyal chen po zhig red/ e legs gzan rdar gyis par zig gi dbangasgyur byed thabs rgyud 'dzin byas nas/ par zig btsan rgyal gyi srid 'dzin lam lugs sngar mus su bzhag pa dang / sa khul du zhing chen btsugs nas spyi dpon dang dmag dpon la so sor bdag gnyer byed du bcug khong gisad dung shar phyogs rgyal blon gyi gus srol byed stangs lag tu bstar nas/blon po rnams kyis khong la pus tshug tu phyag 'tshal dgos pa byas/ e legs gzanardar ni rgyal kha'i minang mgo 'khor nas nyin mtshan med par gsol ston dang spro bsang la g.yengs nas rang nyid la spyod mi tshar ba'i rgyu nor dang dbang cha yod par rlom par 'dug yin na'ang / skyid pa'i dus yun 'ja' dang 'dra ste/ spyi lo sngon gyi 323lo'i dbyar khar e legs gzan rdar la snyung gswā shā po zhig(shod tshul la 'dar nad red zer)phog ste tshe las 'das so/

e legs gzan rdar ni gna' rabs kyi bla na med pa'i na gzhon dmag spyi zhig yin te/ khong gis drang bden ma yin pa'i shar phyogs 'dul pa'i btsan 'dzal dmag 'khrug des btul zin pa'i yal gyi mi dmangs la gnod ri sgo ri gi 'tshe chen po btang yang / shar phyogs dang nub phyogs bar gyi tshong las dang rig gnas brje res la skul 'ded byas shing shar nub 'brel mthun la nus shugs nges can zhig bton yod/ par zig btsan rgyal dang 'dra ste e legs gzan rdar btsan rgyal yang drag shugs btsan 'dul la brten nas btsugs la/ rang gi dpal 'byor rmang gzhi med pas thor zhig tu 'gro rgyu ni bshol thabs med pa red/ e legs gzan rdar tshe las 'das pa dang btsan rgyal yang thor zhig tu song ste dmag dpon tshos rang sa rang 'dzin sgos rgyal po byas nas lo ngo bcu phrag du mar dmag 'khrug brgyab nas zhi 'jags med par gyur/275

mar khi smi si' gtam rgyad/krang kong wu'u/lo ngo nyis stong lhag gi sngon la si si li a gling phran steng gi ghi ri si'i skad grags can gyi mkhar grong rgyal khab si ra khu sa(5717533chu(ṣ+ṭha( spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs brgyad pa nas ghi ri si'i mkhar grong rgyal khab kho rin thu si000ba 55377lozhes pas bskrun)ru mi rnams ha las hang sang pa'i don zhig byung ba ni 'di lta ste/ skyes pa gcer bu zhig lus phung rlon chob chob 'du 'dzi che ba'i khrom srang du spro ba tshad med ngang smyos pa bzhin kha nas yu'u le kha/yu'u le kha zhes 'bod bzhin mdun du brgyugs/ (yu'u le kha ni ghi ri si'i skad du da rnyed song / da rnyed song zhes pa'i don red/)gong gi gcer bur smyo brgyug byed mkhan ni skugana' bo'i ghi ri si'i ches bla na med pa'i tshan rig pa ar khi smi sde si(4106176663 khu119mo'ur+sāṣ+ṭha)zhes pa thongared/ khong la de 'dra'i spro ba skye don ci yin zhe na 'di cho salta ste/ si ra khu sa'i(saskyang7532chu/74)rgyalapohi ༈ro(51 khu10 thosacig)sku rabs gnyis pas mgar ba la sgotshorigagaser btso mas cod pan zhig bzo ru bcug par/ ra chi spibazo bkod legs shing lci tshad kyang sngar gyi gser dang 'dra mod kyang / phyogs kha shas las rgyal po'i thugs ar khi smi sde si/276

su gser nang dngul gyi lhad brgyab min la dogs snang skye ru bcug rgyal po hi ro yis khong gi blo 'dri sa ar khi smi sde si bos nas cod pan la skyon mi byed pa'i cha rkyen 'og gnas tshul ngo ma gang yin rtsad gcod dgos pa'i bka' gnang zhing de ni ha cang khag po'i don zhig yin no//arakhi smi sde si yis las 'gan dang len byas rjes de'i skor la bsam gzhig btang pas nam yang de'i nang mgo 'thom nas 'dug nyin zhig lcam mos khong rang khrus khang du phung po bkru ru bcug khrus gzhong nang chu gang blugs yod pa dang khong chu nang 'dzul ba dang chu yar 'phyur nas phyi la bzhur/de dang mnyam du khong gis chu nang 'dzul tshad ji 'dra'i gting zab na lus po je yang la 'gro ba dang chu yang mu mthud du phyir bzhur nas/ khong lus yongs chu nang 'dzul tshar ba na chu yang phyir bzhur mtshams chad/ de ma nyid du khong gi sems gsal ler song ba dang glo bur du tshan rig gi rtsa ba'i rigs pa zhig gi rtogs pa thob pas/ 'phral du khru gzhong las phyir mchongs nas rgyal po'i pho brang phyogs su brgyugs zhor dang kha nas4yu'u le kha lha yu'u le kha mizhes 'bod zhor byas pa red/dngos gnas de lta red/ ar khi smi sde si yis mthar thug rgyal po'i gser gyi cod pan nang lhad brgyab yod med la dpyad pa'i thabs shes rnyed/lo ngo stong phrag du ma'i ring mi su yin yang chu gzhong nang 'dzul rjes chu ngos yar 'gro ba shes pa ma zad/ lus phung chu nang du je yang la 'gro ba yang shes yod/ ci'i phyir tshul de 'dra byung ba red ce na/ sus kyang de'i rgyu mtshan la cod gcod byed 'dod med/ yin na'ang ar khi smi sde si yis rgyun ldan 'tsho ba'i nang gi snang tshul phal ba zhig las/ lci tshad gcig 'dra yin mod rgyu mi 'dra ba'i dngos po gnyis kyi tshags dam tshad (rtsa4)mi 'dra bas bongs tshad mi 'dra la/ de gnyis kyis phyir btang ba'i chu'i bongs tshad kyang ༵ /dra

ba'i tshan rig gi rtsa ba'i rigs pa gal chen 'di rtogs byung ba red/ de nas khongagis rgyal po'i cod pan dang de dang yang lci tshad gcig pa'i gser rdog cig chu nang du bzhag pa na/ gser rdog des chu phyir phud pa nyung ba dang cod pan gyis chu phyir phud pa cung mang ba mthong bas/ rgyal po'i cod pan nang dngul nyung shas bsres yod pa shes/ khong gis rtsis rig gi thabs shes spyad de sbyad pan nang bsres pa'i dngul gyi lci tshad kyang zhib dag cig mkhyen song ba da// ar khi smi sde si yis rtogs pa'i rtsa ba'i rigs pa ni rgyu gzugs zhi shugs rig pa'i (stongs7stsa)rmang gzhi red/ rjes su khong gis da dung rtsa ba'i rigs pa mang po zhig rnyed pa dang de dag gi rmang gzhi'i steng khong gis 'phyo gzugs kyi rnam bzhag〉ces pa'i gsung rtsom btsams nas/ cha tshang zhing gson nyams ldan pa'i ngang ming grags can gyi ar khi smi sde si'i rtsa ba'i rigs pa ste dngos gzugs ni gsher gzugs nang je yang la song ba'i lci tshad dang desaphyir phud pa'i gsher gzugs kyi lci tshad gcig 'dra yin pa 'di zhib mo bris yod/ ar khi smi sde si'i rtsa ba'i rigs pa spyad de dngos po'i tshags dam tshad de rtsis gzhi re'i bongs tshad la yod pa'i lci tshad gtan la phab thub pas/grangs 'bor de dngos lugs dang bzo skrun lag rtsal gyi rtsis rgyag pa'i skor rgyun du bkol ba red/ chu las lci ba'i sra gzugs dngos po'i tshags dam tshad gtan 'khel byed pa'i dus su de ring bar du yu'u le kha sdod zer pa spyod bzhin yod cing / de ni gsha' las bzos pa'i snod cig yin la snod kha'i rtsibs logs su sbu gu yod pa las chu phyir rgyug thub/ yu'u le kha snod nang chu gang blugs rjes de'i nang dngos po gzhan pa bzhag tshe chu phyir bzhur nas snod gzhan zhig gi nang du thon thub la de ru chu'i bongs tshad rtsi thub cing de yang chu nadī ༵༵ga pa'i dngos po'i bongs gzugs red/ grangs 'bor 'di dngos

po'i ljid tshad la bgos pas na tshags dam tshad thob nges/arakhi smi sde si yis tshan rig la mdzad rjes chen po bzhag yod pa de khong gi skye khungs dang rgyun du sdug res 'bad brtson byas pa dang 'bral thabs med/ khong ni si ra khu sa(5718053377lha)grong khyer gyi de tsam phyugs po min pa'i sku drag cig gi khyim tshang zhig tu 'khrungs/ khong gi pha yab h+phe sdi a si(2661 61 4 67lo7)ni gnam dpyad rig pa ba dang rtsis rig pa ba zhig yin/ ar khi smi sde si ni pha yab kyi shugs rkyen 'og chung ngu'i dus nas slob sbyong bgyi bar shin tu dga' bas/ gna' rabs ghi ri si'i dbyibs rtsis rig pa ba u khe li sde(20 smo sku 'i mcho)yis brtsams pa'i〈dbyibs rtsis rig pa'i rtsa ba'i rigs pa〉zhes pa sbyong myong ba dang / lo na bcu gcig steng khong rang e jib kyi e legs gzan rdar grong khyer du slob sbyong byed du mngags so//e legs gzan rdar grong khyer ni ne le gtsang po'i chu mdor yod/ de ni e jib kyi phu tho le sme'u si(2 01074 03 677)rgyal rabs(spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs bzhi ba nas spyi lo sngon 30lo'i bar)kyi rgyal sa yin zhing skabs de'i 'dzam gling rig gnas kyi lte gnas yin pas/ brjid chags kyi dngos mang bsham ston khang dang dpe mdzod khang yod pa'i steng mkhas pa mang po 'du gnas kyang yin/ ming grags can gyi tshan nyid rig pa ba dang tshan rig pa mang po de ru 'dus nas tshan nyid rig pa dang tshan rig la zhib 'jug gnang bzhin yod/ ar khi smi sde si ni e legs gzan rdar grong khyer du dus yun ring po zhig la 'tsho ba rol nas skad grags can gyi tshan rig pa du ma dang mnyam du slob sbyong gnang myong la/ de'i nang gna' gzhung rtsis rig pa'i shārdos chen u khe li sde(755 r+ya spu 'i ༅7)yi slob ma kho non (77)yang slob sbyong gi mjug rdzogs rjes ar khi smi sde si phyir si ri khu sa ru 2)chos

nas sngar las lhag pa'i 'bad brtson sgos tshan rig zhib 'jug la zhugs te/rtsis rig pa dang dngos lugs rig pa'i phyogs grub 'bras gzi 'od 'phro ba du ma blangs/ gong du brjod pa ni de'i nang gi gcig red/skabs der snyi ri si'i mi'i mig nang du ar khi smi sde si ni gang yang sgrub mi thub pa med pa'i byas rjes ngo mtshar can sgrun mkhan zhig tu snang / khong gis rgyu gzugs zhi shugs rig pa gsar 'dzugs byas pa ma zad/ da dung deng skabs rgya chen por bkol spyod bgyi bzhin pa'i ljid tshad kyi bsdur grangs ni bar thag ldog bsdur dang mtshungs par bshad pa'i 'ja' shing gi nges srol rnyed pa red/ yin na'ang khong gi zhib 'jug bya ba la si ra khu sa'i rgyal po hi ro sku rabs gnyis pas skyon 'dzugs du ma byas/ hi ro yis ar khi smi sde si la/bdagagi re ba ni khyod kyis dngos su 'khrab ston byed dgos pa las don med kyi gzhung lugs mi dgos pa de yin zhes zer/ ar khi smi sde si yis de'i lan du/ bdag la 'gyogs sngas shig gnong dang / bdag gis sa'i go la 'ded thub pa yin zhes spobs pa'i ngang gsungs mod/ yin na'ang / nyi ros go rjes gad mo shor bzhin du ar khi smi sde si yis 'ud shob brgyab 'dug zer/ar khi smi sde si yis zhud shob brgyab pa e yin zhe na ma yin te/ nyin zhig rgyal po hi ro dka' gnad cig la thug ste/ khong gis e jib kyi rgyal po'i tshab du gru gzings chen po zhig bzos pa de ci nas kyang chu nang du 'ded ma thub/ si ra khu sa grong khyer yongs kyis don de la sems khur byed kyi 'dug mod/ kho tshos bsam blo gang mang btang ste thabs shes yod rgu spyad kyang gru de chu nang du 'ded thabs zad pas/ mthar thug ar khi smi sde si gdan drangs nas thag mi gcod ka med byung / ar khi smi sde si yis hi ro la bdag la gru gzings 'di chu nang du 'ded du chug dang zhes gsungs pa'i tshe hi ro la 'phral du sditā0 'thad byung ngo //

de nas ar khi smi sde yis rnyog 'dzing can gyi 'ja' shing 'dred 'khor gyi sgrig chas shig bzos pas/ shugs chung tsam brgyab na shin tu lci ba'i dngos po sgul 'ded bgyi thub pa byas/ bya ba de dag bsgrubs rjes khong gas thag pa zhig nyi ro la sprad ṭ+wāṃ ga ler 'then du bcug pa dang gru gzings de rim bzhin chu nang spyo ñtsā /sna kho/ blon po rnams/ phyi rgyal gyi pho nya rnams kyis ngo mtshar can gyi tshul de mthong rjes/ sgyu ma mkhan gyi 'phrul la ltad mor 'ongs pa bzhin kha gdangs mig cer du gyur/ de nas hi ro yis myur du bsgrags yig cig bton pa dang de ru da nas bzung ar khi smi sde si yis skad cha gang bshad yid ches dang ci bshad legs sgrub byed dgos zhes bris yod/arakhi smi sde si yis tshan rig la phyogs mang po nas mdzad rjes bzhag yod/ khong gis zlum gzugs dang ka zlum gzugs/ rnyog 'dzing lhag tu che ba'i langs gzugs bongs tshad dang ngos kyi bongs tshad/ skor mtha'i ring tshad la rtsis rgyag pa'i spyi 'gros sogs rnyed/ dngos 'phang thig gi gzhu dbyibs kyi bongs tshad ci ltar thob pa'i phyogs ar khi smi sde si yis rig 'ded grangs med byas rjes byed thabs gnyis rnyed cing / dang po ni 'khyol dgag zad thabs yin la/ nga rang tsho'i deng skabs kyi skad char bshad na/ rim bzhin mtshungs 'dra thob pa dang de nas mu mtha' thob pa byed pa'i byed thabs shes shig red/ de ni deng rabs cha phran bsags rtsis tshul gyi rmang gzhi yin de la zhing deng rabs cha phran bsags rig pa'i byed thabs kyi thog ma'i rnam pa chags yod/ nye rabs grangs rig pa ba skad grags can te cha phran bsags rig pa gsar gtod byed mkhan nang gi gcig ste le sbru ne dzi(60 1007ya pu'i017 601621 2 ༅ khuṣ+ṭha)yis kyang ar khi smi sde yi4'khyol dgag zad thabs la bstod bsngags byas te/ su zhig ar khi sme sde si dang a ༵ /na

lo7777(gna' bo'i ghi ri si'i grangs rig pa ba zhig)yi gsar rtsom la byang chub pas na/ mi de deng rabs ches rlabs che ba'i mi snas gsar gtod la ha las ya mtshan mi skye ba red ces gsungs myong / gnyis pa ni shugs rig pa'i byed thabs yin te/ byed thabs de'i nang ar khi smi sde si yis thabs mkhas po'i ngang grangs rig pa dang shugs rig pa zung 'brel byas nas thob pa'i mjug 'bras ni byed thabs dang po dang gcig mtshungs yin/ar khi smi sde si yis kha chems nang / khong gi dur sa'i rdo ring ka zlum dbyibs sheg dang zlum bu'i dbyibs shig bko dgos pa'i re ba bton yod/de nas kyang ar khi smi sde si ma shi gong gi gsar gtod cig mtshon 'dug la/khong gis mtho tshad dang rkub kyi tshangs thig 'dra ba'i ka zlum gzugs kyi bongs tshad ni de'i nang 'du ba'i zlum bu'i bongs tshad kyi phyed ka yin pa rnyed pa red/ar khi smi sde si yis da dung chu'i sgul shugs la brten pa'i rgyu skar 'phrul chas shig bzos pa dang de spyad de nyi zla skar skar gsum gyi 'khor skyod la lan mo byas shing / khong gis bzos pa'i rgyu skar 'phrul chas kyis nyi 'dzin dang zla 'dzin nor med du ston thub pas kyang khong gis skabs der 'phrul chas 'khor skyod kyi rtsa ba'i rigs pa shes yod pa mtshon 'dug go/ar khi smi sde si yis tshan rig la mdzad rjes che na'ang / khong gis lcam mo'i mig nang du khong ni 'tsho ba rol mi shes pa'i mi zhig red/ dper na za ma bzos tshar rjes cog tse'i stong bsgrigs nas khong la za ma bzhes par phebs zhes ci 'dra bos kyang rna bas mi go bar thab mtha'i thal ba'i nang zur gsum dbyibs dang gru bzhi'i dbyibs sogs dbyibs rtsis kyi ri mo bris nas 'dugayang dper na/ lus phung bkru ba'i skabs su lus la byugs bya'i skyu ru ra'i snum gyis rang gi phung po'i steng ris dbyibs 'bri ba dang ma gzhi rang gi ci zhiX hā/ bzhin yod pa brjed 'gro ba red/ gcer bur srang lam du brgyugs

pa'i don 'di'i rjes su ar khi smi sde si'i lcam mo ni khong rang spyi spyod bkru khang du 'gro bar zhed skrag skye ba red/tshan rig la rgyal mtshams med kyang tshan rig pa ni mes rgyal la gtogs/ar khi smi sde si ni rgyal gces pa zhig yin pas rang gi blo gros dang shes bya rang gi mes rgyal srung skyob byed pa'i las don la phul ba red/lo rgyus steng bkod pa ltar na/ spyi lo sngon gyi 214lor rom gyi srid 'dzin mkhan ma se ra si (cha khri7)yis dmag dpung khrid de si ra khu sa la dmag brgyab/ ar khi smi sde si yis si ra khu sa'i mi la ched du 'gog srung dang phar rgol byed pa'i mtshon cha bzos/ khong gis ltag 'khor ljid 'degs 'phrul 'khor zhig bzos shing de la khrung khung gi mchu lta bu'i lcags kyu zhig yod pas rom gyi dmag gru bzung nas bar snang du yar bkyags nas slar mtsho nang du g.yug pa'am yang na brag la brdab nas gru dang mi thal bar gtor ba red/khong gis gsar skrun byas pa'i rdo 'phen 'phrul 'khor gyis spyi rgya 200lhag can gyi pha bongs ni char 'bab pa bzhin dgra bo'i dmag gru'i steng babs pas rom gyi dmag mi mang po la shi rmas thebs/ khong gis da dung bar thag thung sar 'phen pa'i 'phrul 'khor gsar skrun byas nas thag nye sa'i dgra bor rdung deg byas pas/ rom gyi dmag mi rnams la mgo yom klad yom bskor pa dang snying rtsa bkad pa 'dra ba'i 'jigs skrag thebs pas/ mkhar gyi steng du thag pa dang ka gdung yod pa mthong tshe ar khi smi sde si yi 'phrul 'khor e yin snyam nas dbang med du phyir bros rgyag pa red/ cigayo sgyu can gyi rom gyi mis grong mkhar bskor yang phar rgol mi byed pa'i thabs spyad de si ri khu ra mkhar de lo gnyis la bskor nas su yang mi thar ba byas/ spyi lo sngon gyi 212lo'i nyin dang por rom(1070 76)gyi dmag dpung ni mun nag la bstun nas si ri khu ra mkhar nang du thon pa dang 2//ga

rtsub sgos dmar gsod bgyi 'go brtsams/ phyi nyin snga dro nam gshes ni dwangs shing 'jags por 'dug pas/ ar khe smi sde yis spun zla rnams kyi skyabs 'jug zhus skad dang rom gyi dmag mis 'phrog bcom byas pa'i sgra ci yang ma thos par nam rgyun bzhin du dbyibs rtsis kyi ri mo zhig gi kha phye nas 'gram pa bskyor nas bsam gzhigs gtong bzhin pa'i sgang la/ glo bur du grib nag cig gis 'od kha bkag pa dang ljid tig tig gi rkang sgras khong gi bsam gzhigs gtor pas da gzod ci yin ha go bas khong khro'i ngang rom gyi dmag mi de la wa ye/ khyod kyis bdag gi ri mo brlag song / phar rgyugs dang mizhes ngar skad brgyab pa na/ rom gyi dmag mi de khros nas gri shub nas gri bton nas gtum rngam sgos tshur 'ongs pa'i tshe/ ar khe smi sde la brel ba skye zhor skad mthon por/ bdag la chu chod cung tsam byin dang / dka' gnad 'di gcig po sgrub tshar du 'jug dgos/ de min mi rabs rjes ma la ra sprod ma thub pa'i dka'agand cig lus 'gro ba red ces gsungs na'ang / kla klo gdug rtsub can gyi rom gyi dmag mi des gtan nas ma nyan par rno ngar can gyi gri sne ni dgung lo don bdun la son pa'i tshan rig pa de'i brang khog la bsnun pas rlabs che ba'i snying rtsa zhig gi 'phar mtshams bzhag go/ mes rgyal srung skyob dang tshan rig srung skyob gnang ched/ ar khe smi sde yis rang nyid kyi rin thang bral ba'i tshe srog phul ba red/ ar khe smi sde si'i tshe srog rom gyi mis 'phrog na'ang / khong gi snyan grags dang gsar gtod mang po ni mi rnams kyi sems khongs nas nam yang bsub thabs med/ ar khe smi sde si'i ming ni tshan rig dang 'brel zhing khong gis tshan rig las don la gnang ba'i mdzad rjes ni bla na med pa zhig red/en ke si yis kyang ar khe smi sde si ni zhib dag dang brgyud rim ldan pa'i ngang tshanā zlog zhib 'jug gnang mkhan gyi mtshon byed mi sna red ces bsngags

brjod gnang myong / ar khe smi sde si'i tshan rig dgongs pa ni gzhung lugs dang lag len dngos dam 'brel byed pa'i thabs shes yin pas/ da lta'i bar ṣ+ṭṛ hā/ /ga zhib 'jug phyogs la mtshon na da dung mdzub ston gyi don snying ldan

bar snang gi skyed mosatsal dang: lha'iskya 'dra/ sgron stegs/hring krokyong /gna' shul gnas mchog la su yin rung yid smon zhing / gna' rabs 'dzam gling gi ngo mtshar chos can bdun la mi rnams kyi sems pa shor bzhin 'dug de bdun po gang yin zhe na/ de ni spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs gsum pa'i sngon gyi sa dbus rgya mtsho'i shar phyogs mtsho 'gram sa khul gyi brjid nyams ldan pa'i 'dzugs skrun dang bzo rtsal yang rtser son pa'i 'jim brkos brtsams chos de dag bstan pa red/ ngo mtshar bzo bkod bdun po so so legs su grub pa'i dus tshod ltar bsgrigs na gsham gsal yin/ (1)e jib kyi h+pha rog hu h+phu'i (55515 lolko)bang so/(2)sba sbi lon gyi bar snang gi skyed mos tshal/ (3)a she ya chung ba'i ye h+pho so si(2966303 1lkoṣ+ṭha)yi lhamo ar the smi si(21 0713 khu1lornyesatho446)yi lha khang / (4)o lim phi a'i rdzi'u si'i lha sku/ (5)a she ya chung ba'i hwa li khar nā su'u si(576027ba4353 4༅rdopo7)yiskusolu si(5530103 31stsa46)yi bang so/ (6)sa dbus rgya mtsho'i ro sdi(206603 131807 72ce)gling phran steng gi nyi lha'i 'jim sku/(7) e jib kyi e legs gzan rdar gru kha'i sgron stegs bcas yin no/ ngo mtshar bzo bkod 'di dag so sor rmad byung gi khyad chos ldan pas gna' rabs sa dbus rgya mtsho'i dus rabs la gzi 'od kyis bkang ba dang dus ma~X su ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi blo gros dang gsar gtod kyi stobs shugs

kyang mtshon gyi 'dug sems phangs pa zhig la khyad mtshar chos can bdun po'inang e jib kyi gtor gzugs mchod rten las ma lhag par sa yom dang hā/ga 'khrug las 'jigs tshar/ gsham du de'i nang gi gsum ngo sprod bgyi rgyu gna'arabs sba sbi lon gyi bar snang skyed mos tshal/gtsang bo chen po gnyis kyi bzhur rgyud sa khul gyi sba sbi lon grong khyer ni lo ngo stong phrag bzhi yi sngon du bskrun zhing rgyal rabs du ma brgyud gna' rabs shes rig gi lte gnas su gyur pa dang / 'jig rten skyid sdug gang mang mthong myong la spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs gnyis par zhig ro tsam las ma lhag par 'jigs na'ang / grong khyer de ni lo ngo stong phrag gnyis kyi lo rgyus ldan pa'i /tshan snyan dgung la thon pa'i mkhar rnying zhig yin pa tshang mas shes gsal da/ sba sbi lon grong khyer ni sba sbi gsar pa'i rgyal po'i rgyal khab(spyi lo sngon gyi 626 sngon gyi 538lo)kyi rgyal po ne bhu khad ne rdzar(smo6650686062231 2lo tha )sku rabs gnyis pas dbang bsgyur pa'i dus(spyi lo sngon gyi 604:sngon gyi 538lo'i bar dbang bzung ba)su dpal 'byor dang chab srid/rig gnas phyogs so sor sngar med kyi 'phel rgyas byung bas rdzogs ldan gyi dus rabs shig la slebs yod/ grong khyer gyi 'dzugs skrun phyogs mtshon na/ sra brtan phugs 'pher gyi mkhar gyang sum brtsegs ma dang / brjid chags mdzes sdug ldan pa'i lha mo i si thar (mtsho po)gyi mkhar sgo(sba sbi lon gyi lo legs dang dmag 'khrug gi lha yin pa)dang / chos lugs mchod 'bul gyi khrom skor bgrod yul gyi yangs shing drang la rgya che ba'i lam mchog yo) 8snying /

rgyas spros kyi pho brang sogs yod pa de dag gis sba sbi lon ni skabs de'i 'dzam gling stong ches che ba'i grong khyer zhig yin pa mtshon thub/ ngo mtshar che ba'i bar snang gi skyed mos tshal ni kun las lhag pa'i mtshar ldan 'dzugs skrun zhig yin pas mdzes sdug lta bas mi ngoms pa zhig yin stabs mi rnams kyis bstod bsngags yang yang byed/ lo rgyus steng de e jib kyi bang so gtor gzugs mchod rten dang mnyam du gna' bo'i dus rabs kyi ngo mtshar bzo bkod bdun nang gi gcig tu brtsis yod/bar snang gi skyed mos tshal zer ba de dngos gnas bar snang du byung ba'i skyed mos tshal zhig ma yin par de ni gna' bo'i sba sbi lon gyi grong khyer nang skas dbyibs rtsegs dngos shig gi stong bskrun pa'i ngo mtshar can gyi me tog skyed mos tshal zhig red/ skyed mos tshal de spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs drug par bskrun zhing spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs gsum par med par bzos pas deng sang shul tsam yang mthong rgyu med/ de'i skor lo rgyus yig tshang nang yang tshig re 'ga' tsam las bkod mi 'dug dus rabs nyi shu pa'i 'gor 'jar man gyi gna' rdzas bsko 'tshol ru khag cig gis sba sbi lon gyi rgyal po'i pho brang shul rko 'don bgyi ba'i dus su/ de'i shar byang zur du ar las mtshar po zhig gi zhig ro rnyed pa de gna' bo'i yig tshang nang brjod pa'i sba sbi lon gyi bar snang skyed mos tshal gyi dbyibs dang phal cher 'dra bas/ kho tshos de ni bar snang skyed mos tshal gyi rjes shul red ces lom par bshad/ mi rjes ma tshos sngon rabs pas ma rgyu'i rmang gzhi'i steng mu mthud du 'tshol zhib byas nas bar snang skyed mos tshal ni gsham ltar yin par bshad/ de ni mis bzos shing mtho tshad la smi nyi shu nas sum bcu yod pa'i skas dbyibs kyi sa spungs shig yin te/de'i rmang zhabs ni gru bzhi ma yin zhing khyon la smi gru bzhi ma 1260yod/ gzhi theX ༵ 8de re je chung pha chung la btang nas yar brtsigs pa dang / them pa re re

ni sra mkhregs can gyi 'jim dpar so phag gis brtsigs pa'i gzhu dbyibs brtsigs dngos steng rdo chen po mnyam por brtsigs shing de'i thog 'dam rtswa dang 'ba' cha bsres pa'i sbyar dngos rim pa gcig bting ba'i thog tu 'jim dpar so phag bsreg ma rim pa gnyis bting bar zha nye leb ma bting nas chu mi zegs pa byas yod/ de'i 'phror zha nye'i steng sa gshin po blugs nas ljon shing dang me tog ngo mtshar can mang po btab yod/ rtsi shing de dag la nyin re bzhin them pa'i rtse ru bzos pa'i chu rdzing las 'ongs pa'i chu dwangs ma 'dren gyi 'dug cing / chu de ni nye 'khor gyi yi'u h+pha re dzi chu bo las drangs pa dang chu rdzing nas rmang zhabs 'og tu 'jim dpar so phag gis bzos pa'i chu 'dren sbu gu las yar 'jib nas thon pa red/ nyin rer chu drangs pa'i steng nyi 'od kyang 'dang tsam phog thub stabs them skas mthon po'i steng gi rtsi shing la yal 'dab rgyas po skyes shing me tog sna tshogs brtas par shar bas na/ rgyang nas bltas tshe me tog skyed mos tshal de bar snang khams su gnas pa'i snang ba ster bas ming la yang bar snang gi skyed mos tshal zhes thogs so//bar snang gi skyed mos tshal ni bkod pa legs shing ngo mtshar che ba'i ar las shig yin pas 'dzam gling du skad grags shin tu che/ shod rgyun la de ni skabs de'i rgyal po ne lhu khad ne rdzar sku rabs gnyis pas btsun mo'i sems spro ba'i chen bskrun pa red zer/ btsun mo de'i ming la a smi the si ༅lkolko〉zer zhing kho mo ni sme sdi a'i(5061 'a chi )(yi ran mtho sgang gi nub byang khul)mi yin la/ sba sbi lon la slebs rjes pha yul gyi nags tshal dang rdza ri shin tu dran drag ste pha yul dran pa'i sems nad phog pas/ rgyal por brel 'tshub chen po langs nas rgyu dang las ka gang brlag la ma 'dzems par bar snang gi skyed mos tshal bskrun nas btsun mo'i sems nad gsos zer skad/des bas na skyed mos tshal de ni gna' bo'i sba sbi lon gyi bzo pa khri phrag sta snas

chen po la ro sdi(206603 77)gling phran zer/ de'i lo rgyus ni e rjin shes rig skabs dang ghi ri si'i mkhar grong rgyal khab 'dzugs pa'i dus skabs tsam bar yar 'ded rgyu yod/ zu snyi ri si la bsgyur pa'i dus skabs(spyi lo sngon gyi 334 spyi lo sngon gyi 30lo)su/ shar phyogs sa dbus rgya mtsho'i yul gyi dpal 'byor lte gnas ni ghi ri si'i rang yul las shar phyogs su spos nas ro sdi gling phran ni sa khul de'i dpal 'byor dang rig gnas sgyu rtsal bya 'gul gyi lte gnas gtso bo zhig tu gyur/ de ru tshong las dar rgyas che la bsko ris sgyu rtsal yang shin tu dar che/ shod rgyun la lha sku chen po ni brgya phrag du ma yod cing de'i nang ches skad grags che ba ni nyi lha'i lha sku yin zer/sems phangs pa zhig la lha sku chen po 'di bzhengs nas yun ring ma 'gor bar spyi lo sngon gyi 224lor sa yom chen po zhig dang mnyam du ldib song ba red/ spyi lo 653lor lha sku chen po'i zhig ro ni rji'u yi tshong pa zhig gis li'i chag hrig tu brtsis nas drud pas dus de nas bzung sku de la zhib 'jug dang bskyar bzo bgyi byed kyi dngos po ci yang mthong rgyu ma yod/nga tshos 'di ru gna' rabs yig tshang gi tshad yod ma rgyu dang gna' rdzas rgyu cha gzhir bzung nas tshod dpag byas nas ngo sprod tsam bgyi rgyu yin/lha sku de ni mtho tshad la smi 36 5tsam yod pa'i nyi lha ho ri a si (blolko/a+yomo)yar langs tshul gyi li'i sku 'dra chen po zhig yin mod/ lha sku yongs rdzogs li las bzos pa ma yin par de'i phyi ngos li leb brdungs nas bzos pa red/lha sku chen po de brtan po yin ched sku'i khog tu rus sgom bzos shing de ni ring tshad la smi 27yod pa'i lcags kyi ka ba gnyis las grub pa dang zhabs nas dbu'i bar thon du bcug yod/ srol rgyun gyi lta ba ltar na/ lha sku chen po de ro sdi gru kha'i gong du bzhengs shing phyag tu dpal 'bar bsnams shing zhabs gnyis kha gyes nas gru kha'i phyogs gnyis su btsugs nas langs 'du// sang

bar yangs la rgya che bas mtsho gru chen po yang de las rang dgar bgrod thub zer/ yin na'ang nye rabs kyi mkhas pa kha shas kyis skabs de'i cha rkyen 'og tu gna' bo'i lag rtsal gyis mtsho'i gru kha'i phyogs gnyis su zhabs btsugs nas langs pa'i li'i lha sku chen po zhig gtan nas bzo mi thub pas/ lha sku'i rnam pa gzhan zhig ste nyi lha ho ri a si'i dbu ru 'od zer lam lam 'phro ba'i gser gyi cod pan bsnams shing zhabs g.yas pa cung sngon du yod cing g.yon paphyi ru gnas pa'i tshul du gru kha'i phyogs gcig tu btsugs nas langs shing phyag g.yas pa yar btegs nas smin ma'i tshad du bsrings pa/ phrag pa g.yon pas steng gsol ras bsnams shing thu ba sar drud pa/ spyan gnyis kyis rgyang phyogs mtsho ngos su gzigs pa'i tshul snang zhing lha sku chen po de la shugs rten gsum yod pas lhag par brtan pa dang / lha sku chen po ni rdo ka ma ru dkar pos brtsigs pa'i gzhi gdan steng bzhengs yod ces bzhed/ gong brjod tshul gnyis las gzhug ma ni dngos don dang cung mtshungs pa 'dra mod cis kyang de bden min gyi dpang rtags dngos rdzas ci yang med/ lha sku chen po 'di thabs shes gang 'dra zhig la brten nas bzhengs pa'i skor la ma rgyu shin tu dkon pas mi rnams kyis tshod dpag rigs sgre tsam las bgyi mi thub bo//rom gyi lo rgyus mkhas chen phu le lde'u si rgan pas(64 53 2khrib1035750753 2077)6 mi rnams kyis bstod bsngags yang yang brjod pa ni ro sdi gling phran steng gi nyi lha'i 'dra sku chen po de red/ de ni le si sbe si( po khri spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs bzhi ba'i smad kyi bsko ris mkhas po grags can)yi slob bu ren tho si (lo7lo)yi mi ming la kha le si (rdo mo)zhes pas bzhengs skrun byas/ sku 'dra bzhengs nas lo ngo 56(khong gis gzhan zhig tu 66khrishākyang gsungs yod)'gor rjes sa yom khrod du ldeb song ba red/

gna' bo'i gtam rgyud ltar na/ li'i sku 'dra de lo ngo bcu gnyis la bzos pa dang bsdom pa'i dngul dkar po tha lan the 300(tun7 5dang phal cher 'dra ba)'gro song du btang / dngul de dag ni sde smi the le (ṣ+ṭha lkoṣ+ṭha 4)rgyal po'i bor ba'i grong khyer la bskor rgol bgyi byed kyi 'phrul 'khor btsong ba las thob pa red mices gsungs/ khong gi gsung 'di las ro sdi gling phran steng gi nyi lha'i sku 'dra chen po'i lo rgyus mdo tsam shes thub kyang / skad cha rjes ma'i don ci yin zhe na lo ngo 2280lhag gi sngon la ro sdi gling phran gyi mi dmangs kyis gzhan gyi btsan 'dzul la 'thab rtsod byas pa bstan la/ 'thab rtsod de la rgyal kha thob pa'i rkyen gyis da gzod nyi lha'i 'dra sku chen po de bzhengs bstan yod/wa4phyo snga ri —— rme cho ra ci skoskosnang bar shar ba'i nyi lha'i sku 'dra chen po'i ri mo/spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs bzhi ba'i smad tsam la/ ro sdi gling phran dar rgyas stobs shugs can du gyur par/ a she ya chung ba bzung yod pa'i sme se rdon gyi rgyal po e legs gzan rdar gyi mnga' 'og gi dmag dpon an the kho (ṣ+ṭhar+sā7)dang kho'i bu sde smi the le ( sko64)la phrag dog dang zhed snang skye ru bcug pas/ rang gi nye 'gram du stobs 'byor ldan pa'i ro sdi gling phran zhig byung bar ma rung bar gling phran de btsan du 'dzin ched/ spyi lo sngon gyi 304lor mtsho dmag dang dmag gru'i dpung chen po zhig khrid de rgya mtsho'i steng 293

ro sdi gru kha la btsan 'dzul byas/ ro sdi'i mi ni dgra chen po 'ongs par ma skrag ma 'jigs par pho mo rgan gzhon yod rgu skul slong byas nas khrab rmog gyon nas dmag tu zhugs pa dang/ dpa' ngar sgos btsan 'dzul par drag tu 'thab pa dang mthar thug de dag pha rol du skrad de mes rgyal gyi rang btsan dang rang dbang la srung skyob byas/ dmag 'khrug der rgyal kha blangs par dran gso bgyi ba'i ched du ro sdi'i mi rnams kyis spyi lo sngon gyi 302lor ro sdi gru kha ru nyi lha'i 'dra sku chen po bzhengs 'go brtsams shing / spyi lo sngon gyi 290lor yongs su grub/ sku 'dra de bzo byed kyi li ni dgra bo'i lag nas thob pa'i lag cha btsong nas nyos pa red/ma'abarkya e legs gzan rdar gyakha'i lam ston sgron stegs/sme se rdon gyi rgyal po e legs gzan rdar gyis shar phyogs la btsan 'dzul byed skabs/ btsan bzung sa khul du grong khyer gsar pa bcu phrag du ma bskrun zhing grong khyer phal che ba'i ming la e legs gzan rdar zhes btags/ṭī jib kyi e legs gzan rdar grong khyer ni de'i nang gi grong khyer ches che shos na/ grong khyer 'di ne+e le gtsang po'i zur gsum gling phran gyi nub byang sne khul dang sa dbus rgya mtsho'i lho 'gram du byang phyogs kyi h+pha lo si gling phran la kha gtad du yod/ phu tho le sme'u si(2 01076053 677)rgyal rabs kyis dbang bsgyur pa'i skabs su grong khyer de ni e jib kyi rgyal sa yin la sa dbus rgya mtsho sa khul yongs dang nye shar sa khul gyi ches che zhing gal 'gangs che ba'i rgyalaspyi'i brgyud 'dren gru kha zhig yin/ e legs gzan rdar gru khar brgyud paX sdu/ gru la lam ston pa dang lhag par du mtshan mor bgrod pa'i gru gzings

gongagi zur bzhi bor mtsho lha pho si sdom (ṣ+ṭha ma)gyi bus dung 'bud bzhin pa'i sku 'dra re bzhengs la des rlung gi kha phyogs mtshon pa red/ sgron stosas kyi bar sked khag ni smad khag las phra zhing zur brgyad dbyibs su mtho tshad la smi 34yod/ stod rim ni de las kyang phra la ka zlum dbyibs su mtho tshad la smi9yod cing de'i klad ni sgor dbyibs yin zhing de'i nang nam yang gzim rgyu med pa'i sgron me chen po zhig nyin mtshan med par 'bar nas me lce g.yo bar 'dug sgron me'i 'bar rdzas ni rkub nas klad bar du 'degs 'bebs 'phrul 'khor dang 'dra ba'i sgrig chas shig gis skyel 'dren byed/ sgron stegs kyi rtse ru mtho tshad la smigatsam yod pa'i mtsho lha pho se sdom kyi li'i skru 'dra zhig bzhings yod/ de bzhin du sgron stegs chen po de'i spyi'i mtho tshad la(sgron stegs dngos dang de'i yang rtse/ mtsho lha'i sku 'dra bcas)smi 135tsam yod/shod tshul la mi rnams kyis sgron stegs dang bar la spyi le 60yod pa'i mtsho ngos nas sgron stegs mthon po de mthong thub cing / mtshan mo mtsho gru bskyod nas sgron stegs dang spyi le36yod pa'i gnas nas sgron stegs stong gi ngos kong lcags rigs kyi ldog 'phro'i me long las byung pa'i me lce chen por brten nas e le gi gzan sder gru kha ru skyod pa red zer/ gna' bo'i 'dzam gling gi ngo mtshar can gyi bzo bkod bdun gyi nang gi drug ni rgyal po'i me tog ra ba dang dur sa'am yang na mchod 'bul bya yul gyi lha sku yin mod/ e legs gzan rdar gru kha'i sgron stegs ni mi'i rigs la dge mtshan ldan pa'i bzo skrun zhig red/ sgron stegs chen po 'di ngo lo chigastong lhag la bkol spyod byas/ spyi lo700lor e legs gzan rdar gru kha la sa yom byung bas sgron stegs chen por gtor bshig thebs kyang rjes su zhig gso byas/ spyi lo 1100lor sgron stegs chen por slar yang sa yom kyis gtor ba~X zlotang pas de'i smad khag tsam las lhag med/ sgron stegs des lam

ston pa'i nus pa shor nas rgyang blta'i mtho stegs su gyur pa dang rjes sor de'i stong du kha che'i lha khang zhig bskrun/ spyi lo 1301lo dang 1435lor sa yom thengasaganyis byung bas sgron stegs rtsa med du bzos/ gong du nga tshos brjod pa'i sgron stegs kyi tshul ni yig tshang dang der mtshungs dngos po gzhir bzung nas yid tshod tsam byas pa yin no//

rom gyi'abyungasangs/hring krokyong /'dzam gling gna' rabs lo rgyus steng / rom(207776)dang snyi ri si gnyis gcig mtshungs su nam rgyun mi rnams kyis gling gin 'dug pa'i bran g.yog lam lugs kyi rgyal khab red/ rom ni i ṭa li gling phran phyed ga'i steng yod la/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i lte gnas su yod cing gling phran phyed ka yongs ni nar mo lham dbyibs su mngon/ gling phran phyed ka de'i dkyil du the phe 64khrigatsang po ni 'od 'tsher 'tsher gyi dar gyi sked rags bzhin du la them thang chenat+t+waṃ kau sdo 57 717chaṭha)brgyud nub lho nas sa dbus rgya mtsho'i nang bzhur rom byung nas lo ngo brgya phrag du ma'i ring mu mthun du 'phel rgyas byung ba dang rgya bskyed pas/ spyi lo gcig dang gnyis par rim bzhin sa dbus rgya mtsho'i khongs kyi lte gnas byas pa'i gling chen yo rab dang a she ya/ a h+phe ri kha gsum the ba'i bran g.yog lam lugs kyi btsan rgyal chen po zhig tu gyur nas rgyal khab de yang rtser dar ba'i dus rabs su thon/ yin na'ang shes dgos rgyu zhig la/ rom btsan rgyal zhes pa'i rgyal khab chen po 'di ni rom mkhar grong nyeganas su brten nas dar ba de yin/ 'o na rom gyi snga mo'i lo rgyus ga 'dra zhig yin pa dang / de'i 'byung khungs gang yin zhe na gsham du gleng bar bya'o/29sbyo lo sngon gyi nyis stong lo rabs kyi smad du tha phe gtsang bo'i shar 'gram

du grong sde 'ga' chags pa dang de ru la then pa (ṣ+ṭha114)dang / se phan ( r+sā14)pa sogs kyi che gna' bo'i tsho mi 'tsho bar 'dug cing / rjes su de dag rom pa'i mes por gyur pa red/ nom mkhar grong gi 'byung khungs skor la dmangs khrod du khyab che la yun ring ba'i gtam rgyud cig yod pa ni spyang mo zhig gis mi'i bu phug ro smu lu si(507753 7sgrordolho)dang re smu si(50753mcho)gnyis gsos pa'i gtam rgyud ngo mtshar can de red/ da lta'i bar du rom gyi 'grem ston khang zhig tu spyang mo zhig gis mi'i phru gu gnyis la nu ma snun bzhin pa'i li'i sku 'dra zhig bshams yod/nge treri / /dzñārnyi ri༄// ri ri ri —3 go 〉wa ge ri4) / spyang mas mi'i bu phrug la nu ma bsnun bzhin pa'i sku 'dra/shod rgyun la gna' rabs thi ro yi(1701 stsostsacha)spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs bcu gnyis par rtsa med du song rjes/ thi ro i'i mi skor zhig dpon po e ne+e a si(46ba tsho khya khusgro)yis 'go drangs nas phyir bros shing / kho tsho'i mtsho gru rgya mtsho'i steng du nyi ma mang por g.yengs rjes rlung gis mtsho 'gram du ded/ thang shin tu chad pa'i bros bshol pa de tshos chu bo chen po zhig mthong ba dang 'gram gnyis su tshing tshing nags tshal kyis bzung la/ nyi 'dod 'dzoms shing sa gshen po 'dug pa mthong nas sa der gzhi tshugs/ yul de ni i ṭa li mtsho 'gram yin zhing de'i ming du la then (ṣ+ṭha1)sa khul zer/ e ne+e ༵lha ni'i

bu yis la then sa khul du grong brdal btsugs pa'i ming la al sba lon sga(sa5tsho60brtsa sgrolo32khri)zer/lo bcu phrag du ma 'gor rjes/ e ne a si'i phyi rabs pa nu smi thor(sa541001ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha77)gyis al sba lon sga la dbang bsgyur/ de'i gcung po a smu le'u si(me75smo 53lo tsho46)ni gtum drag dang ham sems che ba'i mi zhig yin pas/ rang nyid dbang sgyur pa bgyi ched g.yo zol dang thabs ngan gang yod spyad nas gcen po'i dbang cha 'phrog a smu le'u si yis dbang sgyur byas rjes lo rgas nus med kyi gcen po'i srog ma blangs na'ang / nyin mtshan gang du gcen po'i rjes rabs pas dgra sha len par dogs pa skye bzhin 'dug pas/ gcen po'i bu gsod dgos pa dang gcen po'i bu mo sel we a(266832 18༅tsho ༅)rgyang yul du phyir skyod btang nas mi su dang gnyen sgrig bgyi mi chog pas bka' phab/ yin na'ang / sras mo de 'thab lha smar si(5873777)dang bshos pas bu mtshe ma gnyis skyes/ a smu le'u sis gnas tshul de go rjes 'jigs snang chen po skyes pas rjes su phru gu de gnyis dgra sha rtsod du yong bar zhed nas sel we a bgrongs pa dang / g.yog mo zhig la bu mtshe ma de gnyis sle ma zhig tu bcug nas the phe gtsang po'i nang bskyur dgos pa'i bka' phab/ skabs der the phe gtsang po drag tu 'gyur pa'i dus la 'khel bas drag rlabs chil chil du 'phyur par 'dug g.yog mo de chu 'gram du song nas bu gnyis blugs pa'i sle ma de chu 'gram du bzhag ste phyir log kho mo'i sems su chu da dung en tsam rgyas na phru gu de gnyis kyang gson thabs med snyam/ 'on te chu ni yar rgyas kyang phru gu gnyis ma khur la rgyu mtshan ni sle ma sdong phran la thogs pas red/ cung ma 'gor bar chu chen mar 'then pa dang phru gu gnyis sle ma las mar sa la lhung zhing shugs gang yod kyis ngus nas ba/nā do//

skabs der spyang mo zhig dag dag chu 'gram du chu 'thung bar 'ongs pa dang ngu skad go nas phru gu'i phyogs su brgyugs/ spyang mos phru gu gnyis la gnod pa ci yang ma byas pa'i stong rang gis 'o zhos gsos/ da dung shing rta mo zhig gis kyang rgyun tu shing tog khur yong nas phru gu gnyis la za ru bcugarjes su rgyal po zhis gi phyugs rdzis mthong nas rang gi khyim la khrid nas gso skyong gnang / gcen po'i ming la ro smu lu si(507753 7 lho)dang gcung po'i ming la re smu si(5075bya r+sā)zhes btags so//spun zla gnyis nar son rjes/ lus stobs rgyas shing dpa' ngar ldan pa'i rngon pa pho gsar gnyis su gyur/ nyin zhig phyugs rdzi des khong gnyis kyi khyim khungs sogs rgyu mtshan ro smu lu si la gsal por bshad/ ro smu lu si yis nu bo dang mnyam du al sba non sga grong khyer gyi mi dmangs la 'go khrid mdzad de 'os langs byas te/ gdug rtsub can gyi a sru le'u si'i dbang sgyur rtsa slog btang nas srid dbang 'phrog ste a mes non smi rdor la sprad/de'i 'phror gcen gcung gnyis rjes 'brangs pa mang po dang mnyam du the phe gtsang po'i 'gram ngogs kyi pha la then ( khri71)ri sgang ste spyang mos rang gnyis gso skyong byas pa'i yul der mkhar grong gsar pa zhig btsugs pa red/mkhar grong gsar pa btsugs rjes/ su dpon po bgyi rgyu dang su'i ming de la 'dogs rgyu'i thad la gcen gcung gnyis bar rtsod gling chen po byung nas sus kyang su la khas ma blangs/ rjes su gcen gcung gnyis kyis 'dab chags 'phur 'ongs pa sus mthong na de ni lha'i lung bstan yin par kha 'cham byung /gcen gcung gnyis so sor bzhugs nas ltas bzang por re sgug byas/ re smu si yis dang por bya khra drug 'phur 'ongs pa mthong na'ang / cung ma 'gor par glog 'khyug cing 'brug sgra grags pa sbrags bya khra bcu gnyis ro sku lu si'i nye 'dabs nas 'phur song ba red/ de nas re smu si yis ngas dang zlo/ bya

'phur 'ongs pa mthong bas nga dpon po byed dgos zer/ ro smu lu si yis ngas mthong ba'i bya khra khyod kyis mthong ba las ldab cig gi mang bas nga dpon po byed rgyu lhas lung bstan red zer/de nas rtsod pa je drag tu song ba dang / mjug mthar gdug rtsub can gyi ro smu lu si yis re smu sis kyis mthong chung gi sgo nas rdzong mkhar gsar pa'i ra skor las brgal song zer bar kha g.yar nas rang gi gcung po'i srog 'phrog rjes/ gcung po'i ro'i steng langs nas skad chen po'i ngang su zhig nga'i rdzong mkhar las brgal ba na 'di lta bur srog len rgyu yin zhes ku co brgyab/ dus de nas bzung ro smu lu si la ngo rgol byad mkhan ma byung bas kho rang mkhar grong gsar pa de'i ches mtho'i dbang sgyur pa ru gyur pas grong mkhar gyi ming la yang rang ming la 'grig pa ltar du rom zhes btags/ gtam rgyud 'di ni spyi lo sngon gyi753lo'i zla 4pa'i tshes 21nyin byung bas/ gna' rabs rom gyi mis nyin 'di rgyal khab btsugs pa'i rjes dran nyi ma byed pa red/mkhar grong btsugs rjes grong mkhar nang gi mi 'bor nyung nyung des tsho ba gzhan gyi yul spor mkhan mang po bsdus/ yin na'ang yong mkhan mang che ba ni pho rkyang dang yul 'khyar pa/ ldom po/ jag pa yin pas mi su tshang gis kyang rang gi bu mo de tshor mna' mar mi ster ba red/ de bas na grong mkhar nang pho mang mo nyung gi gnas bab byung pas blo gros can gyi ro smu lu si yis thabs shes sheg rnyed par/ nyin zhig khong gis thag nye'i yul gyi sa phen pa la rom du gsol ston chen po zhig bgyi rgyu yin zhes gdan 'dren zhus/ sa phen pas ci yin ma shes par pho mo gon gzhon mang po zhig 'ongs/ sa phen pa rnams ston mo rol nas dga' dga' spro spro byed pa'i sgang la ro smu lu si yis brda zhig brgyab pa dang nom gyi skyes pa tshos rang gi blo la babs pa'i bu mo rnams bzung nadi spyazlo du log ste gnyen sgrig byas/ sa phen pa rnams la khong khro bzod med

skyes pas rom gyi mir sha 'khon blangs nas rom tu khrag gi 'khor lo skor rgyur sems thag bcad/ha lam lo gcig tsam 'gor rjes sa phen pa dang rom gyi mi yis ri lung zhig tu dmag 'thab chen po byas/ phyogs gnyis kyis ya nga ba'i gsod res byas pa dang / dpal rtul mang po zhig la shi rmas phog pas da dung mu mthud du 'thab na mi gang mang gi tshe srog shor nges red/ skabs der glo bur du ri sgang nas rom gyi 'phrog nas chung ma byas pa'i sa phen gyi bud med skor zhig mar brgyugs 'ongs shing kho mo tsho'i skra 'dzing la gdong ngor mchi ma'i bkang ba/ kha shas kyis phru gu lag mgor btegs nas sar pus mo btsugs te dpal rtul tsho'i sgyud par 'jus nas/ rang gi pha a khu dang phu nu/ khyo ga rnams la dmar 'dzing dang gsod res mtshams 'jog dgos dang / kho mo yug mo dang dwa phrug tu mi gtong pa'i zhu ba zhus/ rom dang sa phen gyi dpa' rtul tshos gnas tshul de mthong bas sems 'gul thebs pas lag cha mar g.yug ste phan tshun mthun pa byung / de nas bzung / tsho ba de gnyis gcig tu 'dres nas mi rabs nas mi rabs bar du rom grong khyer du 'tsho ba rol/ shod rgyun la ro smu lu si yis lo ngo 39la srid dbang bzung ba dang tshe las 'das rjes rom gyi mis lha ru bkur nas mchod 'bul byed ces zer/gtam rgyud ni lo rgyus ngo ma min mod/ gtam rgyud las lo rgyus ngo ma'i gribagazugs tsam mthong thub par dogs pa med/ dper na al sba lon sga mkhar grong ni dngos su yod myong ba dang / ro smu lu sis btsugs pa'i mkhar grong pha la then ri sgang du yod cing de ni gnas spor pa thengs dang po ste la then gyi mi dang thog sdod pa'i gnas red/ spyang mos mi'i bu phug stor skyong byas pa'i gtam rgyud ni/ phyogs gcig nas rom mkhar grong ma bskrun gong du the phe gtsang po'i yul rgyud ni mi grangs nyung ba'i spang rgod yin pas gcan gasdu/ gyi
