yul khams yin pa mtshon zhing / phyogs gzhan zhig nas rom gyi mes po'i ma rgyud tsho ba'i spyi tshogs dus rim brgyud myong ba dang / skabs der tsho ba kha shas kyis spyang ki kho tsho'i srung ma dang mtshon rtags byas pa'i lo rgyus mtshon yod/gna' rdzas sngog 'don byas pa ltar na/ spyir btang du rom mkhar grong ni spyi lo sngon kyi dus rabasaḥpa nas spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs7pa'i bar byung bar ngos 'dzin/ gna' rabs rom gyi mkhar grong rgyal khab ni la then tsho ba dang khyim mtshes kyi tsho ba mnyam 'brel lam yang na gcig bsdus byas nas rim bzhin chags pa red/ spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabasaḥpa nas dus7pa'i skabs su/tsho sde so so ni pha la then (16r+sā1)gtso byas pa'i tsho bdun mna' 'brel chags shing rjes su sa phen pa'i tsho ba nang du bsdus te kha phe tho le (rdo lotsho)ru thun mong gi mkhar rdzong bskrun/ spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs 5pa nas 4par thon dus/a h+phen then (༅01)tsho ba nang du bsdus pa dang / sdod yul gyi mtha' 'khor la gyang mkhar brtsigs/ na chu phyir phud pa dang thang chen gsar skrun byas pas ming la rom btags/ gong smos rom gyi mi dang sa phen pa gnyis kyi dmakā 'asbyikā ni phal cher gcig bsdu'i brgyud rim nang byung ba'i don zhig zin zlo lo sngo/na/ gyi753lo nas spyi lo sngon gyi 510lo'i bar la rom gyi lo rgyus steng rgyal srid dus rabs zer/ dus rabs de lo ngo 200lhag brgyud cing /snga gzhug tu rgyal po bdun gyis dbang bzung / dang po ni ro smu lu si yin la/ches mjug ma ni i sda la li a'i mi (khyan 74༅1zhe)ste ming la thar khu'i ne'u si(13194 7 5lha ma4)chung ba zer/ 6 rgyal srid dus rabs ni rom gyi ya thog spyi tshogs mnyam tshogs lam lugs nas gral rim spyi tshogs la brgal pa'i dus skabs red/ skabs de'i rgyal po mini mi dmangs tshogs chen gyis 'de3༵༵ bsko byas nas byung zhing gnas dbyung btang yang chog pas/ rjes kyi

sger gcod kyi rje bo lta bu'i dbang cha chen po med pas/ tsho khag mnyam tshogs kyi 'go dpon tsam red/spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs7pa nas spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs 6par thon tshe/thon skyed nus shugs mthor 'degs byung ba dang / sger dbang lam lugs gong 'phel du song zhing dmag thob dngos rdzas nyin re bzhin je mang la song ba dang mnyam du nom gyi spyi tshogs nang khul gyi gral rim la gyes 'gyur byung ba nyin re las nyin rer mngon gsal du song / tsho ba'i gong rim sku drag tshos rang gi dbang cha spyad de spyi dbang zhing sa ham 'phrog byas pa dang / bran g.yog dang srung byar gyur pa'i mi ser la bsha gzhog byas/ dbul po dang khyim gzhi dib pa'i tsho ba'i khongs mi rnams sku drag gi srung bya'i mi ser du mi byed ka med byung bas/ sku drag tsho'i lag nas sa zhing chung chung btabs nas sku drag tshor zhabs 'degs zhu dgos byung / dmag 'khrug byung ba na da dung g.yul du zhugs dgos/ gzhan yang rom du da dung mi ser dkyus ma byung zhing de ni rom gyi gna' bo'i tsho mi las gzhan btsan 'dul byas pa'i yul nas 'ongs pa'i mi red/ kho tshor rang dbang can gyi thob thang yod pas bran g.yog min mod/ spyi dmangs kyi dbang cha dang tsho mi'i dbang cha med pas spyi dbang sa zhing mi dbang na'ang khral 'jal dgos shing dmag tu zhugs dgos pa'i 'os 'gan yod/ mi ser dkyus ma mang po zhig sku drag la brten te sku drag gi lag nas sa zhing dang dngul g.yor dgos pas/ dus rgyun du bu lon 'jal mi thub par bran g.yog tu gyur 'gro ba red/ bun bdag la bun chad pa'i mi de sa cha gzhan du bran g.yog tu btsong ba'i dbang cha dang tha na srog gcod pa'i dbang cha yang yod/gral rim gyes 'gyur byung ba je drag du song bas/ mi ser dkyus ma'i 'bor grangs je mang dang dpal 'byor gyi go gnas je mthor song ༵༵ spyi

lugs gsar pa zhig mthar thug rom du byung / de ni lo rgyus mdun du skyod pa'i rnam pa zhig yin la spyi tshogs kyi gsar brje zhig kyang red/tsa rgyal srid dus skabs kyi ches mtha' ma'i rgyal po thar khe ne'u se su pher sbu si(1819510103 559775cu cho4)ni rje ngan gdug rtsub can zhig yin pas kho'i gtum drag srid dbang la rom gyi mi yis ngo rgol drag po byas/ ha lam spyi lo sngon gyi 510lor rom du 'os langs byung bas tha khe ne'u si pher sbu si phyir skyod btang ste rgyal srid med par bzos nas rom spyi mthun rgyal khab btsugs so//tsho307

ngangarisa'amaldaskyabs pa/lu'e krung kho'u/spyi mthun rgyal khab btsugs pa'i dus mgor/ rom ni the phe gtsang po'i 'gram gyi mkhar grong rgyal khab chung chung zhig yin/ nye 'khor mkhar grong rgyal khab gyi nyen kha bkrol ched dang sa khongs gang mang zhig len pa'i ched du/rom gyi mis mna' 'brel byed pa dang dmag 'khrug rgyag pa'i thabs gcig lcog tu spyad de mu mthud du rang gi yul khongs dang stobs shugs je cher btang la/ de dang rom nang khul gyi mi ser dkyus ma dang sku drag bar gyi 'thab rtsod gnyis res bskor nas byas pa red/ spyi lo sngon gyi 390lor rom nang khul gyi mi ser dkyus ma dang sku drag bar gyi 'thab rtsod je drag tu song ba'i skabs su byang phyogs su sdod pa'i sge li'i(6thams 〉〉)mi'i dmag dpung gis dmag brgyab nas rom la thon/sge li'i mi(6thams 〉〉 de ni khel thi yi mi'i (21 3 11ri 6 khag cig yin)ni sngar nub phyogs yo rob kyi nub kyi rgya mtsho'i chen mo'i 'gram rgyud nas rdo no gtsang bo'i(20ba 5 zalko )bar rgyud sa khul du gnas shing / ha lam spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs 5pa'i mjug tu al phe si(4193 lo74lo)ri bo brgal nas i ṭa li byang phyogs kyi sbo gtsang po'i bzhur rgyud la thon/ kho tshor lus stobs rgyas shing 'brog las byed/ 'thab la mkhas shing dpa' ngar ldakā ༵༵ g.yul rgyag rgyu ni dus chen gtong ba'i tshul du brtsi/ de tshos mchor

mnyam gyi gyon pa spras shing mjing par gser gyi ske rgyan bskon nas rmog mi gyon pa/ lag cha ral gri dang mdung dang glo gri thogs/ spyi lo sngon kyi dus rabs 4pa'i dus mgor 'brog sa gsar ba 'tshol ba'i ched du/ mi 'bor khri 'ga' yod pa'i sge li'i tsho ba zhig tsho dpon sbu len gyi 'go khrid nas rom byang phyogs kyi i sda la li a (7 77༅༅)sa khul du btsan spo byas pa ma zad/ da dung mkhar grong khe lu si yum bskor nas rgol te grong khyer de'i mi rnams la 'jigs skrag bskul pas/ mkhar grong des 'phral du rom la dmag rogs bgyi dgos pa'i re ba zhus/ rom gyis rgyal nang gral rim 'thab rtsod kyi rkyen gyis mi gsum las grub pa'i pho nya'i tshogs pa zhig mngags nas sge li'i mi la dmag 'khrug gi mtshams bzhag nas phan tshun zhi bde'i ngang gnas na bzang ba'i kha ta bslab bya byas/ dus mtshungs su/ sge li'i mi la khyod tshos gal srid khe lu si yum (ma ༅67)la rgol ba dang gtses na nom kha rog tu mi 'dug kho thag chod ces tha tshig bsgrags/ tshosge li'i mis nom gyi pho nya'i kha ta la ma nyan pa'i steng / da dung dbang shed bston ham sgos gal te khe lu si sum nas blo 'bab pa'i sa zhig ma lon tshe dmag 'khrug gi mtshams gtan nas mi 'jog ces ku co brgyab pa dang / rom gyi pho nya yis khyod tshor gzhan gyi sa cha 'dzin dgos pa'i gnas lugs ci yod ces dris pa'i tshe/ sge li'i tsho dpon sbu len (lkolko)gyis skeg gi gro bshung nas ngar ngar dzig dzig sgos rom gyi pho nya'i gdung la btsugs nas de ni nga rang tsho'i dbang cha red/ shes dgos pa zhig la/ 'dzam gling ni stobs shugs can la dbang ba red ces ngar skad brgyab bo//rom gyi pho nya la yang khong khro me 'bar ba skyes nas glo gri byung nas sge li pa dang 'thab nas de tsho'i tsho dpon zhig bsad/ de bzhin du gyod don je cher song bas/ sge li pa rnams gyis khe lu si yum la rgol mtshams bcad de 3/snag

dpung rom gyi phyogs su drangs so//sge li pa'i dmag dpung skyod tshad shin tu mgyogs shing / rom las spyi le 5tsam yod pa'i a ne'o gtsang po'i (mtha ma)g.yon 'gram nas rom gyi dmag dpung dang gdung thug brgyab te dmag 'khrug gi 'go brtsams/ sge li pa'i dmag dpung mang pos ri dang spang la g.yogs shing lag tu shing khrab dang mdung ring bzung nas bar snang ngar sgra dang ki sgras bkang pas sa yang yom yom du bsgul pa 'dra byas/ rom gyis dmag 'thab rgyur gra sgrig yag po byas med pas der 'tshab 'tshub por dgra bo bsu nas 'thab/ sge li'i dmag gis bskoranas rgol bar mi yong ba bya ched nom gyi dmag dpung phyogs gnyis su brkyangs te g.yas g.yon phan tshun la gcig ram gcig 'degs bya thub pa byas mod/ sge li pas rom gyi dmag dpung phyogs gnyis su bcad de g.yon phyogasakyi dpung ru gtsang bo'i nang du ded/ rom gyi dmag dpung cig shos kyis gnas tshul de mthong nas dngangs skrag tshad med skyes te phyir bros brgyab/rom gyi dmag mi mang po sge li pas ral gri'i 'og tshe srog shor pa dang de'i nang gi nyung shas thar te mkhar grong nang bros bas thon na'ang skrag 'jigs skye drags pas mkhar sgo rgyag rgyu yang brjed/ de bzhin du nga rgyal can gyi rom gyi dmag dpung pham pa dang rjes su kho tshos a ne'o gtsang bo'i 'gram gyi pham pa myong ba'i nyi ma ste spyi lo sngon gyi 390lo'i zla7pa'i tshes 18nyin ni nom gyi rgyal khab kyi mtshan shas dran gso'i nyin du gtan 'khel byas/sge li pa rnams rgyal kha dang bstun rom mkhar grong phyogs bskyod/ rom gyi gon gas gling gis 'phral ma'i byed thabs spyad de gnas tshul nyen kha can la kha gtad mi 'jal ka med byung nas/ sdod dmangs skor zhig kha rog la mkhar grong gi phyi rol du phyir 'then byas pa dang / dmag mi skor zhig dang rgan gras pa kā/snyo ma skor zhig mkhar nang ma ste kha phe tho li ri sgang gi btsan rdzong srung nas

rogs dmag la sgug rgyu byas/ lo na rgas pa'i rgan gas pa kha shas ri sgang btsanardzong nang 'gro mi 'dod pas khong tshos dus chen thog shom rgyag spyad kyi gzab spros gyon nas lte gnas thang chen du 'ongs nas rkub bkyag steng bzhugs te rgyal khab kyi ched du rang srog blos gtong bar sta gon gnang /phyi nyin snga dro/ sge li pas yang dang yang du myul zhib byas rjes rom gyi mkhar gyang steng srung dmag med pa dang mkhar sgo yang brgyab med pa shes nas/kho len ( tho)mkhar sgo nas rom mkhar nang du brgyugs shing lam bar du 'gog mkhan gcig kyang ma yod/ rgya srang du mi gcig kyang mthong rgyu med pa dang khyim tshang yod rgu'i sge'u khung dang sgo dam du brgyab 'dug pas mi med yul stong gi tshul du mngon/ de nas sge li pa lte gnas thang chen du brgyugs pa dang de ru 'khar ba la brten pa'i rgad po mang po 'gul yang mi 'gul bar rkub bkyag thog bzhugs shing / de dag 'jim sku yin nam mi gson po red snyam pas sge li pa zhig gis sems chung ngang rgad po zhig gi ma rna la reg pa dang smra ra ring por 'jus nas 'then pa'i tshe/ rgad po de shin tu khros nas 'khar ba yar btegs nas sge li pa'i mgo la brdungs/ sge li pas gzod de ni mi gson po yin pa shes nas gri yis bsnun nas bkrongs/ sge li pa gzhan pas kyang lte gnas thang chen du yod pa'i rgan gras pa tshang ma bsad pa dang sbrags 'phrog bcom gyi 'go btsams pas/ nyin kha shas tsam la rom grong khyer mer bsregs nas gyang ro mkhar shul tsam du btang /yin na'ang rom gyi nang mkhar ste kha phe tho li ri sgang gi btsan rdzong ni rom gyi mi'i lag tu bzang 'dug mkhar rdzong de rom mkhar grong gi nub lho'i zur du yod cing sa shin tu btsan te mkhar gyi phyogs bzhi gcong rong yin pas su yang 'dzeg dka' ba red/ ri ngogs su nom gyi srung lha ste lha yongs kyi yab chen khu phi rdo(6591 6022kyis)dngalha mo sgro no/(/000lko ) shes ༵༵ kyi

lha mo smi nyer wa lko༄77 zhes pa bcas mchod sa'i lha khang bskrun yod/ sge li'i dmag rom gyi mkhar grong nang thon rjes ri sgang gi btsan rdzong la tshur rgol thengs mang byas rung ma thul bar pham kha myangs pas/ thabs jus bsgyur nas dus yun /nga por bskor nas ltogs skom gyis rom gyi mi la mgo bsgur du 'jug ḍi phe kā rdo/ ri/ sgang sge li pas bskor yod kyang mkhar grong phyi yi dmag rogasakyis btsan rdzong nang gi gan gras pa tsho 'brel gtug byed e thub thub bltas/ gzhon nu dpa' rtul zhig yod pas mtshan gung ri sgang logs kyi gcong rong la 'dzeg nas btsan rdzong nang thon mod/ stabs ma legs par gzhon nu de'i rkang rjes sge li'i dmag mi kha shas kyis mthong bas tsho dpon sbu len gyi rna bar zhus/ de'i dgong mor sbu len gyis lus zor yang la dpa' ngar ldan pa'i sge li'i dmag mi skor zhig bdams nas 'jab rgol ru khag bsgrigs shing de tsho la/ rom gyi mi rang gis nga tshor sngar ma shes pa'i lam zhig bstan/ lam de la dka' khag che yang rtsa ba nas bgrod mi thub pa zhig ma red/da lta rom gyi mi tshos nga tshor btsan rdzong len pa'i thabs shig bslabs pa'i dus su/ gnas 'di las phyir 'then byas na nga tshos ngo tsha tshad med myong gi red/migacig yar 'dzeg thub pa'i lam du mi gcig re gcig re byas nas mi mang po zhig yar 'dzegs thub ste/ khyod tsho ri sgang klad la 'dzeg thub song na btsan rdzong len dgos/ de lta na bdag gis khyod tsho mi re re la bya dga' dang legs skyes yid tshim pa ster kho thag yin zhes skul ma btang /spu len gyis gtam gyis 'jab rgol ru khag tsho la skul 'ded chen po thob/ha lam nam gung la thon pa'i dus su sge li'i dmag mi tshos gcig gcig gi lag pa sbrel nas 'jab ste kha rog tu brag ngor 'dzegs nas yar thon te zi ladī /spya rom gyi srung dmag bsad de btsan rdzong len la nye na'ang / rom gyi

so ba dang tha na go tshor shin tu rno ba'i sha khyis kyang ci yang ma tshor/ gnad 'gag gi skabs 'dir bsam yul las 'das pa'i don zhig byung ba ni/ snying 'jags khu sim pa'i mtshan mor lha mo sgro no'i lha khang nas ngang dkar skor zhig(shod tshul la lha mor phul ba'i mchod dngos red zer)gis kug kug dag ces skad rgyag zhor gshog pa ngar ngar du rdab rdab byas pas/ srung dmag smar khu si man li u si (6posgolo 4lko/67)gnyid las bslangs pa dang khong 'phral du brgyugs nas lta zhib byas tshe sge li'i 'jab rgol ru khag mthong /dus tshod ni rgyal kha yin te khong mchong thengs gcig gis gcong rong mtshams la thon pa dang phub yar btegs nas sge li dmag mgo ma'i thod par shed kyis brgyab ste g.yang gzar grog rong du g.yugs/ de'i 'phror sge li pa gnyis pa'i brang la ral gris bsnun nas bsad/ mar lhung ba'i mi ro yis brgyab te mi 'ga' shas shig gcong rong du g.yugs/ skabs der rom gyi dmag mi gzhan rnams kyang ram 'degs su thon pa dang ral gri dang phub/ rdo/ mdung / tha na khu tshur dang rdog tho brgyab nas sge li'i dmag gcong rong du brdzangs/ de bzhin du sge li'i dmag gis 'jab rgol bgyi ba'i 'char gzhi pham pa dang kha phe tho li ri sgang yang dgra'i lag tu ma shor ba red/phyi nyin nam langs pa dang ri sgang steng gi srung dmag rnams mnyam du tshogs nas blo rig ldan la dpa' stobs che ba'i man li u si la bya dga' gnang la/ de ni nyin gcig gi kha zas dang 'thung chu red/ rjes su khong la da dung kha phe tho li yi man li u si (rdo 6474lko167) zhes gzi brjid kyi mtshan yang thob/ ngang dkar gyi skad sgra yis btsan rdzong bskyabs pas/dus de nas bzung nom du ngang dkar ni mchog gyur srog chags su bkur mchod byas pas/ rgyal khab mdzod khang gis dngul btang nas ngang dkar gso skyong byas shing / rom gyi mi rnams kyis lo rer gser gyi ngang dka~X /ga

khur nas khrom skor byas te rjes dran byed/sge li dmag gis kha phe tho li btsan rdzong zla ba bdun tsam la bskor na'ang / de'i nang gi mi rnams la dka' ngal gyi mnar gcod du ma thebs la/than kha zas chad kyang btsan rdzong srung nas dpa' ma zhum/ rjes su sge li'i dmag la nad yams byung bas zhi gros bgyi bar yid mthun mi byung ka med byung / rgan gras gling gis gser phun sdi(20507)10)gyisge li'i tsho dpon la rngan du sprad pas da gzod de dag nom las bral nas phyir rang yul du phyin no//sge li pas btsan 'dzul gyis rom mkhar grong rtsa med du gtong la khad tsam byas/ rom yang pham pa chen po'i khrod bslab bya thob pa dang rom mkhar grong slar gso byas shing mkhar grong srung 'gog gi nus shugs kyang sra brtan du btang la/ nang khul gyi chab srid dang dmag don la yang bsgyur bcos rab 〉dri // pa byas nas rgyal khab kyi stobs shugs slar yang je che nas je cher 314

khe gyong gorwasdog ba'i phe ro si'i rgyal khas son hran/rom la sge li'i mis btsan rgol byas rjes/ nang khul bsgyur bcos byas pa brgyud nyams pa sor chud byas pas slar yang phyi rgya bskyed pa'i lam du song /spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs 4pa'i dkyil dang spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs 3pa'i mgo stod du/ rom gyi shar lho'i phyogs kyi sa smo ne (940)la dmag 'khrug thengs gsum brgyab nas de ga'i dmag don tsho pa'i mnyam 'brel gtor/ de'i 'phrorakha phyir 'khor nas byang phyogs su bskyod de sbo chu bzhur rgyud kyi lho yul dus sda la li a'i (7 74༅༅)mi'i sa cha yongs rdzogs blangs nas byang nas sbo chu'i bzhur rgyud dang lho phyogs su kha ne+e a'i ( rdo༅༅)byang mtshams la thon pa'i yul khongs chen po dbang du bsdus pas/ i ṭa li'i dkyil khul gyi 'go gtsor gyur/ de'i rjes su rom gyi nyin mtshan med par kha g.yar nas lho phyogs i ṭa li len thub na ci ma rung zhes khog rtsis rgyag bzhin 'dug lho phyogasa.i ṭa li dang bar du rgya mtshos bcad kyang phan tshun gdong bstan nas yod pa'i si si li a gling phran gyi shar phyogs ni snyi ri si'i gnas spor pa'i dbang 'og gi yul khongs yin stabs de'i ming la snyi ri si chen po miyang zer/ghi ri si pa de dag gis spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabasaḥpa nas bzung / snyi ri si chen po'i mtsho 'gram sa khul du mi ser spel yul gyi mkhar grong rgya chen por btsugs nas dbang sgyur byas pas/ de dag gi dpal 'byor dang chab srid lam 3sdu/sa/

thebs/ don de rom dang tha ren bum gnyis kyi dmag 'khrug gi 'byung gzhir gyur/ spyi lo sngon gyi 281lor rom gyi dmag dpung ni tha ren thum gyi mtha' mtshams su thon/ thog ma'i dmag 'khrug khrod tha ren thum gyi dmag dpung gis pham kha zos/ tha ren thum gyis rang gi stobs shugs rom dang 'gran thabasamed snyam nas/ mtsho'i pha rol gyi mna' 'brel pa ste e phi ru si'i(291753 7lo lo)rgyalapopha ro si(2712603 4༷ )la dmag rogs skyabs ༵ ṭī kū shis ni/ snyi ri si byang ma'i ri khul chen po zhig yin la de'i byang phyogs i ri le a dang sme se don la 'brel zhing / shar phyogs the si le a(16633118 tho lko/༅)dang nub phyogs e o ni a'i tsho khusgro mtsho dang thug yod/ yul de'i sdod mi tshang mas gtso bo 'brog las thon skyed gnyer ba red/ shod tshul ltar na/ e phi ru si ru ches snga mar tsho ba 14yod cing de dag gi mes po ni i ri le a'i (74lko/༅)mi dang rdo le a'i (lkolko/sgro)mi red zer/ smo ro si a'i (r+sā po༅)mi ni tsho ba de dag nang gi ru khag gtso bo yin/ spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs 4par tsho ba 'di'i 'go dpon gyis e phi ru si yongs la dbang bsgyur cing khyim mtshes sme se rdon dang gnyen sgrig nye tshan gyi 'brel ba bsgrigs nas stobs shugs je cher btang yod/ e phi ru si'i (lta ṣ+kalja sko6)ches skad grags can gyi rgyal po ni phe ro si(7ngoX spyi lo sngon gyi 319:sngon gyi 272lo'i bar)yin te/ khong ni e phi ru si'i rgyal po'i rgyud du 'khrungs shing sme se rdon gyi rgyal po'i khyim dang rgyang ring gnyen tshan yang yin/khong ni drag rtsal la spro zhing ham sems che/ shod rgyun la phe ro si lo na shin tu chung ba'i dus su sme se rdon rgyal po e legs gzan rdar gyi grogs po zhig gis khong la deng skabs kyi ches mchog gyur gyi 'thab jus pa su red ces dris tshe/phe ro si yis spobs pa'i ngang phe ro si yin te/ bdag nar son pa'i rdo1 snyi lta

red ces lan btab/ khong pho lo 26la thon dus rgyal por bzhugs pa dang/e phe ru si gcig pur dbang sgyur byas pas sems khongs ma tshim par phyi la btsan 'dzul byas te mnga' khongs rgya skyed par bsam blo gtong bzhin yod pas/ da lta nub kyi sa dbus rgya mtsho'i gnas bab des khong la go skabs yag po zhig bskrun/ tha ren thum gyi mis rom gyi dmag bkag 'gog byed ma thub pas phe ro si gdan drangs nas dmag rogs bos te rta dmag 2000dang rkang dmag 50300mngags nas khong la bkod 'doms gnang du 'jug rgyur khas len byas/ don de tag tag khong gi 'dod mos dang mthun pa byung bas/ go skabs de la bstun nas i ṭa li dang si si le a dbang du bsdus rjes shar phyogs su dmag drangs nas sbal khan(2mji ba)btul nas sa dbus rgya mtsho'i nub phyogs yongs su 'du ba'i btsan rgyal zhig btsugs nas 'thor zin pa'i shar phyogs a li sge shan sder btsan rgyal chen mo'i tshab bya rtsis yod/spyi lo sngon gyi 280lo'i lo mgor phe ro si yis sku dngos su sbyong brdar yag po thob pa'i rkang dmag 2)tshe dang the sa le a'i (tshe lko/༅)rta dmag 303)dang / mda' gzhu ba 207dang / mdung 'phen mkhan 500steng glang po che 20khrid de a sde li a rgya mtsho 'phred du bcad nas i ṭa li ru phebs/khong gi dmag dpung ni glas dmag yin pa'i thog rgya mtshor brgal ba'i skabs su mtsho rlung drag por 'phrad pas god ka che na'ang / rtsa 'dzugs dang dmag chas shin tu legs po red/ da dung ched du sbyong brdar byas pa'i dpung 'jug byed kyi glang po che 20dmag mi rkang thang pa zhig gis khrid cing rgyab tu dmag mi bzhi yar langs nas lag tu mdung ring thog pas gdung mchong byas na bar shugs shin tu che/ de ni nom la thengs dang por 'phrad pa'i stobs shugs can gyi dgra bo yin no//31sbya ro si i ṭa li ru thon pa dang tha ren thum gyi mi rnams ma dga' rung kho

tshor dmag sbyong nan po byed du bcug rjes su tha ren thum lho phyogs kyi he ra khi le a mkhar(5077168 khrims/lko)'og tu phe ro si yis dmag dpung khrid de rom gyi dmag dpung la thengs dang por drag tu 'thab/ 'thab la mkhas shing dpa' ngar che ba'i rom gyi dmag mi la pho ri si thengs7la phar rgol byas kyang phan tshun gyi rgyal pham 'dra mnyam byung / gnad 'gag gi skabs der phe ro si la 'tshab 'tshub med par brtan brling sgos rta dmag la ngar gyis phar rgol dang zhor du glang po che rnams g.yul du zhugs dgos pa'i bka' phab/rom gyi dmag rtas glang po che 'dra ba'i srog chags chen po mthong ma myong bas 'jigs skrag chen po skyes pas mtsher ba dang mchong ste yar mar bros pas rta gong ma non pa rnams brdzis nas sha khrag tu bsgyur/ skabs de dang bstun nas phe ro si yis drag tu phar rgol byas pas rom dmag gis pham kha chen po zos/shod tshul la thengs 'di'i dmag 'khrug nang rom gyi dmag70)ar shi rmas thebs pa dang 2030lhag 'dzin bzung byas/ phe ro si la'ang gyong kha chen po byung bas dmag mi 4000la shi rmas thebs zer/rom la he ri khi le a ru pham kha myong bas/ kho tshos i ṭa li lho phyogs kyi go gnas la ngan rkyen chen po btang / mkhar grong mang po zhig phe ro si'i mnga' 'og tu zhugs pa dang yang na rom las bral nas rang btsan byas/ phe ro si yis rgyal kha dang bstun rom gyi phyogs su bskyod de drangs mor rom dang spyi le bcu phrag yod pa'i yul du dmag sgar brgyab/ yin na'ang rom gyi gnya' ma bsgur par/ he ra khi le a ru pham pa'i dmag dpung yang bskyar rtsa 'dzugasadang kha snon byas/ rom gyi rgan gras gling gis da dung 661 0 lnga 01 (sdi khi tha thor 7ma zazhes pa sger gcod dpon po)bsko bzhag byas nas rom gyi mkhar grong srung du bcug sdi khi tha thor ni skabs thog tu bkod sgrig byas pa'i dmigs bsal go gnas sheg yin la/ rom la glo bur du do/ spyan

byung tshe/ rgan gras gling gis bka' phab nas srid skyong dpon po gnyis kyi nang gi gcig gis go gnas 'di'i 'gan 'khur dgos/ sdi khi tha thor gyis dmag dpung gi bkod 'doms dbang cha dang dmangs srid dbang cha gnyis rang gi lag tu gcig lcog tu bzung zhing des srid skyong bzhin pa'i dus su(lo phyed las brgal mi rung)mi su yin yang de'i bkod 'doms brtsi dgos pas sus kyang ngo rgol bgyi mi chog pa red/ phe ro sis gnas tshul de lta bu'i 'og tu rom la phar rgol byas na nyen kha che ba gsal thag chod pa rtogs pa'i steng kha phu a(28957 7504)sogs mkhar grong rom la dga' zhing rogs ram byed pas/ phyir tha ren thum du log nas dgun gtong bar phebs/ dus mtshungs su khong gis pho nya mngags nas rom dang zhi gros byas/ nom gyi gon gras gling gis gros sol nan tan byas rjes/ phe ro si i ṭa li ru sdod pas na gtan nas zhi gros mi bya bar thag gcod byas/ de nas bzung phe ro si dang rom gnyis kyi bar pho nya mngags nas phan tshun gyis 'dzin bzung byas pa'i bzung dmag glod 'grol btang yang mjug mthar gros mthun ma byung ba red/phyi lo ste spyi lo sngon gyi 279lo'i zla 4par phe ro sis slar yang dmag dpung khrid de nom la phar rgol byas te/ tha ren thum gyi nub byang a si khu lum(230757 ༅lo67)grong khyer gyi nye 'dabs nas dmag 'khrug thengs gnyis pa brgyab/ rom gyis dmag mi khri)bsdus pa ma zad da dung dmigs bsal can gyi dmag 'thab shing rta'i rigs bzos/ de'i steng zo ba'i thab ka dang mdung ring yod cing da dung glang po che dang 'thab pa'i go chas kyang yod/ nom gyi mis glang po che mer skrag pa shes nas da gzod drag chas de lta bzos/ rom gyi dmag gis bdams pa'i g.yul ra yang kho tshor phan khe che ste/ de ni nags tshaX ༵ ba'i sgang gshongs shig yin pas/ phe ro si yi mdung thog dmag dpung

dang rta dmag dang glang chen dmag gis nus shugs 'don rgyu shin tu dka'/de'i phyir dmag 'thab pa'i nyin dang por rom la rgyal kha thob/ yin na'ang phyi nyin phe ro si yis thabs mkhas po'i ngang rom gyi dmag dpung nags tshal las phyir thang chen du khrid pas na/ khong gis tshags dam pa'i mdung thogs dmag dpung dang glang po che'i dmag bkol spyod byed thub pa byung bas/ rom gyi dmag gis shugs phud pa'i thabs bral rkyen phe ro si la rgyal kha thob/thengs 'di'i dmag 'khrug nang phan tshun la gyong gud chen po thebs te/rom gyi phyogs nas mi 6000lhag gi gyong kha phog cing de'i nang kho tsho'i srid skyong dpon po sde khi yu si'i ( ma mo/yang rang srog shor/ phe ro si'i phyogs dmag mi 5000lhag la shi rmas thebs shing de'i nang phe ri si yi snying grogs dang dmag dpon du ma 'du/ de lta na phe ri si'i gyong kha chen po zos zos tu a si khu lum (slo146shāstatshe'i)dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha blangs stabs/ dmag 'khrug gi mjug rdzogs pa'i dus su phe ri si rang nyid rgyal kha thob par dga' spro ci yang ma skyes par yid skyo ba'i ngang / gal te da dung 'di lta bu'i rgyal kha thengs gcig blangs tshe bdag gi dmag dpung tshar 'gro ba dang su yang bdag dang mnyam du phyir e phi ru si la log thabs med ces zer/ dus de bzung nub phyo/the trī kra // /sbyi sdob pa la yid gdung zhing khe gyong go ldog gi rgyal kha laphe ri si thengs gnyis la rom gyi dmag las rgyal na yang / khong ni rgyal kha bed skyod byed mkhas pa'i mi zhig min/ rom gyis spyi lo sngon gyi 279lor mgyogs myur du khar ṭha sgo((87 62607〈chad lta'i thu ne si'i (477)shar byang du yod pa)dang mnyam gcig tu phe ri si la ngo rgol byed pa'i mna' 'brel chings yig bzhag nas stobs shugs je cher btang / rjes su khar ṭha sgo yis si si li a'i sgo ri si'i mkhar grong si ra khu se(5713054mkhrisnro1)la

dmag drangs/ si ra khu se yis phe ro si la dmag rogs bgyi dgos pa'i re ba zhus pas spyi lo sngon gyi 278lor phe ro si i ṭa li dang bral nas si si li a ru phebs nas khar ṭha sgo dang dmag 'khrug brgyab/ de ni jus nor zhig yin pas rom la dbugs len ngal gso'i dus skabs shig sbyin pas/ dmag shugs dang mkho dngos la kha gsab brgyab nas mgyogs por lho phyogs i ṭa li'i grong khyer mang po phab nas phe ro si dang 'thab rgyur gra sgrig byas/phe ro si yis si si li a ru lo gsum la dmag 'khrug brgyab pa dang 'bras bu gcig kyang ma lon pa'i thog rang dgar gcig gcod byas shing dmag gi sgrig lam mi dam pas/ snyi ri si'i mi rnams ha cang ma dga' ba red/de nas cung ma 'gor bar tha ren thum la nyen kha byung bas khong rang sbyi lo sngon gyi 275lor phyir i ṭa li ru ma log ka med byung / sam rnam(bya sku 157 9cholko)gyi spe ne wen thum(200050ba 57 ༅khutshom)ru rom gyi dmag dpung dang mthar mjug gi dmag 'khrug brgyab/ rom gyi dmag 'thab shing rta'i steng nas gtor ba'i me thal gyis phe ri si'i glang po che la drag tu rgol bas/glang po che ni 'drog nas kha phyir 'khor nas bros te rang gi dpung nang brgyugs nas gnod pa chen po bzos/ thengs 'dir phe ro si la gyong gud chen po byung bas/ i ṭa li btang nas phyir ghi ri si ru mi 'gro thabs med byung / lo gsum gyi rjes su phe ro si ni ghi ri si'i ar sgo si mkhar grong(21303 ma mo)du sung lam dmag 'thab cig gi nang dgra dang 'thab pas tshe las 'das/snyan grags dgongs su khyab pa'i phe ro si yi dmag dpung ni i ṭa li ru rom gyi dmag gis cham la pham par rgyu rkyen mang po yod kyang / gtso bo ni rom la dmag don rtsa 'dzugs yag po yod pa dang / spyi dmangs dmag dpung ni zhing chung las grub la/ ru sde ltar du bsgrigs pas yong khungs mang zhing sgrig ladī ༵༵na pas dmag 'thab kyi stobs shugs ni phe ro si'i sgrig lam zhan zhing

glas pa'i dmag mi las che ba smos med red/ phe ro si la mtshon na khong ni ham sems che ba'i nyen mchong pa zhig las ma 'das pas/ khong la dmag don phyogs kyi blo gros yod kyang chab srid dang 'thab rtsod kyi thabs jus zhan la/nga rgyal dang gdug rtsub che stabs/ mna' 'brel pa dang mthun sgrig bgyi mi mkhas pas rom gyi mdun nas pham kha chen po zos pa red/phe ro si tshe las 'das pa'i lo ste spyi lo sngon gyi 272lor rom gyis tha ren thum 'du ba'i lho phyogs i ṭa li dbang 'og tu bsdus/ lo kha shas 'gor rjes da dung rang btsan tshul du gnas pa'i tsho ba dag gis ngo rgol byas pa med par btang nas/ spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs gsum pa'i dkyil du nom gyis i ṭa li gling phran phyed ka gcig gyur byas nas sa dbus rgya mtsho'i rgyal khab stobs shugs can zhig tu gyur nas si si li a gling phran bzung ba'i khar ṭha sgo dang do zla'i tshul du gnas shing / rgyal khab de gnyis btsan 'dzul byed par shin tu dga' bas phan tshun ma rung bar dgra zla la gyur to/323

nyan ne sgal gyis rom thil gyis mnan pa/wa wapho de'i dmag 'khrug gnyis pa/spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs gsum par/ sa dbus rgya mtsho'i nub khul yul du rgya mtsho'i 'gram gnyis su bran g.yog lam lugs kyi rgyal khab chen po gnyis yod/ gcig ni a h+phe ri kha byang ma'i khar ṭha sgo(687 6820༅〈6)yinal/cig shos ni i ṭa li'i gling phran phyed ku'i steng gi rom(507075)red/khar ṭha sgo yi mis rgyal khab btsugs nas lo brgya phrag du ma'i lo rgyus yod cing /kho tshos mes po h+phe ne+e khe a'i mi yi rgya mtshor skyod pa'i nyams myong rgyud 'dzin byas nas/ mgyogs shing yang ba'i g.yor gru spyad de mtsho steng tshong las gnyer bzhin yod pas/ sa dbus rgya mtsho'i nub khul yongs su thon pa dang tha na gi sbi ra thar(61 678 872lo796)mtsho 'gag brgal nas phyi phyogs su rgya bskyed/ kho tsho thon pa'i yul du mtsho thog skyod par phan khe yod tshe btsan bzung byas nas tshong las gnas gzhi'i sa khul byed/ dus yun ring po 'gor ba dang sa khul de dag tshong las mi ser spel yul du bsgyur/ spyir bshad na/'byor phyug ldan pa'i si si li a'i gling phran/ khor se gling phran/(6073614khroza)sar bden gling phran(3876605lo1)nas i sbi li a'i chagalko11gling phran phyed ma'i(se phan du yod pa)'gram rgyud kyi rgya che ba'i mcho khongs ni dus rabs 'ga' yi ring ha lam khar ṭha sgo yis khor 'dzin byas yod/ khar ṭha sgo srid gzhung gis rang gi thob zin pa'i khe phan la srung skyob bya ched dmag gru ru khag chen po btsugs shing khyim mtshes rgyal khab nang de la do zla 'ongs pa gardi/ 4kyang med/ yin na'ang / dus bzang gi yun ma ring par dus rabs

gsum pa'i dkyil du rom gyi mis 'gran zla med pa'i sgo nas i ṭa li gcig gyur btang bas/ stobs 'byor che zhing gzhan la ham sems bcangs pa'i rom zhes pa zhig khar ṭha sgo yi gdong khar langs/ phe ro si dang dmag 'khrug brgyab pa'i dus su rom dang khar ṭha sgo gnyis mnyam 'brel byed myong yang dmag 'khrug gi mjug rdzogs pa dang rgyal khab stobs ldan de gnyis kyis 'bru rigs g.yur za zhing mkhar grong du ma yod pa'i si si li a gling phran 'phrog rtsod byas shing de'i 'phror nub kyi sa dbus rgya mtsho'i dbang cha bcod nas dgra bor gyur pas/ mthar mjug khyod shi nga gson gyi 'khrug chen zhig rgyag dgos byung / nom gyi mis h+phe ne khe a'i mi la pho no(20601 boṣ+ṭha)zer bas dmag 'khrug 'di la lo rgyus steng pho ne'i dmag 'khrug zer zhiji snga gzhug thengs gsum la brgyab pa red/ spyi lo sngon gyi 2yolo nas sngon gyi 241lo'i bar du rom dang khar ṭha sgo gnyis kyi lo ngo 20tsam la pho ne+e dmag 'khrug thengs dang po brgyab par khar ṭha sgo pham pas si si li a sogs sa khul shor ba'i steng rom la 'jal chings dngul 'bor chen 'jal/ 'on kyang de ni thengs dang po'i 'gran bsdur yin te phan tshun gnyis kyis ngar ngar phad phad sgos da dung 'thab rgyur sta gon byed kyin 'dug ram gyis shugs gang yod kyis mtsho dmag dar spel byas nas khar ṭha sgo yi mgo gnon dgos snyam/ khar ṭha sgo yis kyang rom la dgra sha bcod de rgya mtsho'i steng gi sngar yod khe phan la srung skyob byed dgos 'dod/de bas na dmag 'khrug 'di ngo bo'i steng bshad na gcig kyang drang bden gyi dmag 'khrug cig ma yin no//spyi lo sngon gyi 237lor khar ṭha sgo yis phugs thag ring ba'i 'char gzhi zhig bkod pa ni 'di lta ste/ dmag dpon chen po ha mel khar sbar kha(55711231 28107 5skolotsā )yis dmag sde skor zhig khrid de se sdu/ gyi

shar lho'i mtsho 'gram sa khul bzung pa dang / yul de'i phun sum tshogs pa'i rang byung thon rdzas dang 'thab jus thog gi go gnas spyad de rom la ngo rgol byed pa'i dmag don gnas gzhi btsugs/ khong gi lo na dgu can gyi bu han nasbal(5thabs1 khyim tsho༅7)yang khong dang mnyam du de ru phebs/ shod rgyun du ha mel khar gyis bu hal ne sbal mes po'i mchod stegs mdun du khrid de ji srid bar du rom gyi dgra zla bgyi rgyu dam bca' 'jog tu bcug zer/ ha melakhar sbar kha yis se phan du lo dgu tsam dbang 'dzin mkhan byas mthar yul de'i i sbe li an sa r+sālko1ṣ+ṭhagyi mis bkrongs/ de'i rgyud 'dzin mkhan ni khong tshang gi mag pa ha si sdi ru sbal(5474nem ṣ+ṭha ༅)zhes pa yin zhing des glas dmag mang po bsdus pa ma zad mtsho 'gram du grong khyer gsar pa zhig btsugs pa'i ming la khar ṭha sgo gsar pa zhes btags cing stobs shugs kyi khyab khongs e bhi ro(2670 077)gtsang po'i bar du slebs yod/ spyi lo sngon gyi 221lor ha si sdi ru sbal gzhan gyis lkog gsod byas/ chung ngu'i dus nas bzung dmag 'khrug nang sbyong brdar thob pa'i lo na 25thon pa'i han ne sbal gyis dmag don dbang cha bzung / khong la 'gyur med kyi gshis ka dang bkod 'doms kyi blo gros ldan pas dmag mi tshos gus bkur thob pa red/rom gyi dbang sgyur pa tshos khar ṭha sgo'i mi'i se phan gyi spyod tshul la dngangs skrag dang dogs zon byed kyi 'dug spyi lo sngon gyi 226lor rom gyi 'thus tshab kyis ha si sdi ru sbal dang sa mtshams gcod pa'i phyogs gros mol byas nas/ khar ṭha sgo yi dmag dpung e bhi ro gtsang po las brgal mi chog pa byas shing don dngos su e bhi ro gtsang bo'i lho rgyud khar ṭha sgo yis dbang 'og tu 'du bar khas blangs/ yin na'ang gtsang po'i lho phyogs mtsho 'gram mkhar grong sa sgrun thum(5865ba 57 777)ni tag tag kha rom la phyogs pas kha 36 sgo'i do zlar langs/ spyi lo sngon gyi 219lor han ne sbal gyis sa sgun

thum blangs shing / nom gyis the gtogs byas rung han ne+e sbal gyi khas ma blangs/ spyi lo sngon gyi 218lor nom gyi rgan gras gling gis khar ṭha sgo la g.yul slong ba'i dmag brda btang bas pho ne'i dmag 'khrug thengs gnyis pa'i 'go brtsams so//rom gyi re ba ltar na/ dmag 'khrug 'di se phan kho nar rgyag pa'am yang nas h+phe ri kha ru rgyag pa las i ṭa li ru dmag 'khrug ma brgyab na bzang snyam/yin na'ang kho rang tshos khog rtsis rgyag nor song ba red/ bla na med pa'i dmag don mkhas pa han ni sbal gyis lag snga rtsod pa'i 'thab jus bkol nas i ṭa li ru dmag drangs te/ rom gyi dmag dpung rang srung bgyi ba'i gnas su mi lhung ka med byung / lo de'i dbyar kha han ne+e sbal gyis rkang dmag 5mi57dang rta dmagami47dang glang po che —bcu lhag khrid de khar ṭha sgo gsar pa nas dmag skyod pa'i lam du chas/ lam bar du ri bo dang chu bo du ma brgyud pa dang dka' ngal tshad med myangs/ sge li'i lho phyogs brgyud pa'i skabs yul sdod pa rnams kyi 'jab rgol gang mang thebs/ khyad par du ston mjug tu nam yang kha bas bzung ba'i al phe si ri bor brgal ba'i skabs su dka' khag de las lhag par 'phrad pas dmag mi dang dmag rta mang po shi bas mthar mjug rkang dmag 20000dang rta dmag 6000dang glang chen 'ga' las ma lhaga'on kyang gyong gud chen po myangs rjes han rna sbal gyi dmag dpung glo bur du yis li byang ma'i sbo chu thang chen du slebs pas rom gyi mi ngo mtshar cing kha gdangs mig cer du ha las te ci byed gang byed med par gyur/ de nas han ne sbal ni sbo chu thang chen du ngal gso dang dag ther bgyi zhor dgun kha btang la/ rom la ngo rgol byed pa'i yul de'i sge li pa bsdus nas dmag dpung la kha gsab brgyab te sbo chur brgal nas rom gyi dmag dang 'thab 'go brtsams/de ni dmag 'khrug chen po zhig yin te spyi lo sngon gyi 217lo'i zla 6sdu/ thi

ra si sme nu si(11—17005bya khrimachiglo)mtshe'u 'gram du g.yul 'gyed pa red/ tan ne+e sbal gyis sa btsan sa ngar 'dzin bgyi ched nyin bzhi zhag gsum la na 'dam sa khul chen po zhig brgal/ de ru chu'i gting zab pas dmag mi rnams kyis rta ro'i steng ngal gso dang gros bsdur bya dgos byung / mi rta mang po shi ba dang glang po che yang gcig las ma lus pa'i steng han ne sbal rang nyid kyis mig gcig kyang shor ba red/ de lta byung yang han ni sbal gyis mtshe'u 'gram gyi ri chung chung zhig gi steng du yib sgug byas/ rom gyi dmag gi dmag dpon chen po ni sge u si h+pho la smi ne (༅:gi lkoṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha7)yin zhing kho'i dmag dpung mtshe'u dang ri gnyis bar gyi sa dog mo zhig tu bgrod pa'i dus han ne sbal gyi dmag dpung glo bur du mchong 'ongs nas 'thab pas rom gyi dmag dpung ha lam rtsa med du bzos/ rom gyi dmag mi mang po mtshe'u nang du ded de chu nang du shi ba dang h+pho la smi ne+e kyang dmag 'khrug nang 'thab nas rang srog shor/ dmag 'khrug 'di'i rom la ha las su bcug pas/ rom gyi mis mgyogs myur du 'gog srung 'dzing rags la shugs snon byas nas rom mkhar grongasang skyob byed pa'i gra sgrig byas mod kyang / han ne sbal gyis thad kur rom gyi phyogs la dmag ma drangs par shar khul a sde li a mtsho 'gram brgyud lho phyogs su bskyod de/ thon thon sa ru rom gyi mna' mthun pa tshor rom las kha bral dgos pa'i bslab bya btang nas/ khong ni i ṭa li yi bcings 'grol mkhan yin zhes bshad/ de ni han ne sbal gyis rom kher rkyang du phud pa'i thabs jus shig red/ 'on kyang rom gyi mna' mthun pa mang shas kyis mtha' 'bras gang 'dra yong bar bsgugs pa dang rgyu mtshan ni de dag tan ne sbal gyis mtha' mjug gi rgyal kha len thub min la dogs pa skyes pas red/thi ra si me nu si mtshe'u 'gram gyi dmag 'khrug des rom gyi rang rlom dang rardo sdusar la rdung deg chen po thebs pas/ srol rgyun gyi thabs bkol nas sdi

bshams nas lo rgyus steng khan ne dmag 'khrug tu 'bod pa'i 'go btsams pa red/ dmag 'khrug de la zhugs pa'i rom gyi dmag dpung la rkang dmag8'tshe dang rta dmag 6000yod cing / khar ṭha sgo'i phyogs nas rkang dmag 4000snyodang rta dmag 10000tsam dmag 'khrug nang zhugs/ tan ne sbal gyis dmag dpung ni gzhu'i dbyibs su bstar bsgrigs nas stobs zhan rnams dkyil du bzhag nas sna 'bur du thon nas sngon du skyod pa dang dmag dpung go hrag g.yas g.yon la bkod cing rta dmag de'i mtha' ru bstar nas bskor bcom byed pa'i 'thab jus spyad/ 'thab 'dzing gi 'go brtsams tsa na nom dmag gi khar ṭha sgo'i dkyil bstar dmag dpung la ngar gyis rgol pas de dag ni dus dang bstun nas phyir 'then pa dang chabs cig tu g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi mdun du bskyod(gzhu dbyibs go ldog par grub)pa dang rta dmag gis kyang mtha' gnyis nas rom gyi rta dmag la drag rgol byas pas rom gyi dmag dpung dam por bskor pas/ rom gyis dpung mdun ma zing zing long long du gyur nas ngar nus 'don ma thub par khar ṭha sgo'i dmag gi drag rdung 'og 'phral du 'thab 'dzing gi nus shugs shor/ mthar mjug khar ṭha sgo'i dmag dpung gi tsha 'ded drag rdung 'og nom gyi dmag mi mang che ba'i tshe srog shor/ dmag mi 10000lhag gson bzung byas shing kha shas la lung bros nas shor/ dmag dpon pha'u lu si'i (thu lo)rang srog btang ba dang wa ro (77)ni bros nas thar/ han ne sbal la dmag mi 6000lhag gi gyong gud thebs/ khan rna ru pham nyes tshabs chen myong ba'i don de rom mkhar grong nang khyab pa dang gnam la sprin phug ron tsam yang med par thog sta re 'dra tsam zhig bab 'dra'i 'jigs snang bskul bas/ 'jigs snang ma yal gong gi nom gyi rgan gras gling gis nyen kha'i dza drag dus kyi thabs jus spyad de lo ngo 17la slebs pa'i spyi da~X yongs dmag nang zhugs dgos pa dang / rgyal khab kyis ma dngul

btang nas bran g.yog skor zhig nyos nas dpung sde gnyis bsgrigs/ thabs jusagazhug mar bltas tshe rom gyi bran bdag tsho dka' gnas ci 'dra zhig tu lhung yod pa shes thub/khan ne+e dmag 'khrug gi rjes su rom gyis i ṭa li ru dbang sgyur byed pa'i go gnas la g.yo 'gul byung ste/ 6 mna' mthun pa mang po rom la bral nas han rna sbal gyi phyogs su langs/ de'i nang rom lho phyogs kyi kham phe rna a'i((3793ba18mo ༅༅)mkhar grong chen po kha phu a(28957me'i:rdzo12)yang 'du/ si si li a'i gling phran steng ‘gi mkhar grong si ra khu se(57170536 65rnye1shākya) yangaza 7 0 yis tan ne+e sbal la rgyab skyor bgyi rgyu byas/ rom ni nyen gnas 'di lta bu da lta'i bar du byung ma han ne+e sbal/myong la/ kho tshos nges par du gnas tshul dngos la bsam gzhig yang dag byas nas/ gting thag gcod pa'i dmag 'thab mi rgyag par stobs shugs bsags te dmag mi'i sems shugs slar gso byas thog skabs btsal nas phar rgol byed dgos pa red/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas i ṭa li la rgyab 'gal byasapa'i mi rnams la chad pa snying rje med par bcad de mna' mthun pa mirnams han ne sbal gyi phyogs su mi langs pa bya dgos/ spyi lo sngon gyi 212lor rom gyi dmag gis kham thu a mkhar grong la dpung 'jug byas/ kham phu a la nyen kha tshabs chen byung bas han ne+e sbal la dmag rogs bgyi dgos pa'i brda brgyab/ han ne+e sbal gyis kham phu a bskor ba'i rom gyi dmag phyir 'dren ched skabs shig thad kur rom la dmag drangs pas/ rom gyi mi rnams 'jigs snangatshad med skyes te kha nas han ne sbal khyim sgor slobs song zhesdu spyad

brgyab te mtha' mjug gi shi dus thon pa lta bu'i snang tshul bstan/ 'on kyang han ne+e sbal gyis thad gar rom la phar rgol ma byas la de ni rom gyi 'gog srung shin tu brtan pas yin yang srid/ cis kyang don rkyen des rom gyi mi la 'jigs skrag chen po bskul bas/ shod tshul la khan ne+e dmag 'khrug mjug bsgril nas lo zla du ma 'gor rjes pha ma tshos phru gu ngu ba'i skabs su han ne+e sbal khyim sgor thon song zhes skrag bslangs nas ngu skad gcod pa red zer/ rom gyi dbang sgyur pas kham phu a blangs rjes gtor brlag dang dmar gsod byas rjes yul de'i sdod mi mang po bran g.yog tu btsong / ha lam dus mtshungs su rom gyi si ra khu se la dmag drangs nas dmar gsod brgyab pas tshan rig pa ar khi smi sde si yang bkrongs/ de lta na rom gyis rang la rgyab 'gal byas zin pa'am yang na bgyi snyam pa'i i ṭa li'i mi dang si si li a'i mi la sus han ne sbal dang mnyam 'brel byas tshe mjug 'bras yag po med pa'i tha tshig bsgrags pas/ tan ne+e sbal gyis rom khor rkyang du phud pa'i re ba stong zad du song /dmag 'khrug gi dus yun je ring la song ba dang glas dmag zad gron dmag 'thab dang yun ring dmag 'thab la mi mkhas pa phyir mngon pa dang / 'thab la mkhas pa'i nom gyi dmag gi stobs shugs rim bzhin slar gso byas pas/dmag 'khrug de ni khar ṭha sgo la gnod pa che ba'i phyogs su 'khor/spyi lo sngon gyi 210lor rom gyis rang 'gul sgos si khe phi o(206553khuXngs0553 410 41910 lkotsho mor+shakhri )la dmag dpung skor zhig khrid du bcug nas se phan la phar rgol byas shing / phyi lor khar ṭha sgo gsar pa blangs pas tan ne+e sbal gyi gnas gzhi sa khul shor ba red/ khong gis khar ṭha sgo'i rang yul nas dmag rogs bgyi bar re ba bcangs kyang khar ṭha sgo'i srid 'dzin sku drag tshos han ne sbal la phrag dog byas nas khong la dbang che drag na kha swā sdur mi thub par snyam nas han ne+e sbal la kha ya ma byas/ han ne+e sbal gyis

rang gi gcung po la dmag rogs byed du mi 'jug ka med byung yang / gcung pos se phan nas dmag dpung zhig khrid nas i ṭa li'i byang khul du slebs pa rom gyi dmag gis rtsa med du btang / de las lhag pa'i gnas tshul ngan pa zhig la si khe phi os mo ṣ+ṭha khrid pa'i dmag dpung sum khri a h+phe ri khar rgyang skyod du song nas spyi lo sngon gyi 24lor u thi kha(pu 1 07 67 6)nas skam sar thon pas na/ khar ṭha sgo'i sku drag rnams la 'jigs skrag dang 'tshab cha skyes nas han ne+e sbal phyir log nas rom gyi dmag dpung 'gog dgos pa'i bka' bskur/ tan ne sbal gyi dgra bo'i rgyal khab tu lo 15la 'phred gzhung kun tu dmag 'thab la zhugs kyang mthar thug skyo gdung dang khong khro nyis 'dres su rgya mtsho'i steng nas phyir khar ṭha sgo la mi log ka med byung / spyi lo sngon gyi 202lor rdza ma'i(2847 266)nye 'dabs kyi gting thag gcod pa'i dmag 'khrug brgyab pas khar ṭha sgo pham song pa red/ de ni han ne sbal gyi pham kha dang po yin la ches mjug mthar gyi pham pa yang red/ phyi lo khar ṭha sgo yis brnyas bcos myong ba dang 'grig chags dka' ba'i zhi ba'i chings yig khas len byas pas phu ne dmag 'khrug thengs gnyis pa'i mjug rdzogs la/dus de nas bzung khar ṭha sgo yis rgya mtsho'i steng gi rgyal khab stobs ldan gyi go gnas shor bas/ rom ni nub khul sa dbus rgya mtsho'i bdag por gyur/han ne sbal phyir rgyal nang du phebs rjes sku drag dbang cha can chos phyir 'bud thebs rkyen spyi lo sngon gyi 195lor si ri a ru bros bshol du phebs/ da dung rom la dgra sha rtsod rgyu ma brjed par si ri a'i rgyal po la an thi sgo nu sku rabs gsum par rom la ngo rgol byed mkhan rgya chen po rtsa 'dzugs byas nas i ṭa li la phar rgol bgyi ba'i re ba zhus kyang rgyal po des dang len ma byas/ spyi lo sngon gyi 183lor han ne sbal rom gyis ded pas thabs zad de a she ya chung ba'i yul zhig tu 'khon sems yid du bcas nas rang srog bcad do// 333

han ne+e sbal shi nas lo ngo 34'gor ba dang rom gyis gdug rtsub sgos thengs gsum pa'i phu ne+e dmag 'khrug(spyi lo sngon gyi 149lo:sngon gyi 146lo)bslangs nas khar ṭha sgo rtsa ba nas med par bzos shing de'i mnga' khongs rom gyi4a h+phe ri kha zhing chen du bsgyur/ shul lus pa mang shas bran g.yog tu gyur/dus de nas bzung khar ṭha sgo zhes pa'i rang btsan gyi rgyal khab cig gtan nas med par gyur to/ 334

khi rakhu du nu gnyis kyibazurabacos/ku'u zhu'e ce/phu ne dmag 'khrug nas bzung / rom ni sa dbus rgya mtsho'i btsan bdag tu gyur/ rom grong khyer ni i ṭa li'i grong khyer ches che shos yin pa ma zad rom spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi chab srid kyi lte gnas su gyur yod/ skabs der rom gyi bran g.yog bdag po'i lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs la dus yun ring por gab sdod du gnas pa'i 'gal ba sna tshogs phyir gsal por mngon 'ongs/dang po bran g.yog dang bran bdag gi bar gyi 'gal ba yin la/ gnyis pa ni miser dkyus ma dang(gtso bo zhing chung ston pa)phyug po chen po'i bar gyi 'gal ba red/ gsum pa ni dbang du bsdus pa'i mi dang dbang du bsdu mkhan gyi mi gnyis bar gyi 'gal ba yin zhing / bzhi ba ni dbang sgyur gral rim nang khul gyi 'gal ba red/ 'gal ba de dag mnyam du bsres pa dang phan tshun shugs rkyen bzhag pas spyi tshogs kyi gral rim 'thab rtsod ni dza drag dang rnyog 'dzing che ba'i tshad cig tu thon yod/spyi lo sngon gyi 137lor/ rom gyi 'bru mdzod khang du 'bod pa'i si si li a gling phran du bran g.yog gis 'os langs byas/ thengs 'di'i 'os langs la spyi lo sngon gyi 132lor rom gyi dmag dpung gis drag gnon byas mod kyang /'os langs des sa dbus rgya mtsho'i sa khul la shugs rkyen chen po bzhag zan g.yog gis 'os langs byas pa dang dus mtshungs su i ṭa li'i zhing bas ༵༵ sa

zhing rtsod len gyi las 'gul bslangs/ yun ring por phyi la dmag 'khrug brgyab pas rgya che ba'i zhing ba tsho dmag tu zhugs nas sgorang yul dang bral nas yul gzhan du 'gro dgos byung stabs sa zhing spang rgod du lus pa ma zad bran g.yog lam lugs kyi gzhis ku'i bar 'gran rtsod dang phyir phud byas rkyen zhing pa mang po'i khyim gzhi 'thor pas/ kho tsho'i sa zhing bran bdag chen po chos btsan sgril byas/ si si li a'i 'os langs byas nas cung ma 'gor bar rom gyi 'bru rigs kyi rin gong je mthor song bas mi dmangs kyi 'tsho bar dka' sdug chen po byung / khyim gzhi 'thor ba'i zhing khyim chung ba tshos sa zhing btsan sgril la ngo rgol byas nas/ slar yang sa zhing thob dgos pa'i re ba nan zhu byas pa ma zad/ da dung re ba de kha dbyangs kyi tshul du dur rdo'i ngos dang lha khang /bzo bkod mang po'i gyang ngor bris/ rom gyi dmag zhabs bca' khrims kyi thag gcod ltar na/ zhing chung la rgyal khab kyi ched du dmag tu zhugs pa'i 'os 'gan yod pas/ de dag ni nom dmag dpung gi yong khungs gtso bo red/dmag la zhugs pa'i mi yis nges par du rang gis gyon chas dang go cha gra sgrig bya dgos/ zhing pa mang po'i khyim gzhi 'thor bas/ kho tsho dmag tu zhugs pa'i nus pa med stabs rom gyi dmag shugs kyang je zhan du song pas/ rom gyi bran bdag gral rim gyi dbang sgyur la nyen kha byung ngo //gnas bab de la dmigs nas dbang sgyur gral rim nang gi mig rgyang ring ba'i mi kha shas la/ nges par du bsgyur bcos byas nas spyi tshogs 'gal ba je lhod du gtong pa'i bsam tshul byung / skabs der bsam blo de 'dra ldan pa'i chab srid pa dang bsgyur bcos pa mang po byung zhing / de'i nang ches skad grags che ba ni thi spe ru si khi ra khu si(11 ye053 507970ba103 6188603chag lkoṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭhasbyi lo sngon gyi 163lo :sngon gyi 132lo)dang sge'u si khi ra khu si(shā/303504910ba103077060347 choṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha)phu nu gnyis yin no//

thi sbe ru si dang sge'u si gnyis ni pha ma gcig gi phu nu yin zhing sku drag gi khyim du 'khrungs bas/ chung ba'i dus nas bzung ghi ri si'i rig gnas kyi bag chags bzang po thebs yod/ ghi ri si'i bran g.yog bdag po'i dmangs gtso'i chab srid dang spyi dmangs kyi 'dra mnyam bcas kyi bsam blos kyang khong gnyis la shugs rkyen zab mo bzhag yod/ na chung dus su phu nu gnyis rgyun dus zhing bsgyur bcos dang zhing chung dpal 'byor nyams gso'i gsang pa'i chab srid tshogs khag bar 'brel ba byung myangs/ thi sbi ru si khi ra khu si ni a h+phe ri kha byang ma ru se phan la brgyab pa'i dmag 'khrug nang zhugs myong bas dmag shugs kyi gnad don phyogs la tshor shes rnon po byung / khong gis thugs su rom gyi dmag gi thon khungs gnad don ni sa zhing gnad don dang 'brel ba shin tu che bar dgongs/ khong gi thugs su sa zhing bsgyur bcos kyi 'char gzhi 'ig gi myu gu 'bus pa'i thog zhing pa tshos kyang / khong gis dbul po'i ched du skad cha bshad pa dang don dag sgrub gnang dgos pa'i re ba bton/spyi lo sngon gyi 133lor rgya che ba'i mi cisgoraser dkyus ma dang dmag khongs nas phyir rtortsa /log pa'i dmag mi rgan pa/ 'khyam pa 'byor med pa tshos bkur zhus 'og thi sbi ru si ni dmangs srung dpon por bskos/rgyab skyor byed mkhan tshos rogs ram 'og tu khong gis sa zhing bsgyur bcos kyi khrims don gros gzhi zhig gi thog ma'i khi ru khu si phu nu gnyis/'char ga'i mdzad de/ sku drag phyug po tshos lhag par blangs pa'i rgyal dbang sa zhing gzhung bzhes brgyab te/ rgyal khab kyis sa rin ltar spyin tshab 'jal rjes/sa zhing dbul phongs spyi dmangs la sprod rgyu byas/ 'on kyang khrims do/ snas

gzhi 'jam po 'di la'ang sku drag rnying zhen pa tshos ngo rgol byas/ rang nyid kyi chab srid kyi 'dod tshul dril bsgrags bya phyir thi sbi khu si ni dus rgyun du 'og rim mi dmangs nang phebs nas rgya srang dang thang chen du yid dbang 'gug pa'i gsung bshad gnang bzhin 'dugasmyo i ṭa li ru 'khyam pa'i gcan gzan dang ri dwags la so sor nyal sa'i khung bu yod kyang / i ṭa li'i ched du 'thab 'dzing la zhugs pa'i mi rnams la nyi 'od dang mkha' dbugs las ci yang med/ khong tshor ngal gso dang nyal sa'i gnas mo med par/ bza' zla dang bu phrug khrid de la lung 'khyam dgos byung / spyi dpon du 'bod pa'i mi de tshos dmag mi tsho la mes po'i dur sa dang mchodakhang srung ba'i ched du 'thab dgos zhes skul slong byas kyang de ni rdzun gtamakho na yin te/ rgyu mtshan ni dmag mi gcig la yang rang gi mes po'i dur khang med/ kho tsho g.yul sar shi gson 'dzem med du 'thab pa ni phyug po rnams kyi 'byor ba dang dbang thang gi ched du red/ kho tshor 'dzam gling bdag po zhes 'bod kyang sa zhing tshun gang tsam yang med ces gsungs so//zhi dul yid 'gug gi skad cha 'di las rgya che ba'i mi ser dbul phongs rnams kyi sdug bsngal brjod yod pas/ nyan mkhan tshos mig la mchi ma 'khor bzhin thal mo brdab nas dga' bsu byas/ mang tshogs kyi spro sems 'khol ba'i rgyab skyor 'og tu/ thi sbi ru si'i drag skyod kyi jus gzhi zhig bton pa gsham ltar/ dang po khyim tshang gcig gis rgyal dbang sa zhing 'gru sge rum(/56077 7 ha lam spyi ching gcig gi bzhi cha'i gcig dang 'dra) 50)pas bdag tu gnyer mi chog pa dang bu phrug yod mkhan la phru gu re re la 'gyushe rum 250sgon dgos shing phru gu gnyis las brgal mi chog gnyis pa/grangs tshad las brgal ba'i sa zhing rgyal khab kyis blangs nas 'gru sge rum 30snroshā bgos nas zhing pa dbul por 'debs su 'jug dgos shing phyir

btsong mi chog gsum pa/ mi gsum u yon lhan khang zhig btsugs nas don 'dir 'gan 'khur dgos/ jus gzhi 'dis bran g.yog bdag po yongs kyi rgyang ring khe phan la srung skyong byas shing / khyim gzhi'i 'thor ba'i zhing ba la'ang sems gso tsam byas yod pa red/ yin na'ang jus gzhi 'dir spyi dmangs tshogs chen steng du brda thag gcod pa'i dus su rnying zhen sku drag tshos ngan slu byas pa'i dmangs skyob dpon po o tha lus si (ṣ+ṭhashā )yis mngon du dkrug cha brgyab te skad chen pos ngo rgol byas pa dang / sku drag tshos 'dems shogā 'then sa'i sgam chung brkus pas thabs zad de tshogs mtshams mi 'jog ka da sbyongs / 'du grol ba'i ring du thi sbi ru si yis o tha lus si la kha ta bslab bya gnang nas legs nyes thob shor shes su bcug pa dang / bsgyur bcos byas pa las a tha lus si la thebs pa'i god ka de rang nyid kyi rgyu nor gyis spyin tshab sprod rgyu byas rung a tha lus kyis dang len ma byas/ tshogs 'du slar tshogs pa dang thi sbi ru si yis spyi dmangs tshogs chen gyis brda thag ma bcad gong o tha lus si'i 'gro sdod ci byed kyi gnad don la gros mol byed dgos zhes dgongs 'char bton pa dang / brda thag bcad pa'i mjug 'bras la mi ser dkyus ma yis a tha lus si'i go gnas tsha len byas pa'i steng thi sbi ru si'i bton pa'i jus gzhi la yang gros 'chams byung ba red/ khong gi gyos po dang nu bo sge'u si khi ra khu si gsum gyis mi gsum u yon lhan khang btsugs shing / tshogs 'du grol ba dang thi sbi khu si ni spro sems 'khol ba'i mi ser dkyus ma chos dkyil du bskor nas phyir rang khyim du phebs so/yin na'ang 'thab rtsod ni mu mthun du mtshams ma chad par/ sa zhing chen po bzung ba'i sku drag tshos rang gi bzung ba'i sa zhing rgyal khab kyi ma yin par sger gyi yin zer nas yar mi sprod pa red/ sa zhing thob zin pa'i ༵༵ pa

la sa bon nyo spyad kyi dngul med pas/ srid gzhung la dngul bun gtong ba'i re ba zhus kyang / rgan gras gling gis de don mchog mchan ma bkod/ de'i thad du thi sbi ru si yis rgyal po'i sku gshegs ma thag gi rgyal po'i rgyal khab phar sga mon(2816870ba deng skabs thor khi'i yul khongs su yod pa)gyi rgyal mdzod yongs mi gsum u yon lhan khang la sprad de bkol spyod bya rgyu thag bcadacing / mi gsum u yon lhan khang gis hur brtson byas rkyen bsgyur bcos la'abras bu nges can thob/ —dmangasaspung dpon po bdam thon yong ba'i 'gran bsdur bya ba'i dus la nye ba dang / sku drag chen po rnams kyis thi sbi ru si la skur 'debs gang mngabyas nas/ thi sbi ru si yis rgyal po'i dbang cha 'phrog rgyu red ces dang / phar sga mon gyis kho la sku gshegs pa'i rgyal po'i cod pan dang gsol chas khyer yong zhes ku co brgyab/ kho tshos da dung bsam bzhin du bdam rtsod kyi dus tshod niston mjug nas zhing las la brel ba che ba'i dbyar kha la bsnur/ tha na thi sbi rtsasi lkog gsod gtong rgyu yang byas/ 'di thams cad la thi sbi ru si'i thugasakhral mi gnang thabs med byung / gal te rang nyid kyis las 'gan bsdungaṭa'adzin byed ma thub na/ gom mgo spos ma thag gi bsgyur bcos rkang rjes lanasub tsam du 'gyur pa ma zad/ khong nyid dang bsgyur bcos pa tsho'i tshe srog kyang 'chor nges pas khong slar yang bdam thon 'gran brtson la zhugs rgyuthugs zlo kā kā/ dgyi/ 133lo'i dmangs srang dpon po 'dems pa'i nyin desarom gyi lte gnas thang chen du mi ser glo stong 'dus nas thi sbi ru si'i gtababashad la nyan/ skabs der bsgyur bcos la dga' ba'i rgan gas sku drag cig mi tshogs las thi sbi ru sa'i mdun du 'ongs nas/ phyug po tshos drag dpungabasdi/sdu nas khyed rang gi srog 'phrog par yong bzhin 'dug pas myur du sa

sgrig gyis zhes bshad/ thi sbi ru si'i 'gram du langs pa'i mi rnams la khong khro rab tu 'bar nas lu ring yar brdzis nas mdung ring lag tu bzung ste dgra bor bsgugs/ yin na'ang rgyang ring du yod pa'i mi rnams kyis don ci byung ha ma go bar skad chen pos ci yin dris/ mi mang po'i 'ur sgra che ba dang thi sbi ru si yis thag ring sa'i mi'i mi go snyam nas mdzub mo mgo la btsugs nas rang gi tshe srog la nyen kha yod tshul bstan/ gnas 'dir 'dus pa'i thi sbi ru si la ngo rgol bgyi mkhan tshos thi sbi ru si yis rgyal po'i cod pan gyon nas rgyal por 'dug rtsis byas/ khos spyi mthun rgyal khab rtsa slog bgyi rgyu red ces 'ur cha bslangs/ nyes med nyes 'dogs kyi skad cha de rgan gras sku drag tsho'i rna bar thon pa dang mchod dpon ne+e si kha thon (༅0rdoṣ+ṭha)la khong khro me 'bar ba 'dra zhig skyes nas/ smyos pa bzhin du spyi mthun rgyal khab la srung skyob bgyi 'dod mkhan tsho bdag gi rjes su shog dang zhes skad brgyab pa dang lu ring gi thu ba lag tu bzung nas lte gnas thang chen du brgyugs pa dang / rnying zhen pa'i rgan gras skor zhig gis kyang lag tu dbyug pa dang shing leb bzung nas ne sikha thon gyi rjes su 'brangs nas brgyugs pas rdung res gsod res kyi 'go brtsamasdu/ sbi ru sis rang la rdung mkhan tsho thon pa mthong nas 'phral du phyir bros pa dang mdun gyi mi ro zhig la thogs nas sar 'gyel ba dang yar langs rtsis bgyi ba'i skabs mi zhig gis lag tu ong skyags kyi sug pa bzung nas shed gang yod kyis khong gi mgo la brgyab pa dang sprags mi mang pos dbyug pas brdungs nas tshe srog bcad/ya nga ba'i dmar 'dzing gsod res nang thi sbi ru si la rgyab skyor byed mkhan 38lhag gis tshe srog shor ba dang de dag gis ro yang the phe gtsang bo'i nang du bskyur/ yin na'ang mi dmangs mang tshogs ni rnying zhen pastu zlog

gnon la gnya' ma bsgur par mi ser dkyus ma'i sa zhing rtsod len gyi 'thab rtsod de mu mthud du je drag je ngar du song / rgan gras gling gis thi sbi ru si'i sa zhing gros gzhi de med par bzo ma phod pa dang / sa zhing u yon lha khang gtor ma phod mod/ rom dang rgyang ring sar song na rnyog dra mi yong bar dmigs nas sge'u si khi ra khu si ni sar den gling phran(581666batha 18)du nor don dpon por mngags/sge'u si khi ra khu si ni thi sbi ru si las lo9las chung ba dang gshes kur brel ba che la spro thung zhig yin pas khong gi phu bo dang 'dra ba'i zhi 'jam lhod po zhig min yang / khong la bla na med pa'i rtsod gling gi nus rtsal yod pas blo stobs dang dpa' ngar sgos stegs bu'i steng yar 'gro mar 'gro byas nas yud tsam zhi stod du sdod pa med/ shod rgyun la khong gis me lce lta bu'i gshes ka 'di khyad du gsod phyir/ g.yog po la sgra snyan zhig bzung nas rang gi rjes su 'brangs su bcug ste skad cha bshad skabs skad mgo mtho ba dang tshig rtsub por gyur dus sgra nyan gyi skud pa thengs gcig 'then nas skad cha 'jam po yin dgos pa'i brda rgyag tu bcug zer skad/ cis kyang khong yang khong gi phu bo ci bzhin gzhung drang zhing lugs mthun drang bzhag la mos pa zhig yin pas/sar den gling phran du las 'gan khur ba'i dus su mtshan snyan grags nyen rer je cher song / de'i phyir rgan gras gling gis khong la phrag dog byas nas yul de ru las 'gan 'khur ba'i dus yun je ring la btang nas phyir nom du yong mi thub pa byas/ sge'u si yis don de go rjes spyi lo sngon gyi 124lor khong khro'i ngang bka' gyen ldog byas nas phyir rom du phebs nas sku drag dbang chen tsho'i lkog g.yo ngan jus ther 'don byas pa dang dmangs srung dpon po'i bdam thon 'gran rtsod la zhugs nas/ phu bo lags kyis ma 'grub pa'i las don mu mthud du /12 rgyu thugs thag bcad/

don de kun du khyab pas mang tshogs kyis ngar nyams che ru 'phel ba dang 'dems bsko byed pa'i nyin der mi ser rnams phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas klad bkab med pa'i thang chen du 'ongs pas ga sa gar mi yis khengs pas zing zing long long gi tshul du mngon/ mi la la khang pa'i thog tu langs pa dang la la mda' g.yab la 'byar nas bsdad 'dug 'dems bskos mtha' 'bras kā sge'u si la bar chad med par spyi lo sngon gyi 123lo'i dmangs srung dpon ra ba/zlo sdu /yis las 'gan khur rjes bsgyur bcos kyi gros gzhi rab dang rim pa bton zhing / de'i snying don ni sngar bzhin du sa zhing gi gnad don yin zhing de la rgya che ba dang gting zab pa'i chab srid kyi don snying yod/ khong gis dang po la 'bru rigs kyi bca' khrims bton nas/ rgyal khab kyis 'bru rigs rin gong dma' mor nom gyi dbul po btsong dgos/ gnyis pa 'dri gcod bca' khrims bton nas/ rgan gras gling gi lag nas 'dri gcod kyi dbang cha 'phrog ste gsar thon tshong pa phyug po'i skya mi yi lag tu sprad/gsum pa zhing chen gyi bca' khrims bton nas/ a she ya zhing chen(phar sga mon 90268sku0ba 8109)gyi dpya khral gyi yong 'bab skya mi la 'gan gtsang len byed du 'jug dgos/ bzhi ba dmag don bca' khrims bton nas lo 17ma thon pa'i skyes pa'i spyi dmangs dmag la gtan nas zhugs mi chog pa dang / rgyal khab kyis 'thab mo ba la gyon pa dang go cha 'don sprod byas nas/dmag gi yong khungs khag theg byas nas dmag don gyi stobs shugs la shugs snod rgyag dgos/ lnga ba ni lam bzo ba'i bca' khrims bton nas i ṭa li mnga'akhongs nang rgya chen por lam bzo ba dang lam bzo bzo ba la gla phog ster dgos/ de lta byas tshe sa khul so so'i 'brel gtug la shugs snon dang /dpal 'byor gyi 'phel rgyas la skul 'ded byas pa dang chabs cig tu bzlo spyan

'gan len byas pa'i skya mi dang dbul po rnams la las ka sgrub pa'i go skabs mkho sprod byas/ sge'u si yi bsgyur bcos khrims don gros gzhi la rgya che ba'i mi ser dang skya mi/ 'thab mo ba tshos rgyab skyor byas pas khong gi mtshan snyan grags lhag tu je cher song la dbang cha yang je cher song / spyi lo sngon gyi 122lor khong yang bskyar dmangs srung dpon por bdams/ gom gang mdun spos sgos sa zhing gi gnad don thag gcod bgyi ched sge'u si yis yul gsum du gnas spor yul khongs 'dzugs rgyu'i 'char gzhi bton nas/ yul gnyis i ṭa li yi rang khongs su 'dzugs pa dang yul gcig a h+phe ri kha gling chen gyi khar ṭha sgo yi shul du 'dzugs rgyu byas/ gzhan yang khong gis i ṭa li yi sdod dmangs la rom spyi dmangs kyi dbang cha yod pa byas nas rom spyi dmangs dang i ṭa li rang dbang dmangs gnyis bar gyi 'gal ba zhib bar gtong ba'i dgongs 'char bton/ sge'u si yis khrims don gros gzhi bton pas sku drag rnying zhen pa tsho ma rangs par khong rang de tsho'i dgra bor gyur/ kho tshos g.yo zol thabs ngan sna tshogs spyad de mi ser la slu brud btang nas bsgyur bcos la gtor brlag byas/sge'u si yis i ṭa li yi mi ser la spyi dmangs kyi dbang cha ster rgyu'i dgongs 'char la rgan gras phyogs khag gi ngo rgol drag po byas pa ma zad/ da dung i ṭa li yi mi la dbang cha ster 'dod med pa'i mi ser rnams kyis kyang ngo rgol byas/gon gras phyogs khag gis i ṭa li yi mi ser rang yul la bral 'dod med pa'i sems khams spyad de dmangs srung dpon po gzhan pa le we sde ru su'u (lto cho smo)la i ṭa li ru gnas spor yul khongs 12'dzug sa rgyu'i bsam 'char 'don du bcug de ni mi sems slu ba'i rdzun gtam yin rung dngos don gyi ha ma go ba'i mi ser rnams kyis bden du brtsis nas sge'u si yi 'char gzhi la kha ya ༵ sdus/ rim bzhin du sge'u si ni kher rkyang du lus pas spyi lo sngon gyi

121lo'i dmangs srung dpon por 'dems ma thub pas/ skabs der sku drag rdolha kyang da nā dus la bab song zer nas sge'u si la mngon sum 'dzem med du la spyo ༵ sngon// gyi 121lo'i lo 'gro'i nyin zhig mchod 'bul cho ga zhig gi steng rnying zhen pa'i rgyug khyi zhig gis mchod stegs steng gi mchod rdzas blangs nas bsnyad rko ba'i ngang gtor brlag pa tsho phar song / mi gzhung drang tsho la lam gzur zhes skad ngan brgyab/ sge'u si yi rgyab skyor pa tshor khong khro rab tu skyes nas phar mchong nas phan tshun rdung res dang rgyag res byas te rgyug khyi de'i mug srog blangs/ rnying zhen pas shi bor dgra sha rtsod dgos zhes par kha g.yar nas sgrog tse dang rkub skyags phar g.yug nas dmar 'dzing bgyi rgyu sta gon byas pa'i tshe la/ gnam nas 'brug sgra ldi ri ri grags pa dang char ba chen po drag tu bab pas 'khrug rtsod de'i mtshams bcad/phyi nyin snga dro rgan gras gling gis brel myur tshogs 'du bsdus nas sge'u si sogs ni spyi'i dgra bo red ces khyab bsgrags byas pa dang / grong khyer yongs nyen zon do dam byas/ kho pa tshos spyi lo sngon gyi 133lo'i rtsub spyod de slar yang bkol nas drag shugs spyod rgyu byas/ sge'u si la mi rnams kyis kha ta byas nas khong gi lag rogs pa las mi ser gyi drag dpung zhig 'dzugs rgyu'i re ba bton par thugs 'thad byung nas a h+phen then (༅01)ri sgang bzung na'ang /khong gis gros gleng tshogs chen brgyud de khrims dang mthun pa'i sgos dgra bo las rgyal dgos snyam nas mi mngags te rgan gras gling dang gros mol byed du bcug yin na'ang snir thob pa'i lan ni bsgyur bcos pas nges par du mgo bsgur dgos zhes pa red/ cung ma 'gor bar rnying zhen pa'i drag dpung gis char bab pa 'dra ba'i mda' mo'i 'gebs srung 'og a h+phen then ri sgang la rgol du brgyugs/ bsgyur bcos pa'i drag dpung mgyogs por med du bzodri sang

sge'u si ni 'thab zhor bshol zhor du bran g.yog gcig khrid nas the phe gtsang bo'igayas 'gram gyi nags tshal nang bros/ ra mda' slebs la khad du khong gis bran g.yog de la rang gi srog len dgos pa'i bka' babs pa dang bran g.yog gis dang len byas rjes rang srog bcad/ khrag dri bro ba'i char rlung 'di'i nang bsgyur bcos pa 307lhag dmar gsod btang bas/ sa zhing rtsodalen gyi bsgyur bcos las 'gul 'di la de bzhin rnying zhen sku drag tshos drag gnod byas pa red/khi ra khu si phu nu gnyis kyi bsgyur bcos ni mthar thug skyo gdung khrod mjug bsgril pa dang / de'i rgyu mtshan ni bran g.yog lam lugs cha tshang du rgyas pa dang dngul lor skyed lci'i bu lon bya 'gul drag tu 'phel ba'i cha rkyen 'og zhing chung gyes bral dang nyams dpus su 'gro ba ni rang shugs su 'byung ba'i 'gro phyogs yin la/ sa zhing chung ngu dbang ba'i lam lugs slar gso dang sngar mus 'jog rgyu ni stong bsam kho na yin pas yin la/ skabs de'i gral rim stobs shugs kyi bsdur tshad kyang bsgyur bcos pa zhan pas kyang red/'on kyang chab srid bsgyur bcos mkhan khi ra khu si phu nu gnyis kyis mi ser dkyus ma'i phyir du sa zhing chen po dbang mkhan tsho la rdung deg byed phod pa dang las don de'i ched rin thang bral ba'i na chung gi tshe srog kyang phul bas/khong gnyis kyi dpa' bo'i mdzad rjes dang 'thab rtsod snying stobs la rjes rabs pa tshos dad gus byed dgos pa red/ rom gyi mi dmangs kyis khi ra khu si phu nu gnyis la 'dra sku bzos nas mig rgyag che ba'i sar bzhengs te/ mi rnams la mjal ba dang mchod 'bul byas te sems gting nas rjes dran byed du bcug go/ ri 346

'dzing res sda si phar nga khu si/krang kong wu'u/khi ra khu si phu nu gnyis kyi bsgyur bcos las 'gul pham rjes/ rom gyi spyi tshogs kyi 'gal ba sna tshogs mu mthud du je drag tu gyur/ bran g.yog je mang du song ba'i steng khyim gzhi 'thor pa'i zhing pa yang je mang je mang du song /i ṭa li yongs su bran g.yog bdag por sdang sems thal drag tu skyes pa dang thug pa tsam la 'thab pa'i stobs shugs shugs su bsags yod/ spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs dang po'i lo rabs70par/ rom gyi lo rgyus steng rgya ches che ba'i bran g.yog gi 'os langs byung / 'os langs kyi gtso 'dzin ni si phar tha khu si(594 753lo༅lha spyi lo sngon gyi1 4sngon gyi11lo'i bar)yin pas de la si phar tha khu si 'os langs zer/ 'os langs dmag gis i ṭa li'i mnga' khongs su lho 'dul byang 'thab byas nas rom gyi bran g.yog bdag po'i dbang sgyur la rdung deg drag po byas pas dga' skyo gnyis ldan gyi 'thab 'dzing lo rgyus gang mang zhig byung ngo //si phar tha khu si ni rdzi re si(16770 677)yi mi yin la/ nom btsan 'dzul pa la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab 'dzing zhig gi nang rom gyi dmag gis 'dzin bzung byas nas bran g.yog tu btsong / khong thengs du mar lcags sgrog las thar nas bros na'ang yang bskyar bzung nas phyir khrid/ mjug mtharaban g.yog bdag pos g.yung du mi 'bab 7pa'i bran g.yog nā /ma

grong khyer lho phyogs kyi kha phu a((895775r+sā༅)yi 'dzing res pa'i slob grwar khrid de 'dzing res pa byed du bcuga'adzing res ni rom bran bdag sku drag tsho'i gcan gzan lta bu'i dmar dga'i 'dod jam tshim ched kyi rol rtsed cig red/ bran bdag sku drag chosazhe rol rtsed de la ched du ltad mo pa khri phrag du ma shong ba'i 'dzing res bya ra bskrun yod cing de'i nang du bran bdag sku drag tshos btsan shed kyis 'dzing res byed mkhan bran g.yog tshor glo gri dang ral gri mdung mo rtse gsum sogs lag tu thogs nas phan tshun dmar 'dzing byed du 'jug la/ tha na bran g.yog dang gcan gzan gtum po 'dzing res byed du bcug nas dga' po skyid po byed/ 'dzing res pa'i slob grwa ni skabs de'i rom gyi ched du 'dzing res bran g.yog sbyong brdar bgyi sa yin zhing do dam la'ang gdug rtsub dang gtum drag gis khengs 'dug 'dzing res bran g.yog tsho sbyong brdar byas tshar rjes rom sogs grong khyer chen po'i rtsal 'gran ra bar khrid nas dmar 'dzing byed du bcug ste brag bdag tsho'i rtsed chas su gyur/kha phu a yi 'dzing res pa'i slob grwa ni rtsal 'gran sa chen po so sor 'dzing res pa 'don sprod byed pa'i slob grwa gtso bo yin zhing de'i nang du nam rgyun rgyal khongs gzhan gyi mi ste rdzi re si'i mi dang sge li'i mi/ li sgu ri a(21650 chis/lhatsho༅)yi mi dang khel thi si'i(261 cu po )mi sogs yod/ 'dzing res pa tsho'i mthun sgril la gtor brlag bya ched g.yo sgyu can gyi bran bdag tshos bsam bzhin du tsho ba mi gcig pa'i 'dzing res pa'i bar dmar 'dzing bgyi ru bcug nas de tsho'i bar dkrug shing rgyag pa red/ si phar tha khu si yis 'dzing res pa'i slob grwa'i nang du khyad par can gyi mi mgo bsdu ba'i nus rtsal spyad nas/ rgyun 'khyongs lhod med du bran g.yog tsho'i khrod du gaXdī zlo'i 'brel gtug dang dril bsgrag skul 'ded byas te/ khong gis rang

dbang chen du g.yul rar rang srog gtong ba las/ dgra bo'i rol rtsed kyi ched du dmar 'dzing ra bar 'chi rgyu min zhes gsungs pas na/ khong gi 'bod skul de la rdzi re si'i mi yi rgyab skyor thob pa ma zad/ sge li'i mi sogs mi rigs gzhan gyis kyang de la blo thag rbad bcad kyi rgyab skyob byas/ dus nges can zhi/ la gra sgrig byas mthar 'os langs byed pa'i rtsa ba'i mthun rkyen yongs su 'a mazlo/ lo sngon gyi75lor rom gyi rgyal khongs kyi sa khul so sor mu ge byung nas spyi lo sngon gyi73lo'i bar mtshams ma chad cing / skabs de ni rom la phyi'i dmag 'khrug khrod dka' khag chen por 'phrad pa'i dus kyang red/ si phar tha khu si dang khong gi 'thab grogs tshos rang la phan pa'i dus skabs der bstun nas 'os langs grabs gshom byas rung / gsang ba phyir shor bas dus bkag gi sngon du 'os langs bya rgyu thag bcad byas/spyi lo sngon gyi73lo'i nyin zhig tu/ si phar tha khu si yis 'go khrid de 'dzing res pa bdun cu don brgyad kyis sne rtse rno ba'i dbyug pa dang tshod grikha dbrag sogs lag tu bzung nas khong tshor lta rtog byed mkhan gyi bran bdag dang srung dmag bsad rjes/ kha phu a yi 'dzing res pa'i slob grwa'i phyi ru brgyugs/ lam bar du 'dzing res pa'i slob grwa zhig gi skyel 'dren ru khag gi lag nas lag cha 'phrog ste rang tshor drag chas spras rjes thad gar le bar bcu phrag 'ga' yi phan gyi li su we ri bo'i phyogs su bskyod pas/ zil shugs nom yongs la khyab pa'i bran g.yog 'os langs ni de bzhin du 'go brtsams so/i ṭa li lho khul gyi wi su we ri bo ni mtho tshad la mtsho ngos las smi 1270yod cing ri ldebs su nags tshal chung chung dang rgyan 'brum gyi ra bas gang zhing mtha' 'khor du g.yang gzar mthon pos bskor bas 'jogs thabs bral ba zhig red/ ri bab shin tu btsan zhing ri rtser bgrod pa'i lam ༵ /ga

kyog gi kher lam gcig las med/ yodapa' bo gcig gis btsan 'gag srung gyur na/ dpa' bo khri yis rgol yang gtor dka'o zhes pa'i dpe bzhin gyi rang byung btsan rdzong zhig red/ si phar tha khu si dang khong gi 'thab grogs tshos ri de ru dmag sgar btsugs nas 'phral du dmag sbyong byed pa'i 'go bcoms/ khi re khi si (222lo)dang en nu ma i (6767)gnyis ni si phar tha khu si yi lag 'og gi dmag dpon byas/ kho tshos rgyun chad med par ri rtsar song nas bran bdag gi gzhis ka la 'jab rgol byas nas dmag rgyags blangs pa dang dus mtshungs su dmag 'khrug la sta gon gang legs byas nas tshur rgol pa tsho rdul du brlag par btsams/ si phar tha khu si yis bsgron pa'i 'os langs kyi me lce 'dis mun nag can gyi rom la 'od gsal sbyin pa dang 'dra ba'i rnam pa byung bas/ bran g.yog mang po dang khyim gzhi shor ba'i zhing pa tshos gnas tshul de go nas phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas 'ongs te 'os langs su zhugs pa dang / de'i nang da dung bud med mi nyung ba zhig yod/'os langs kyi dpung sde yang mi grangs 10000tsam la 'phel/ gna' rabs rom gyi skabs su bran g.yog bros byol byas pa ni rgyun mthong gi don zhig yin stabs/ si phar tha khu sis 'os langs byas par dang thog nom srid gzhung gis mthong chen ma byas mod/ 'on kyang 'os langs dmag dpung gi dpung rgya mu mthud du je cher song ba dang 'os langs pas 'thab jus phyogs 'gog srung mi byed par phar rgol byed pa'i 'go brtsams pa nas bzung / rom gyi rgan gras gling la 'tshab cha langs pas myur du khe ro sde'u si (marma'i lo)la dmag 30)nyikhridanas blu su we ri la dmag drangs nas ri mgor 'gro sa'i ter lam bcad de 'os langs dmag dpung ri rtser ltogs skom gyis gsod pa'i re ngan bcangs/35/ pha thar khu si yis 'tham mo ba rnams la dpa' bo 'thab nas 'chi ba

las/ ltogs shi gtan nas rgyag rgyu min mi zhes 'bod skul btang ste/ 'os langs pa tshos dpa' ngar cher skyed dang jus shugs mnyam 'don byas nas dgra dmag gis bskor ba las thar ba'i byed thabs btsal ba dang / mthar thug dgras bskor ba las thar ba'i thabs shes mtshar po zhig rnyed de/ si phar tha khu si yis 'thab mo ba tsho ri ngos nas ri skyes rgun 'brum gyi 'khri shing bsgrug tu bcug nas skas mnyen mo bzos nas g.yang gzar ngos nas mar 'phangs padang mun pa 'thibs pa'i mtshan mo zhig tu dal mor mar brag rtsar babs nas dgra bo'i rgyab phyogs su song ste glo bur du drag rgol byas pas rom gyi dmag mi tshor mgo 'thoms klad yom bskor ba dang kha 'thor sna 'thor du btang / dgra dpon khe ro sde'u si de zang zing khrod 'tshab 'tshub por rta sga med cig gi rgyab la mchongs nas phyir bros brgyab/dmag 'khrug dang por rgyal kha blangs pa des 'os langs pa tsho'i dpa' sems che ru bskyed cing dpung sde yang je cher song bas kham phe ne a (tshimatha༅)thang chen yongs phal cher dbang du bsdus/'jigs skrag gi bla 'dar bzhin pa'i nom gyi rgan gras gling gis slar yangakhrims 'dzin mkhan phu sbru re wa lon ne+e (077/ gro tsho)la dmag 12000lhag khrid nas 'os langs pa'i dmag dpung 'gog tu mngags/ si phar tha khu si ni nyen khar 'phrad kyang brel 'tshab med par dpa' ngar dang blo gros kyis wa lon ne yi dmag gi tshur rgol rdul du brlag yin na'ang / wa lo ne yis sems ma shi bar kyag kyog bgrod dka' la sa stong lung stong gi ri sul zhig tu 'os langs dmag dpung bskor na'ang / blo rig ldan pa'i 'os langs dmag gis thar thabs mkhas po zhig rnyed de/ dgra bo'i shul du dor pa'i mi ro shing sdong steng bcings nas so pa'i tshul du yar bslangs rjes me phung bsgron pa dang dmag dung 'bud mkhan gcig shul tu bzhag nas dus tsho15 sbyor

khul du 'gal ba byung / 'os langs pa tsho ni spyi tshogs kyi khongs mi 'dra ba mang po nas 'ongs pas so so'i 'dod mos kyang mi 'dra pas 'thab jus bkod sgrig la bsam 'char mi 'dra ba mang po byung / si phar tha khu si gtso byas pa'i rgyal khongs gzhan gyi bran g.yog tshos skabs de'i nom spyi mthun rgyal khab ni dmag don phyogs rgyal khab chen po zhig yin pas phan tshun stobs shugs bsdur pas na 'os langs dmag de la mi do stabs byang phyogs su bskyod de al phe si ri bor brgal nas rom gyi dbang sgyur las thar thabs bgyi dgos pa'i bsam 'char bton zhing / khi re si khe'i gtso byas pa'i khyim shor zhing pa mang che ba ni sa skye rdo skye'i i ṭa li'i mi yin pas/ khong tshos mu mthud du rom gyi dmag dpung la 'thab pa'i re ba che bas/ mthar thug khe ri si khi yis mi 100)nyitsam khrid nas dmag dpung gtso bo dang kha bral ba dang a thu ri a'i kha rgan sge'u a zhes pa'i ri bo ru pho bho li kho ra'i dmag dpung gis rtsa med du btang / khi re sakhi dang dmag dpon gzhan en nu ma e zhes pa gnyis kyang dmag 'khrug khrod rang srog shor/ si phar tha khu si der dmag rogs su yong snyam mod yong khom ma byin/ nang khul kha gyes su song ba des 'os langs dmag la chag sgo chen po byung zhing / dpa' bo 'das pa rnams la 'dun mchod byas rjes si phar tha khu si ni mu mthud du byang phyogs su bskyod/spyi lo sngon gyi72lor 'os langs dmag gis pho sgo li kho ra dang len thu ra si gnyis kyi dmag dpung tshogs skor chen po gnyis dang / ri'i lho phyogs kyi sge li'i tsong tu'u yis khrid pa'i rom gyi dmag rdul du brlag ste dgra bos mtha' bskor dang rjes 'ded/ sngon bkag dkyil gcod byed pa bcas las thar nas grong khyer smo thi na (cha smo6)blangs te rgyal kha'i ngang sda sbo ( 77)chubo'i bzhur rgyud du phebs/ skabs der 'os langs dmag gi mi grangs ni 120000lhag la thon zhing / rom spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi lho phyogs ༵ /sa

tsho tsho rig/ri / gong7 7 lnge 74dā —mo ———g.yul ngor 'jug bzhin pa'i si phar tha khu si/langs kyi me lce sbar ba red/ rgyal kha thob pa'i spobs sems kyis skul 'ded 'og 'os langs pa mang po zhig gis sngar gyi 'char gzhi bsgyur nas phyir lho /snye lha// :dozerdo 11 ste) thesko the / sar1rdo /nya casags su da ma nga ra la la da sa pa' ba ba na/ phar tha khu si yis kyang mu mthun du byang phyogs su song pas na/ mi 'bum phrag cig brjid chags gnam du zug pa'i al phe si ri bor brgal rgyu ni de 'dra'i sla mo zhig min par dgongs nas/ 'os langs mkhan tsho'i bsam 'char dang du blangs te/ al phe si ri bo mi brgal bar phyir lho phyogs su dmag skyod byed rgyu thag bcad do//'os langs dmag ni slar yang a sdi re thi khi(4607 10 ༅ ༅༅)rgya mtsho'i 'gram ngogs su thon pa dang / rom gyi dbang sgyur pa tsho si phar tha khu si'i zil shugs kyis spa skung bar btang pas/ myur du rgyal khab kyi gnas tshul dza drag can du gyur pa khyab bsgrags byas rung sus kyang dmag spyi'i 'gan len ma thub par lus/ mthar thug cis kyang ming la khi ra su si (581053354

zhed snang ci yang ster ma thub/ si phar tha khu si yis rlung dang char ba che ba'i mtshan mo zhig la dmag dpung khrid nas 'obs dung la sa 'dam dang shing gi yal gas kha gsab khod snyoms byas nas phar brgal te/ glo bur du dgra bos bkag bcad byas sar drag rgol byas rjes a sde re thi khi mtsho 'gram gyi sbu ru i thi (lko cha)grong khyer gyi phyogs su bskyod de/ rgya mtshor brgal nas shar phyogs la bskyod rgyu dang mthar thug rang rang gi pha yul du log rgyur gra sgrig byas/ gnad 'gag gi skabs der 'os langs dmag gi nang khul du kha bral gyi gnas tshul thengs gnyis pa byung / 'os langs dmag khag cig si phar tha khu si'i rjes 'brangs nas sbu ru thi i la 'gro 'dod med par/ kho rang tsho rang 'dod du gtso shugs dmag dpung dang kha bral nas kher rkyang du g.yul ngor zhugs pas/ 'phral ma nyid du rom gyi dmag gis rtsa med du btang / de las kyang tshabs che ba zhig la shar phyogs las 'ongs pa'i rom gyi dmag dpung zhig gis si phar tha khu si'i sngon du sbu ru thi i blangs pa dang / khi ra khu si la'ang se phan nas phyir thon pa'i pham phe'u si((thabarngu53 2079103 506053 27)yi dmag rogs byas rkyen/ 'os langs dmag dpung mdun rgyab gnyis ka dgra bos bzung ba'i nyen gnas su lhung bas/ si phar tha khu sis kyang da ni mthar thug gi dmar 'khrug mi byed ka med yin pa mkhyen no//spyi lo sngon gyi71lo'i dpyid kur 'os langs dmag dang khi ra khu si'i rom gyi dmag dpung gnyis kyis sbu ru thi i gru kha'i nye 'gram gyi a phu ri a ru rgyal pham thag gcod kyi g.yul chen po bshams/ bran g.yog tsho srog la ma 'dzems par dpa' ngar sgos 'thab 'dzing la zhugs pa dang si phar tha khu si yang g.yul ngo'i ches mdun ngos su rta mchog rgyab tu zhon nas ral gri dgung la 'phyar nas bgā/sdu te khi ra khu si gsod dgos snyam kyang gte bo de lag tu ma rnyed par

nom gyi ngamag dpon gnyis dang dmag mi du ma bsad/ si phar tha khu si dgra dmag dang drag por dmar 'dzing byed pa'i skabs der rom gyi ming la h+pho ri khi lazer pa'i dmag dpon zhig gis khong la rgyab phyogs nas glo bur du mdung gis bsnun pas si phar tha khu si'i bla la rmas phog nas rta gong nas sar lhung /khong gi 'thab mo ba tshos tshul de mthong nas 'phral ma nyid du phyogs der brgyugs nas rang srog la ma 'dzems par si phar tha khu si bskyabs/ 'thab mo ba zhig gis rta zhig khrid 'ongs nas khyed nyid rta la zhon nas mgyogs por nyen gnas 'di las 'bral dgos zhes zhu ba byas kyang si phar tha khu sis rang nyid dang mnyam shi mnyam gson gyi 'thab grogs tshor gzigs zhor du sems gting la tshor snang zab mo du ma skyes nas 'thab grogs tsho dang kha 'bral 'dod gtan nas ma yod par skad mthon pos gal te dmag 'khrug 'di la rgyal kha thob na nga tsho'i dgra bo'i lag nas dmag rta lon nges te/ gal srid dmag 'khrug 'di'i nang pham kha zos na dmag rta 'di yi ci byed ces gsungs nas ral gris bsnun nas dmag rta bsad/rom gyi dmag ni rgya mtsho 'phyur ba bzhin tshur blugs pa dang si phar tha khu si la'ang rmas chen po phog pas rkang pa gcig gi mgor langs nas lag pa gcig gis phur sgor zhig bzung nas rang lus srung zhing lag pa cig shos kyis gri thung zhig bzung nas mu mthud du dgra bo dang dmar 'thab byas mthar dpa' ngar ngang rang srog blos btang ngo // khong gi dpa' bo'i snying stobs de la pha rol pa chos kyang khas mi len ka med byung / rom gyi dmag mi cig gis kyang g.yul gyi ches mdun phyogs su dpa' ngar ngang 'thab 'dzing bgyi bzhin pa'i si phar tha khu si ni/ khong gi blo rig dang thabs rtsal de ches phul du byung ba'i dmag spyi dang phal lam 'dra ba'i skabs der rang srog shor zhes zer skad/ 357

si phar tha khu si'i yi 'os langs de bzhin du pham / 'os langs de ni rom gyi bran bdag lam lugs ches dar ba'i dus su byung la/ lo rgyus cha rkyen gyi bkag rgya thebs pas 'os langs dmag gis bran g.yog dang zhing ba'i gsar brje'i dmigs yul gcig gyur du gtong ma thub pas/ 'os langs pa'i stobs shugs gcig tu sgril ma thub pa ni thos langs pham pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo yin no// yin na'ang si phar tha khu si'i 'os langs kyi ri klung khyur mid gtong thub pa'i snying stobs des gna' rabs rom la g.yo 'gul drag po btang bas rom gyi dpal 'byor dang spyi tshogs lam lugs la 'gyur ldog chen po byung du bcug si phar tha khu si yis 'os langs khrod mngon pa'i dpa' bo'i snying stobs dang dmag don bkod 'doms kyi blo gros kyis lo ngo nyis stong lhag gi ring gnya' gnon myong ba'i mi dmangs kyis rang nyid bcings 'grol bgyi ba'i 'thab rtsod kyi blo stobs la skul 'ded byed bzhin yod/ mar khe si yisatsa gna' rabs 'byor med gral rim kyi 'thus tshab dngos ma red ces bstod bsngagasabyas shing / len nying gis kyang si phar tha khu si ni phal lam lo ngo nyis stong sngon gyi bran g.yog 'os langs ches che shos nang gi ches rmad du byung ba'i dpa' bo zhig red ces bsngags brjod gnang ngo //358
